jobs.title: Digital Applications Manager
jobs.location: Owens Cross Roads, AL, United States
jobs.description:
Position Summary

This role leads the Applications Center of Excellence in Huntsville, the team responsible for evaluating the integration and performance of inkjet print-engine components and systems for OEM customers. The position provides the team's technical leadership and quality oversight; develops and supervises engineers, chemists, technicians, and data scientists; and manages its programs, laboratory operations, and operating budget. Reports to the Director of Applications; supervises the Applications Center of Excellence team and works with OEM customers’ engineering teams.

As the Digital Applications Manager, you will be responsible to:

• Technical LeadershipReviews and approves technical reports and feasibility conclusions before release.Serves as the technical escalation point for complex investigations and root-cause analysis.Guides the scoping and design of feasibility and characterization programs.Maintains the group’s technical standards, methods and competency framework together with the Principal Applications Engineer.
• Team Leadership and DevelopmentHires, onboards and sets expectations for team members.Coaches and develops each team member through development plans, regular feedback and appropriate delegation.Conducts performance reviews and prepares promotion recommendations in coordination with the Director and Human Resources.Plans cross-training so that critical methods and knowledge are shared across the team.
• Program and Resource ManagementPlans, prioritizes and schedules the program portfolio across customer and internal requests.Assigns work, balances capacity and raises risks to commitments early, with options.Tracks and reports the team’s throughput, quality and program status.
• Customer and Business EngagementLeads the team’s technical engagement with OEM customers’ engineers through program meetings, findings and reports.Presents the team’s findings and capabilities to customers and internal partners in clear, practical terms.Identifies and evaluates technical opportunities for the group.
• Laboratory and BudgetManages laboratory operations: safety, equipment readiness, calibration and supplies.Manages the operating budget and prepares business cases for equipment and staffing investments.

To perform your job as expected, you will be required to have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Engineering, Materials Science, Physics or related field from a 4-year college or university strongly preferred.
• 8+ years related experience in inkjet applications or related field, including leading customer-facing technical programs and development of others.
• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office - Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
• Must be available and willing to travel

We offer a competitive salary with excellent benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, pet insurance, HSA and FSA, 401(k), and more. Through our programs, which now include Paid Volunteer Time Off and Paid Parental Leave, we support the needs of our employees, their dependents, and their communities by providing a benefit package that is easy to understand, easy to access, and affordable for all our employees.

Don’t just choose a job; choose a career that emphasizes employee growth in a safe, environmentally conscious culture.   Embark on your Colorful Career with us!

We require post-offer, pre-employment drug screens, physicals, and background checks.

Equal Opportunity Employer: disability/veteran.

jobs.title: Facility Technician
jobs.description:
Good with tools? Like figuring out why things aren’t working?

Are you the person people call when a door won’t close, a tap starts dripping or a flat-pack desk needs putting together? Put those practical skills to work helping us keep our buildings running smoothly.

If you’ve picked up practical skills through DIY, a course or by helping friends and family, we would like to hear from you.

What you’ll do

• Fix the everyday stuff. Adjust doors and windows, tighten loose fittings, sort out minor plumbing issues and assemble or repair furniture.
• Keep the building running. Carry out routine checks, replace light bulbs, and handle basic electrical work within your training. Work out when a fault needs a qualified electrician.
• Look after heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC). Carry out basic HVAC maintenance and minor repairs, including replacing filters, and flag issues that need a specialist.
• Keep the workplace in good shape. Patch small holes, touch up paint and help move furniture, supplies or equipment where they’re needed.
• Get repairs sorted. Respond promptly to emergencies and urgent issues such as leaks, help make the area safe and follow up on repairs. Show contractors where they need to work and check in while they’re on site.

What you’ll bring

• You’re comfortable using basic hand tools and enjoy working out how to fix things.
• You take care of your tools and equipment, finish jobs properly and let the team know when something needs more attention.
• You work well with others, can communicate in English and are comfortable with the basics of Word and Excel.
• You are comfortable responding quickly to emergencies and urgent issues.

Sound like you? Apply and tell us about something you’ve fixed, built, or maintained. It can be as simple as getting a stubborn door to close properly. We’d love to hear how you did it.

• Competitive remuneration package
• Comprehensive training
• Professional and personal development
• Health insurance
• Dynamic working environment
• Gym membership
• Outstanding experience in an international environment

jobs.title: Staff Backend AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Backend AI Platform Engineer to lead the development of core backend services powering our Agentic AI Platform. In this role, you will be the primary technical driver for building reasoning-driven agents, multi-agent orchestration, and outcome-based workflows.

You will collaborate with the Principal AI Architect to bridge the gap between high-level design and scalable implementation. You will own the development of high-performance APIs and orchestration runtimes, integrating frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith. This role is highly hands-on and requires a technical leader who can navigate a fast-paced environment while maintaining high engineering standards.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Backend Development

• Lead Implementation: Act as the lead engineer for agent runtime orchestration services, focusing on reasoning, planning, and tool invocation.
• API & SDK Design: Own the development of robust APIs and SDKs that enable internal and external teams to build and deploy agent workflows.
• State & Memory Management: Build and optimize stateful dialog management and memory services for multi-turn, context-aware agents.
• Agent Communication: Implement multi-agent communication (A2A) protocols and shared context systems.

System Architecture & Execution

• Microservices Leadership: Execute the transition to cloud-native, event-driven backend services using microservices or service mesh architectures.
• Workflow Design: Build and manage task scheduling and long-running operations using tools like Temporal or Airflow.
• Performance Optimization: Optimize LLM orchestration for performance and cost through caching, batching, and token monitoring.

Integrations & Data Services

• Data Pipeline Ownership: Implement and maintain RAG pipelines and integrations with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS).
• Telemetry Integration: Ensure all backend services support LangSmith-based evaluation and comprehensive observability.

Security & Reliability

• Tenant Isolation: Implement RBAC, API authentication, and multi-tenant isolation logic.
• Engineering Excellence: Set the standard for automated testing (unit, integration, load) and implement OpenTelemetry for full system visibility.
• Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and code reviews for more junior backend engineers on the team.

Required Qualifications:

• 6+ years of backend engineering experience.
• 1-2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML platform development.
• Expert Proficiency: Strong programming skills in Java and Python.
• Framework Expertise: Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or LangSmith.
• Distributed Systems: Deep understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, and Kubernetes.
• Cloud & Data: Solid experience with AWS, Terraform, and a mix of relational (PostgreSQL) and Vector databases.
• Orchestration: Practical experience with workflow engines like Temporal or Airflow and messaging systems like Kafka.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with AI-driven planning systems or dialog state tracking.
• Background in enterprise security (RBAC, SSO, OAuth2).
• Experience working in a high-growth SaaS or startup environment.
• Active contributions to open-source backend or AI frameworks.

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Application Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Staff or Senior Staff Applications Engineer to provide technical leadership in the definition, development, evaluation, and customer deployment of advanced power-management ICs.

This role works across the complete product lifecycle, from customer requirements and architecture definition through silicon evaluation, system optimization, customer design-in, and product launch. The successful candidate will combine deep power-electronics expertise with hands-on laboratory skills, strong system-level engineering judgment, and the ability to influence technical direction across customers and cross-functional engineering teams.

The position may be filled at the Staff or Senior Staff level based on experience, technical depth, leadership, and demonstrated scope of impact.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with Tier 1 and Tier 2 customers, Product Management, Design Engineering, Systems, Test, and Quality teams to define system and performance requirements, product features, specifications, and architecture for advanced power-management ICs.
• Provide technical leadership for products incorporating DC-to-DC buck and boost converters, charge pumps, hybrid power converters, ADCs, fuel-gauge functions, general-purpose monitors, clocking, analog and digital interfaces, and device-to-device communications.
• Lead and contribute to system architecture, IC-level design, and board-level design reviews, identify technical risks, and ensure alignment with system and customer requirements.
• Lead silicon evaluation and characterization at IC, PCB, and system level, including first-silicon bring-up, performance characterization, debug, evaluation reporting, and identification of errata or required product improvements.
• Analyze and resolve complex technical issues spanning silicon, firmware, PCB, and system behavior, working across engineering disciplines to identify root cause and drive corrective actions.
• Lead creation and technical review of datasheets, objective specifications, application notes, evaluation reports, errata, and technical presentations describing product features, performance, and operation.
• Drive customer design-in activities and provide senior technical guidance during product evaluation, system integration, debugging, qualification, and product launch.
• Support technical investigation of customer issues and RMA activities during the product development lifecycle, driving root-cause analysis and resolution of early-stage failures.
• Develop and improve Python-based automation for silicon evaluation, characterization, instrument control, data analysis, and reporting to improve test coverage, repeatability, and engineering efficiency.
• Design and review mixed-signal and power evaluation PCBs, including schematic capture, component selection, board bring-up, and debug for internal and customer evaluation.
• Develop, evaluate, and verify SIMPLIS system-level models, FPGA prototypes, or equivalent modeling and prototyping platforms to investigate architectural trade-offs, product feasibility, and correlation with silicon behavior.
• Identify and drive improvements in applications engineering methodologies, tools, automation, and technical best practices.
• Mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers and contribute to the development of broader team capability.

• Strong experience with DC/DC converters, power-management ICs, or analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits used in applications such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, battery-powered systems, computing platforms, chargers, or related products.
• Deep understanding of power-conversion concepts including buck/boost operation, control loops, stability, transient response, efficiency, switching behavior, sequencing, protection functions, and system-level interactions.
• Strong hands-on experience in silicon evaluation, characterization, board bring-up, and system-level debugging.
• Experience developing, interpreting, and reviewing system requirements, electrical specifications, and product performance requirements.
• Strong knowledge of multi-layer mixed-signal and power PCB design, schematic capture, component selection, layout considerations, and measurement techniques.
• Experience using laboratory instrumentation such as oscilloscopes, electronic loads, power supplies, DMMs, power analyzers, network analyzers, and related measurement equipment.
• Experience with Python or equivalent programming and scripting languages for test automation, instrument control, data analysis, and reporting.
• Experience with SIMPLIS or comparable power and system simulation tools is highly desirable.
• Experience with FPGA-based prototyping, digital interfaces, or embedded and firmware validation is desirable.
• Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex and ambiguous technical problems and make sound engineering decisions.
• Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and customer-facing skills.
• Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and work effectively across global and cross-functional engineering organizations.

Education & Experience

• BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Typically 8+ years of relevant industry experience for Staff-level consideration, with Senior Staff candidates expected to demonstrate broader technical leadership, organizational influence, and ownership of complex or strategic products and technologies.
• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required to support customers and engineering activities, generally less than four weeks per year.

Leveling Guidance

Staff Applications Engineer

• Independently leads complex product and silicon-evaluation activities, drives customer design-ins, resolves difficult technical problems, improves engineering methodologies, and provides technical guidance within an area of expertise.

Senior Staff Applications Engineer

• Operates as a broader technical authority, influencing product and system architecture, leading resolution of complex or systemic problems across multiple disciplines or programs, establishing engineering methodologies and best practices, guiding other senior engineers, and influencing technical direction across the organization and with strategic customers.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

jobs.description:
This position will report directly to the Chief Legal Officer and will be responsible for handling a wide range of corporate and securities matters related to the growth, operation and further development of this global publicly traded corporation. The role will be the primary legal support to the SEC reporting, tax, treasury, insurance, investor relations, finance and stock plan administration functions of the Company.  This role requires a person to possess a strong securities and corporate governance background, and an analytical and detail-oriented growth mindset, coupled with strong communication skills.  This role will also serve as a leader in enterprise risk management and information security compliance, working closely with business leaders on business continuity processes, compliance programs and related disclosures.  This role will also help lead the global HR compliance projects of the company in partnership with regional HR legal specialists.  This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated individual with a strong background in corporate law that has demonstrated the ability to expand to the wide breadth of areas of an in-house legal team to contribute to our organization's success.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Advise on a broad range of securities laws and corporate governance matters to ensure compliance with legal requirements and company policies generally applicable to Freshworks’ business.

Includes close collaboration with tax department on legal entity structuring and intercompany arrangements and finance department on annual filings for subsidiaries.

Monitor corporate governance best practices and regulatory and legislative developments and advise on compliance with applicable standards and updates to policies and training materials.

• Develop strong working relationships and trust by actively collaborating with others in Legal and Compliance teams and across multiple functions within the Company.

• 15+ years of relevant experience practicing with national law firm, with at least 8 years in-house experience at public-traded technology companies, preferably during the growth-to-great phase of its lifecycle.
• Strong securities and corporate governance experience (along with an understanding of financial statements and equity plans) to support all periodic reporting and equity plan compliance of a U.S. public company with an internal finance team.
• Strong knowledge of corporate law principles, regulations, and best practices.
• High level of business acumen and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify risks and help make strategic business decisions aligned with legal parameters quickly and effectively in the face of ambiguity and uncertainty.
• Ability to drive your own results and “roll up sleeves” to take on any project (from admin to strategy) in a small in-house legal team environment to get stuff done.
• Low ego individual that thinks like a business person (not a lawyer) and sees challenges as opportunities to develop and find innovative ways to get work done while helping shape and nurture an amazing work culture.
• Demonstrated experience in providing strategic legal leadership and contributions to lead or influence operational process, procedure, and strategy to achieve business outcomes.
• Demonstrated self-initiative, integrity, and resilience. Must be committed to constant curiosity and have willingness and ability to make decisions following feedback, input and collaboration to deliver desired results for the Company.
• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively across all levels of an organization with enterprise-wide viewpoint to avoid siloed thinking. Strong presence and the ability to work independently with business functions, external auditors, outside counsel and senior-level executives to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations in a business-oriented manner.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving aptitude
• Proficiency in mathematical calculations and chemistry concepts
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work collaboratively in a mentoring environment

• Strong knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) and/or Enterprise Service Management (ESM), with experience in areas such as ITOM, ITAM, or ITIL practices.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer, Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
At Freshworks, we're introducing AI across our GTM organization to accelerate how we understand buyers and act on revenue signals.

As a key member of the Web & Revenue Marketing team, you will build the agents, automations, and intelligence systems that help our frontline teams operate more effectively.

We're looking for a GTM operator who is also a hands-on builder—someone who deeply understands how revenue teams work and can turn those problems into AI-powered workflows and systems.

Our buyer signals currently live across Salesforce, Marketo, Outreach, product usage data, intent platforms, and other systems. You'll connect those signals, add context and intelligence, and build workflows that help revenue teams determine who to engage, why, when, and what action to take.

You may come from Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, Revenue Technology, Marketing Operations, or a similar technical GTM function. You don't need to be a traditional software engineer, but you do need to be someone who has personally built solutions, not just managed the tools or processes around them.

You'll have executive sponsorship, high-impact problems to solve, and a blank canvas to help shape how AI is applied across the Freshworks GTM organization.

What You'll Do:

• Build AI-powered GTM Workflows: Design and deploy agents and automations across lead management, account research, routing, scoring, prioritization, personalization, seller briefings, and follow-up
• Turn Buyer Signals into Action: Connect and enrich signals across web activity, intent, product usage, CRM history, engagement data, and third-party sources to identify high-value accounts and recommend actions
• Automate the GTM Stack: Build integrations and workflows across systems like Salesforce, Clay, Marketo, sales engagement platforms, enrichment provides, internal data sources, and AI tools
• Build Agents and Internal Tools: Use LLMs, APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and scripting to create tools that make sellers and revenue teams faster and more effective
• Solve Frontline GTM Problems: Partner directly with Sales, SDR/BDR, Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, RevOps, and Demand Gen teams to understand workflow friction and translate business needs into working solutions
• Prototype and Iterate Quickly: Build solutions, get them into users' hands, measure their effectiveness, and iterate based on real-world feedback
• Make AI Workflows Reliable: Implement validation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, monitoring, error handling, and other mechanisms needed to move successful prototypes into production

What We're Looking For

• Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations, GTM Systems, Revenue Technology, Marketing Operations, or a similar GTM function
• Strong understanding of B2B revenue workflows including lead management, routing, enrichment, qualification, account prioritization, prospecting, and pipeline generation
• A hands-on builder who has personally created automations, integrations, internal tools, or data workflows—not just managed the systems or processes around them
• Experience working with GTM platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, or similar
• Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered workflows or agents using Claude, OpenAI, Relevance, MCP, n8n, Workato, or similar tools
• Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, data integrations, automation platforms, or scripting to connect systems and bring ideas to life
• Ability to partner directly with Sales, Marketing, SDR/BDR, and RevOps teams and translate business problems into working technical solutions

Nice to Have

• Experience with SQL, Python, JavaScript, or data warehouses
• Experience building account intelligence, enrichment, scoring, routing, or signal-based GTM workflows

jobs.title: Director - Global Talent Management
jobs.description:
Freshworks is rethinking how we develop, evaluate, and listen to our people — and this role is at the center of that transformation. As Director of Performance Management & Employee Listening, you will lead two of our most strategically important people practices: a comprehensive redesign of how we approach performance management, and a shift to a modern, continuous approach to employee listening.

This is a role for someone who thinks systemically, designs with the business in mind, and cares about execution as much as strategy. Ultimately, you are helping us build something lasting: a sustainable culture of high performance and an employee experience that is genuinely differentiated. You will work as part of a small, senior Workforce Strategy & Org Development team — owning your domain with a high degree of autonomy and leading through influence across a matrixed organization. You will not manage a large team, but you will need to move a lot of work through people who don't report to you.

Based at our San Mateo headquarters, you will work alongside senior leaders and represent the People team in high-visibility conversations at the VP and executive level. We need someone who commands a room, earns trust quickly, and brings both creative thinking and rigorous follow-through to everything they own. Critically, you know that even the best-designed programs fail without deliberate change management — and you build enablement, communication, and adoption into your work from the start.

What You’ll Do

Performance Management Transformation

• Lead a meaningful transformation of how Freshworks approaches performance management — moving from a process-heavy, subjective model to a streamlined, AI-assisted approach that is easier for managers, more consistent in its outputs, and more tightly connected to business outcomes.
• Design and own the end-to-end performance system: the methodology, the tools, the calibration approach, and the employee and manager experience.
• Coordinate across HR, Total Rewards, HR Technology, and business partners to deliver an integrated solution that actually works in practice.
• Build and maintain executive alignment. This work is visible to senior leadership, and you will present, defend, and iterate on it in real time.
• Lead the change management and enablement strategy for the performance transformation — developing communications, training, and leader readiness plans that drive understanding and adoption across the organization.
• Hold the bar on quality and detail at every stage.

Employee Listening

• Own our employee listening strategy and programs, including our continuous listening platform, pulse approach, and how we translate signals into leadership action.
• Drive the shift from periodic survey cycles to an always-on listening culture — designing and executing the change management strategy that moves leaders from passive recipients of survey results to active owners of the employee feedback loop.
• Build leader-facing tools, frameworks, and communications that make listening data accessible and useful, not just reportable.
• Track program health, participation trends, and sentiment over time; surface risks and opportunities and bring forward clear recommendations.
• Stand up and lead a cross-functional employee experience working group — bringing together leaders from People Analytics, Employee Experience, and the HRBP community to build a cohesive, multi-lens view of the state of the employee experience. This group will be responsible for maturing how we aggregate and interpret employee signals, and for delivering a regular, centralized view of organizational health to senior leadership.
• Continuously improve our approach as AI capabilities and listening methodologies evolve

Change Management & Enablement

• Own the change management and enablement strategy across both performance and listening — from how we communicate program shifts to how we build leader capability and drive adoption at scale. The goal is not compliance with new programs; it is durable behavior change that builds a culture of high performance and an employee experience people can feel.
• Apply behavioral science principles to the design of change interventions — using what we know about habit formation, social norms, loss aversion, and motivation to design programs that shift behavior, not just awareness.
• Design and deliver leader enablement programs that translate program changes into concrete behaviors: what leaders need to know, do, and model differently as a result of each transformation.
• Build a communication and engagement framework that keeps employees, managers, and senior leaders informed, aligned, and bought in throughout multi-year transformation cycles.
• Serve as the connective tissue between program design and organizational readiness — ensuring that what we build in the design room actually lands in the field.
• Measure adoption and enablement effectiveness; use data to identify where uptake is lagging and adjust approach accordingly.

• 8–12 years of progressive experience in HR, people strategy, organizational effectiveness, or a related field.
• Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives from design through execution in a fast-paced environment. • Deep expertise in performance management design — you’ve built or significantly redesigned performance systems before and understand how to make them fair, scalable, and defensible.
• Meaningful experience in organizational design and development — you can help leaders think through structure and effectiveness, and you know how to turn those conversations into action.
• Strong change management and enablement skills — you know how to bring people along through transformation, build leader capability, and design adoption strategies that actually stick. • Familiarity with continuous listening platforms and methodology; experience driving leader adoption of listening tools is a strong plus.
• An AI-first mindset — you’re curious about what AI makes possible in people practices and you bring that perspective to how you design programs and solve problems.
• Exceptional executive presence — you’re comfortable presenting to C-suite leaders, you communicate with clarity and confidence, and you can hold your own in high-stakes rooms.
• High attention to detail — you care deeply about getting things right and you’ll get into the weeds to make sure they are. • Strong cross-functional instincts — you build trust with Finance, Strategy, and Operations partners and you design solutions that work for the business, not just for HR. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can translate complexity into clarity for any audience.

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

The Senior Director of Marketing Intelligence & Decision Science will lead the evolution of Freshworks’ marketing intelligence and performance ecosystem. This leader will transform how Marketing measures performance, generates insights, predicts outcomes, and drives decision-making across the business.

This role combines executive-level business performance leadership with deep analytical, operational, and technical fluency. The ideal candidate will modernize measurement frameworks, establish scalable data and insight infrastructure, advance predictive and AI-driven capabilities, and enable the organization to make faster, smarter, and more proactive decisions.

This leader will serve as a strategic partner across Marketing, Sales, Finance, RevOps, and Data/IT while helping shape the future operating model for GTM intelligence and performance management.

Marketing Intelligence & Business Performance

• Own the strategic measurement framework for Marketing performance across pipeline, bookings, funnel conversion, efficiency, and revenue contribution
• Lead executive-level business performance reporting, insights, and storytelling across WBRs, QBRs, forecasting reviews, and strategic planning cycles
• Translate complex performance trends into clear business narratives, risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations
• Establish proactive performance monitoring and early warning systems to identify emerging trends and business risks
• Drive standardization and governance of KPIs, definitions, measurement methodologies, and reporting consistency across GTM

Decision Science, Modeling & Advanced Analytics

• Build and scale advanced analytics and decision science capabilities including predictive modeling, forecasting, segmentation, attribution, propensity scoring, experimentation, and scenario planning
• Partner with Marketing and GTM leadership to improve investment allocation, funnel optimization, and performance predictability
• Advance AI and machine learning applications across marketing intelligence, measurement, targeting, and operational decision support
• Establish scalable experimentation and measurement frameworks to improve business decision-making and performance optimization
• Drive adoption of data science and AI capabilities in practical, business-oriented ways

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Machine Learning
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Machine Learning Staff Engineer to lead the development of core backend services powering our Agentic AI Platform. In this role, you will be the primary technical driver for building reasoning-driven agents, multi-agent orchestration, and outcome-based workflows.

You will collaborate with the Principal AI Architect to bridge the gap between high-level design and scalable implementation. You will own the development of high-performance APIs and orchestration runtimes, integrating frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith. This role is highly hands-on and requires a technical leader who can navigate a fast-paced environment while maintaining high engineering standards.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Backend Development

• Lead Implementation: Act as the lead engineer for agent runtime orchestration services, focusing on reasoning, planning, and tool invocation
• API & SDK Design: Own the development of robust APIs and SDKs that enable internal and external teams to build and deploy agent workflows
• State & Memory Management: Build and optimize stateful dialog management and memory services for multi-turn, context-aware agents

System Architecture & Execution

• Microservices Leadership: Execute the transition to cloud-native, event-driven backend services using microservices or service mesh architectures

• Performance Optimization: Optimize LLM orchestration for performance and cost through caching, batching, and token monitoring

Integrations & Data Services

• Data Pipeline Ownership: Implement and maintain RAG pipelines and integrations with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS)
• Telemetry Integration: Ensure all backend services support LangSmith-based evaluation and comprehensive observability

Security & Reliability

• Tenant Isolation: Implement RBAC, API authentication, and multi-tenant isolation logic
• Engineering Excellence: Set the standard for automated testing (unit, integration, load) and implement OpenTelemetry for full system visibility
• Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and code reviews for more junior backend engineers on the team

Required Qualifications:

• 6+ years of backend engineering experience
• 1-2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML platform development
• Expert Proficiency: Strong programming skills in Java and Python
• Framework Expertise: Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or LangSmith
• Distributed Systems: Deep understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, and Kubernetes
• Cloud & Data: Solid experience with AWS, Terraform, and a mix of relational (PostgreSQL) and Vector databases
• Orchestration: Practical experience with workflow engines like Temporal or Airflow and messaging systems like Kafka

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with AI-driven planning systems or dialog state tracking
• Background in enterprise security (RBAC, SSO, OAuth2)

jobs.title: Principal Engineer — Product & Application Security
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Engineer — Product & Application Security to be the top technical authority for how Freshworks builds secure software. As an IC6 Principal, you set the multi-year security technical vision for our products and platform, make the calls on our hardest security-architecture problems, and are the person the company relies on when the stakes are highest — across a multi-tenant SaaS estate serving 72,000+ customer accounts and hundreds of integrations.

As Freshworks evolves from a suite of service products into an AI-first system of business intelligence — with autonomous agents, a Knowledge and Context Graph, and a growing agentic surface — the security bar must rise with it. This role goes beyond leading individual reviews and remediations: you define the secure-by-design paradigms, reference architectures, and organization-wide standards that determine how thousands of engineers ship, and you drive the strategic bets (AI/agent security, supply-chain integrity, zero-trust data protection) that keep Freshworks ahead of the threat curve.

You will operate as a company-wide force multiplier — writing code and reference implementations, setting technical direction that outlives any single project, mentoring Staff and Senior Staff security engineers, and partnering directly with VP Engineering, the CISO organization, and product leadership to make security a durable competitive advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Security Technical Vision & Strategy

• Own the multi-year technical vision and architecture strategy for product and application security across all Freshworks products (Freshdesk, Freshservice, and the shared Platform), and drive alignment on it across engineering and the CISO organization
• Define the secure-by-design reference architectures, paradigms, and organization-wide standards (authN/authZ, tenant isolation, data protection, secrets, API security) that thousands of engineers build against
• Set the strategic security agenda for the AI-first platform — securing the AI Agent Platform, Knowledge/Context Graph, and agentic workflows — anticipating threat classes before they reach production
• Act as the final technical decision-maker and tie-breaker on the hardest, highest-risk security-architecture trade-offs

Product & Application Security Engineering

• Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for the most critical, cross-cutting, and highest-risk systems — including identity and access, the integrations/connector framework (300+ apps), and the agent runtime
• Set the standard for secure code review, manual and AI-assisted penetration testing, and vulnerability analysis; drive root-cause remediation strategies that eliminate whole vulnerability classes across the estate, not one bug at a time
• Architect and harden multi-tenant security controls: strict tenant isolation, authentication/authorization models, secrets management, data protection, and API gateway security
• Own the security design for AI/agentic features — prompt injection defense, tool-invocation authorization, non-human identity, and permission-scoped context access

Left-Shift & Secure SDLC at Scale

• Define the organization-wide, AI-assisted left-shift strategy: how SAST, DAST (e.g., Snyk), SCA/dependency scanning, secret detection, and IaC scanning are embedded across every CI/CD pipeline to catch issues before production
• Set the direction for security tooling, automation, and paved-road frameworks and libraries that make the secure path the default path — including code-component asset inventory (API/SBOM/RBAC/secrets/integrations) and secure-by-default product hardening
• Own the software supply-chain security strategy: centralized software artifact repository management (e.g., Sonatype Nexus), code artifact repository guardrails, and CI/CD pipeline hardening
• Establish secure coding standards, golden patterns, and guardrails; operationalize threat modeling and maturity models (SAMM) across the product portfolio; and define the security quality gates the whole org is measured against

Vulnerability Management & Incident Response

• Serve as the top technical escalation point for the most severe security incidents — leading investigation, containment strategy, and post-incident architectural hardening
• Set the risk-based prioritization framework for findings from internal testing, bug bounty, third-party pen tests, and researcher disclosures, and drive systemic fixes
• Shape the strategy for the bug bounty and responsible-disclosure program

Technical Leadership & Influence

• Act as the recognized top IC authority for product security — mentoring and multiplying Staff and Senior Staff engineers and security champions, and raising the security bar across the entire engineering organization
• Influence company-level strategy: advise VP Engineering, the CISO organization, and product leadership; represent Freshworks' product-security posture to enterprise customers, auditors, and (where appropriate) the external security community
• Drive cross-organizational security initiatives to completion through technical credibility and clarity — building consensus across many teams without formal authority

Security Domains You'll Set Direction On

You will be expected to provide deep technical direction — and roll up your sleeves — across the full product security roadmap, including:

• Compliance & trust enablement: internal and external pen testing (PCI vault, VAPT), Google CASA, TX-RAMP control validation, SDLC documentation control reviews, audit evidence, risk assessment prioritization, and new-product-introduction (NPI) security assessments
• Continuous security assessment & automation: DAST onboarding for public APIs and continuous-deployment integration, SCA bug triage, CI/CD environment assessment, continuous control monitoring, security scorecards, and anomaly-detection rule configuration
• Shift-security-left: code-component asset inventory (API/SBOM/RBAC/secrets/integrations), supply-chain attack prevention, threat-modeling operationalization, and product-security maturity models (SAMM)
• Product security features: step-up authentication for sensitive operations, SCIM/secure SAML, OIDC federated SSO, OAuth for APIs and third-party apps, secrets injection, customer data masking, field-level encryption, BYOK, DNSSEC, header hardening (CSP/X-Frame), IMDSv2, egress proxy enforcement, hardcoded-secret cleanup, IAM role right-sizing, SIEM audit-log integration, and SSPM tool integration

Metrics & Impact

• Define the security KPIs the organization is held to: reduction in high/critical findings reaching production, coverage of critical services by threat models, mean time to remediate, and adoption of secure-by-default frameworks
• Deliver a measurable, sustained reduction in exploitable risk across the entire product portfolio while improving — not slowing — engineering velocity

Professional Experience

• 12+ years in software engineering and/or security, with deep, sustained hands-on ownership of application/product security for production SaaS at enterprise scale
• Track record as a Principal-level (or equivalent) individual contributor whose technical vision and standards shaped an entire engineering organization — you have defined direction that outlived individual projects
• Deep experience securing multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS platforms (ideally on AWS), including tenant isolation, authN/authZ, and API security at scale
• Demonstrated impact eliminating vulnerability classes and setting the security frameworks, reference architectures, or paved roads adopted org-wide

Technical Expertise

• Authoritative, current knowledge of application security anchored in OWASP frameworks — Web Top 10, API Security Top 10, ASVS, the LLM Top 10, and the newer OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (the real-world attack classes targeting autonomous agents) — plus secure design patterns, authentication/authorization (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM), session management, and cryptography
• Mastery of threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE), secure code review, and both manual and AI-assisted penetration testing across web, API, and cloud surfaces
• Deep experience embedding security into CI/CD at scale: SAST, DAST (e.g., Snyk, Snyk Code), SCA, secret scanning, IaC scanning, artifact-repository management (e.g., Sonatype Nexus), and container/Kubernetes security aligned to the OWASP Kubernetes Top Ten (RBAC, workload isolation, supply-chain, and misconfiguration risks)
• Strong coding ability in one or more of Ruby, Java, Go, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript — enough to build reference implementations and security tooling and to be credible in any code review
• Deep cloud security expertise (AWS preferred): IAM and role right-sizing, network/egress controls, KMS/secrets management, BYOK/field-level encryption, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
• Authoritative grasp of cryptographic and compliance standards relevant to enterprise SaaS — e.g., FIPS 140-2/140-3, PCI, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and Google CASA / TX-RAMP control frameworks
• Deep understanding of securing AI/LLM and agentic systems — including Claude and other LLM security concerns such as prompt injection, insecure tool use, model/data exposure, and non-human identity

Leadership & Influence

• Ability to set technical direction for and influence an entire engineering organization — and senior executives (VP/CISO) — through technical credibility and clear communication
• A genuine service-oriented, "make the secure path the easy path" mindset toward internal developers
• A multiplier: track record of growing Staff and Senior Staff engineers and building a durable security-champion culture across distributed teams

Nice to Have

• Deep experience securing ITSM, CX/CRM, or service-management products and their data models
• Recognized external contributions: open-source security projects, published research, CVEs, standards bodies, or conference talks (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, OWASP)
• Industry certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CISSP, or equivalent (valued, not required)
• Experience defining or scaling bug bounty / responsible-disclosure programs
• Deep familiarity with modern AI/ML stacks — LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and agent frameworks (LangGraph, MCP, A2A) — and their security models
• Experience shaping compliance and audit programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

jobs.title: Material Handler I (1st Shift)
jobs.description:
The basic function of a Material Handler is to supply product to the production lines in order to keep the lines running in a timely and accurate manner.

Schedule: 1st Shift, Mon - Thurs from 5am - 3:30pm

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Essential Job Functions)

The duties and responsibilities of this position shall consist of, but not be limited to, the following:

• Responsible for moving product to and from the production lines in order to keep the machines running.

• Responsible for processing within product specifications.

• Use forklifts, pallet jacks, and other equipment to move items

• Follow all safety procedures and regulations

• Adheres to all Food Safety Quality requirements

• Maintain accurate records of product movement

• Responsible for all job rotation tasks such as placing empty containers on line, observing filling process, repackaging boxes, stacking product on pallets, etc. in an accurate and timely manner.

• Maintains a safe and clean work area.

• Readily accepts, and adapts quickly, to any task/production line reassignment and works closely and cooperates with any reassigned team leader and team members to accomplish production requirements.

• Cooperates and communicates well with co-workers and strives at all times to promote teamwork, build team spirit and heighten morale.

• Demonstrates a positive attitude and consideration towards fellow employees.

• Participates actively in any training program that is made available by the company.

• Recognizes and performs duties which need to be performed although not directly assigned.

• Performs work duties and responsibilities in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices. (i.e.: wears hairnet/beard net, and clean clothes at all times, washes hands when returning to work area, does not wear jewelry, does not have objects in mouth (gum, candy, tobacco) while working, does not bring food into plant except in break room, etc.)
• Completes paperwork and documentation in an accurate, neat and timely manner. (ie: production tickets, downtime reports, etc.)
• Is knowledgeable of all company rules, regulations, policies and procedures and complies with them at all times. Follows all departmental Standard Operating Procedures and reviews them regularly.

• Performs other duties and assumes additional responsibilities as necessary.

Preferred Education:

• High School Diploma or GED are preferred

Preferred Experience:

• Experience using Forklifts, Pallet Jacks or other equipment to move product
• Experience in a Manufacturing environment beneficial

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE and ABILITIES:

• Ability to work effectively with others.
• Ability to carry out routine and repetitive tasks.
• Ability to understand and follow verbal or demonstrated instructions.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; must work effectively with all levels of management and employees.

The starting rate for this role is $16.96 - $23.32 (Hourly). Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Link Snacks Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the Team Member will be required to wear the appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (i.e beard/hairnet, ear plugs, frock, boots, etc), stand for extended periods of time, and use hands/arms to push, pull, reach and occasionally lift above head.  The Team Member must occasionally lift, push, pull up to 25 pounds and 50 pounds infrequently. Team Members are requested to visually inspect equipment and/or product.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

jobs.title: Staff Program Manager - Voice of the Customer Programs
jobs.description:
This role will lead our effort in capturing, synthesizing, and acting on customer feedback. In this role, you will serve as the strategic owner of our VoC infrastructure, turning quantitative metrics and qualitative customer insights into actionable business and product strategies. You will directly manage customer-facing survey initiatives, act as a primary platform administrator and power user for Qualtrics, monitor our product feedback channels, and support our qualitative research efforts including customer focus groups.

What You Own

Survey Architecture & Qualtrics  — Own, manage, and optimize the enterprise Qualtrics platform for customer-facing survey and feedback initiatives, acting as the primary subject matter expert and administrator. Design, launch, and manage customer-facing survey programs across the lifecycle, including NPS, CSAT, CES, onboarding, and post-interaction surveys. Establish data collection best practices to reduce survey fatigue and ensure high response rates and representative sampling.

Product Feedback & Cross-Functional Collaboration — Collaborate with Product and Customer Adoption & Experience teams to build and scale a standardized product feedback process. Connect OvC data to ChurnZero Health Scores. Aggregate insights from direct surveys and customer-facing teams to translate customer feedback into prioritized product backlog items and feature enhancements. Design a close-loop process to communicate how feedback drives change both internally (with cross-functional teams) and externally (with customers).

Focus Groups & Qualitative Insights — Plan and support customer focus groups, advisory boards, and in-depth interviews to gather deep qualitative insights. Synthesize qualitative findings alongside quantitative data to create unified story-driven reports for leadership.

Playbooks & Enablement — Educate customer-facing teams on our survey initiatives and feedback processes. Design playbooks for pre- and post-survey outreach that align with best practices on responding to customer feedback in a supportive manner.

Program Strategy & Analytics — Build executive dashboards and quarterly reporting to track core CX metrics, customer sentiment trends, and the ROI of VoC initiatives. Establish automated workflows to flag and address detractor issues in real time.

Program Goals

• Deliver quarterly executive Root-Cause Analysis for key CX surveys
• 10+ NPS improvement in year one
• 90% adherence to Detractor Close-Loop Response target of 48 hours
• 25% of Product Roadmap VoC-driven
• Consolidate all CX surveys into Qualtrics

• Experience: 4+ years of Program Management experience 3+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX), Market Research, or Customer Insights, with direct ownership of VoC programs
• Technical Experience: Hands-on experience with Qualtrics (survey design, logic, dashboards, and integrations) is preferred.
• Qualitative Expertise: Demonstrated experience organizing, facilitating, and analyzing findings from focus groups and customer interviews.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Strong ability to translate raw data into clear narratives that influence Product, Engineering, and Executive decision-making.
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Marketing, Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

The annual base salary range for this position is $166,345 - $205,485. This role is also eligible for a target bonus.

Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate PR Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Sr. Manager of Executive Communications to be the primary architect and manager of our CEO, CTO, CIO, and CMO’s external voice. You will own the editorial strategy, calendar and output that turns Freshworks' narrative into category-shaping thought leadership — across executive social media handles, keynotes, podcasts, media.

This role  sits in the Corporate Communications function and is critical in driving clarity on the business strategy and in amplifying definitive points of view on the future of AI-powered service operations. You will work across the marketing organization and directly with the Freshworks management team to amplify POVs from these leaders and evolve the marketing operations and infrastructure to do it at scale.

What You Will Own:

1. Category Leadership

• You are the strategic owner of our executive POVs — ensuring our C-suite defines the market narrative around AI-powered service operations and the mid-market EX category.
• Build and maintain the Executive Communications Narrative Stack — the definitive source code for executive POV across keynotes, bylines, analyst briefings, media, and sales surfaces.
• Develop and execute the executive thought leadership program positioning the CEO and leadership bench as the primary category voices for the future of Employee and Customer Experience.
• Help drive the PR engine for EX category creation: earned media placements, opinion bylines, and the executive podcast circuit — at volume and with velocity.
• Coordinate with Analyst Relations to leverage Freshworks positioning through each analyst cycle.
• Establish Freshworks as the credible, practical alternative to legacy platforms by grounding all executive content in mid-market simplicity, AI productivity, and time-to-value.

2. Executive Narrative Stack & Messaging

• Own the narrative architecture that connects platform capabilities to market-facing executive communication — translating AI-powered service operations into simple, credible business value.
• Deliver updated messaging source code for use across sales enablement, event keynotes, analyst relations, and media — ensuring every GTM surface reflects a unified executive point of view.
• Align executive storytelling with vertical GTM programs across priority industries (technology, financial services, healthcare, professional services) as Freshworks scales its upmarket motion.
• Partner with Product Marketing to integrate platform launches, competitive differentiation, and customer proof points into executive narratives that drive market confidence.

3. Social & Influencer Amplification Engine

• One strong POV becomes dozens of targeted assets. You will evolve and operate the flywheel that turns executive perspective into measurable reach.
• Manage the executive social amplification engine across LinkedIn and YouTube, targeting growth in AEO traffic and share-of-voice in the service software space
• Convert thought leadership content into platform-specific assets modulated for audience segment and buyer stage — from C-suite prospects to mid-market practitioners.
• Build and maintain relationships with influencers, community leaders, and industry voices to extend Freshworks' executive reach organically.
• Actively monitor the enterprise tech zeitgeist — surfacing moments where our executives can enter conversations with insight, not noise.
• Support the AI influencer and social amplification programs that are central to the marketing growth engine, including creator partnerships and content series on LinkedIn and YouTube.

4. Integrated Corporate Narrative

• Support the Sr. Director, Corporate Communications to ensure executive comms supports and amplifies the company's premium brand investments, partner programs, and flagship events.
• Partner with Brand, Product Marketing, Enterprise Field Marketing, Digital Marketing, Investor Relations, and Employee Engagement to ensure executive messaging is precisely aligned with the broader narrative at each phase of the Marketing roadmap.
• Support corporate milestone communications — funding announcements, product launches, analyst report placements, and strategic partnerships — with executive-ready narratives.

5. AI-Powered Execution at Marketing Velocity

• Our Marketing organization operates on an MVP model: ship fast, test resonance, iterate, and scale what works. You will bring this discipline to executive communications.
• Build AI-assisted content workflows that multiply executive output — from first-draft generation and message testing to social scheduling and performance tracking — without sacrificing strategic quality.
• Operate with product-style development cycles: launch content quickly, measure resonance with press, analysts, and customers, and iterate based on signal rather than assumption.
• Implement an editorial calendar infrastructure that integrates with campaign rhythms, product releases, analyst cycles, and event schedules across the full marketing calendar.
• Instrument and report on executive communications impact: earned media coverage, analyst sentiment, executive social growth, and contribution to brand awareness and pipeline.

Experience & Domain

• Minimum 8 years in executive communications, PR, or corporate communications, with the majority of that time in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.
• Deep fluency in the IT service management, Employee Experience, or HR tech landscape — you understand the buyer, the influencer ecosystem, and the analyst community.
• Demonstrated track record of building and executing C-suite thought leadership programs that generated measurable brand impact.
• Experience driving executive narrative through category-creation or company-repositioning moments, not just sustaining existing brand presence.

Strategic & Creative Capability

• Exceptional writing and editing — you can translate complex AI and platform concepts into precise, resonant executive language that works across media, analyst, and social contexts.
• Strong narrative architecture skills: you build messaging frameworks, not just individual pieces of content.
• Proven ability to develop and execute against an editorial calendar under pressure, with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
• Experience partnering with analyst relations teams to develop and deliver executive briefing narratives.

AI Proficiency & Operating Model Fit

• AI-native operator: you actively use AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, testing, and workflow automation — and you are always looking for new leverage points.
• Comfortable with data: you track what resonates, report on performance, and adapt content strategy based on signal.
• Thrives in an MVP model: you ship, learn, and iterate rather than waiting for perfection.
• High EQ and executive presence: you build trusted relationships with C-level leaders and navigate their preferences with confidence and discretion.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Freshworks is looking for an experienced Deal Desk Strategy Manager to play a critical role in shaping and accelerating some of our largest and most strategic deals. Reporting to the Senior Director of Deal Desk, this senior individual contributor will partner directly with Account Executives and regional sales leaders to develop deal strategy early, navigate complex commercial decisions, and drive transactions from initial opportunity through close.

This is more than a traditional Deal Desk role — you’ll operate as a trusted advisor to Sales, bring together the right partners across Legal, Finance, and Operations, and help remove the friction that can stand between a great opportunity and a closed deal. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence how Deal Desk operates at scale, mentor others on the team, and build toward future people leadership as the organization continues to grow.

• Run point on Deal Desk activities for the largest and most strategic transactions in your region, embedded directly with assigned AEs and RVPs
• Proactively initiate deal strategy conversations with sellers before paperwork or approvals are required — not after
• Document the sequence of events required to close each assigned deal, and drive the cadence needed to hit it
• Establish a regular meeting cadence with account teams to drive deal velocity from inception to closure
• Own deal strategy and structuring end-to-end, including all order form updates and documentation
• Exercise judgment to triage deal complexity — resolving strategic, high-stakes deals personally while routing standardized work to our shared services Deal Desk team; this prioritization skill is a core part of growing into people leadership
• Identify and secure all necessary internal approvals; own correspondence with Legal on contract terms and redlines, and partner with Finance, Sales Ops, and other cross-functional teams as needed on pricing, revenue recognition, and deal terms
• Join customer calls as needed, speaking directly to deal structure and terms to accelerate turnaround time and remove friction to close
• Serve as an escalation point for complex or stalled deals across the region, stepping in to unblock and drive resolution
• Provide ongoing, proactive deal enablement for your regional account teams (not just reactive deal support)
• Act as a go-to resource and informal mentor for newer Deal Desk team members, sharing deal strategy best practices and coaching on deal structuring
• Identify recurring friction points across deals and recommend process, template, or workflow improvements to Deal Desk leadership
• Support quarter-end and month-end close crunch periods, including flexibility for after-hours support during peak close windows
• Contribute directly to team targets across deal cycle time, approval turnaround, accuracy, escalation rate, and Sales satisfaction

• 7–10+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar deal-support function, including direct experience with enterprise or strategic-tier deals
• Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted advisor to AEs and RVPs — shaping deal strategy proactively, not just processing paperwork
• Strong working knowledge of contract structuring, order forms, pricing and discounting frameworks, and standard commercial terms
• Comfort partnering directly with Legal, Finance, and Sales Ops to resolve complex contract, pricing, or revenue recognition questions
• Sound independent judgment for triaging deal complexity and knowing when to escalate, delegate, or resolve personally
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience speaking directly to customers on deal structure and terms
• A track record of informally mentoring or supporting peers, and genuine interest in growing into a people leadership role
• Ability to manage a high volume of concurrent deals under tight deadlines, particularly during month-end and quarter-end close
• An analytical, process-oriented mindset — comfortable spotting patterns across deals and proposing scalable fixes
• Flexibility to provide after-hours support during peak close windows as needed

As a Receiving Specialist, you will be responsible for managing the store's backroom operations by receiving products into the POS system, keeping products organized and accounted for, and helping process weekly pallets. You would also be in charge of processing damaged or defective products back to the Fulfillment Center, and reporting these items to the Inventory Control Team. Additionally, you would work closely with the management team to ensure that an adequate level of product is in stock for customer purchase, that the merchandise is properly maintained, and that the merchandise is displayed appropriately with proper signage and favorable shelf placement.

You can expect our 5 Core Values to drive everything we do.

• Maintain store presentation according to company standards, including store housekeeping, merchandising, and retail standards. This includes the backroom and workstations.
• Maintain awareness of all product knowledge information, merchandise promotions, and advertisements set forth by the Marketing Team

jobs.title: Intern- Equipment Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
Renesas Electronics America Inc. is looking for an Equipment Maintenance Technician Intern to support our wafer fabrication equipment in our manufacturing facility in Palm Bay, Florida. The successful candidate will be a self-starter with excellent written and communication skills. This position offers development opportunities working for a leader in the design and manufacture of high-performance analog semiconductors. If you are qualified and interested, we invite you to apply.

The candidate will serve as an Equipment Maintenance Technician Intern in a 24X7 analog wafer fab producing 150mm & 100mm wafers in BiCMOS, CMOS, and bipolar silicon technologies.

The candidate will work side by side with experienced Maintenance Technicians to perform preventative and corrective maintenance on various semiconductor manufacturing equipment, to include, diagnosing, testing, and repairing equipment by utilizing electrical repair procedures.

The candidate will learn problem solving techniques on complex electronic and mechanical systems to include; installation, operation, repair, and maintenance of electromechanical equipment.

Requirements:

• Candidate must be working towards an AS degree in Electronics Engineering Technology or Mechatronics with an emphasis in electronics.
• Willingness to work in a clean room environment and follow strict clean room requirements
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Detail orientated, team player with good verbal & written communication skills

Due to the nature of this position and the required access to areas where ITAR-controlled articles and/or technical data may be present, candidates must meet the applicable U.S. person requirements for ITAR access. This includes individuals who are:

• A U.S. citizen or U.S. national;
• A lawful permanent resident (Green Card holder); or
• A protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3).

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: Lead Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Freshworks, we're on a mission to help businesses delight their customers and employees through simple, powerful software. As we continue to grow our Enterprise business, we're looking for a Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of Key and Enterprise customers across North America.

You'll serve as a strategic partner to your customers, helping them maximize the value of their Freshworks investment while driving adoption, retention, and long-term growth. You'll work closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to proactively manage risk, strengthen executive relationships, and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What You'll Do

• Own a portfolio of approximately 30-35 Key and Enterprise customers representing $5M-$7M in ARR.
• Build trusted relationships with business, technical, and executive stakeholders
• Drive adoption, value realization, customer health, retention, and renewal readiness
• Lead Executive Business Reviews, success planning, and other strategic customer engagements
• Proactively identify customer risk and coordinate cross-functional teams to drive resolution
• Partner closely with Account Executives on account strategy, renewals, and expansion opportunities
• Identify opportunities to deepen customer relationships and expand the value customers receive from Freshworks
• Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Support, and Professional Services to deliver successful customer outcomes
• Travel as needed for executive engagements and onsite customer meetings

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of relevant customer-facing SaaS experience, including experience managing strategic or enterprise customers
• Demonstrated success driving customer adoption, retention, renewals, and growth
• Experience building relationships with both technical and business stakeholders, including executives
• Strong commercial mindset with experience partnering on renewals and expansion
• Experience leading EBRs/QBRs and navigating complex customer relationships
• Strong communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills
• Proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to navigate multiple priorities

This is a hybrid position based at our San Mateo, CA headquarters, with an expectation of working onsite Tuesday through Thursday. Regular travel is required to support executive customer engagements, strategic business reviews, and onsite meetings.

The annual base salary range for this position is $112,000 - $145,000 USD. This role is eligible for a target bonus and operates under an 80/20 pay mix (80% base salary, 20% variable compensation). Actual compensation will vary based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability and life insurances, flexible spending, commuter benefits and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits.

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

jobs.description:

Surgeons worldwide are changing the way surgery is performed by utilizing our robotic surgical device to enhance their surgical precision and greatly improve patient benefits. The focus of the Clinical Sales Representative (CSR) is to clinically sell to maximize the da Vinci® Surgical System’s utilization in the LA territory.

jobs.title: Geo Expansion & Device Lifecycle Manager, International & Commercial Operations, Neuroscience
jobs.description:
As part of the IMCO Neuroscience/Parkinson’s Commercial team this role will lead our efforts within geographic expansion and device lifecycle management (LCM). This high-impact role integrates regulatory execution, cross-functional project management, and global commercialization, requiring a strong device/combination product development foundation and offering the opportunity to lead strategic planning and execution.

As an initial area of focus, this role leads the Produodopa/Vyalev geographic expansion across 23+ new markets. The role is expected to evolve to support device LCM and commercial priorities from pre-launch strategy and preparation through launch execution and device transitions. Initiatives include Duodopa’s CADD Legacy-to-Duopump conversion, Vyafuser prefilled-syringe (PFS) and Mini-Pro platform launches, and digital support tools. This high-visibility, fast-paced role requires strong organizational skills and the ability to navigate complexity and deliver international programs from strategy through execution.

What You'll Do

• Lead cross-functional Parkinson’s geographic expansion, and device lifecycle management workstreams across new and existing global markets.
• As central point of contact, ensure on-time delivery of geographic expansion and device LCM initiatives. Develop, track and own integrated plans, timelines, milestone and cross-functional dependencies.
• Prepare governance materials and associated updates, align on decision points, and escalate decisions and resource constraints early to support alignment and prioritization. Develop cross functional mitigation plans when necessary.
• Partner with Regulatory Affairs to map country-level submission requirements and maintain visibility into submission status across target markets
• Proactively supporting and/or lead integrated planning for device launches and transitions, digital support tools, and other commercial priorities, from pre-launch strategy and preparation through execution.
• Build scalable planning, governance, and launch-readiness tools to improve Commercial Operations and support geographic expansion and multiple LCM initiatives in parallel.

What You Bring

• 5–8 years of experience in the medical device, combination product, pharmaceutical, or biotech industry
• Experience managing complex, multi-market regulatory or commercial programs with cross-functional stakeholders
• Strong combination product or device development foundation, with familiarity in global submission processes (EU, and/or other markets) and how regulatory readiness, supply, and commercialization depend on one another.
• Proven ability to build and manage integrated project plans, drive accountability, and communicate progress clearly to leadership
• Experience working across Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, Quality, and/or Commercial functions
• Track record of operating in fast-paced, matrixed environments with competing priorities, influencing without direct authority and coordinating multiple initiatives in parallel
• Bachelor's degree required; engineering, life sciences, or a related technical field strongly preferred

What Will Set You Apart

• Direct experience with drug-device combination products and multi-country regulatory submissions
• Experience in multi-country launch readiness, device lifecycle management, or drug-delivery platform transitions; digital patient support tool familiarity is an advantage.
• Familiarity with reimbursement strategy, HCP-facing labeling, or market access considerations
• Experience leading FDA pre-submission meetings or equivalent regulatory interactions

jobs.description:

To thrive as an NBCU intern, you are ready to bring your passion for media, entertainment, and technology along with your desire to learn each day. Here, you can develop your skills at a company that cares about its employees, its communities, and its culture.

NBC & Telemundo Connecticut Internships provide students with real world experience and exposure to working in the television industry. Internships at NBC & Telemundo Connecticut are paid and do not require course credit.

NBC Connecticut & Telemundo Connecticut are looking for a team player to join our Sales team. As a Sales Marketing intern on this team, you will support the development of multiplatform campaigns and strategies that drive advertising revenue for the stations.
