· Assist with the creation and development of sales marketing materials including custom sales presentations, campaign recaps, performance highlights, one sheets.

· Participate in brainstorming sessions with sales team to develop creative solutions for advertisers

· Assist in the sourcing of leads for sales team that could lead to development of new business revenue – stay on top of current events, market trends, emerging business categories and competitive efforts to identify innovative revenue streams

Work with the various departments responsible for deliverables: production to execute on commercial and lifestyle production, creative services to assist with graphics for sales campaigns, digital team to launch online campaigns, etc.

· Help with the execution and build of social media contesting and promotion: assist in submitting requests for rules & regulations, submitting production requests for creative, reconciling winners, and recapping campaign success

· Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal, the locations (listed below) you are open to for internships, and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).

• Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above

• Familiarity with and experience using multiple social platforms

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Events
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Event Manager to join Freshworks’ Event Experience team within Brand Marketing, reporting to the Director of Event Experiences. Ideally based in our San Mateo, Bellevue, or Boston office, this role will play a key part in delivering elevated, cohesive, and operationally excellent event experiences across Freshworks’ global portfolio.

The Event Experience team serves as a centralized hub of excellence for global events, setting the strategy, standards, governance, and ways of working that enable scalable, unified, and results-driven programs. The Senior Event Manager will help bring that strategy to life, contributing event-level perspective, developing plans and experiences, and partnering closely with the Director and cross-functional teams to turn broader objectives into exceptional events.

In the first 6–12 months, you’ll take ownership of a portfolio of high-priority events and serve as a strategic and operational partner from planning through execution. You’ll lead event workbacks, experience development, production, vendor and agency relationships, and cross-functional alignment, while contributing to the continued evolution of the team’s playbooks and ways of working. Success means delivering events that are flawlessly executed, purposeful, differentiated, and connected to Freshworks’ broader brand and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Support a portfolio of high-priority events from planning through execution, ensuring the attendee experience is purposeful, on-brand, and aligned to event objectives.
• Drive day-to-day event planning and execution across agenda, experience, logistics, production, and delivery, coordinating closely with cross-functional stakeholders.
• Bring event narratives to life, overseeing Run-of-Show, stage management, AV, technical production, and onsite execution.
• Manage production agencies and vendors ensuring high-quality delivery, cost efficiency, strong relationships, and adherence to Freshworks standards.
• Own event budgets from initial estimates through final reconciliation, including contracts, purchase orders, and procurement processes.
• Partner with Creative Services to execute the event look and feel across stage, environmental, signage, digital, and other attendee touchpoints.
• Contribute to the evolution of event playbooks, production standards, workbacks, and best practices, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
• Post event evaluations, capture learnings, and recommend improvements that strengthen future experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Director, People Analytics and Workforce Planning
jobs.description:
The Senior Director, People Analytics & Workforce Planning is responsible for leading Freshworks' People Analytics function, establishing enterprise workforce planning capabilities, and advancing the adoption of AI across HR in alignment with the company's broader AI strategy.

The role will define the strategy, operating model and governance for the function, delivering workforce insights that enable strategic business decisions, organizational effectiveness and long-term workforce planning. The Senior Director will build and lead a high-performing team responsible for analytics, workforce planning and strategic decision support.

Key Responsibilities

People Analytics

• Lead the People Analytics function, establishing its strategy, operating model and roadmap.
• Develop enterprise workforce analytics, executive dashboards, AI-driven insights and strategic reporting to support business and talent decisions.
• Advance the function from operational reporting to predictive analytics, AI-enabled decision support and strategic workforce intelligence.
• Establish governance, standards and enterprise workforce metrics to ensure consistent, accurate reporting across the organization.
• Leverage AI and advanced analytics to automate reporting, improve data quality, uncover workforce trends and enable faster decision-making.
• Identify opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness through data-driven insights.

Strategic Workforce Planning

• Establish and lead Freshworks' enterprise workforce planning capability.
• Develop workforce planning methodologies, AI-assisted capacity models and scenario planning frameworks.
• Partner with Finance, Corporate Strategy and other stakeholders to align workforce plans with business priorities and long-term growth objectives.
• Deliver insights and recommendations on workforce composition, organizational design, productivity and future talent demand.
• Leverage AI to enhance workforce forecasting, skills planning and organizational modeling.

AI Enablement

• Partner with HR leadership to operationalize and advance the HR AI roadmap in alignment with the company's enterprise AI strategy.
• Identify, prioritize and implement AI-enabled capabilities that improve HR productivity, decision-making and employee experience.
• Establish governance, adoption measures and success metrics for AI initiatives across the People function.
• Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend opportunities to enhance people analytics, workforce planning and HR operations.

Leadership

• Build, develop and lead a high-performing People Analytics & Workforce Planning team.
• Establish priorities, operating rhythms and delivery standards for the function.
• Lead, coach and develop managers and individual contributors while fostering a culture of analytical rigor, AI adoption, innovation and continuous improvement.
• Build organizational capability in analytics, workforce planning and the effective use of AI across the People function.
• Serve as a strategic advisor to senior HR and business leaders on workforce strategy, organizational effectiveness and people analytics.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Analytics, Economics, Statistics or a related discipline.
• 15+ years of progressive experience in People Analytics, Workforce Planning, Business Analytics or a related discipline, including significant people leadership experience.
• Demonstrated success building and scaling enterprise People Analytics and Workforce Planning capabilities, with a strong understanding of workforce analytics, organizational design and strategic workforce planning.
• Experience partnering with senior business leaders and leading cross-functional initiatives in a global organization to influence strategic decisions through data-driven insights.
• Excellent analytical, communication and executive presentation skills.

jobs.title: Superintendent
jobs.description:
The Superintendent is responsible for the daily management and coordination of assigned construction projects. This individual will lead field operations, coordinate subcontractors, maintain schedules, enforce safety standards, and ensure projects are completed according to plans, specifications, quality standards, and budget expectations.

Current projects include a veterinary clinic at the Racine Zoo and an addition at The Prairie School in Wind Point, Wisconsin.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage ground-up construction projects from sitework and foundations through structural construction, finishes, and final turnover.
• Develop and maintain project schedules and three- to six-week look-ahead plans.
• Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, deliveries, inspections, and field personnel.
• Review drawings and specifications to identify potential conflicts and resolve issues before they affect the schedule.
• Maintain high standards for workmanship, jobsite safety, cleanliness, and organization.
• Monitor field productivity, labor utilization, and material usage to minimize delays and unnecessary costs.
• Communicate regularly with project managers, owners, architects, engineers, and subcontractors.
• Maintain accurate daily reports documenting manpower, jobsite progress, deliveries, and other project activities.
• Coordinate inspections, punch lists, and project closeout.

• 7–10 years of commercial construction experience, including significant ground-up construction experience.
• Proven experience leading commercial construction projects as a Superintendent or comparable field leader.
• Strong understanding of sitework, foundations, concrete, structural steel, framing, building envelope, and interior construction.
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and schedules.
• Demonstrated ability to lead subcontractors, manage field operations, and hold teams accountable.
• Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Working knowledge of construction safety, quality control, and scheduling.
• Valid driver's license and ability to travel to job sites throughout southeastern Wisconsin.

Preferred: Experience with commercial, educational, institutional, or industrial projects; union trades; and projects in the $5 million–$20 million range.

What We Are Looking For

We want a hands-on leader who takes ownership of the jobsite, anticipates problems, and understands the importance of planning, productivity, quality, and profitability.

The ideal candidate earns the respect of subcontractors and field crews, communicates proactively, and takes pride in delivering successful projects safely, on schedule, and within budget.

Compensation and Benefits

• Base Pay: $53.31 – $62.81 per hour ($110,885 – $130,645/year equivalent, based on a standard 2,080-hour work year), commensurate with experience and qualifications.
• Union Fringe Benefits: Full union benefit package (healthcare, pension, and training funds) paid on top of your base wage, which can get your total earnings package up to around $94.71 per hour (nearly $197,000/year in combined wages and benefits). (Open to current union carpenters or non-union candidates willing to join the local union).
• Company Vehicle: Company-provided truck with take-home privileges and a company credit card for fuel and job-related expenses.
• Cell Phone Stipend: Annual cell phone allowance.
• Paid Time Off: Negotiable vacation and paid holidays tailored to your experience level.
• Performance & Incentives: Eligibility for project/performance-based bonus incentive

Join Our Team

If you are an experienced commercial construction Superintendent who knows how to lead ground-up projects and deliver results, we would like to hear from you. Join Bukacek Construction and help us build our next generation of successful projects!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse-Neuro Med Surg Full Time Days
jobs.description:
At this time, Palos Hospital is not considering external ADN candidates for our RN openings. We appreciate your interest in Northwestern Medicine and encourage you to apply to other opportunities at https://jobs.nm.org/. Internal ADN candidates are still encouraged to apply.

The Staff Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• The registered professional nurse assumes accountability and responsibility for the individualized, age-specific care of a patient along the continuum from admission to discharge. She/He gives direct care to assigned patients and assists with other patient care when necessary. The registered professional nurse’s decisions and actions on behalf of the patient/family are determined in an ethical manner. She/He collects and analyzes the assessment data in determining nursing diagnoses, collaborates with the patient/family and other health care team members, develops a plan of care to attain realistic outcomes, provides education founded on evidence-based practice, and systematically evaluates the quality and effectiveness of nursing practice.

Responsibilities:

• Assess and records patient status and identifies patient care needs upon admission/point of care entry.
• Organizes the assessment health data so that it is accurate, complete and accessible.
• Identifies problems that need immediate attention.
• Validates diagnoses with patient/family and other health care team members.
• Documents diagnoses in a manner that facilitates the determination of expected outcomes and plan of care.
• Initiates Problem List at the time of admission and updates as needed. Incorporates principles of age-specific care into the patient’s plan of care.
• Documents that the patient’s individualized plan of care has been discussed with and agreed upon by the patient/family.
• Begins plans for discharge at time of admission; consults with patient/family and health care team members regarding discharge plan.
• Identifies patient teaching needs on admission and throughout hospital stay.
• Arranges conferences with patient and/or family and other members of health team when indicated to plan care.
• Prioritizes and organizes nursing interventions that are evidence based and reflective of established standards of care.
• Provides individualized, mutually agreeable, patient and family education that is founded on evidence-based practice and research guidelines.
• Documents all assessments, interventions and patient responses.
• Reviews consistently the patient’s health data to keep the Plan of Care updated.
• Assures that revisions to the plan of care are systematic and ongoing and are driven by measurable realistic goals.
• Documents the patient’s progression toward identified outcomes
• Identifies unmet outcomes and provides direction for continuity of care.
• Reassesses nursing actions for effectiveness in achieving desired outcomes.
• Communicates with patient/family and health care team members re: patient care and nursing’s role in the provision of care.
• Collaborates with patient/family and healthcare team members re: the patient’s progress/plan of care.
• Presents relevant patient information at multidisciplinary meetings/conferences for feedback from peers.
• Makes appropriate referrals as needed for continuity of care.

Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Strong interpersonal skills

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Web Operations
jobs.description:
Engineers in Freshworks Marketing build the websites and systems behind our digital experiences. They work with designers, marketers, product managers, and infrastructure teams to develop scalable applications, backend services, and content platforms.

Role Description

As a Staff Engineer, you will set technical direction across our marketing engineering teams and stay closely involved in implementation. You will identify gaps in our systems, build substantial proof of concepts, and lead architectural changes that improve how we deliver and operate our platforms. Working with engineering leadership, you will help decide which problems deserve attention and take ownership of solving them.

We are looking for deep engineering expertise and strong critical thinking. You should be curious about how things work, question assumptions, and follow problems through the code and its dependencies. You will use AI extensively to investigate and build as well as assist throughout your day. You remain responsible for understanding the results and knowing when to steer the work or change course.

How you work with people matters. We want someone colleagues can approach with a question or a different view. Explain your thinking clearly, listen carefully, and be willing to change your mind when the evidence warrants it. Share work early and follow through on commitments. Your work should remove recurring obstacles and help other engineers take on harder problems.

Responsibilities

• Set Full Stack Architectural Direction: Define how our web applications, backend services, CMS platforms, and cloud infrastructure should evolve together. Document the reasoning behind decisions and give teams a practical path from the current architecture to the next.
• Lead Proof of Concepts: Autonomously investigate ambitious ideas and build working prototypes to find out whether an approach will work. Explain what you learned and recommend which ideas to pursue. Lead the work to turn promising prototypes into reliable production systems that the team can maintain.
• Find and Solve Systemic Problems: Identify gaps and recurring bottlenecks across our platforms. Trace root causes, weigh alternatives, and make changes that improve performance, reliability, or the team's ability to deliver. Balance longer-term improvements with current commitments.
• Build Shared Tools: Develop reusable modules, internal tools, and reference implementations that solve problems across teams. Help engineers adopt them and address problems they encounter.
• Collaborate with International Teams: Work closely with engineering and cross-functional partners across time zones. Bring people into decisions early, explain complex work clearly, and document enough context for others to contribute asynchronously. Raise risks promptly and keep agreed follow-ups moving.
• Coach Engineers and Technical Leads: Help lead engineers work through architectural decisions and guide their teams. Share your expertise through pairing, design reviews, and practical training. Encourage questions and help engineers develop their own technical judgment.
• Set Engineering Standards: Use code and design reviews to improve maintainability, testing, and operational reliability across teams. Work with the relevant partners to translate accessibility, security, and privacy requirements into implementation and testing practices.
• Lead AI Use Across the Team: Build and improve AI workflows for investigation, prototyping, and production work. Define what agents need to know, what they can access, and how their work will be checked. Teach engineers how to direct the agents and review their output. Refine these practices as the team uses them.
• Shape Technical Priorities: Bring architectural risks and opportunities to engineering and business leaders. Explain the costs, dependencies, and expected benefits of proposed work so leaders can make informed decisions. Help teams plan the work alongside existing commitments.

• Architecture and Problem Solving: Experience designing and evolving systems used by multiple teams. Strong understanding of service boundaries, distributed systems, data flow, caching, and failure handling. Ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and make sound decisions with incomplete information.
• JavaScript and TypeScript: Deep language knowledge and strong experience with React and Next.js, including rendering, state management, asynchronous behavior, and performance trade-offs.
• Node.js and Backend Systems: Hands-on experience building secure APIs, integrating services, and managing asynchronous processing. Ability to diagnose problems across frontend applications and backend systems.
• HTML and CSS: Strong knowledge of semantic markup, DOM and Web APIs, modular CSS, and responsive layouts. Experience diagnosing browser behavior, rendering issues, and performance bottlenecks.
• CMS and Content Platforms: Experience with headless CMS architecture, content modeling, and CMS or DAM integrations. Familiarity with platforms such as Contentful, Contentstack, or WordPress, and the trade-offs in how content is stored and delivered.
• Cloud Infrastructure and Tooling: Expertise with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability. Ability to evaluate deployment approaches and build tooling that improves development and production support.
• Accessibility and Quality: Strong understanding of accessible UI patterns, including keyboard navigation, focus management, and assistive technology testing. Experience defining testing strategies and diagnosing performance and reliability problems in production.
• AI Engineering and Automation: Extensive hands-on experience with coding agents, LLM APIs, and automated engineering workflows. Understand how context, tools, and model limitations affect results. Judge when to give agents autonomy, when to intervene, and how to verify their work through tests and code review. Choose models and manage context to balance quality, speed, and cost.
• Technical Communication: Ability to represent engineering in discussions with senior leaders, up to and including the C-suite. Explain recommendations in terms of business impact, cost, and timelines. Adjust the level of detail to the audience, answer questions directly, and be clear about trade-offs and uncertainty. Write useful documentation and give and receive constructive feedback.

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our office locations in either of the following: San Mateo, CA, Bellevue, WA, or Boston, MA.

The annual base salary range for this position is $ 192,000- $237,000. This role is also eligible for a target bonus.

jobs.title: Director - Demand Generation
jobs.description:
Freshworks is looking for a senior demand generation leader to help build and modernize our scaled demand engine across our product portfolio.

This role is for a hands-on operator and builder. You will own the day-to-day demand generation engine across channels, work closely with Revenue Marketing leadership on strategy and prioritization, and help rethink how demand generation should operate in an AI-forward company.

We are not looking for someone to simply run the traditional demand gen playbook faster. We want someone who can question what is working, identify what is not, build better systems, and use AI and automation to fundamentally improve how we generate, qualify, nurture, and convert demand.

You will partner closely with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Analytics, and regional marketing teams to create an integrated demand engine that drives measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and execute the scaled demand generation roadmap across our product portfolio, balancing pipeline goals, audience priorities, channel performance, and budget.
• Build and optimize always-on demand programs across SEM, SEO, AI search/GEO, content syndication, webinars, conversational marketing, lifecycle, nurture, and emerging channels.
• Build AI-native and agentic workflows into the demand engine, including audience identification, campaign orchestration, lead qualification, personalization, optimization, and reporting.
• Own performance across key demand generation metrics including MQCs/MQLs, SAOs, conversion rates, pipeline contribution, pipeline velocity, CAC, CPL, and channel efficiency.
• Manage and continuously optimize multi-million-dollar budgets across channels and campaigns based on incremental pipeline impact and ROI.
• Partner with Sales and RevOps on lead scoring, qualification, routing, SLAs, and handoff processes to improve conversion from demand through pipeline.
• Partner with Product Marketing to ensure campaigns, messaging, and audience strategies are coordinated across product lines rather than fragmented.
• Build a rigorous testing and experimentation culture, with clear hypotheses, measurement frameworks, and decisions on where to scale, optimize, or stop investment.
• Lead and develop a high-performing demand generation team while remaining close enough to the work to diagnose problems and drive execution.
• Evaluate and help evolve the demand generation martech stack, including marketing automation, intent data, conversational marketing, AI tools, and orchestration platforms.

What Success Looks Like:

In this role, success means building a demand engine that is:

• Predictable in generating qualified pipeline
• Efficient in how budget is deployed
• Stronger at converting demand into sales opportunities
• Integrated across products, regions, and channels
• Increasingly automated and AI-native
• Measured on business outcomes, not activity volume

The Profile We Are Looking For

• You are equally comfortable looking at a pipeline dashboard, challenging a channel strategy, designing a new operating system, and getting into the details with the team.
• You are not overly attached to legacy marketing playbooks. You care about what actually creates an incremental pipeline and are willing to stop programs that no longer perform.
• Most importantly, you are a builder. You see demand generation as a system to continuously redesign and improve, not simply a collection of campaigns to run.

• 10+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing, ideally in enterprise SaaS.
• Significant experience owning scaled demand generation programs and measurable pipeline targets.
• Experience managing multi-million-dollar marketing budgets and making channel allocation decisions based on performance and ROI.
• Strong understanding of demand generation economics, including CPL, CAC, conversion rates, pipeline coverage, velocity, and incremental return.
• Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI-enabled or agentic workflows within a marketing or demand generation environment.
• Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot and CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
• Experience with intent and account intelligence platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase and conversational marketing platforms such as Qualified or Drift.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently diagnose performance issues using data.
• Strong partnership skills across Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Analytics, and executive stakeholders.
• Experience leading and developing demand generation teams.

Preferred:

• Experience in a scaled, sales-led enterprise SaaS company with a multi-product portfolio.
• Experience operating in both enterprise and SMB/mid-market motions.
• Experience at an AI-native company or building AI-native marketing systems.
• A strong point of view on AI search, GEO, and how buyer discovery is changing.
• Experience with ITSM, customer support, CRM, or adjacent enterprise software categories.

We're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse world we serve. At Freshworks, you'll find inclusive teams, flexible thinking, and opportunities to grow your career - while making work better for millions.

If this sounds like a journey you want to be part of, we'd love to meet you. Let's building something refreshing together.

jobs.title: CNC Programmer
jobs.description:
The CNC Programmer will program Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machines (Milling, Waterjet, Cutter), perform setup and machining first runs of new machined parts, conduct operator training, and setup of production and maintenance support items using CNC Mills, Standard Mills, Standard Lathes, Waterjet and Textile Cutters and other related equipment.

First Shift Schedule:  Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

What You'll Do

• Program for Precision: Develop, modify, and prove out CNC programs for mills, routers, waterjets, and textile cutters, supporting both new product development and ongoing production needs.
• Bring Designs to Life: Interpret engineering drawings, customer specifications, machining parameters, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) requirements to plan effective machining processes.
• Set Up & Optimize: Perform machine setups, configure tooling and offsets, establish reference points, and verify program accuracy through first-run machining and inspection.
• Leverage Advanced Software: Use Mastercam, AutoCAD, and 3D modeling tools to develop machining programs for simple and complex parts. Program waterjet and textile cutting equipment using applicable software.
• Solve Technical Challenges: Troubleshoot machining issues, adjust programs and controls, replace worn tooling, and maintain quality standards throughout the manufacturing process.
• Design Custom Solutions: Develop fixtures, tooling, experimental parts, and working sketches to support specialized production and engineering requirements. Coordinate with vendors to fabricate custom tooling when needed.
• Support Production Excellence: Create and maintain accurate machining work instructions, manage CNC tooling inventory, and help improve work center efficiency.
• Share Your Expertise: Train production employees in the safe and effective operation of CNC equipment, promoting consistent processes and quality results.
• Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with engineering, production, and other departments to resolve problems, meet customer requirements, and support continuous improvement.
• Work Safely: Follow established safety practices, company policies, and applicable quality and environmental management requirements.

Education & Experience

• Associate degree in Applied Science in Computer-Integrated Machining or a related discipline from a two-year college or technical school, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, and experience.
• Previous experience as a CNC programmer or machinist in a manufacturing or product development environment is preferred.

Technical Expertise

• Proficiency in G-code programming and CNC machining processes.
• Experience with Mastercam 2024 or newer and AutoCAD 2024 or newer.
• Experience with Autodesk Inventor 3D and/or SolidWorks.
• Knowledge of CNC routers and mills, conventional mills and lathes, machine controls, tooling, offsets, and setup procedures.
• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, customer specifications, and GD&T requirements.
• Ability to machine both fibrous materials and metals.
• Strong mathematical skills, including basic calculations, geometry, and trigonometry.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and other relevant computer-based systems.

Experience with the following equipment and systems is a plus:

• 3-axis CNC routers and mills, particularly MultiCam.
• 5-axis CNC routers and mills, particularly C.R. Onsrud machines with MachMotion or FANUC controllers.
• Aggregates and angle heads.
• FLOW waterjet systems and Flow Cut/Flow Path software.
• Eastman textile cutters and Eastman Cut Pro software.
• Standard machining equipment, including conventional mills and lathes.

The Qualities That Will Set You Apart

• Analytical problem-solver: You can break down complex machining challenges, troubleshoot issues, and develop practical solutions.
• Detail-oriented: You understand that precision, accuracy, and careful verification are essential to producing quality parts.
• Independent and resourceful: You take initiative, exercise sound judgment, and know how to find answers when challenges arise.
• Collaborative communicator: You work effectively with people across departments and organizational levels, sharing technical information clearly and respectfully.
• Continuous improver: You look for opportunities to improve machining processes, work instructions, tooling, and overall work center performance.
• Committed to safety and quality: You take pride in following established procedures and helping others work safely and effectively.

Working Environment & Physical Requirements

This position works in both office and manufacturing environments, with exposure to loud noise, moving mechanical equipment, and fumes or airborne particles. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) includes approved footwear, safety glasses or goggles, and respirators when applicable.

The role requires the ability to sit and stand for extended periods, bend, reach, use stairs, and lift up to 50 pounds, with occasional team lifting of up to 100 pounds. Effective communication and the ability to use computers and related equipment are also required. Reasonable accommodations will be considered where feasible.

The minimum and maximum salary range for this full-time position is $60k - $90k + benefits.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location.  Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and/or training.  Please note that the compensation details listed in this posted role reflect the base salary only and do not include bonus or benefits.

jobs.description:
At this time, Palos Hospital is not considering external ADN candidates for our RN openings. We appreciate your interest in Northwestern Medicine and encourage you to apply to other opportunities at https://jobs.nm.org/. Internal employee ADN candidates are still encouraged to apply.

At Northwestern Medicine Palos Hospital, we believe that a smooth transition from the ER to inpatient care is crucial for optimal patient outcomes. Our ER Transitional Care department is dedicated to ensuring that patients receive the highest quality of care, with a focus on safety, comfort, and a seamless transition to the next phase of their medical journey.

In this role, you will care for patients who are boarding in the Emergency Department while awaiting an inpatient bed. You will deliver comprehensive nursing care through patient monitoring, assessments, medication and infusion management, and other essential clinical interventions. Opportunities to collaborate with inpatient teams, including supporting discharge processes, are also part of this position.

We are seeking nurses with a strong background in Telemetry or Med Surg for this position.

The Staff Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The registered professional nurse assumes accountability and responsibility for the individualized, age-specific care of a patient along the continuum from admission to discharge.  She/He gives direct care to assigned patients and assists with other patient care when necessary.  The registered professional nurse’s decisions and actions on behalf of the patient/family are determined in an ethical manner.  She/He collects and analyzes the assessment data in determining nursing diagnoses, collaborates with the patient/family and other health care team members, develops a plan of care to attain realistic outcomes, provides education founded on evidence-based practice, and systematically evaluates the quality and effectiveness of nursing practice.

Responsibilities:

• Assess and records patient status and identifies patient care needs upon admission/point of care entry.
• Organizes the assessment health data so that it is accurate, complete and accessible.
• Identifies problems that need immediate attention.
• Validates diagnoses with patient/family and other health care team members.
• Documents diagnoses in a manner that facilitates the determination of expected outcomes and plan of care.
• Initiates Problem List at the time of admission and updates as needed. Incorporates principles of age-specific care into the patient’s plan of care.
• Documents that the patient’s individualized plan of care has been discussed with and agreed upon by the patient/family.
• Begins plans for discharge at time of admission; consults with patient/family and health care team members regarding discharge plan.
• Identifies patient teaching needs on admission and throughout hospital stay.
• Arranges conferences with patient and/or family and other members of health team when indicated to plan care.
• Prioritizes and organizes nursing interventions that are evidence based and reflective of established standards of care.
• Provides individualized, mutually agreeable, patient and family education that is founded on evidence-based practice and research guidelines.
• Documents all assessments, interventions and patient responses.
• Reviews consistently the patient’s health data to keep the Plan of Care updated.
• Assures that revisions to the plan of care are systematic and ongoing and are driven by measurable realistic goals.
• Documents the patient’s progression toward identified outcomes
• Identifies unmet outcomes and provides direction for continuity of care.
• Reassesses nursing actions for effectiveness in achieving desired outcomes.
• Communicates with patient/family and health care team members re: patient care and nursing’s role in the provision of care.
• Collaborates with patient/family and healthcare team members re: the patient’s progress/plan of care.
• Presents relevant patient information at multidisciplinary meetings/conferences for feedback from peers.
• Makes appropriate referrals as needed for continuity of care.

#NMSouth

• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others

• Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) acceptable with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Experience
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Director, Digital Experience to lead how customers discover, evaluate, and engage with Freshworks through our website. You'll shape the web experience roadmap, lead designers and program managers, and partner with engineering to deliver better customer journeys and measurable business results.

You're a program manager at heart who stays close to the execution. You'll run Scrum across design and engineering, turn competing priorities into clear plans, and help the team deliver with speed and quality. You'll treat the website as a product, balancing launches and publishing needs with continuous improvements to its effectiveness.

What You'll Do

Web Experience and Roadmap

• Set the web roadmap and decide what to tackle next. Use customer needs and performance data to weigh improvements, redesigns, migrations, and localized experiences.
• Review designs with content and engineering partners. Make sure pages are easy to use and reflect the brand, with accessibility and conversion considered during design.
• Agree on web priorities with Web Revenue, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Marketing Operations. Turn campaign and product plans into work the team can deliver.

Program Delivery and Scrum

• Own request intake. Before work enters a sprint, confirm the problem, required content and assets, acceptance criteria, and the person who can approve it. Check template reuse, CMS constraints, and technical feasibility with engineering before committing.
• Run sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, reviews, and retrospectives with design and engineering. Keep commitments visible, remove blockers, and follow up on changes agreed in retrospectives.
• Track work through design, content development, QA, and launch. Flag dependencies or capacity problems early, explain the trade-offs, and get decisions from the right people.

Team Leadership

• Manage the designers and program managers. Set goals, give regular coaching and performance feedback, and keep workloads realistic.
• Stay involved in major projects and help design, engineering, and marketing resolve problems that slow delivery.

Web Operations and Continuous Improvement

• Run CMS and publishing operations. Keep content models, templates, and review steps documented so people know what they can publish and who needs to approve it.
• Agree on who signs off on each release and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT). Decide which issues block launch and which can follow. Check accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and tracking with engineering, then verify critical journeys on the live site.
• Choose experiments with conversion and analytics partners, review the results, and then use them to decide what to do next. Track delivery time and rework alongside website performance.
• Partner with design and engineering to test AI-assisted workflows that improve planning, creative exploration, and delivery.
• Use automation and AI tools when they save time or reduce mistakes. Keep human review and data safeguards in place.

• Experience owning a company website or leading web programs in enterprise B2B SaaS, including work that spans design, engineering, and marketing.
• Experience managing designers and program managers, including regular coaching, performance feedback, and workload planning.
• Ability to turn unclear requests into workable plans and spot dependencies before they cause delays.
• Experience building and improving workflows in Airtable or comparable work-management platforms; Airtable experience preferred.
• Experience running Scrum or a similar agile process with designers and engineers. You can explain what you changed when the process wasn't helping the team deliver.
• Good design judgment and the ability to give useful feedback. Experience using customer data and test results to decide whether a web change worked.
• Hands-on experience with CMS content models, publishing and web UAT. You can work through production or quality problems with engineering and understand web integrations, accessibility, and page performance
• Clear communication with technical teams and senior stakeholders, especially when scope, timing, or resourcing needs to change.

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tuesday - Thursday) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting
jobs.description:
As a Senior Revenue Manager, you will keep the revenue close accurate and on time while partnering with finance, systems, and business leaders on long-running process and systems transformation programs, including the use of AI and automation in revenue operations. You will act as second reviewer on revenue transactions and final reviewer on high-value items, coordinate with FP&A on forecasting and variance analysis, and work closely with our India-based revenue managers, who serves as first reviewer, in a follow-the-sun close model. Hands-on experience with Salesforce, NetSuite and billing or revenue automation platform such as Zuora, Zuora RevPro, or Salesforce Billing is central to the role. This role suits someone who can balance the demands of a recurring close with multi-quarter, cross-functional project work led by others.

Close and Review

• Lead the revenue close process and serve as second reviewer on revenue reconciliations and disclosures
• Identify items that need technical accounting input and escalate them to the technical accounting team with the right context and support
• Maintain a materiality and escalation framework that defines which items stop at first review, which require second review, and which require final review

Process and Systems Transformation

• Work with finance, IT, Billing, Sales Ops, and Data leaders on multi-quarter revenue transformation programs, such as billing-to-revenue integration, revenue subledger enhancements, contract management, and close automation
• Represent revenue accounting and the close in design discussions, providing input on requirements, process flows, and impacts on review and controls
• Help drive adoption and change management across the US and India teams, including training reviewers to work with AI-assisted outputs
• Help translate business and accounting needs into system requirements, and challenge designs that would add risk or manual effort to the close
• Support testing, UAT, and cutover readiness, and confirm post-implementation processes and controls work as intended

India Team Collaboration

• Partner with the India managers (first reviewer) to set review standards, checklists, and escalation thresholds
• Provide clear handoffs, feedback, and coaching to keep review quality consistent across time zones
• Analyze second-review findings and trends with the India manager, and drive root-cause fixes

FP&A Coordination

• Coordinate with FP&A on revenue forecasting and budget-to-actual variance explanations
• Provide revenue and deferred revenue data, bookings-to-revenue bridges, and insight into drivers such as renewals, upsells, churn, FX, and pricing changes
• Align on close calendars and flash results, and flag risks and one-time items early

Controls and Audit

jobs.title: Senior Scientist I/II - Solid Sate Characterization
jobs.description:
AbbVie Analytical Research & Development (Analytical R&D) is a global analytical scientific organization responsible for all CMC analytical activities related to the development of AbbVie's pharmaceutical products.  Our scope includes AbbVie's diverse pipeline of innovative small molecule medicines and spans from the selection of Discovery candidate molecules to Late Stage Clinical.  We are building a world-class team of scientists and leaders who will drive the advancement of industry-leading analytical capabilities and make meaningful contributions to advance AbbVie's pipeline of innovative medicines.  Careers in AbbVie Analytical R&D provide unique opportunities to work with global and cross-functional teams to drive exceptional science and innovative product development strategies.  We are looking for diverse candidates with strong scientific experience to join the AbbVie Analytical R&D team and can offer exciting and rewarding career opportunities for these candidates.

Position Description:

This Senior Scientist – Solid State Characterization position will be in a technical specialty group - Physical Analytical Chemistry (PAC) withing Analytical R&D.  The PAC group is a global team of experienced and innovative scientists which utilize a diverse set of physical analytical tools to advance CMC development programs by providing insights and driving the understanding of materials, processes, and products.  Additionally, the group contributes to development and justification of control strategies and authors relevant sections of regulatory submissions across all development phases.

We are looking for a subject matter expert in X-ray and electron diffraction for crystallographic and solid-form characterization of drug substances (DS) and drug products (DP), from early form discovery through regulatory filing. The role focuses on single crystal X-ray diffraction (SCXRD), Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), electron diffraction (3D ED/MicroED), Rietveld refinement, quantitative phase analysis (QPA), and phase-appropriate polymorph quantitation methods both in drug substance and drug products. The scientist will work closely with Molecular Profiling Drug Development, Process Chemistry, Formulation, Process Engineering, Analytical, Operations, Quality Assurance and CMC-Regulatory.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support new product development with advanced methods development and validations, technical transfer packages, and generation of technical data in support regulatory requirements.
• Serve as technical SME in X-ray and electron diffraction for crystallographic and solid-form characterization of DS and DP; Responsible for PXRD method development for DS and DP, validation/technical transfer packages, and generation of technical data in support regulatory requirements
• Serve as the PXRD expert for supporting solid form screening, identification, crystallinity, and stability studies; perform indexing, Pawley/Le Bail fitting, Rietveld refinement, and structure determination from powder data.
• Perform quantitative phase analysis: Quantify polymorphic and amorphous content in DS and DP using Rietveld, whole-pattern, and multivariate approaches, addressing low drug load, excipient interference, preferred orientation, and micro absorption.
• Apply advanced diffraction such as VT/VH-XRPD, in situ, synchrotron, and PDF analysis to study phase transformations and poorly crystalline/amorphous materials.
• Apply SCXRD and 3D ED/MicroED structure determination, including absolute configuration and crystal packing of APIs, salts, cocrystals, hydrates, and solvates; generate calculated powder patterns and CIF reports.
• Conduct orthogonal solid-state characterization including X-ray diffraction, thermal analysis, moisture sorption, microscopy, spectroscopy as applicable for solid form, impurity and stability studies
• Support solid form control strategies per ICH Q6A, author Module 3 sections and health authority responses, and ensure GMP and data integrity compliance.
• Highly autonomous and productive in performing laboratory work, method development and troubleshoot; processing, interpreting, and visualizing data to facilitate project team decisions
• Represent PAC on CMC teams, lead form-change investigations, mentor scientists, and implement new diffraction technologies.
• Build strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of team to enable higher performance.
• Routinely demonstrate scientific initiative and creativity in research or development activities and maintain a high level of productivity in the lab.
• Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, appropriate handling of materials, controlled drug and radioactive compounds, and GxP compliance, where applicable.

Qualifications:

• Bachelors, Masters, or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Material Science, Physics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field typically with minimum 10 (BS), 8 (MS), or 0 – 2 (Ph.D.) years related industry experience.
• Strong technical background in solid state characterization, excellent analytical problem-solving, communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Capable of independently developing and troubleshoot analytical methods.
• Extensive hands-on PXRD experience, including indexing, Rietveld refinement, QPA, and polymorph and amorphous quantitation.
• Track record of developing and validating PXRD methods for DS and DP in a GMP environment, with knowledge of ICH Q2(R2), Q6A, Q14, and USP <941>.
• Expertise in small molecule SCXRD structure solution and refinement, including disorder modeling and absolute structure; and knowledge of 3D ED/MicroED approaches.
• Proficiency with tools such as Olex2, SHELX, CrysAlisPro, TOPAS, Diffrac Eva and DQuant, GSAS-II, HighScore, Mercury, and the CSD.
• Hands-on experience with DSC, TGA, hot-stage and polarized light microscopy, DVS, and strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
• Experience with Raman/FTIR/NIR, solid-state NMR, SEM, SAXS, micro-CT, and crystal structure prediction, and particle characterization is preferred.
• Experience with AI/ML and data science for automation of phase identification and Rietveld/QPA workflows, chemometrics, and Python or R scripting is preferred.
• Experience with biophysical characterization tools of nanoDSC, DLS, SEC-MALS, CD, AUC, nanoDSF in peptide, LNP and biologic materials, formulations and process characterization is preferred.
• Strong pharmaceutical industry experience in solid state characterization is preferred
• Ability to coordinate activities and work simultaneously on multiple projects, in a global, fast-paced setting where priorities may change quickly.
• High attention to detail and creative problem solving while exhibiting strong interpersonal skills and proven ability to work independently as well as part of cross functional teams
• Knowledge of instrument set-up, troubleshooting, management and maintenance.
• Experience extracting insights from multidimensional data sets, along with other physical analytical characterizations, and connecting to pharmaceutical materials, processes, and products
• Practical knowledge of organic structure, functional groups, chemistry, and modern spectroscopic techniques as applied to small-molecule analytical analysis.
• Create a learning environment, open to suggestions and experimentation for improvement.
• Embrace the ideas of others, nurture innovation and manage innovation to reality.

jobs.title: 2D Pixel Artist
jobs.description:
We’re currently seeking a talented 2D Pixel Artist to help our team on their next adventure. You will join an international and experienced team, contributing to the creation of high-quality visual content for our games.

*Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory. *

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Create high-quality pixel art assets for characters, environments, props, UI assets, and visual effects that align with the game's artistic vision.

• Collaborate closely with Game Designers, Artists, Developers, and other stakeholders to ensure visual consistency and seamless implementation of assets.

• Develop and maintain asset libraries following technical and artistic constraints.

• Produce pixel art sprites, tilesets, icons, and animations while respecting style guides and production pipelines.

• Participate in defining and evolving the visual style of the game through references, mockups, and visual explorations.

• Ensure assets are optimized and ready for implementation in the game.

• Review and provide constructive feedback on internal and external art deliverables.

• Organize and update work and backlog using project management and planning tools.

• Work closely with producers and cross-functional teams to continuously improve visual quality and player experience.

• Support marketing initiatives by creating key visual assets when required.

• Carry out all other related tasks.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

• Fluent English is mandatory for this position.

• BA in Art, Graphic Design, Game Art, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 2+ years of professional experience as a Pixel Artist.

• Strong understanding of pixel art fundamentals, including readability, silhouette, proportion, color theory, and composition.

• Demonstrated experience creating sprites, tilesets, UI assets, and pixel art animations.

• Proficiency with pixel art tools such as Aseprite, Photoshop, Pyxel Edit, or equivalent software.

• Good understanding of animation principles and their application to pixel art.

• Portfolio showcasing high-quality pixel artwork, including environments, characters, props, UI assets, and animations.

• Please include a portfolio showcasing your pixel artwork. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

• Attention to detail and passion for creating polished assets.

• Self-motivated with excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.

• Positive attitude with the ability to receive and provide constructive feedback.

• Strong team player with experience working in Agile development environments.

• Ability to adapt to production needs and balance creativity with technical constraints.

Bonus:

• Experience shipping mobile, PC, or console games.

• Experience working on live games and producing assets within production deadlines.

• Experience creating pixel art assets optimized for different screen sizes and resolutions.

• Experience creating pixel art visual effects (VFX).

• Basic 2D animation experience.

• Experience creating game UI assets.

• Familiarity with retro-inspired and modern pixel art workflows.

• Understanding of asset optimization and game production pipelines.

• Passion for games and knowledge of the gaming industry.

• Spanish or Catalan is a plus.

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)

• Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
• Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
• Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
• Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
• Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
• 5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
• Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
• Life Insurance with AXA.
• Office Gym open from 7 AM to 8 PM
• Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
• Language training for English, Spanish, and French.
• Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
• Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
• Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Alumni Engagement
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Alumni Engagement will build and manage an active and supportive community that strengthens the alumni network through relationship building, volunteer development, alumni services, educational programming and events with the goal of continuous, meaningful alumni engagement.

Reporting to the Vice President, Alumni Engagement, the Senior Manager, Alumni Engagement is responsible for the design, implementation and evaluation of progressive alumni engagement strategies that build enduring and mutually beneficial relationships, inspire loyalty and support, strengthen the institution's reputation and engage our alumni in meaningful activities that advance the institution. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional organizational skills, including expertise in project leadership and relationship management. They will have a demonstrated track record of building and maintaining a robust alumni program and must have the poise and ability to build relationships with multiple constituents, influence action and achieve results.

Responsibilities

• Implement a comprehensive and inclusive alumni strategy that engages alumni and creates rewarding experiences designed to foster lifelong connections between alumni and the institution.
• Develop and deploy activities valued by alumni, including event management, digital platform oversight and volunteer programs with outcomes focused on building relationships and brand loyalty.
• Work across functional areas to identify, recruit and engage alumni in meaningful activities with students, staff and each other to enhance admissions and student success and to advance the institution’s mission.
• Manage alumni engagement in the student experience for student mentorship and prospective student outreach and sourcing alumni speakers for student initiatives.
• Identify, cultivate and steward alumni volunteers. Implement the alumni awards and recognition program.
• Plan, organize and help execute in-person and virtual alumni events such as alumni receptions, reunions, student events, campus visits and conferences.
• Strategize, recommend and implement new tactics and initiatives to increase brand awareness and alumni engagement.
• Partner with Corporate Affairs to share the story of our alumni community.
• Support efforts to accelerate the brand strategy by sourcing and leveraging alumni stories to showcase our global community of lifelong learners.
• Contribute to communications for alumni, including university announcements, eNewsletters, alumni stories and profiles, social media posts and online community group posts and announcements.
• Manage an alumni leadership council/advisory board; design the group’s objectives, host regular meetings (virtual and in-person), record minutes and report on activity and progress to university stakeholders.
• Track alumni engagement and ROI, compile metrics and analytics and prepare progress reports.
• Support efforts to maintain an up-to-date alumni database; provide reporting to university stakeholders when requested.
• Manage budget related to the institution's alumni engagement activities.
• Raise internal awareness of the alumni engagement efforts through project leadership, collaboration and clear articulation of the alumni program's value, benefits and goals.
• Establish and build relationships with institutional alumni and maintain regular communication with them.
• May supervise a Senior Coordinator or Specialist, Alumni Engagement.
• Contribute to Alumni Engagement goals by supporting other duties and projects as needed.

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications or a related field required
• Master's degree preferred
• 7+ years experience in a community relations, marketing or relationship management role
• Previous alumni relations or related community management/higher education experience preferred
• Experience using CRM platforms and/or integrated student information systems preferred (e.g., Banner, HubSpot)
• Proven leadership skills, particularly in starting new initiatives, launching successful direct marketing/outreach programs, fundraising or membership organizing activities.
• Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), database applications and web-based tools.
• Ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines
• Ability to travel 5-6 times per year (valid passport is required for Ross Vet)
• Ability to work occasional weekends and evenings to support alumni events

Actual pay will be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. jobs.title: Industrial Technician - Grand Rapids/Muskegon Area
jobs.description:
JOB POSITION:  Industrial Technician

Are you interested in becoming an experienced Overhead Crane Service Technician? Join Konecranes, one of the world’s largest material handling companies. We're seeking skilled individuals with electrical and mechanical expertise, comfortable working at extreme heights. Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

Education: High School Diploma required. Associate degree in Industrial Electrical and/or Mechanical Technology or related field preferred or equivalent vocational/technical training and experience.

Experience: Minimum one (1) year experience involving electrical troubleshooting and mechanical repair. Some electronic experience but not necessary. Prior experience with cranes is a benefit, but not required.

Other Requirements: Must have and maintain a good driving record, including a valid driver's license. Must be willing to work off the ground. Can work varied overtime, as needed by customer, be available for "on call" as part of the service office rotation and be able to travel and work out of town, on occasion.

Must be able to frequently lift to 25 lbs. Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a daily basis. Must be able to lift to 75 lbs. although not on a daily basis. Must be able to lift 100 lbs. on a rare basis. This position requires frequent climbing, balancing, stooping/crouching, and overhead reaching. This position requires occasional pushing, pulling, kneeling, and crawling. This position will be inside approximately 90% of the time and outside approximately 10% of the time. This position will be frequently exposed to heat, cold, noise and heights.

• This is a safety sensitive position.
• *KCN

What we offer:

Salary: $22 - $48 an hour - Pay is determined based on skills, geographic location, internal equity, market/data analysis, number of years of prior relevant experience, degrees and/or certifications, technical assessment score, etc.

Company Vehicle: Our Service Technicians get a work truck and a gas card to be used for business purposes. Candidates must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Sick Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

Konecranes moves what matters. Konecranes is a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer - Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Disabled/Other Protected Category.

Konecranes, Inc. and its affiliates will not accept resumes from external recruiters or agencies without a Service Agreement and Agency Portal submission. Any resumes sent without a Service Agreement and Agency Portal submission with Konecranes, Inc. are void of any fees and free for internal use. Applicable Konecranes data protection obligations are the responsibility of the agency.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse Hospital At Home In House Registry Days
jobs.description:
The Staff Nurse Inpatient  reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A clinically competent, registered, professional nurse who prescribes, delegates and coordinates nursing care to the acutely ill patient through the nursing process of assessment, planning, intervention, implementation and evaluation.  Effectively interacts with patient, significant others, and other health team members, while maintaining ANA standards of professional nursing practice.

Responsibilities:

• Collects and analyzes data, identifies expected outcomes, develops and implements an individualized plan, coordinates care delivery and evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.
• Directs care and determines the appropriate utilization of any assistant involved in providing direct patient care.
• Collaborates with patient, family, physicians and ancillary staff. Creates a documented plan, focused on outcomes and decisions related to the care and delivery of services that indicates communications with patients, families, and others.
• Participates in shared governance, committee work, and unit projects.
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings.
• Utilizes the best available evidence, including research findings to guide practice decisions.

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)

*Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) acceptable with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.

Licensure:

• Registered Professional Nurse licensure for state working in.
• Additional Requirements for the Hospital at Home & Home Health: At point of hire and annually, required to have a valid driver’s license and an annual driving abstract

Certification:

• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Additional Requirements for the Emergency Room: ACLS, PALS/ENPC & TNCC within one year of hire
• Additional Requirements for the Pediatric Emergency Room: Pediatric Advanced Life Support TNCC within one year of hire
• Additional Requirements for Non-Invasive Cardiology: ACLS
• Additional Preferences for the Emergency Room and the Pediatric Emergency Room: Trauma Nurse Specialist (TNS) Emergency Communications Registered Nurse Certified Pediatric Nurse Certified Emergency Nurse

Experience:

• Preferred: Experience in specific clinical area

Behavioral Attributes:

• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities

Physical Demands:

• Travel required within designated geographic area

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area
• Additional Preferences for the Emergency Room and the Pediatric Emergency Room
• Trauma Nurse Specialist (TNS)
• Emergency Communications Registered Nurse
• Certified Pediatric Nurse
• Certified Emergency Nurse

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Civil Underground Utility Design Engineer
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a highly motivated Civil Underground Utility Design Engineer to support the planning, design, coordination, and implementation of underground utility infrastructure projects. This role is primarily a civil engineering position focused on underground pathway design, utility corridors, duct banks, utility crossings, and associated civil infrastructure.

The successful candidate will have practical experience developing buildable underground utility designs for electric, water, wastewater, telecommunications, or other buried infrastructure systems. Telecommunications experience is helpful but not required. The strongest fit is a civil design professional with hands-on experience creating underground pathway layouts, reviewing plan-and-profile drawings, coordinating utility conflicts, and supporting permitting and construction delivery.

This is a fully remote position requiring collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams, utility owners, permitting agencies, municipalities, transportation agencies, and construction personnel across multiple geographic regions.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

Underground Utility Infrastructure Design

• Develop and review civil engineering designs for underground utility systems and utility corridor projects. Design underground pathways, duct banks, trenches, utility crossings, access structures, conduit systems, and related civil infrastructure.
• Evaluate utility routes and develop buildable alignments for greenfield and brownfield projects.
• Incorporate utility conflicts, right-of-way constraints, environmental considerations, agency requirements, and permitting conditions into design solutions.
• Prepare construction drawings, plan-and-profile sheets, details, specifications, exhibits, and permit packages.
• Support utility relocation planning, pathway optimization, and coordination between proposed and existing infrastructure.

Civil 3D Design and Engineering

• Modeling Use Autodesk Civil 3D to develop and review alignments, profiles, surfaces, corridors, grading, utility layouts, and civil design models.
• Generate and validate plan-and-profile drawings, utility exhibits, quantity takeoffs, design calculations, and project deliverables.
• Analyze conflicts between proposed underground utility pathways and existing subsurface or above-ground infrastructure.
• Integrate survey data, GIS information, LiDAR, utility records, as-builts, and field information into engineering models.
• Support digital engineering workflows and model-based delivery practices.

Engineering Review and Quality Assurance

• Perform technical reviews of civil utility design packages and engineering deliverables.
• Verify compliance with client standards, utility owner requirements, agency criteria, and industry best practices.
• Review depth of cover, utility separations, crossings, access spacing, corridor configurations, constructability, and maintainability.
• Identify design risks, utility conflicts, constructability issues, and deficiencies, and provide clear recommendations for resolution.
• Support quality management reviews and continuous improvement of design delivery standards.

Utility Coordination and Permitting

• Coordinate with utility owners, municipalities, transportation agencies, permitting authorities, and project stakeholders.
• Support utility conflict resolution, utility relocation planning, and agency coordination throughout design and construction.
• Assist with permit applications, design exhibits, agency comments, and regulatory review responses. Participate in design review meetings, utility coordination meetings, and constructability workshops.

Construction and Implementation

• Support Provide engineering support during construction and implementation activities.
• Review contractor RFIs, submittals, field modifications, and change requests.
• Evaluate field conditions and recommend practical civil engineering solutions.
• Support as-built documentation, redline review, and project closeout activities.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline plus 2 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Experience with Autodesk Civil 3D is required.
• Experience developing civil engineering plans or underground utility designs.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.
• Experience designing underground utility pathways, utility corridors, duct banks, utility crossings, utility relocations, or buried infrastructure systems.
• Background in civil infrastructure, electric distribution, water/wastewater utilities, municipal utilities, transportation utilities, telecommunications, or other utility design environments.
• Strong working knowledge of Autodesk Civil 3D, AutoCAD, ArcGIS, Bluebeam Revu, Bentley OpenRoads, or similar engineering platforms.
• Experience interpreting engineering drawings, specifications, survey data, utility records, and construction documents.
• Working knowledge of utility coordination, right-of-way requirements, permitting processes, and agency review procedures.
• Experience performing utility conflict analysis, subsurface utility coordination, constructability reviews, quantity takeoffs, and cost estimating.
• Familiarity with DOT requirements, utility accommodation policies, municipal design standards, and common underground utility design practices.
• Experience supporting transportation, municipal, utility, industrial, energy, data center, broadband, or large infrastructure projects.
• Telecommunications or fiber optic OSP design experience.

• Sponsorship is not available for this role now or in the future.
• Relocation is not available for this role.
