jobs.title: Registered Nurse-Hospital At Home Full Time Days
jobs.description:
The Home Hospital RN reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Registered Nurse embodies the attributes of the Relationship Based Care model and performs to PPM core functions. Under the direction of the department leadership, consistently reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the State of Illinois Nurse Practice Act, the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Home Hospital Nurse treats acutely ill patients in the home as a substitute for in-hospital care. The Home Hospital Nurse is a forward-thinking, creative individual who wants to practice in an innovative clinical setting and values interdisciplinary teamwork and patient-centered care. The Nurse will provide hospital-level acute care in a patient’s home and will be part of the NM Hospital at Home team including (depending on each patient’s needs) Physicians, Paramedics, Advanced Practice Providers, Pharmacists, Case Managers, Social Workers, Home Health Aides, Physical Therapists, and other operational staff. Provides home visits within defined radius around site hospitals according to Hospital at Home care Model

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Care Coordination

• Performs a comprehensive assessment on all assigned patients as evidenced by completed documentation.
• Communicates changes in patient’s condition promptly.
• Utilizes appropriate nursing diagnosis and data from the assessment to derive realistic outcomes and documents them as measurable goals on the plan of care; modifies care plan, if indicated, in order to identify realistic patient goals.
• Identifies and prioritizes patient needs and/or nursing diagnosis for patients and documents.
• Collaborates with patient, family, and other members of the health care team when planning patient care and documents accordingly. Assesses patients with regard to discharge planning and makes the appropriate referrals as necessary.
• Evaluates and documents the patient response to nursing interventions and alters the plan of care as necessary.
• Assesses patients with regard to discharge planning and makes the appropriate referrals as necessary, including palliative care.
• Assures completed discharge instructions, medication reconciliation and provide information to patient/family regarding the use of the patient portal and other pertinent resources.

Patient Education/Ethic and Diversity

• Supports patient/family/spiritual/cultural needs when assessing the patient and family needs for teaching; identifies the patient's learning level and readiness, and documents education record.
• Utilizes the teach back methodology for advancing patient education about medication side effects and new medication education.
• Utilizes and distributes Krames for patient education /clinical condition.
• Utilizes culture vision as a resource in care planning and delivery.
• Treats patients, families and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity.
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care.
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice.
• Calls for an ethics consult when appropriate.

EBP and Research

• Implements nursing interventions consistent with the established plan of care based on evidenced based care.
• Maintains and advances the professional image and science of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through use of best available evidence utilizing resources such as Ovid/Joanna Briggs, Up to Date, Culture Vision, and other reliable sources of evidence.
• Demonstrates active involvement in clinical LADDER project or process improvement at the unit/organization level.

Healing Safe Environment

• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Conveys complete, timely, and accurate information at bedside shift report/hand-off
• Rounds hourly in collaboration with patient care technician

• Participates as a unit safety facilitator or as identified resource for quality initiatives as requested
• Participates in unit huddles

Relationship to Colleagues

Shared Leadership

• Demonstrates effective interpersonal skills in leading and directing others; deals with conflict directly and appropriately.
• Demonstrates proficiency in the charge nurse/preceptor role when assigned; assumes responsibility for coordinating patient care for the entire unit.
• Takes the clinical lead when patient’s condition changes and confers with the primary care physician about the appropriate treatment plan or the need to transfer to the appropriate level of care.
• Serves as a resource and role model for new staff, students, and other system personnel
• Assists with precepting, unit orientation, and mentoring as requested.
• Participates in the peer evaluation process by providing feedback to colleagues on a regular basis, and through participation in clinical case peer review.
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to responsibly accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence.
• Identifies barriers to effective clinical practice and communicates to nursing leadership and practice operations council.

Resource Utilization

• Ensures an appropriate level of care order is documented in the EMR for all admissions.
• Understands and adheres to the charging of supplies.
• Participates in any value-based unit/organizational initiative.
• Demonstrates a personal commitment to decreasing utilization overtime hours.

Use of Technology

• Assures all electronic and paper documentation is complete.
• Utilizes the guardrails for the Alaris pump.
• Understands physiologic monitoring and the implications to drive changes to clinical management of the patient.
• Utilizes the bed management system
• Identifies new technologies for unit, hospital or system use.
• Participates in CEOC activities for the advancement and optimization of the medical record as requested.

Relationship to Self

Professional Practice

• Attends internal professional development offerings i.e. Schwartz Rounds, Nursing Grand Rounds.
• Obtains certification in the nursing specialty of practice.
• Demonstrates accountability for his/her professional practice-competencies, ELM learning, dress code adherence
• Participates in professional organization through membership, leadership, or committee work
• Takes assigned lunch breaks.

Required:

• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Minimum of one-year of recent nursing experience in acute or emergency setting
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities

• At point of hire and annually, required to have a valid driver’s license and an annual driving abstract

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join our Rexel USA team in Augusta, GA!

Summary:

The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for providing experienced quality assurance support to the commercial and local branch teams. Apply process improvement methodologies and quality assurance tools to improve customer service, supplier productivity, quality, cycle, and delivery performance within an ISO/NQA-1 based Quality Management System (QMS). Support direct contact with some of the largest customers and/or suppliers in several key vertical segments. The Quality Engineer will provide training and coaching with in the quality organization.

What You'll Do:

• Develop, review, and maintain nuclear quality assurance manuals, procedures, and work instructions in compliance with ASME NQA-1
• Plan and lead internal quality audits, supplier/vendor evaluations, and external/NUPIC-style audits
• Review technical specifications, material test reports (MTRs), calibration records, and non-destructive examination reports
• Develop and drive process consistency to ensure compliance with sourcing quality and qualification requirements
• Execute continuous improvement projects to reduce defects and cycle time and improve fulfilment
• Assist in developing and implementing ISO compliant processes for applicable business functions
• Conduct process audits and manage regulatory compliance requirements
• Drive customer quality improvements utilizing the quality dashboard metrics
• Manage non-conforming material, customer complaint, and corrective/preventive action processes
• Prepare sound responses to customer-issued corrective actions
• Lead internal and support external ISO audits
• Lead cost of quality reduction initiative for given area of responsibility
• Lead and track supplier/part qualifications and surveillance activities for assigned commodities or segments
• Collaborate with Sales and Procurement to obtain necessary vendor compliance information (i.e. REACH, RoHS)
• Monitor supplier performance to identify and drive process improvement, manage root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action implementation
• Partner with procurement to establish methods of evaluating existing suppliers and approve potential suppliers through various assessment screens and quality metrics
• Work with external customers, internal customers, and business leadership as needed to meet goals and communicate performance

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Be able to rigging/skinning with low to medium polygon counts.
• Take active part in the game creation process by interacting with the design team.
• Contribute effectively to the art pipeline while understanding target platform constraints.
• Have a strong time management skills to reach project deadlines/milestones.
• Collaborate with the rest of the Art Team to obtain a consistent visual style for the game.
• Work with the Programming Team to integrate your animations in the game while respecting technical constraints.

PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS

In order for your application to be considered, you must submit a portfolio or other samples of your work. All portfolios must contain a detailed shot breakdown of the work. It must be very clear what you, the applicant, are responsible for in your reel, screenshots, scanned pictures, web page portfolio, etc.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Examples of basic cycles of a character. Cycle of walk, run, idle, attack, jump, etc.
• Examples of physics of movement. It can be a character doing parkour, moving weight, a skateboarder, etc.
• Examples of combination of cycles. Idle + attack, idle + run + attack, etc.
• It would also be interesting if among all the examples there is some quadrupeds, or characters of more than two feet.

• At least 4 or more years of experience in 3D Studio Max, Maya or Blender.
• Have a clear understanding of character motion, camera movement, physics-based motion and of the fundamental principles of animation.
• Be able to define and execute creative and stylish animations (vehicles, objects, characters).
• Positive attitude with the ability to receive and provide objective feedback
• Be a team player: we use agile development methods, where the team members are in permanent contact. Open mind and good communication skills are a must.
• Attention to detail, meticulous and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and to adapt easily to change.
• Good command of English.
• Work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is a must.

Bonus

• Solid background in academic drawing, sketching and/or illustration.
• Working Unity experience.
• Have modelling skills (2D/3D), knowledge and experience of Blender, Unity, particle effects creation programs (e.g. combustion, particle illusion, Fork) and motion graphics programs (eg After Effects).
• Experience working on mobile games.
• Passion for games and some knowledge of the games industry.
• Spanish or Catalan is a plus.

Manufacturing equipment and processes require a high degree of specialized attention around the clock. The primary objective is to maximize efficiency and prevent any interruption of production by achieving control over the systems the manufacturing cycle depends on. Primarily these systems include facility, equipment, utility, and controls. These systems are maintained and continually improved by Engineer Technician I’s. They also contribute to the design of products and processes. The role will provide technical support for industrial automation and controls systems, including PLCs, HMIs, Vision systems, and associated manufacturing equipment, with a focus on troubleshooting and minimizing production downtime.

Responsibilities

• Works in an independent manner under the guidance of a supervisor or technical lead. Assignments have clear and specified objectives and require the investigation of a limited number of variables. Examples of supporting assignments include: system maintenance, equipment or process design and development, validation of equipment, materials and processes, preparation of specifications.
• Complies with applicable policies and procedures, regulatory and safety requirements.
• Provides technical service. Daily monitoring and troubleshooting of assigned systems. Troubleshoots industrial automation and control systems, including PLCs, HMIs, sensors, instrumentation, Vision systems, and associated equipment. Expected to recommend improvements in design, installation, start-up or execution of a project or task as well as the maintenance of a program.
• Maintains documentation, monitoring logs, Best Operating Practices (BOPs), training manuals, etc. for regulatory compliance. Assists in the implementation of long-term projects to maintain efficiency.
• Assists operations in the process of troubleshooting to determine potential impacts on production and facility systems.
• Exchanges information with project team members, designers, management, and other engineering or production personnel. Delivers recommendations and suggestions to project team members and management within the department.
• Provides limited technical assistance and information to production, engineering groups and outside consultants, contractors, and various departments within the Company.
• Participates and/or assists engineers in the design of process equipment or systems for optimal performance. Assists in the start-up of new and troubleshoots existing facilities/equipment to ensure optimal operation and performance. Supports the installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automation and controls equipment and systems.
• Identifies issues and implements troubleshooting techniques necessary to avoid production downtime. Closely monitors systems as assigned for potential issues and/or improvements. Utilizes PLC diagnostics, HMI information, electrical drawings, and equipment documentation to identify and resolve automation-related issues.
• Responds to requests, evaluates problems, determines causes and communicates and implements solutions in the most efficient manner.

• High School/GED is required. Technical school completion/certification preferred.
• At least 5 years prior technical experience in area(s) of specialty with basic knowledge of systems described.
• Working knowledge of PLC-based control systems, preferably Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation or Siemens platforms.

Business Unit/Department: South
Location: Afton, TX /On-site
Reports to:  Project Executive
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As a Senior Project Manager (PM) at Loenbro, you will be an essential part of our project team leading the delivery of next generation hyperscale and AI data center campuses supporting cloud, AI, and high-performance computing workloads. This role provides full lifecycle ownership of mission-critical infrastructure projects from site development through commissioning and turnover along with successful execution of several projects. You’ll work closely with the Project Executive, Field Leadership, and customers, gaining valuable experience and contributing to the project’s overall success.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Project Planning and Initiation: Collaborate with clients, engineers, and stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables. Develop comprehensive project plans, schedules, and budgets to ensure successful project execution. Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies.

• Team Management: Build and lead project teams, including electricians, technicians, and subcontractors. Assign tasks, set clear expectations, and monitor team performance to ensure project objectives are met. Foster a collaborative and productive work environment.

• Resource Allocation: Coordinate and allocate necessary resources, including materials, equipment, and personnel, to meet project requirements. Manage procurement and vendor relationships to ensure timely delivery of materials and services.

• Project Execution and Monitoring: Supervise all aspects of project execution, ensuring adherence to safety protocols and quality standards. Monitor project progress, budget, and timelines, and take proactive measures to address any issues or deviations. Regularly communicate project status to clients and stakeholders.

• Change Management: Handle project changes and scope adjustments efficiently, ensuring minimal impact on project timelines and costs. Document and communication changes to all relevant parties.

• Quality Assurance: Implement quality control procedures to guarantee the highest standards of workmanship and safety. Conduct inspections and ensure compliance with relevant electrical codes and regulations.

• Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, reports, and records. Prepare and deliver regular progress reports to management and clients.

• Project Closure: Conduct project reviews to evaluate performance against project objectives and client expectations. Ensure all project deliverables are completed, and necessary documentation is provided to clients. Prepare and submit final project reports and invoices.

Skills

• Strong knowledge of electrical systems, codes, and regulations.

• Proficiency in project management software and tools.

• Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously, change order requests, scheduling, take-off meetings, and client communication.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

• Commitment to safety and quality standards.

Qualifications

Required:

• 7+ years of proven experience as a Project Manager in the Electrical Data Center construction industry or large-scale industrial facilities required.

• Applicants with a Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or related field are encouraged to apply.

• Applicants with a National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 70E or OSHA Certification are encouraged to apply.

• Applicants with prior experience utilizing PM software and tools such as Bluebeam, Procore, Accubid, and Primavera P6 are encouraged to apply.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Ability to safely walk and navigate active job sites, including uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and other jobsite access points.

• On-site, indoor office setting with controlled temperature.

• Frequent visits to outdoor construction sites with exposure to weather extremes.

• Potential exposure to noise, dust, chemicals, or other environmental factors.

• Ability to work outside and at the job site most of the time is required.

• Ability to travel up to 10%, as needed.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Financial Account Management
jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

The Sr. Director, Financial Account Management is the enterprise leader responsible for advancing Financial Account Management across all of Covista's institutions, with accountability for in-school and out-of-school collections, third-party billing, employer reimbursement, and Payment & Account Services (PAS). This leader will define and execute the strategy for modernizing how we support students in understanding and meeting their financial obligations, while strengthening cash collections, reducing preventable bad debt, and driving consistent, effective account-management operations across the enterprise. Success in this role requires a strong combination of enterprise strategy, analytics, operational excellence, and cross-functional leadership. The Sr. Director will partner across Enrollment, Advising, Finance, Student Finance, Technology, and other key functions to identify opportunities, evaluate performance and external drivers, and translate insights into scalable strategies and practical actions that improve both student and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Own the enterprise collections strategy for active and former students across all five institutions, including segmentation, outreach, payment options, account resolution, escalation paths, and third-party agency performance.

• Build a clear performance framework for collections. Define KPIs that measure what the operation can influence, such as contactability, promise-to-pay conversion and kept rate, liquidation and recovery rates, payment-plan performance, cure rates, aging movement, productivity, and channel effectiveness.

• Partner with Finance and institutional leaders to connect operational collection trends to receivables and bad-debt performance while separating controllable execution from factors such as student credit profile, program mix, persistence, forecasting assumptions, and the macroeconomic environment.

• Improve the student financial journey by partnering with Enrollment, Advising, and Student Finance to surface affordability challenges earlier, strengthen financial-readiness conversations, and reduce balances that become difficult to resolve.

• Lead third-party billing and employer reimbursement operations, improving billing accuracy, timeliness, collections, reconciliation, aging visibility, and the experience for students, sponsors, employers, and institutional partners.

• Lead PAS (Payment & Account Services), establishing consistent standards for payment processing, account support, issue resolution, and service quality.

• Use data, experimentation, and technology to continually improve collections strategies, including prioritization, messaging, channel mix, workflow, automation, vendor capabilities, and colleague productivity.

• Establish an enterprise operating rhythm with dashboards, performance reviews, root-cause analysis, and action plans that create transparency and accountability across institutions.

• Lead, develop, and organize high-performing teams with clear goals, strong coaching, thoughtful capacity planning, and a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and student-centered problem solving.

• Ensure collection, billing, payment, and account-management practices operate within applicable institutional policies, consumer-protection requirements, and other relevant compliance standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Complies with all policies and standards

• Bachelor's Degree Required, Master's Degree Preferred
• 10+ years progressive leadership experience in collections, accounts receivable, consumer finance, financial operations, servicing, billing, or a related field, including leadership of sizable operational teams. Required
• Demonstrated success improving collection performance, reducing delinquency or bad debt, and building measurable operating strategies. Required
• Experience leading through a complex, matrixed organization and influencing partners outside of your direct reporting structure. Required
• Experience with third-party billing, employer or sponsor billing, payment operations, or comparable receivables processes strongly preferred. Required
• Strong analytical fluency with experience defining KPIs, interpreting portfolio and operational performance, and turning data into decisions.
• Ability to balance financial outcomes with a respectful, student-centered approach to account resolution.
• Strong executive communication, change leadership, and talent-development skills.
• Demonstrated experience leading large-scale functions with autonomy, facilitating execution across multiple departments, key stakeholders, and institutions to achieve strategic objectives
• Continuously innovate and improve operations and student service functions in order to drive quality, process and outcome improvement
• Able to build and communicate a persuasive business case to stakeholders within a complex matrix environment
• Able to generate and analyze data and present a synthesis of findings and recommendations to influence change and drive achievement of organizational and institutional objectives
• Displays strong strategic-planning skills, accompanied with exceptional business acumen
• Foster a strong culture of care, service, academic excellence and integrity
• Highly skilled people leader with proven track record of great selection and development of talent

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected salary range for this position is between $137,847.00 and $249,126.75. Actual pay will be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements. The position qualifies for the below benefits.

Covista offers a robust suite of benefits including:

• Health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance
• 401k Retirement Program + 6% employer match
• Participation in Covista’s Flexible Time Off (FTO) Policy
• 12 Paid Holidays

For more information related to our benefits please visit:  https://careers.covista.com/benefits

You are also eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

jobs.title: 1:1 Personal Aid
jobs.description:
Job Overview

A family is hiring a 1:1 Personal Aide for their adult family member who attends The Helix Adult Academy (THAA) in San Rafael, CA, a post-secondary program for adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities. The aide will work on-site at THAA during program hours to help the student participate in classes and activities as fully and independently as possible. This role involves hands-on personal care, including support with eating, toileting, and mobility throughout the day.

The aide is employed directly by the family and reports to them. While on-site, the aide must adhere to all THAA policies, procedures, and staff directives, collaborating cooperatively with the Program Director and instructional team. By providing consistent daily support, the aide will learn the student’s communication style, preferences, and success strategies to deliver steady, respectful, and individualized care.

Note: This position covers personal care and learning environment support. It does not provide Adaptive Skills Training or execute individualized adaptive skills plans.

Duties

 - Help the student with eating and drinking at meals and snack times

 - Help the student with toileting and personal hygiene in a way that protects their privacy and dignity

 - Help with mobility, positioning, and moving around campus, including transfers when needed

 - Encourage the student to do as much for themselves as they safely can

Learning and Participation Support

 - Give one-on-one support to the student throughout the program day, including classes, breaks, lunch, and transitions

 - Help the student follow classroom routines, directions, and schedules, prompting them when needed

 - Reinforce what instructors teach and help the student stay engaged and organized during lessons and activities

 - Encourage positive social interactions with classmates, staff, and community members

 - Use calm, consistent, positive approaches to help the student manage stress, frustration, or changes in routine

Safety and Communication

 - Keep the student safe and supervised at all times, following all THAA policies, safety/emergency procedures, and staff directives

 - Keep daily records of personal care, observations, and notable events to share with the family

 - Share relevant information with the Program Director or instructional team when site assistance is required

 - Maintain open communication with the family regarding the student's day and any concerns

 - Uphold student and family confidentiality while treating the student with dignity and respect at all times

Qualifications

 - Required: Minimum of 1 year of direct service experience working with individuals with autism, intellectual or developmental disabilities, or other special needs

 - Direct experience providing personal care, including help with eating, toileting, hygiene, and mobility transfers

 - Knowledge of special education principles, positive behavior support strategies, or a background in behavioral health/social services preferred

 - Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with the student, family, and THAA staff

 - Patience, flexibility, good judgment, and the ability to maintain a calm presence when challenging situations arise

 - Reliable, punctual, and committed to consistent daily attendance

 - Physically able to execute mobility support, transfers, and remain active throughout the program day

 - Verifiable background check required

Schedule

 - Hours: 30 hours per week

 - Location: On-site at The Helix Adult Academy (San Rafael, CA)

 - Shift Times: Monday through Thursday, 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM

Pay: $35.00 - $37.50 per hour

Ability to Commute:

 - San Rafael, CA 94901 (Required)

jobs.title: Research & Development Intern
jobs.description:
Legend Biotech is a global biotechnology company dedicated to treating and, one day, curing life-threatening diseases. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, we are advancing the next generation of cell therapy through a portfolio of innovative technologies, including autologous, allogeneic, and in vivo cell therapy approaches. Our research spans chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T), T-cell receptor (TCR-T), natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies, and other emerging platforms designed to transform the treatment of serious diseases. From our global network of research and development sites, we are committed to discovering and developing safe, effective, and cutting-edge therapies for patients worldwide.

Legend Biotech entered into a global collaboration agreement with Johnson & Johnson to jointly develop and commercialize CARVYKTI® (ciltacabtagene autoleucel; cilta-cel). Through this strategic partnership, we combine complementary expertise and capabilities to advance innovative immunotherapies for patients living with multiple myeloma.

Legend Biotech is seeking a Research and Development Intern as part of the Novel Car Design R&D team based in Somerset, NJ.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Research and Development Intern to join the Novel Car Design R&D team. This internship will focus on advancing our assessment of in vivo CAR T cell platform. This role will provide hands-on experience in preclinical research and adoptive cell therapy, providing the intern with the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge experiments and data analysis that drive innovation in our research program.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in the execution of laboratory experiments, including mammalian cell culture, virus preparation, and immunological and biochemical assays.

• Perform transfections for virus production and assess viral titers using flow cytometry–based and ELISA-based assays.

• Conduct PBMC transduction and perform immunoassays to screen and validate candidates with improved efficacy and safety profiles.

• Perform cytotoxicity assays, immunophenotyping, and cytokine analyses.

• Maintain accurate and detailed records of experimental procedures, data, and observations in laboratory notebooks.

• Analyze experimental data and prepare summaries and reports for team discussions.

• Collaborate with senior scientists and team members to troubleshoot, optimize, and refine experimental protocols.

• Candidate is encouraged to provide technical approaches and troubleshooting strategies, but all experimental plans, data interpretation, and project-related decisions require review and approval by the manager or designated mentor.

• Decisions regarding project scope, timelines, resource allocation, and overall strategic direction remain under management oversight and are aligned with overall business pipeline priorities.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled (Will not have graduated during summer of 2027) in an university with Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D program in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Immunology, or a related field.

• Preferred to have basic laboratory skills with some hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture (immune cells) and other standard molecular biology techniques, including flow cytometry, qPCR/ddPCR, ELISA, and immunoassays. The ideal candidate would also have some cellular therapy experience.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving, and organizational abilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Works well independently while thriving in a collaborative team environment.

• Prefer the candidate to have some knowledge of data analysis tools such as Microsoft Office (Excel, Powerpoint), Graphpad Prism.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Patrianna

Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.

Design, build, and manage advanced data systems that turn raw player data into actionable insights, powering personalized gaming experiences for millions.

The Project Manager will lead high-impact initiatives involving AI enablement, business process transformation, automation, employee productivity solutions, digital capabilities, data-driven decision-making, and organizational change management. jobs.title: Chief Treasurer
jobs.description:
At Woolpert, you’ll do work that matters.

As a leading global architecture, engineering, and geospatial firm, we help clients solve complex challenges that shape communities, strengthen critical infrastructure, advance technology, and improve the world around us. Here, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, tackle meaningful projects, and build a career defined by growth, opportunity, and impact.

Position Overview

Woolpert is hiring a Global Treasurer to join our dynamic Finance & Support team in the United States. This position reports to the Chief Financial Officer and will be responsible to set the direction and vision for the global treasury function for Woolpert at the corporate level, establish the strategy for cash and liquidity management, capital structure, foreign exchange risk, and treasury operations across all U.S. and international operating entities, in alignment with financial policies and strategies developed with the Chief Financial Officer. The Global Treasurer will serve as the executive treasury partner to the Chief Financial Officer, the Chief Accounting Officer, and the company's private equity sponsors, recommending and deploying capital to fund organic growth and a high-volume acquisition program. Global Treasurer will build and govern a scalable, institutional-grade treasury infrastructure, including the selection and implementation of an enterprise Treasury Management System and the integration of newly acquired companies into global banking, liquidity, and control frameworks.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.  Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

• Sets the vision, strategy, and operating model for the global treasury function at the corporate level across all corporate and operating entities in the United States, Ireland, the United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, India, and South Africa.

• Works closely with the Chief Financial Officer and Chief Accounting Officer to develop financial policies and strategies, and advises the Chief Financial Officer and private equity sponsors on optimizing the capital structure, managing debt leverage, directing credit facility drawdowns, and securing funding for domestic and international acquisitions.

• Directs global cash and liquidity management, including multi-currency cash pooling, in-house banking, and intercompany net settlement across USD, GBP, EUR, AUD, JPY, SGD, MYR, INR, and ZAR.

• Establishes cash forecasting and working capital strategies that balance project based payroll and billing cycles with capital deployment requirements for acquisitions.

• Designs and executes tax-efficient cash repatriation and intercompany funding strategies in alignment with corporate accounting policy and local statutory rules, including those of India, South Africa, and Malaysia. Determines the credit needs of the organization and makes arrangements for funds.

• Directs the selection, implementation, and global roll-out of an enterprise Treasury Management System to replace fragmented legacy systems, including decisions resulting from the in-flight global treasury request for proposal.

• Integrates newly acquired operating companies into consolidated banking, liquidity, and internal control frameworks, and coordinates with accounting leadership on purchase accounting mechanics, debt facility classification, and transition of opening balance sheet cash.

• Establishes standardized global treasury policies, workflows, and internal controls across a decentralized network of operating companies, and delegates authority for receipt, disbursement, banking, credit, and other financial transactions.

• Develops and manages foreign exchange and interest rate risk mitigation programs that protect cross-border project margins and earnings from currency and rate volatility.

• Rationalizes the global banking footprint, maintaining relationships with banks, rating agencies, and insurance companies and consolidating strategic relationships with top-tier institutions to reduce transaction friction and fee structures.

• Delivers weekly and monthly treasury reporting to executive leadership and private equity sponsors, monitors expenditures, and maintains compliance with debt covenants and leverage thresholds.

• Ensures compliance with U.S. and international banking and financial regulations, including FBAR, FATCA, anti-money laundering requirements, and local statutory regimes such as Reserve Bank of India guidelines and South African Reserve Bank regulations.

• Supports global corporate risk management and insurance programs, including professional liability (errors and omissions), international project risk, and asset protection coverage.

• Leads, develops, and mentors treasury staff and cross-functional finance teams through system migrations and operating model changes, including hiring, performance management, and pay decisions for the treasury organization.

What You Will Bring:

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• 15 years of progressive corporate treasury experience, including experience as a Treasurer or Assistant Treasurer.

• Experience leading treasury operations for a multi-national organization with multi currency cash, liquidity, and foreign exchange exposure.

• Experience managing debt facilities, covenant compliance, and capital structure in a leveraged or private equity-backed environment.

• Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including treasury integration of acquired entities.

• Expert knowledge of global cash management, liquidity structures, cash pooling, in house banking, and intercompany funding.

• Advanced knowledge of foreign exchange and interest rate hedging strategies and related accounting implications.

• Knowledge of U.S. and international banking and financial regulations, including FBAR, FATCA, and anti-money laundering requirements.

• Ability to set strategy and direction for a global function at the corporate level and translate it into standardized policies, controls, and workflows.

• Ability to build and present treasury reporting and analysis to executive leadership, lenders, and investors.

• Ability to lead organizational change, including system implementations and operating model transitions.

• Strong negotiation skills with banking and financial partners.

• Effective communication and collaboration skills across multiple countries, time zones, and cultures.

PREFERRED EDUCATION:

• Master's degree or higher in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

• Experience in a private equity-backed organization with a high-volume acquisition program.

• Experience with cash management, tax, and currency repatriation requirements in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, India, and South Africa.

• Experience leading an enterprise Treasury Management System implementation, such as Kyriba or GTreasury.

• Experience in a project-based or professional services business model, such as architecture, engineering, geospatial, or consulting.

• Experience with corporate insurance programs, including professional liability and international project risk coverage.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, OR TRAINING: (if applicable)

• Certified Treasury Professional (CTP).

• Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA).

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

• Knowledge of purchase accounting mechanics and opening balance sheet cash transition for acquired entities.

• Knowledge of treasury practices in decentralized, multi-entity operating environments.

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including:

• Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate).

• Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.

• Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team.

• Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries.

• Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases.

• Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more!

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation and ABM Manager, Americas
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Demand Generation and ABM Manager, Americas, you will be tasked with owning pipeline performance across segments in AMER, from first signal of intent through acquisition, close and expansion, as a strategic builder who can read a funnel, find where it leaks and turn that insight into programs that convert. You will pair rigorous pipeline inspection and ICP discipline with a modular program architecture that Regional Marketing Leaders can pick up, adapt and activate in their markets at speed, while coordinating with Global Digital Marketing and Global Integrated Marketing so regional programs mirror global plays and receive the right amplification. You are the center of gravity for segment demand excellence in the region, working in close partnership with Sales, SDRs, Partner Marketing, Global Marketing and Regional Marketing Leaders, and keeping a structured feedback loop with the region so programs stay grounded in market reality.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Inspect the funnel with rigor from MQL through SAL and SQO to Closed Won, by segment and channel, identifying where leads stall, where conversion underperforms and where pipeline is leaking; distinguish sourced from influenced pipeline, and flag data-quality and attribution gaps before drawing conclusions or setting baselines.

• Run a regular inspection cadence with Sales, SDRs and Regional Marketing Leaders, and translate findings into clear optimization and planning inputs; analyze performance across the full customer lifecycle, from net new acquisition through pipeline acceleration, close and expansion.

• Run structured gap analysis on coverage, conversion, program mix and account engagement against pipeline targets, and prioritize the highest-impact gaps to close; design lifecycle and expansion plays that grow revenue in the existing customer base in partnership with Sales and Customer Success, using the right triggers, messages and motions for each segment.

• Develop, maintain and regularly refresh the ICP and target account framework for the assigned segments, using firmographic, technographic, behavioral and intent data; measure ICP strength by testing how well program targeting, account selection and pipeline outcomes align to the ICP, and recommend changes where they diverge; scrutinize account selection for programs deployed in the region so targeting is intent-driven and ICP-aligned before execution begins.

• Build and maintain a modular program library of repeatable, plug-and-play plays, including always-on automated engines, vertical activations, nurture sequences, pipeline acceleration and flagship programs; make the library visible and actively socialized so adoption is pull, not push, and so Regional Marketing Leaders can deploy proven plays without rebuilding from scratch; hand off logistics and execution to the Regional Marketing Manager once programs are ready to scale.

• Run a structured cadence with Regional Marketing Leaders to present new programs, gather field intelligence on what is and is not working, and prioritize the next development cycle; build partner leverage into program design from the outset, working with Partner Marketing to integrate partner-led and partner-assisted motions rather than bolting them on later.

• Partner with Global Digital Marketing and Global Campaigns so regional programs mirror global campaign frameworks and receive the right paid, digital and intent-driven amplification; coordinate regional input into global plans and ensure global assets, plays and timelines are translated into programs Regional Marketing Leaders can use; collaborate on always-on, automated demand engines, including marketing automation, personalization, content syndication and paid digital.

• Join SDR briefing calls ahead of each program deployment to set expectations, monitor conversion against KPIs, and convene the team quickly to diagnose, adjust and capture learnings when execution falls short.

• Feed program performance data into the consolidated reporting framework owned by the Marketing Program Manager, covering pipeline contribution, account engagement, funnel progression and ROI; champion a test-and-learn culture, running structured experiments across channels, messages and tactics and sharing insights with the wider team and global stakeholders.

• Deliver a weekly report to the AVP and Americas Marketing leadership on program health, covering pipeline contribution, funnel conversion and performance against plan, with the specific actions needed, owners and timing for any program that is off track.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• Proven experience in B2B demand generation, integrated marketing or lifecycle marketing, ideally in technology or cybersecurity, with a clear record of pipeline contribution and measurable ROI rather than activity metrics.

• Strong analytical capability, including hands-on experience inspecting funnel data from MQL to closed won, diagnosing conversion gaps and turning findings into prioritized actions.

• Deep understanding of ICP definition, account segmentation and prioritization, and how to apply firmographic, technographic, behavioral and intent data to guide targeting and personalization.

• Experience building modular, repeatable campaign plays and program frameworks that can be scaled and localized across markets, with a demonstrated ability to drive adoption across distributed field teams.

• Experience with always-on, automated demand programs and the supporting stack, including marketing automation, nurture, paid digital, retargeting and content syndication.

• Experience coordinating with global digital and campaign teams to translate global frameworks into regional execution.

• Experience working with partner ecosystems and integrating partner-led and partner-assisted motions into demand and expansion programs.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Sales, SDR, Customer Success, partner and global teams without direct authority and maintain effective feedback loops with the field.

• Organization and an execution focus, with the ability to manage multiple programs and priorities, and comfort working in agile, OKR-driven and matrixed organizations.

• The ability to deliver the outcomes this role is measured on, including segment pipeline contribution that is on plan and growing with a data-backed view of where it comes from, what drives it and what is not working; a funnel that tells a coherent story about where leads convert and where SQO progression is healthy, with programs in motion to close the gaps; an ICP and target account framework that is sharp, current and reflected in every program; Regional Marketing Leaders deploying your programs into their market plans at pace; regional programs aligned to global campaigns with no duplicated or conflicting effort; full lifecycle plays, including expansion, that generate measurable revenue growth beyond acquisition; partner motions built into programs by design that contribute measurably to pipeline; a quarterly cadence with Regional Marketing Leaders in which field intelligence flows back into the program cycle and the library improves visibly each quarter; and weekly program health reporting that reaches the AVP and Americas Marketing leadership on schedule, with every flagged issue having an owner and a next step.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

• Flexible time off

• Paid company holidays and paid sick time

• Gender-neutral parental leave

• Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Life and disability insurance

• Health and dependent care FSA

• Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• ARAG pre-paid legal

• Nationwide pet insurance

• Cancer Care program

• Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

• Home office allowance

• Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

• Wellness coach

• Wellness/gym reimbursement

• Fertility coverage

• Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply.  If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Base Salary Range

$132,000—$182,000 USD

jobs.title: Production Specialist - Jr. Engineer - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Job Overview:

The Production Specialist – Management Trainee is an entry-level engineering position designed to develop future operational leaders within stow's manufacturing organization.

The role combines hands-on production experience, technical problem-solving, process optimization and structured leadership development. The successful candidate will gain an in-depth understanding of manufacturing operations by actively participating in daily production activities, working alongside experienced operators, technicians, engineers and production supervisors.

During the initial development phase, the Production Specialist will focus on mastering production equipment, manufacturing processes, quality standards and operational procedures, with particular emphasis on roll forming operations and automated manufacturing technologies.

As technical expertise and operational understanding develop, the role will progressively expand toward production coordination, continuous improvement projects, performance management and team leadership.

The ultimate objective is to prepare a high-potential junior engineer to assume a supervisory or management position within stow's manufacturing operations over the coming years.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop a thorough understanding of stow's manufacturing processes, equipment and production technologies.
• Work directly on the production floor alongside experienced operators and technicians to understand daily operations and technical challenges.
• Learn to set up, operate, monitor and troubleshoot roll forming machines, automated welding or painting lined and other manufacturing equipment.
• Gain practical experience with PLC-controlled equipment, HMI interfaces and automated production systems.
• Understand the handling of steel coils, material feeding systems, tooling changes and production line adjustments.
• Learn to interpret technical drawings, manufacturing specifications, production orders and quality requirements.
• Participate in equipment inspections, preventive maintenance activities and technical troubleshooting.
• Develop the ability to identify production bottlenecks, equipment inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
• Assist in developing and implementing production standards, work instructions and operating procedures.

• Collaborate with engineering, maintenance, logistics and quality teams to resolve operational challenges.
• Support the implementation of new production equipment, processes and manufacturing technologies.
• Assist production supervisors in monitoring daily production performance against operational targets.

• Support the implementation of corrective actions to improve production reliability and efficiency.

• Actively promote a strong safety culture and compliance with QSHE standards.
• Learn and apply occupational safety procedures, including lockout/tagout, PPE requirements and safe material handling.
• Support investigations of quality deviations, production defects and equipment failures.
• Contribute to corrective and preventive action plans.
• Ensure that continuous improvement initiatives support safe, reliable and sustainable production processes.

• Develop coaching, communication and problem-solving skills through interaction with production employees.
• Gradually take responsibility for coordinating small improvement projects and cross-functional initiatives.
• Support supervisors in organizing daily production activities and resolving operational issues.
• Prepare to progressively assume responsibility for a production team or manufacturing department.

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
• Recent graduates and candidates with up to 2 years of relevant professional experience are encouraged to apply.
• Relevant internships, technical projects or manufacturing experience are considered an advantage.

Technical Skills

• Strong technical aptitude and interest in industrial manufacturing processes.
• Basic understanding of mechanical systems, automation and industrial production equipment.
• Ability to interpret technical drawings and engineering specifications.
• Familiarity with PLC systems, industrial automation or manufacturing software is an advantage.
• Interest in production performance indicators, manufacturing efficiency and process optimization.

Personal Competencies

• Strong learning agility and willingness to develop new technical and managerial skills.
• Natural curiosity and a hands-on, practical approach to problem-solving.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with operators, technicians, engineers and management.
• Proactive attitude, initiative and willingness to take ownership.
• Resilience, adaptability and the ability to perform in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to combine analytical thinking with practical execution.

Working Conditions

• The position is primarily based at stow's manufacturing facility in Adairsville, Georgia.
• Significant time will be spent on the production floor, particularly during the initial development phase.
• Flexibility to work across different production shifts may be required to gain a comprehensive understanding of manufacturing operations.
• Occasional travel to other stow facilities may be required for training, knowledge transfer or operational projects.
• Compliance with all applicable safety and operational procedures is mandatory.

Career Development Opportunities

This position is intended as a long-term development opportunity within stow's manufacturing organization.  Depending on individual performance, demonstrated competencies and organizational needs, the successful candidate may progress toward positions such as Production Supervisor, Production Manager, Operational Excellence Manager or other manufacturing leadership roles.  Progression is based on demonstrated readiness and business opportunities rather than a guaranteed promotion or fixed timeline.

What do we offer you?

• PTO, days paid sick leave, 11 US paid holidays
• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
• Company paid Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
• Company Paid Life Insurance
• Company Paid Accidental Death & Dismemberment
• 401K with employer match, currently 4%

WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.

WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.

The Role:

We are seeking a highly capable, self-directed Technology Support Specialist to modernize technology operations across a complex, multi-entity family office environment. This hands-on role sits at the intersection of technology strategy, cybersecurity, MSP oversight, and executive support. The ideal candidate is a strong technology generalist who thrives in entrepreneurial environments, equally comfortable developing long-term strategy and solving day-to-day challenges. You will serve as the primary owner of the technology ecosystem across several distinct business entities, each with its own infrastructure, email environment, and operational needs. You will liaise with other WorldQuant employees to assist such employees in connection with their respective duties to affiliated entities. This role will initially focus heavily on technology modernization and implementation initiatives, with the potential for the scope of the role to evolve into broader technology leadership responsibilities as the organization grows and its needs continue to evolve.

- Own and execute the technology roadmap across all family office entities.

- Assess the current environment and develop prioritized recommendations to improve security, efficiency, scalability, and end-user experience.

- Lead implementation efforts across infrastructure, productivity platforms, identity management, and cybersecurity.

- Evaluate and implement practical AI and automation solutions, including agentic AI platforms, to improve productivity and operations, consistent with applicable security, confidentiality, privacy and governance requirements.

- Assess current cybersecurity posture and build a prioritized roadmap to strengthen it, including endpoint protection, identity management, access controls, phishing prevention, mobile security, backup/recovery, and business continuity.

- Provide high-touch support to executives and staff, in-person and remotely.

- Deploy, configure, and maintain laptops, mobile devices, workstations and related technology.

- Support executive travel and remote access needs.

What You'll Bring:

- 8+ years of relevant progressive IT experience, with demonstrated strength as a technology generalist in lean, high-touch environments.

- Experience supporting a family office, investment firm, or comparably confidential, high-touch organization.

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, identity management, endpoint management, and cloud-based technologies.

- Experience leading technology modernization efforts across infrastructure, productivity platforms, identity systems, and cybersecurity.

- Demonstrated experience evaluating, selecting, and managing MSPs and other external technology vendors.

- Experience implementing cybersecurity best practices: SSO, MFA, endpoint protection, access controls, and related security controls.

- Familiarity with AI tools, automation, and emerging technology trends, with a track record of translating them into practical business value.

- Strong project leadership across complex, multi-entity or multi-stakeholder environments.
