jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
The Business Development Manager will create sustained demand for Sika Resinous Flooring systems across the U.S. manufacturing sector by developing targeted accounts, influencing specifications and converting early-stage opportunities into a qualified project pipeline and profitable revenue. Success requires intensive, disciplined relationship building across the complete decision chain: manufacturing end users and facility stakeholders, architects and engineering specifiers, general contractors, flooring contractors and other project influencers. The role is not limited to lead generation. It owns the long-cycle work of gaining access, understanding operational needs, positioning the right Sikafloor system(s), securing specification preference and coordinating the commercial team through project conversion.

Accountable For:

• Build and execute a national manufacturing-market growth plan, including clear account priorities, segment focus, value propositions, engagement strategies and measurable conversion milestones.
• Develop deep, multi-level relationships within targeted end-user accounts, including corporate engineering, operations, facilities, maintenance, EHS, procurement and plant-level decision makers.
• Engage architects, engineering firms, consultants and other specifiers early in the design cycle to position Sika Flooring systems in project specifications and basis-of-design documents.
• Build productive relationships with general contractors and selected flooring contractors to improve project visibility, constructability alignment, bidding support and conversion rates.
• Create and continuously advance a healthy project pipeline from account identification through specification, bidding, award and revenue realization.
• Act as the manufacturing-market subject matter lead for Sika Flooring, translating customer needs, industry trends and competitive activity into practical commercial action.

Core Responsibilities:

• Strategic Account Development

• Identify, segment and prioritize high-potential manufacturing accounts using market size, facility footprint, capital investment, flooring needs and strategic fit.
• Create account plans that map stakeholders, sites, current systems, pain points, upcoming projects, incumbent suppliers, decision processes and next actions.
• Establish a consistent engagement cadence, including site visits, technical discovery, executive-level discussions, lunch-and-learns and project follow-up.
• Develop account-specific value propositions focused on safety, hygiene, durability, lifecycle cost, speed of installation, operational continuity and technical performance.
• Expand successful project relationships across additional plants, regions and corporate networks.

2. Specification and Project-Pipeline Development

• Identify projects at the earliest possible stage and work with end users and specifiers to define performance requirements that align with Sika Flooring solutions.
• Develop, review and influence project specifications in coordination with the appropriate Sika technical and specification resources.
• Maintain accurate opportunity values, stages, stakeholders, probability, timing and next steps in Salesforce (SFDC). CRM discipline is essential to the role.
• Coordinate samples, mock-ups, system recommendations, technical documentation, budget pricing and other preconstruction support required to advance opportunities.
• Track projects through design, tender, contractor selection, award and installation, ensuring clean handoffs to regional and territory sales teams.

3. Commercial Coordination and Conversion

• Partner with regional management, territory sales representatives, the BDM team lead and technical resources to assign ownership and execute agreed opportunity plans.
• Identify and develop qualified flooring contractors capable of supporting targeted manufacturing accounts and project requirements.
• Engage general contractors and construction managers to strengthen Sika visibility, resolve project barriers and support successful bids.
• Lead cross-selling and collaboration with relevant Sika business units and the SPAR team.
• Protect pricing quality and margin by developing differentiated, specification-led opportunities.

4. Market Leadership and Business Intelligence

• Monitor manufacturing investment, construction activity, regulatory drivers, technology changes, competitor positioning and emerging customer requirements.
• Identify threats to Sika Flooring solutions and present fact-based recommendations to management.
• Represent Sika and Sika Flooring at approved trade shows, industry associations, customer events and technical forums.
• Provide concise monthly reporting covering account progress, pipeline creation, specification activity, conversion risks, wins, losses and required management support.

• Bachelor's degree (BA or BS) required; a combination of relevant education and industry experience may be considered.10+ years of successful sales or business development experience in resinous flooring, industrial construction or a closely related building-materials market.Demonstrated success developing complex, long-cycle opportunities involving end users, specifiers, general contractors and specialty contractors.Specification-selling experience strongly preferred, including the ability to influence system selection before a project reaches bid stage.Proven record of strategic account development, opportunity conversion, leadership, creativity and disciplined execution.Outstanding presentation, written communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.Working proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, plus CRM and sales-management platforms. Salesforce experience is preferred.Ability and willingness to travel extensively throughout the United States, including regular customer, project and industry visits.Valid driver license in good standing

• 401k with Generous Company Match

• Disability Insurance

• Paid time off, paid holidays

• Floating holidays + Paid Volunteer Time

jobs.description:

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Gain real project experience alongside experienced engineers
• Assist in programming programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems utilizing industry leading software
• Participate in Client/Stakeholder interactions, with potential onsite occurrences
• Plan Factory Accepting Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) protocols and troubleshoot control processes

• Experience with Python programming and the ability to learn and apply additional programming languages as needed.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. jobs.description:
(ID: 2026-4055)

Axle is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

Axle is seeking a TAC Scientist to join our vibrant team at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) supporting the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) located in Bethesda, MD.

Benefits We Offer:

• 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• 401K match up to 5%

• Educational Benefits for Career Growth

• Employee Referral Bonus

• Flexible Spending Accounts: Healthcare (FSA) Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK) Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP) Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

Position Information:

The purpose of this position is to plan and conduct research experiments using complex molecular biology, next generation sequencing, and tissue analysis techniques, develop and validate data analysis pipelines, and maintain Genome Analysis Core and Tissue Analysis Core instruments while training others in their use.

Additional Qualifications:

Certifications & Licenses

• Masters Degree

Field of Study

• Microbiology

Software

• Microsoft Office

Skills

• Perform a wide range of complex procedures and techniques including, cell culture, molecular biology, DNA/RNA analysis, DNA/RNA isolation, DNA/RNA purification, DNA/RNA next generation (Illumina) sequencing, flow cytometry, gene cloning

• Interact with students, post-doctoral fellows and non-doctoral research technicians on experimental design and laboratory-based methodologies

• Maintain accurate, daily records of experiments

• Monitor advance in scientific methods through peer-reviewed journals

• Troubleshoot projects when standard workflow yields unexpected results

• Communicate and present project progress to colleagues in group setting

• Train students and other scientists on laboratory workflows and use of laboratory instruments, including qPCR instruments, liquid handling robots, thermal cyclers, and tissue analysis

Deliverables:

• Maintain accurate, daily records of experiments

jobs.title: Fraud & Risk Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Who we are: 
Nitra's mission is to build a more efficient healthcare system and the technology that makes it possible.  Our goal is to provide an ecosystem of fintech and software solutions that help doctors better manage their practices, so they can have time back to focus on what matters to them most.
 
We operate with urgency, intensity, and ambition. The bar is high because the opportunity is massive. We expect excellence, ownership, and intellectual rigor from every team member. We move fast, make bold decisions, and hold ourselves accountable to results. At the same time, we believe great companies are built on trust and respect. Every voice matters. Every contribution counts. When we win, we win together.
 
We are scaling rapidly and on a clear trajectory toward becoming a unicorn this year — and beyond. Our growth is not accidental; it’s the result of disciplined execution, relentless focus, and a team that refuses to settle. We are building a category-defining company, and we’re looking for people who want to do the most meaningful work of their careers.
 
If you want comfort, this isn’t the place.
If you want impact, ownership, and the chance to help build a generational fintech company, welcome.
 
Nitra was created by unicorn founders who have successfully scaled to thousands of customers and exited $1B+ public offerings. They are joined by an ambitious and experienced team from American Express, Citi, PayPal, Capsule, Plaid, Bloomberg, Meta, Facebook, and Mastercard. The team is backed by some of the world’s leading VCs (Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, etc.) and is supported by an expert group of advisors including the cofounders of Square and Xendit, executives from Intuit, former Governors, White House senior staffers, and a co-founder of CityMD.
 
Nitra maintains a hybrid work policy, with team members working from the office four days per week and Wednesdays designated as a work-from-home day. 
 
We're looking for:
A Fraud & Risk Compliance Officer to help build and manage Nitra’s fraud prevention, risk management, and compliance programs across our financial products, primarily our business credit card and business checking account programs. You’ll be responsible for developing monitoring frameworks, identifying potential fraud and financial risks, and implementing policies and controls that protect the Company as transaction volumes and product offerings scale. Working closely with Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations, you’ll play a key role in strengthening Nitra’s overall risk and compliance infrastructure.

jobs.title: Marketing Pitch Deck Reviewer
jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for experienced marketing professionals to review sales and marketing presentation materials, evaluate messaging effectiveness, and provide actionable feedback to improve audience engagement, brand alignment, and overall presentation impact. This role will partner with sales, marketing, and business development teams to ensure pitch decks clearly communicate value propositions, resonate with target audiences, and support business growth objectives.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own:

• Review sales and marketing pitch decks, presentations, proposals, and related collateral for clarity, accuracy, and effectiveness.

• Evaluate messaging, storytelling, branding, and visual design to ensure consistency with company objectives and market positioning.

• Provide detailed, constructive feedback on content structure, flow, audience relevance, and call-to-action effectiveness.

• Assess presentations from the perspective of target customers, executives, investors, and other key stakeholders.

• Recommend improvements to value proposition articulation, competitive differentiation, and customer benefit messaging.

• Ensure materials align with brand standards, marketing strategies, and corporate communication guidelines.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex concepts and improve audience understanding.

• Collaborate with sales, marketing, product, and leadership teams to refine presentation materials.

• Review visual elements including graphics, charts, data presentation, and slide design for professionalism and impact.

• Support the development of presentation best practices, templates, and messaging frameworks.

• Stay current on industry trends, marketing techniques, and presentation design standards.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in marketing, brand management, sales enablement, corporate communications, or related disciplines.

• Demonstrated experience reviewing, creating, or optimizing sales presentations, marketing collateral, or executive presentations.

• Strong understanding of customer-centric marketing principles, storytelling, and persuasive communication.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to provide constructive feedback while balancing strategic objectives and stakeholder perspectives.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities.

• Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, and presentation design best practices.

• Professional or Expert level proficiency (C1/C2) in English

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $25 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.description:
Ready to step out of the cookie-cutter SDR grind and into a role where your creativity, grit, and strategic thinking actually dictate your paycheck and career trajectory?

At Wunderkind, the Business Development Associate (BDA) role is the absolute engine room of our growth. We don't do mindless, automated spamming. Our BDAs are elite researchers and tactical copywriters who find innovative ways to break through the noise and open doors with decision-makers at the world’s top online retailers.

Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue. We scale a brand’s ability to create and grow customer relationships through websites, email, text, and ads. We believe individuals should have the freedom to choose the kind of internet they want. An internet that fosters genuine relationships with brands. An internet that treats humans like real people instead of “web traffic.” We also believe in empowering brands to treat their customers as individuals, satisfying their unique needs with tailored experiences and thoughtful communication. By expertly personalizing, automating, and scaling beautiful one-to-one experiences, Wunderkind helps brands acquire new customers at scale and keep them loyal for life.

We demand world-class performance, but in return, we offer a launchpad unlike any other. We have a proven track record of rapidly developing our BDAs into lucrative Closing roles (AEs/BDs), Strategic Consulting roles, and Executive Concierge roles.

If you want to blend into the background, this isn’t the place for you. If you want to own your success and scale your career, let’s talk.

🛑 Let’s Get One Thing Straight Before You Apply...

We don’t believe in generic outreach or mass applications. We believe great opportunities are earned through thoughtful research, personalization, and genuine effort.

That’s how we approach our prospects, and it’s what we look for in the people who join our team. Your application is your first opportunity to show us how you stand out.

💼 What You’ll Do:

• Execute Account-Based Magic: Build and execute hyper-customized, multi-channel outreach campaigns (via email, social selling, gifting, referrals, and corporate events) to hook key executive decision-makers.

• Quality AND Quantity: Your success is not measured on soul-crushing daily activity vanity metrics. Instead, you are assessed on monthly quota attainment, revenue pipeline generated, and how you live our core values. You'll need to grind, but you'll need to do so with skill.

• Deal Quarterbacking: Act as the strategic conduit between Sales, Marketing, and Leadership to map out target accounts.

• Pipeline Partnership: Team up directly with our deal-closing sales reps to keep enterprise prospects highly engaged throughout the full sales lifecycle.

🎯 What You Must Bring to the Table:

• The 12-Month Rule: You have at least 12+ months of experience in a fast-paced Sales environment, with a proven track record of holding your role and hitting your goals for upwards of a year.

• Resilience & Grit: You view "no" as a puzzle to solve, not a personal rejection. You have solid, undeniable evidence of your prospecting skillset.

• Tech Stack Fluency: You are highly proficient with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and know how to use it for deep-dive account mapping, not just basic filtering.

• An Analytical, Coachable Mindset: You are an entrepreneurial self-starter with a healthy dose of humility, resourcefulness, and a burning desire to constantly optimize your playbook.

🌟 Bonus Points For:

• Prior experience navigating a B2B sales environment (SaaS is our strong preference, and MarTech SaaS is even more desirable).

• A clear, definitive goal to build a long-term, high-earning career trajectory in sales.

🚀 Why Wunderkind?

We don’t just fill seats; we build future revenue leaders. We expect the absolute best from our team, but the rewards match the demands. If you want to learn the art of enterprise prospecting, get promoted based on merit, and work with a team that has your back, hit apply. (And remember: make it personal).

📞 So what's the process?

Beyond the application stage, we'll ask you to:

1️⃣ Meet with a recruiter: 20 minutes and we'll explore whether you <> Wunderkind are a match. We'll talk comp, role, company, progression and your skills.
2️⃣ Interview: 30 minute time limit, Live. Your one chance to show our hiring manager how you stand out from the batch-and-blast to deliver truly personalized, impactful messaging that opens the doors to revenue.
3️⃣ Skills Assessment Mock: We'll ask you to build a Account-Based Marketing plan for a prospect opportunity and present it to us. Show us you can do the job!
4️⃣ Final Call: If you've made it this far, its time to ask some final competency questions and follow-ups from the previous round, before we decide!
💰 And then it's offer time, baby! Let's get you started with Wunderkind!

Fair compensation notice:
The base salary (excluding variable) range for this role is $65,000.00 to $75,000.00 in New York & California. Regional pay bands apply in other states. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Associate
jobs.description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

The Clinical Trial Associate (CTA) will provide clinical trial coordination support to Project Teams for assigned clinical trial(s). This support includes tracking a wide range of key operational activities and maintenance of essential study documentation, including the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF). This position will work in collaboration with internal team members and with external vendors and CROs. The position will report to the Head of Clinical Operations and will work cross-functionally to support clinical operations activities for a product’s development.

What you will do

• Assist the Clinical Trial Manager(s) (CTM) in the day-to-day operational activities of assigned trials to ensure study objectives and timelines are met with consistently high quality, in compliance with applicable SOPs and regulatory guidelines

• Maintain clinical trial files (including eTMF), project processes, tracking systems, and other utilized study or departmental systems

• Assist in tracking and coordination of biomarker testing with 3rd party labs/central labs

• Collaborate with CRO/appropriate vendors to ensure timely training and access to necessary systems (e.g., EDC, IWRS, ePRO, eTMF) for external stakeholders (e.g., CRO and Clinical Site Staff)

• Coordinate Project Team and departmental meetings, including associated documentation

• Assist with vendor / clinical site agreements, budgets and reconciliation / tracking of purchase orders and invoices for assigned trials

• Explore, adopt, and integrate AI-enabled tools and automated digital workflows into daily trial operations (such as documentation review, tracking, and meeting synthesis) to optimize operational efficiency

• Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key stakeholders within the organization, its CROs and vendors, and clinical sites

Skills and qualifications

Essential:

• At least 2 years of experience in a clinical research environment

• Bachelor’s degree in a science-based discipline, or equivalent practical clinical research experience.

• Curiosity about artificial intelligence and an eagerness to learn, adapt, and leverage emerging AI-driven tools and digital technologies to support clinical trial operations

• Basic understanding of drug development, including familiarity with FDA and ICH GCP guidelines to ensure the appropriate conduct of clinical studies

• Self-motivated and comfortable with shifting priorities and change in a scaling environment

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across interdisciplinary teams and external partners

• Exceptional attention to detail and proactive organizational skills with a proven ability to prioritize competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Willingness to learn, able to take (and apply) direction and ability to manage multiple, parallel tasks

Nice to have:

• Prior experience supporting early-phase clinical trials in oncology, immunology or rare disease

Culture and values

We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.

Thoughtful
Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.

Brave
Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.

Determined
Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.

Together
Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.

Creating an extraordinary company

We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

Hybrid working

It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week (currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.

Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
What We Do:

Florence software advances cures by helping the world’s most important research sites do their best work. Our solutions are now used by over 65,000 research teams in 90 countries around the world—we’re the most widely deployed site workflow tool in the industry. By the end of the decade, we’ll double the pace at which new medicines get to market by doubling the output of trial site teams. To date, we were named a Deloitte Fast 50 business, G2 Category Leader, an Inc. & AJC best place to work, and an Inc. 5000 company five years in a row.

At Florence, we are committed to make the world a better place by accelerating research while providing an environment for our employees where they can be happy in their lives, enjoy their jobs, and grow.

What You’ll Bring to The Team:

We are looking for a curious, experienced, and passionate analytics professional to assist with providing cutting edge solutions. The Senior Analytics Engineer will contribute to producing innovative, impactful analytics products while ensuring data is maintained as an asset with high quality standards.

This is a hybrid role with two main areas of focus:

• Analytics engineering: building and maintaining tested, documented data models, the semantic layer, and data quality checks.

• BI and reporting delivery: working with product and business teams to define what they need, then building the dashboards and reports that meet those needs.

Here are some ways you'll make an impact:

Data modeling and quality

• Design, build and maintain dbt models that are tested, documented and reusable across reports and products.

• Own and extend our semantic layer so each metric is defined once and used consistently in every report and BI tool.

• Build data tests, freshness checks and monitoring, and fix data quality issues at the source.

• Improve the performance and cost of transformation workflows in our cloud data warehouse.

• Work with data engineering to bring streaming data into the models for near-real-time reporting.

• Apply tenant-level access controls and data governance standards so each customer sees only their own data.

• Maintain data dictionaries and model documentation.

Reporting and enablement

• Work with product, customer-facing and business teams to turn reporting requests into clear requirements, and recommend the right type of reporting and data source for each use case.

• Build and maintain dashboards and reports for internal teams and customers.

• Train users and write guides so teams can answer their own questions, and troubleshoot reporting tools when issues come up.

• Mentor junior team members and review their work.

• Work with leadership to set team standards, goals and priorities

An Ideal Candidate Has:

• 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development or data engineering, including building data models used in production.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, information systems or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• Advanced SQL, and experience building data models in dbt or a similar framework using version control, code review and CI/CD.

• Strong grasp of dimensional modeling and experience with a cloud data warehouse.

• Experience building dashboards and reports in at least one major BI tool, such as Tableau or Amazon QuickSight.

• Ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and explain technical tradeoffs, data sources and analytical options in plain language.

• Ability to manage your own priorities across data modeling work and incoming reporting requests.

• Strong understanding of Generative AI (GenAI), Large Language Models (LLMs), and their applications in analytics.

• Experience leveraging tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Claude for data analysis and business insights.

• Knowledge of Prompt Engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

• Ability to build AI-powered analytical solutions and intelligent assistants.

• Experience using AI to automate data analysis, reporting, and insight generation.

• Understanding of AI agents and agentic workflows.

• AI agent integration with reporting platform like Quicksight / tableau.

Bonus Points if you have:

• Experience in clinical trials, life sciences or another regulated industry, including familiarity with GxP or 21 CFR Part 11 data integrity expectations.

• Experience with Snowflake, dbt Cloud, and MetricFlow or another semantic layer.

• Experience with streaming data, such as Kafka.

• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS data and row-level security.

• Python for data work and automation.

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools, or preparing data and metrics for natural-language or LLM-based analytics.

What’s in it for you?

• Do well. We offer a competitive compensation package, medical and dental insurance, and office space in the heart of the city.

• Do good. We insist that health technology is the highest calling for software development. We pride ourselves on working on something bigger than ourselves; helping advance cures and therapies.

• Make the leap. Join our high-output culture to create innovative, modern, and purposeful software solutions.

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator - Gunbarrel Rd
jobs.description:
BenchMark Physical Therapy, a brand partner of Upstream Rehabilitation, is looking for a Patient Care Coordinator to join our team in Chattanooga, TN

Are you looking for a position in a growing organization where you can make a significant impact on the lives of others?

What is a Patient Care Coordinator?

• A Patient Care Coordinator is an entry-level office role that is responsible for maintaining pleasant and consistent daily operations of the clinic.

• Our Patient Care Coordinators have excellent customer service skills.

• Patient Care Coordinators learn new things – a lot! The Patient Care Coordinator multitasks in multiple computer programs each day.

A day in the life of a Patient Care Coordinator:

• Greets everyone who enters the clinic in a friendly and welcoming manner.

• Schedules new referrals received by fax or by telephone from patients, physician offices.

• Verifies insurance coverage for patients.

• Collects patient payments.

• Maintains an orderly and organized front office workspace.

• Other duties as assigned.

Fulltime positions include:

• Annual paid Charity Day to give back to a cause meaningful to you

• Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

• 3-week Paid Time Off plus paid holidays

• 401K + company match

Position Summary:

The Patient Care Coordinator - I (PCC-I) supports clinic growth through excellence in execution of the practice management role and patient intake processes. This individual will work in collaboration with the Clinic Director (CD) to carry out efficient clinic procedures. The PCC-I position is responsible for supporting the mission, vision, and values of Upstream Rehabilitation.

Responsibilities:

• Core responsibilities Collect all money due at the time of service Convert referrals into evaluations Schedule patient visits Customer Service

• Create an inviting clinic atmosphere.

• Make all welcome calls Monitor and influence arrival rate through creation of a great customer experience

• Practice Management Manage schedule efficiently Manage document routing Manage personal overtime Manage non-clinical documentation Manage deposits Manage caseload, D/C candidate, progress note, and insurance reporting Monitor clinic inventory

• Training o Attend any required training with the Territory Field Trainers (TFT) for Raintree and other business process updates. Complete quarterly compliance training.

Qualifications:

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• Communication skills – must be able to relate well to Business Office and Field leadership

• Ability to multitask, organizational detail, ability to meet deadlines, work with little to no supervision

• As a member of a team, must possess efficient time management and presentation skills

Physical Requirements:

• This position is subject to inside environmental conditions: protections from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes; exposed to noise consistent with indoor environment.

• This is a full-time position operating within normal business hours Monday through Friday, with an expectation of minimum of 40 hours per week; May be required to attend special events some evenings and weekends, or work additional hours as needed.

• This position is subject to sedentary work.

• Constantly sits, with ability to interchange with standing as needed.

• Constantly communicates with associates, must be able to hear and speak to accurately exchange information in these situations.

• Frequently operates a computer and other office equipment such as printers, phone, keyboard, mouse and copy machines using gross and fine manipulation.

• Constantly uses repetitive motions to type.

• Must be able to constantly view computer screen (near acuity) and read items on screen.

• Must have ability to comprehend information provided, use judgement to appropriately respond in various situations.

• Occasionally walks, stands, pushes or pulls 0-20 lbs., lifts 0-20 lbs. from floor to waist; carries, pushes, and pulls 0-20 lbs.

• Rarely crawls, crouches, kneels, stoops, climbs stairs or ladders, reaches above shoulder height, lifts under 10 lbs. from waist to shoulder.

This job description is not an all-inclusive list of all duties that may be required of the incumbent and is subject to change at any time with or without notice. Incumbents must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and that, if requested, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable associates with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship.

jobs.title: Container Management Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

• Collaborate in the development, engineering, design, and implementation of returnable container management concepts, process definitions, and continuous improvement initiatives to establish efficient, standardized, and sustainable container management operations.

• Design, develop, and optimize end-to-end returnable container processes, including container demand planning, fleet sizing, circulation concepts, empty container return logistics, inventory control, and supplier replenishment strategies to support reliable manufacturing operations.

• Analyze and optimize supplier-related logistics processes, including transportation, returnable packaging, scheduling, material flow, and container handling, to ensure a reliable, efficient, and technically robust closed-loop container supply chain.

• Proactively identify technical and operational risks within the container supply chain through data analysis, capacity evaluation, inventory assessment, and process monitoring. Develop, coordinate, and implement corrective and preventive measures in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders as part of bottleneck and escalation management.

• Develop and validate engineering-based container planning models, considering supplier demand, container cycle times, transportation lead times, shipment frequency, safety stock, and process constraints to determine optimal container fleet requirements and ensure sufficient container availability throughout the supply chain.

• Analyze, structure, validate, and maintain container inventory and logistics data used for planning, control, forecasting, and performance management. Support root-cause analysis of inventory discrepancies, complaints, process deviations, and system-related issues, and initiate corrective actions and physical inventories as required.

• Establish effective technical and operational communication with Tier 1 suppliers to define container management requirements, align logistics processes, resolve operational issues, and drive continuous improvement of container flow and inventory performance.

• Engineer, plan, and control the closed-loop circulation of returnable containers between the Scout manufacturing plant and Tier 1 supplier locations, ensuring adequate container availability while optimizing fleet size, inventory distribution, circulation times, transportation efficiency, and overall system capacity.

• Evaluate container demand, circulation times, inventory requirements, transportation frequency, supplier consumption patterns, and operational constraints to identify opportunities for process optimization, cost reduction, and improved returnable asset utilization.

• Develop and implement standardized container management processes, including operating procedures, process flow diagrams, planning parameters, inventory control methods, and performance indicators to support consistent and scalable logistics operations.

• Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital tools, container tracking systems, reporting solutions, and data interfaces used for container inventory management, logistics planning, demand forecasting, and operational control.

• Apply structured engineering problem-solving and continuous-improvement methodologies to investigate container shortages, excess inventory, delivery disruptions, process inefficiencies, and recurring operational issues. Develop sustainable countermeasures based on root-cause analysis and process performance data.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Blythewood, South Carolina

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• 4+ years of professional experience in automotive production, logistics, or industrial operations, including areas such as inbound/outbound logistics, supply chain management, container management, and JIT/JIS environments.

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Logistics Engineering, or a related engineering or technical field. An equivalent amount of relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

• Experience with automotive logistics and container management systems strongly preferred, including container flow, tracking, utilization, standardization, and continuous improvement.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, and optimize complex logistics and material-flow processes using data-driven and engineering-based problem-solving methodologies.

• Experience developing or improving process workflows, system requirements, operational standards, and technical solutions supporting container management and supply chain operations.

• Strong understanding of process efficiency, root-cause analysis, continuous improvement, capacity planning, and operational performance metrics.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify process constraints, evaluate technical alternatives, and implement scalable solutions.

• Proficiency in quantitative modeling and statistical analysis, including capacity, fleet-size, and cycle-time calculations, and in simulation or optimization of material-flow and returnable-container circulation systems.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL) to build planning models, dashboards, and KPI reporting.

• Experience with ERP and logistics systems (e.g., SAP) and container tracking or inventory management tools, including defining data requirements and system interfaces.

• Knowledge of returnable packaging and container design standards (e.g., VDA, AIAG), including load-carrier specifications, packaging density, ergonomics, and handling requirements.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial Base Salary Range: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00

Internal Leveling Code: IC9

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
For more than 50 years, ENSCO has been providing leading-edge engineering, science and advanced technology solutions to governments and private industries worldwide.

ENSCO prides itself in creating and applying advanced technologies for mission success. We provide systems engineering, integration, and advanced technology services to transform the future safety, security, and resiliency of critical missions on the ground, in the air, in space, and in the information systems that connect these domains.

Learn more about ENSCO.

Position Description

The Mission Systems Group (MSG) provides security solutions for the United States government. MSG employees offer a multi-disciplinary approach to solve some of the most challenging technical problems in complex operational environments. Our areas of expertise are in sensor development and integration; chemical, biological, nuclear, and geophysical phenomenology; software applications; modeling and simulation; and operational applications of technology.

Key customers include the Department of Homeland Security, the Department of War, and the Department of Energy.

ENSCO is looking for a senior data analyst to provide laboratory quality assurance (QA) analysis and sample data curation for an upcoming project. The role will involve performing periodic queries as well as producing charts and summaries of data quality indicators from sample collections and laboratory analyses. Responsibilities will include writing reports, developing/modifying scripted analytics using R, and periodic onsite subject matter expertise (SME) consultations to assist in the formulation, maintenance, documentation, and application of R-scripted analytical tools for use in operations.

This position will be a hybrid position of remote work and recurring work at the customer's site.

Qualifications Required:

• Bachelor's degree in applied mathematics, statistics, physical sciences, or an equivalent technical specialty.

• At least five years of related experience that includes analyzing data from scientific applications, preparing quality assurance reports for laboratory measurements, and using AIMS and its utilities.

• Understanding of scientific principles behind sampling and laboratory measurement of chemical, nuclear, or biological materials in the atmosphere

• Proficiency with the R and Python programming statistical scripting languages (including experience with Shiny, ggplot2, and tidyverse).

• Proficiency in using Git/GitLab for software version control

• MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE TS CLEARANCE

• MUST HAVE THE ABILITY TO OBTAIN AND MAINTAIN A TS/SCI SECURITY CLEARANCE

• MUST BE ABLE TO TRAVEL

Qualifications Desired:

• Master's degree in physical sciences with graduate level coursework in applied statistics

• Minimum of 5 years of practical experience applying statistical methods such as control charts, time series, linear regression, or analysis of variance

• Proficiency with writing SQL to query results from databases

• Proficiency with writing statistical data processing and graphics programs using Fortran, C, Visual Basic, Microsoft Excel, Access, or equivalent

• Experience working directly with laboratories

• Ability to prototype new concepts

• Active TS/SCI security clearance

Required Certifications: None

U.S. Citizenship Required: Yes

Security Clearance Required: Top Secret

Employment Type: Part-time 20 (20 - 29 hours weekly)

Background Check Type: 7 Year Pre-Employment

Drug Screen Required: None

Position Contingent Upon Contract Award: Yes

Salary Range

$44.23—$72.12 USD

REAL ID Requirement

This position may require the ability to access to U.S. federal facilities. In accordance with the Department of Homeland Security’s enforcement of the REAL ID Act, as of May 7, 2025, individuals must present a REAL ID-compliant form of identification or an acceptable alternative to gain entry. For a list of acceptable forms of identification, please click here.

Benefits

At ENSCO, a positive working environment and a competitive salary are only part of the reason for choosing a career here. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that creates a stimulating and supportive environment where you can thrive - visit ensco.com/careers/benefits to learn more.

Export Control and Licensing

This position may involve access to technology or technical data that is controlled under U.S. export control laws and regulations and the release of which to a non US person may require an export license from the U.S. Government.

Privacy

jobs.title: VP, Global Head of Demand Sales
jobs.description:
About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making 'net new' ad placements. How we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off: it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-octane, strategic, and commercially relentless VP, Global Head of Demand Sales to lead our global revenue efforts from our New York headquarters. As the primary architect of our Demand growth strategy, you will hold full accountability for the expansion and health of our Demand book.

This role carries a global remit, overseeing high-performing teams across the United States, Canada, and the UK, with a mandate to scale our footprint into new international territories. You will be the direct line manager for our Demand Team leaders, including Directors, Senior Directors, and Executive Directors.

Key Responsibilities

• Full P&L Accountability: Own the global Demand revenue target, driving forecasting and delivering on aggressive quarterly and annual growth benchmarks.

• Deep Senior-Level Partnership: Maintain strong partner relationships with Account Management leadership and senior strategic stakeholders to ensure that Wunderkind’s client experience is world-class and growth-minded, end-to-end.

• Leadership of Leaders: Provide direct management, mentorship, and strategic direction to a senior leadership layer. Responsible for professional development, quota setting, and performance management of Directors, Senior Directors & Executive Directors.

You’ll be an executive sponsor, an active and engaging networker, and a brand ambassador for Wunderkind Ads. Expect to speak publicly, network deeply, and, ultimately, drive revenue through diligent use of your expansive network across Programmatic, CTV, display and video.

• Strategic Business Growth: Define and execute the sales playbook for a growth-minded Ads business, ensuring a consistent go-to-market strategy across the entire United States, Canada, the UK, and anywhere else in the world we enter!

• Global Market Expansion: Identify and penetrate new international markets, leveraging our success in the US, Canada and the UK to further our global presence.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to ensure the ad-tech stack aligns with demand-side requirements and market trends.

Required Qualifications:

• Industry Experience: Minimum of 15 years directly relevant industry experience: the majority gained within the United States.

• Leadership Experience: Minimum of 6 years in a formal management capacity, carrying cumulative responsibility for skilled & senior revenue-generating employees. Strong preference for candidates who have managed other managers.

• Strategic Scope: Must have held a strategic role in a growth-minded Ads business with operations across the entire United States (not limited to NYC).

• Global Remit: Proven ability to manage global teams and revenue streams, particularly across the UK and Canada. Experience of planning & executing flawless market entry into new territories (at speed) is highly desirable.

• CTV & Programmatic Media Expertise: Deep expertise across CTV, video, and emerging ad formats, with hands-on experience working with leading DSPs and platforms, including The Trade Desk, Google DV360, and Yahoo DSP.

Additional Qualifications

• Clear Communicator: Inspires performance, challenges underperformance: Unafraid of tackling the tough challenges, but ensures their people are engaged with the mission as they do!

jobs.title: Sr. AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, AI

Location: LatAm, Remote in Colombia

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there. We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, AI to lead end-to-end product delivery for complex GenAI and agentic AI engagements. This role demands deep AI fluency, hands-on prototyping ability, and the product judgment to navigate non-deterministic systems at enterprise scale. It is ideal for an experienced AI product leader who can own the full arc of an engagement — from framing the problem through shipping a production-grade agentic solution — while building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.

In this role, you will work as the primary product lead on a cross-functional AI delivery team, owning the roadmap, defining agent behavior, running evals, and guiding delivery from discovery through phased rollout. You'll bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully with engineering on architecture decisions and the communication skills to frame AI tradeoffs clearly for executive audiences.

Why This Role Matters

Senior Product Managers, AI are how Robots and Pencils turns AI ambition into shipped agentic systems. On the engagements you lead, you own discovery and delivery end-to-end, define the agent behavior and evals that hold up in production, and keep the team focused on outcomes — not just features. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days; that pace holds only when someone owns the product like their own, stays close to both the user and the model, and surfaces the AI trade-offs — latency, cost, quality, safety — before they cost the result.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

• Own end-to-end product delivery for complex AI and agentic AI engagements, from discovery and hypothesis framing through phased rollout and production readiness

• Define and maintain AI product roadmaps that connect agent capabilities to measurable enterprise business outcomes

• Lead discovery activities including user research, stakeholder interviews, and assumption testing — framing the riskiest hypotheses first and de-risking them before committing to build

• Design and run experiments including POCs, pilot deployments, and scenario-based testing of multi-step agentic workflows, edge cases, and failure recovery

• Define agent behavior end-to-end including system prompts, tool schemas, context management, summarization, and working memory patterns across multi-step tasks

• Own backlog management and sprint execution day-to-day on complex AI engagements — prioritizing work, refining agent behavior and requirements with engineering, and keeping the team moving.

• Own and run evals frameworks covering task completion, reasoning quality, tool selection, failure recovery, and safety — iterating based on evidence rather than assumptions

• Define success metrics at the agent level including task completion rate, cost per task, escalation rate, and time to resolution alongside business KPIs

• Establish human-in-the-loop boundaries and guardrails — when the agent acts autonomously, when it escalates, and how to handle non-deterministic output

• Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot — and agentic frameworks where relevant — to move faster than traditional product

Collaboration & Communication

• Lead stakeholder working sessions, prioritization discussions, and risk conversations with senior client stakeholders with confidence and clarity

• Communicate complex AI tradeoffs, agent behavior, and product decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical executive audiences

• Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and serve as a reliable, consultative partner throughout the engagement

Leadership & Influence

• Lead prioritization decisions by balancing business value, technical feasibility, cost, latency, and delivery timelines

• Frame every request in terms of user and business outcomes, pushing back on feature-level thinking and managing AI hype cycles with realistic expectations

• Begin mentoring junior AI PMs on the engagement, sharing knowledge on evals, agent design, and AI product delivery practices

What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years of experience in product management with hands-on experience shipping AI features or products

• Ability to read code (Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript), evaluate architecture decisions, and make informed product tradeoffs on technical constraints

• Deep understanding of AI concepts including LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt and context engineering, agentic systems such as planning, tool use, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails, and evals

• Proven ability to prototype AI and agentic solutions using modern AI tools to validate hypotheses and de-risk product decisions (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)

• Experience running evals for AI systems and iterating based on results

• Experience defining agent behavior including system prompts, tool schemas, and human-in-the-loop boundaries

• Strong experience working with AWS AI services in a product context (e.g., Bedrock, Lambda, SageMaker, Kendra)

• Strong client communication skills and the ability to frame AI capabilities and limitations for non-technical executive audiences

• Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the AI landscape evolves rapidly

• Experience in a consulting or agency environment is a plus.

• Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AWS Strands) is a plus.

• Software engineering background (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript) is a plus.

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

• Hands-on experience working with open-source LLMs, even in side projects or POCs.

• Exposure to multi-modal AI (vision, voice, or document AI) beyond text-based agents.

• Awareness of AI governance or responsible AI frameworks (privacy, safety, model usage policies).

• Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing.

jobs.title: Non-Revenue Water (NRW) Director
jobs.description:
Main Accountabilities

Lead YWC's Non-Revenue Water reduction as the single accountable owner of water losses across the five governorates. Build, staff and run the NRW Directorate. Turn the NRW Action Plan and the Leakage, Intakes & Wastage Reduction Programme into measurable year-on-year results, and deliver the contractual Annual Improvement to Adjusted Non-Revenue Water Indicator (AIANI). The role also contributes directly to the Annual Water Sales Indicator (AWSI) and the Specific Power Consumption Indicator (SPCI).

Support the progressive move from intermittent to continuous supply, zone by zone, and leave behind a self-sufficient YWC NRW organisation, with proven methods, tools and trained Jordanian staff, at the end of the Management Contract.

Starting point (diagnosis from the Veolia work to date; figures under verification during baselining)

• NRW of about 47% overall, close to 70% in Mafraq; no systematic split between physical and commercial losses
• No District Metered Areas (DMAs) or District Metered Zones (DMZs); System Input Volumes not fully metered, so no reliable water balance
• No active leak detection; NRW department of 1 engineer and 3 technicians at HQ, with limited equipment
• Intermittent supply (about 80 l/capita/day in Irbid, Jerash and Ajloun), which limits acoustic leak detection and pressure management
• Many illegal connections, inaccurate mechanical meters (air registration), unmonitored tanker filling stations, and poor GIS data

Detailed Job Description

Scope of the position:

• Internal relations (Veolia / YWC): CEO; COO / Operations Director, Governorate Directors and ROU managers; Commercial & Customer Service Director; Technical Director; Asset Management Director; IT Director; Finance Director; HR Director; QHSE Manager; Contract Manager (KPI reporting); RRF Coordinator; YWC Control Centre (OCC); Veolia and Seureca back-stopping experts.
• External relations: Minister of Water and Irrigation for NRW Meetings, Water Authority of Jordan (WAJ) and Ministry of Water and Irrigation; MCPMU (contract monitoring) and any KPI verification body; US Government and other donors and IFIs; NRW contractors and suppliers (leak detection, find-and-fix, meters, PRVs, loggers, telemetry); municipalities, security and judicial authorities (illegal connections); IWA and professional networks.

Management & Leadership

• Set up the NRW Directorate: organisation, job descriptions and staffing within the approved establishment; recruit, train, appraise and lead the team
• Sit on the Executive Committee; present NRW performance at the monthly performance reviews and, as required, to the Board, WAJ and MCPMU
• Prepare and control the NRW budget (OPEX and CAPEX); prioritise spend on cost-benefit (economic level of leakage, payback)
• Manage NRW contractors and service providers: specifications, procurement support,
• supervision, measurement and certification of works
• Identify and coach a Jordanian deputy and successor in line with the Management Contract
• handover approach

Strategy & Planning

• Own and update the NRW Strategy and Action Plan (Deliverable 15) and the Leakage, Intakes & Wastage Reduction Programme (Deliverable 16), with quick wins and priority zones
• Run the NRW delivery tracker and monthly progress reporting
• Set NRW targets by governorate and ROU and cascade them into the YWC performance management system
• Contribute the NRW components of the YWC Strategic Plan 2027-2031 and of the investment programmes (RRF, donor programmes)

Water Balance, Metering & KPI

• Establish the IWA standard water balance by governorate and supply system, with data-confidence grading
• Lead the programme to meter and verify all System Input Volumes (sources, production, bulk transfers)
• With the Contract Manager, define the AIANI baselining method and annual calculation, and prepare the evidence for verification
• Report NRW with standard indicators (% of SIV, m³/connection/day, Infrastructure Leakage Index where data allows)

Physical (Real) Losses

• Hydraulic zoning: design and commission DMZs and DMAs (boundary valves, inlet meters, loggers) and run their monitoring (minimum night flow)
• Pressure management (PRVs, flow and time modulation) and optimisation of supply schedules with Operations
• Active leakage control: build in-house leak detection teams (acoustic logging, correlation, ground microphones, tracer gas) and test innovative methods (satellite, AI) where justified
• Set leak repair standards and response times (materials, methods, reinstatement) and monitor repair quality and speed with Operations
• Plan the DMA-based transition from intermittent to continuous (24/7) supply, jointly with Operations and Technical
• Use hydraulic models and leak history to prioritise mains and service connection replacement with Asset Management

Commercial (Apparent) Losses, jointly with Commercial & Customer Service

• Customer meter policy: sizing, accuracy class, testing (Q1-Q3), replacement programme, air-registration issues; large-customer and bulk meters
• Illegal connections programme: detection, regularisation and enforcement
• Monitoring of tanker filling stations and other unbilled authorised consumption
• Analysis of unbilled, estimated, zero-consumption and blocked accounts; customer census and database quality
• Assessment of smart metering and AMR pilots, including existing installations

Data, Digital & Control

• NRW data management: GIS (network, DMAs, leaks, meters) and SCADA/telemetry of DMA inlets and PRVs, integrated into the YWC Control Centre (OCC)
• Daily and monthly NRW dashboards by DMA, ROU and governorate (e.g. Power BI)

Investment & Donor Programmes

• Prepare NRW investment cases, technical specifications, BoQs and tender documents
• Act as technical lead for donor-funded NRW programmes (including US Government-funded NRW programmes and RRF components): FIDIC contract administration, supervision, progress and donor reporting, environmental and social safeguards

Capacity Building & Change

• Design and deliver a training and certification programme for NRW staff, ROU field teams and contractors
• Write SOPs and manuals for all NRW processes within the YWC document control system
• Build an NRW culture among operational managers and support customer leak-reporting campaigns with Communication

Health, Safety & Quality (QHSSE)

• Ensure safe working for field teams (excavations, traffic management, confined spaces, night work); promote a zero-harm culture
• Contribute to YWC certification against ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 55001

• Bachelor's degree in Civil, Hydraulic, Mechanical or Environmental Engineering (minimum); a Master's in water engineering or water resources management is preferred
• At least 15 years in water distribution and NRW management, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (Director, Deputy Director, or Team Leader / Project Manager of an NRW programme)
• Has led at least one IFI-funded, performance-based NRW reduction contract (e.g. World Bank, IDB, AfDB) from mobilisation to verified results
• Has managed the operation and maintenance of a large urban distribution network (pressure zones, PRVs, telemetry) inside a water utility
• Has rolled out tens of DMAs or pressure zones, leak repair programmes of thousands of repairs, and meter replacement / apparent loss programmes, with documented water savings
• Experience of intermittent supply in emerging-market utilities; Middle East experience desirable
• Has led teams of 50+ staff plus contractors, and trained and certified utility staff
• Registered or chartered engineer (or equivalent); active in the IWA Water Loss Specialist Group or similar (desirable)
• Fluent English (written and spoken) required; Arabic and/or French an advantage
• Mobility: resident in Irbid, Jordan, with regular travel across the five governorates

Competencies required for the position:

Knowledge (technical and contextual)

• IWA water balance and performance indicators (CARL, UARL, ILI); economic level of leakage
• Distribution network hydraulics and operation, including intermittent supply conditions
• Metering technologies and standards (ISO 4064 / OIML R49); apparent loss mechanisms
• Performance-based and management contract mechanisms; KPI incentive and penalty regimes
• IFI and donor procurement and safeguard rules (World Bank, US Government, IDB, etc.); FIDIC (NEC an asset)
• Health and safety requirements for network works; Middle East / Jordanian water sector context (desirable)

Professional know-how

• Design and city-scale roll-out of DMAs, pressure zones and pressure management
• Hydraulic modelling (InfoWorks WS, WaterGEMS, EPANET): build, calibration, scenario testing
• Leak detection equipment and methods; leak repair programmes at scale
• GIS, SCADA and telemetry; NRW data analysis and reporting (Excel, Power BI)
• Budget, programme (MS Project) and contractor management; specifications, tenders and donor reports
• Design and delivery of structured training; writing SOPs and manuals

Interpersonal and personal skills

• Leadership of large multicultural teams (local and international staff, contractors)
• Results-driven; rigorous with facts, figures and measurement
• Coaching and knowledge transfer; builds successors
• Influence and diplomacy with authorities, donors and staff representatives
• Resilience and pragmatism in a constrained and changing environment
• Integrity and visible safety leadership

Performance indicators for the position (targets set in the annual objectives):

• Contractual AIANI annual improvement against the Appendix 8 trajectory; contribution to AWSI (recovered billed volume) and SPCI
• Water losses NRW volume and % of System Input Volume by governorate and ROU; m³/connection/day; ILI where data allows
• Measurement % of System Input Volume metered and verified; water balance data-confidence grade
• Network control Number of DMAs/DMZs established and actively monitored; % of network under pressure management
• Leakage control Km of network surveyed; leaks detected and repaired; average repair time
• Apparent losses Meters tested and replaced; illegal connections detected and regularised
• Continuity of supply Zones moved to continuous supply; average hours of supply per day
• Delivery & cost Deliverables 15 and 16 on time and approved; NRW budget execution; cost per m³ saved
• People & safety Staff trained and certified; successor readiness; LTIFR and zero serious incidents for NRW teams

As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination.

The preceding description is not designed to be a complete or exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities that will be carried out by the selected candidate.

Veolia Middle East does not and shall not discriminate in any forms in its recruitment processes.

jobs.description:
Company introduction:

Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.

The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.

We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing. - Compass Pathways

The Associate Director, Internal Communications is responsible for building and executing a cohesive internal communications program that strengthens organizational alignment, reinforces corporate culture and ensures employees understand Compass’ strategy, priorities and progress as the company advances toward its next phase of growth and potential commercialization.
