jobs.title: Robotics Intern, Prototyping and Robotics Operations
jobs.description:
At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences.
This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role.
Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!


The Vision
We envision a future with robots that help people in real environments through interactions that allow robots to understand, adapt, and grow with us. We believe robots should work well alongside people, helping where wanted and enabling people to spend more time on the activities they enjoy most. Achieving this vision requires robots that operate reliably in messy, unstructured environments and that people can understand, collaborate with, and rely on.
The Team
Our goal is to revolutionize robotics by enabling long-horizon dexterous behaviors to be efficiently taught, learned, and improved over time in diverse, real-world environments with people.
Our team brings together expertise in hardware, simulation, perception, controls, machine learning, and human-robot interaction. PROps supports this research through robot operations, data collection, fleet maintenance, prototyping, lab infrastructure, and the processes that keep this work safe and consistent.
The Opportunity
As a Robotics Operations Intern, you will work with the PROps team to learn the end-to-end robotic data collection pipeline and help improve the processes that support it. During this internship, you will gain hands-on experience with robot operations while helping to maintain the documentation of our workflows and developing practical improvements for the team. This internship is suited to someone who enjoys learning technical systems and making complex work clearer, more consistent, and easier to execute.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
About Nintex:

At Nintex, we are transforming the way people work, everywhere.

As the global standard for process intelligence and automation, we're trusted by over 10,000 public and private sector organizations across 90 countries. Our customers, from industry giants like Amazon, Coca-Cola, and Microsoft, rely on the Nintex Platform to accelerate their digital transformation journeys by managing, automating, and optimizing business processes quickly and efficiently. We improve their lives through the technology we build.

We are committed to fostering a workplace that supports amazing people in doing their very best work every day. Collaboration is constant, our workplace is fun, the environment is fast-paced, and we value our people’s curiosity, ideas, and enthusiasm. Driven by passion and accountability, we take initiative, measure progress, and deliver results. Our culture fosters innovation and problem-solving, fueled by curiosity and a commitment to thinking big. Together, we move with agility, prioritize customer needs, and build unity through empathy, leaving a positive impact wherever we go.

About the role:

We are seeking an experienced Security Operations Engineer to join our global Information Security team. This individual will play a critical role in protecting the organization's technology infrastructure, cloud environments, applications, and information assets by identifying, investigating, containing, and remediating cybersecurity threats and incidents.

The ideal candidate brings 4–6 years of hands-on security operations experience within complex, geographically distributed technology environments, with strong experience in Microsoft Azure security operations and familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

This position requires strong technical investigation skills, sound security judgment, and the ability to independently manage security incidents from initial detection through containment, remediation, and closure. The Security Operations Engineer will collaborate with infrastructure, engineering, cloud operations, identity management, and other business and technology stakeholders across multiple geographic regions.

The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in a dynamic environment where security threats, technology platforms, and business priorities continually evolve.

Your contribution will be:

Security Monitoring and Threat Detection

• Monitor, analyze, and investigate security events and alerts across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, identity systems, applications, and security infrastructure.

• Identify suspicious activities, indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous behavior, and potential cybersecurity threats using SIEM, EDR/XDR, and other security monitoring technologies.

• Correlate security events across multiple data sources to identify potential threats and determine their scope, severity, and business impact.

• Analyze security telemetry from enterprise security tools, and other cloud and infrastructure platform and distinguish actionable security threats from false positives through structured investigation and technical analysis.

Security Incident Investigation and Response

• Independently investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents, including phishing, malware, ransomware, credential compromise, unauthorized access, suspicious network activity, and cloud security events.

• Perform incident triage, classification, prioritization, and escalation in accordance with established incident response procedures.

• Execute or coordinate containment and remediation activities, including endpoint isolation, credential revocation, access restriction, malicious artifact removal, and other corrective actions.

• Collect, preserve, and analyze technical evidence to support incident investigations and post-incident reviews.

• Participate in major security incident response activities, including cross-functional coordination and escalation to security leadership.

• Participate in an on-call rotation or incident response escalation process as required.

Threat Analysis and Continuous Improvement

• Analyze emerging cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, and adversary behaviors relevant to the organization’s technology environment.

• Apply threat intelligence and established frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, to improve incident investigations and identify potential attack patterns.

• Identify recurring security events, investigation inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve operational effectiveness.

• Contribute to the development and refinement of incident response procedures, investigation playbooks, and operational documentation with recommend improvements.

Security Engineering and Platform Improvement

• Partner with Infrastructure, Identity, and application teams to strengthen endpoint, identity, email, SaaS, and cloud security controls across the corporate technology environment.

• Develop and maintain security detections, alerting logic, dashboards, workflows, and automation within SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and related security platforms.

• Support onboarding and validation of new telemetry sources, integrations, and security controls to improve security visibility and detection coverage.

• Analyze incidents, security trends, and control gaps to identify and drive practical improvements that reduce organizational risk and improve operational effectiveness.

• Participate in security reviews of new technologies, infrastructure changes, and business initiatives, providing technical recommendations and security guidance.

To be successful, we think you need:

Required Qualifications

Professional Experience

• 4–6 years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), cybersecurity operations, incident response, or a closely related security function.

• Demonstrated experience investigating and responding to cybersecurity incidents within a complex enterprise technology environment.

• Experience supporting security operations in a technology company, SaaS provider, cloud services organization, or similarly complex technology-driven enterprise.

• Strong hands-on experience investigating security events and incidents within Microsoft Azure environments.

• Working familiarity with AWS and GCP security concepts, services, and logging capabilities.

• Experience working with geographically distributed infrastructure and collaborating with technical teams across multiple regions.

Technical Skills

• Hands-on experience with SIEM technologies and EDR/XDR technologies with working knowledge of Microsoft Azure security services, cloud logging, identity security, and incident investigation techniques.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, VPNs, firewalls, and common network attack techniques.

• Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems, system logs, authentication mechanisms, and common indicators of compromise.

• Understanding of identity and access management concepts, including SSO, MFA, privileged access, and cloud identity services.

• Knowledge of common cybersecurity threats, including phishing, malware, ransomware, credential attacks, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and data exfiltration.

• Familiarity with incident response methodologies and frameworks, including NIST incident response guidance and MITRE ATT&CK.

• Ability to analyze security logs, correlate technical evidence, and independently develop defensible investigation findings.

Professional Competencies

• Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to independently prioritize and manage multiple security investigations in a fast-paced environment.

• Sound judgment when assessing incident severity, escalation requirements, and appropriate response actions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to diverse audiences.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, infrastructure, cloud operations, and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA CySA+, GIAC GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, or equivalent industry credentials.

• Experience investigating incidents involving Kubernetes, containers, cloud-native applications, or modern SaaS architectures.

• Experience with SOAR platforms, security orchestration workflows, or automated incident response playbooks.

• Basic scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.

• Experience with digital forensic investigation techniques, endpoint artifact analysis, or memory and disk analysis.

• Exposure to detection rule tuning, SIEM content development, or security monitoring optimization.

What’s in it for you?

Nintex has a hybrid working model, enabling us to build culture, learn, and grow together. We intentionally connect and collaborate, while emphasizing flexibility with a blend of at-home and in-office work. This role is a hybrid role in our local Nintex office.

While our offerings differ from country to country, we offer our entire global workforce an array of exciting perks and benefits, including

• Global Gratitude and Recharge Days

• Flexible, paid time off policy

• Employee wellness programs and counseling resources

• Meaningful peer recognition and awards

• Paid parental leave

• Invention/patenting assistance

• Community impact, paid volunteer time, and opportunities

• Intercultural learning and celebration

• Multiple tools through which to learn and grow, and an incredible global community

View more about our benefits here: https://www.nintex.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Global-Perks-and-Benefits.pdf.

Target Compensation Range (US ONLY): 150,000 - 180,000 USD annually. On target compensation refers to the base salary and applicable variable target for this role. The range is an estimate, base pay will ultimately be decided at the offer stage, based on an individual candidate's skills and experience aligned with the needs of the role. Base pay may vary based on several factors including geographic location, role specific qualifications, and seniority. Nintex also offers a competitive benefits package including paid time off, twelve paid holidays, 401(k) with employer match, and more.

Nintex participates in E-Verify for work authorization.  We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Organization.

The selected candidate will work under the direction of transportation and environmental planning staff to provide environmental support for transportation projects throughout the Mid-Atlantic Region and beyond. The candidate will be based in Conshohocken, PA, Philadelphia PA, Pittsburgh PA, Hunt Valley, MD, or Glen Allen, VA, with hybrid schedules available.

The selected candidate will be self-motivated team player, have excellent technical writing and interpersonal communication skills, and be highly client focused. Most importantly, the candidate must have a positive attitude and a passion for learning and developing their skills as an environmental planner.

The job responsibilities for the position will include but are not limited to:

• Work under the general direction of the Task or Project Lead
• Prepare documents, including Categorical Exclusions, Environmental Assessments and possibly Environmental Impact Statements
• Perform field evaluations and assessments, such as wetland delineations, resource assessments, and threatened and endangered species screening in addition to providing support to planning studies and reports
• Preparing technical reports
• Documenting and reporting details pertaining to waterway permit packages (federal and state encroachments, coast guard, aids to navigation, etc.)
• Preparation of meeting materials, attendance at meetings, and responding to comments

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• BA/BS in Environmental Planning, Ecology, Environmental Science, Natural Resource Management, Environmental Engineering or related field + 4 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Demonstrated experience in planning and environmental permitting in Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland or Virginia
• Valid U.S Driver's License and as a condition of employment, must pass AECOM's Motor Vehicle Records Review

• Masters Degree in Environmental Planning, Ecology, Environmental Science, Natural Resource Management, Environmental Engineering or related field
• 6+ years of demonstrated experience in planning and environmental permitting in Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland or Virginia
• Experience with the preparation of NEPA environmental documents, including CE’s EA’s and EIS’s for FRA, FTA and/or FHWA
• Experience with wetland delineations using the USACE Regional Supplements and biological field surveys
• Experience developing regulatory permit applications and assessing impacts to jurisdictional resources
• Familiarity with state and federal environmental regulations, specifically the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA); Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act; Section 4(f) of the Department of Transportation Act/Section 2002 of Pennsylvania Act 120; Sections 401 and 404 of the Clean Water Act; 25 PA Code Chapters 102, 105, and 106; Sections 9 and 10 of the Rivers and Harbors Appropriation Act of 1899, Wild and Scenic Rivers Act, and Endangered Species Act
• Transportation or experience; especially PennDOT, DelDOT, Maryland SHA, VDOT and/or Amtrak and familiarity with agency processes

jobs.description:
Position: Sr. Mental Health Technician

Location: Castle Rock, CO - Teen Residential Treatment Center

Schedule: Full Time Day Shift (12.5 Hour Shifts)

Compensation: $22.00 Per Hour + FT Benefits.

What You'll Do:

• Client Care & Engagement: Support teens through daily activities, including group therapy, recreation, and skill-building exercises, ensuring their safety and well-being.

• Team Leadership: Mentor Behavioral Health Technicians, assist with training new staff, and ensure seamless communication during shift changes.

• Documentation & Compliance: Maintain accurate records of client behaviors and incidents, adhering to all regulatory standards.

• Crisis Intervention: Utilize your expertise in de-escalation techniques to respond effectively to crises and support the creation of safety plans.

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience working with adolescents in a behavioral health setting (mental health and/or substance use) is REQUIRED

• An associates or bachelor's degree in psychology, social work, or related field is preferred

• Candidate must have excellent communication, organization, and interpersonal skills

• Candidates must have a firm understanding of trauma-informed care

• CPR certification strongly preferred, or the ability to obtain CPR certification within first 30 days of employment

• A valid driver’s license with no restrictions - Must be willing to transport clients in a 15-passenger van. Upon hire candidates will need to submit/pass a full background check including fingerprinting, and a Motor Vehicle Report to qualify for employment

Support For You Personally and Professionally

At Sandstone Care, we deeply value our employees and believe that exceptional care begins with you. That’s why we provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance both your personal and professional journey. Here are some of the benefits you’ll enjoy:

• 4+ Weeks of Paid Time Off: You deserve a healthy work-life balance, and we want you to have it. That’s why we offer a generous combination of paid time off (PTO) and paid floating holidays, giving you plenty of time to recharge and enjoy your personal life.

• Robust Employee Assistance Program: We care about your well-being and peace of mind, and we want you to have access to the support you need. That’s why we offer a robust employee assistance program that includes counseling, legal consultations, financial planning, and wellness coaching. Whether you need help with stress management, legal issues, budgeting, or personal growth, we’ve got you covered.

• Continued Education and CEU Support: We are committed to expanding your professional development, ensuring you have the tools and knowledge to thrive in your role. That’s why we offer continued education and CEU support, allowing you to pursue new skills, certifications, and opportunities for growth.

• Collaborative and Supportive Community: You are not alone in this journey. You are part of a tight-knit and supportive community of team members who foster a positive work environment and provide a network of encouragement and collaboration. You’ll find a culture of respect, diversity, and fun at Sandstone Care.

Compensation and Benefits

Explore our Compensation and Benefits Package:

• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Your health matters, and we've got you covered with extensive medical, dental, and vision plans to cater to you and your family's well-being.

• Financial Security: Rest easy with our inclusive package featuring short-term and long-term disability coverage along with life insurance, offering you and your loved ones added financial protection.

• 401k Program with Matching: Plan for your future with confidence as we support your long-term financial goals through our 401k program, which includes up to a 5% match.

What to Expect: Our Interview Process

Here's an overview of what comes next:

• Application Review: We'll promptly review your application within one business day.

• Phone Interview with a Recruiter: Expect a 20-30 minute interview with one of our recruiters to discuss the position and logistics

• Interview with Hiring Manager: You'll have a 1-hour onsite interview with the hiring manager.

• Offer: If all goes well, you'll receive an offer.

• Candidates applying for this position should be aware that an offer for employment in this position is contingent upon passing a comprehensive background check, encompassing criminal records and motor vehicle reports.

We believe that embracing diversity and promoting equity and inclusion are integral to our mission of providing high-quality behavioral health services.

Sandstone Care is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. jobs.title: AI Platform Architect
jobs.description:
About us

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

Job Summary

We are seeking for a visionary AI Platform Architect to design and oversee the comprehensive infrastructure stack that powers our most demanding distributed AI workloads. Moving beyond individual hardware components, this role acts as the unifying technical authority across hardware, software, compute, network, and storage. You will be responsible for architecting a cohesive, AI rack scale platform optimized for

trillion-parameter LLM training and high-throughput inference. By orchestrating everything from advanced clustering and distributed training frameworks down to the physical layer—spanning PCIe Gen 5/6 pathways, NVMe storage topologies, and RDMA fabrics—you will ensure our AI research and deployment teams have a flawless, frictionless, and extraordinarily powerful platform at their disposal.

Responsibilities and Duties

• End-to-End Platform Architecture: Define the holistic architecture for highly clustered AI environments, ensuring zero-bottleneck data flow between parallel storage systems, AI compute nodes, and ultra-high-bandwidth network fabrics.

• Workload Orchestration: Influence the strategy for AI workload scheduling and orchestration, utilizing tools like Kubernetes or Slurm to manage distributed training jobs, model check-pointing, and inference serving at massive scale.

• Full-Stack Optimization: Profile and eliminate system-level bottlenecks across the entire AI pipeline, tuning everything from deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, DeepSpeed, etc.) down to OS-level NUMA pinning and I/O scheduling.

• Hardware-Software Co-design: Work closely with software, firmware, and OS engineering to influence platform design, ensuring the software stack fully exploits underlying hardware capabilities, including complex ARM mesh interconnects (RNI, HNF, SNF) and advanced merchant silicon features.

• Silicon Influencing Strategy: Drive the 3-to-5-year technical vision for the AI platform. Collaborate closely with subject matter experts in processor, memory, storage, GPU, thermal, mechanical, BIOS, and Manageability disciplines to define requirements specifications to communicate and present to internal and external silicon teams to influence features, optimized board routing guidelines, power and thermal targets, and the correct feeds and speeds for a competitive AI platform. This will require a deep knowledge of the AI industry and significant market competitive analysis including TCO (OPEX / CAPEX) analysis of new technologies.

Candidate Profile

Essential:

• Experience: Demonstrated ability in systems engineering, cloud architecture, or HPC, hardware engineering with at least 4+ years functioning as a Lead or Principal Architect for large-scale AI or machine learning platforms.

• Distributed AI Frameworks: Deep practical knowledge of how large models are trained and deployed, including data/tensor/pipeline parallelism and the infrastructure requirements of modern LLM architectures.

• Systems Interconnects: Authoritative understanding of system-level bottlenecks and data pathways, including deep familiarity with PCIe Gen 5/6, NVMe namespaces, and RDMA (RoCEv2/InfiniBand) integration.

• Orchestration & Containerization: Experience with container orchestration platforms and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tailored for GPU-heavy bare-metal and cloud environments.

• Cross-Domain Leadership: Exceptional ability to bridge the gap between AI researchers/data scientists and low-level hardware/CPU/memory/storage/GPU/network engineers, translating model requirements into strict infrastructure specifications. Ability to generate Platform engineering requirement specifications that can be used to guide and influence future silicon designs.

Desirable

• Rack scale GPU AI Platforms experience: Hands on experience with rack-as-a-system

• AI platforms that integrate all the latest networking, cooling, and GPU technologies currently present in the market.

• Software / Scripting experience: Working knowledge of scripting language such as Python/JSON to characterize workloads on bare metal AI compute systems to expose issues with current Neural engine silicon solutions.

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. Our benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, commuter benefits, wellness services and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

jobs.title: VP of Marketing
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Yieldmo is an advertising platform that helps brands invent creative experiences through tech and AI, using custom ad formats, proprietary attention signals, predictive format selection, and privacy-safe premium inventory curation. Yieldmo believes all ads should be human-centered, tailored, and provoke users' emotions and actions. Yieldmo helps brands deliver the best ad for every impression opportunity, merging creative and media for proven results.

What We Need

We’re looking for a VP, Marketing to own how Yieldmo shows up in the market and how our revenue teams tell our story and win. You’ll set marketing strategy across brand, communications and PR, product marketing, and sales enablement for Sales, Account Management, and our emerging Sports business. You’ll be accountable for marketing’s contribution to pipeline and revenue.

This is a senior, hands-on role. Our marketing function is intentionally lean, so you’ll write the press release, build the pitch deck, and run the enablement session yourself, while setting the strategy and the quality bar for everyone who contributes. You’ll partner with Revenue and Product leadership, and you’ll be the person the executive team relies on for the company narrative.

You know what actually moves a deal and a market. You put yourself in the shoes of our clients and our sellers, anticipate what they need, and deliver it before they ask.

What You Can Expect In This Role

Strategy and leadership

• Own Yieldmo’s marketing strategy, annual plan, and budget. Set priorities with the executive team and Revenue leadership, and report on marketing’s impact on pipeline and revenue.

• Define and own the company narrative, including positioning, messaging architecture, and competitive differentiation, and make sure it shows up consistently everywhere Yieldmo appears.

• Bring the voice of the market and the seller into executive discussions, surfacing client feedback, competitive insights, and gaps that shape positioning and the product roadmap.

Brand, communications, and PR

• Lead PR and corporate communications directly. Build relationships with trade media and industry analysts, write and pitch announcements, and manage earned media.

• Build an executive thought leadership program, including bylines, speaking opportunities, awards, and industry visibility, and personally prepare executives for interviews and stages.

• Own brand standards across the website, social channels, events, and all revenue-facing materials.

Product marketing

• Turn product launches and priorities, including YMax.ai and Yieldmo Sports, into market-ready positioning, packaging, launch plans, and seller training, in partnership with Product.

Sales enablement

• Personally build the highest-impact sales narratives, pitch decks, one-pagers, enablement kits, and custom collateral.

• Build and run the full enablement lifecycle, from new-hire onboarding and pitch certification to ongoing product training and quarterly education programs.

• Own Yieldmo’s sales content ecosystem in Seismic, including governance, taxonomy, lifecycle management, and adoption, so every seller can find current, on-brand material in seconds.

• Define and report on enablement KPIs, and use the data to cut what isn’t working and double down on what is.

Demand and programs

• Plan and execute account-based campaigns, client and agency events, and roadshows that create pipeline and deepen relationships with priority accounts.

• Design vertical, industry, and moment-specific programs that give sellers timely, resonant reasons to open doors with top brands and agencies.

Operating model

• Build a transparent intake and prioritization process that balances proactive strategy with requests from Revenue teams, and hold the line on priorities when needed.

• Report to the Chief Revenue Officer and manage one direct report, with clear direction, feedback, and quality control.

• Use AI throughout the function to scale content creation, personalize materials, and make seller self-service faster, so a lean team can operate with outsized output.

Requirements

• 10+ years in B2B marketing, product marketing, communications, or sales enablement, including 4+ years leading a marketing function or major program area.

• 5+ years in advertising or ad tech.

• Direct experience running PR and communications, including earned media, announcements, and executive visibility.

• A track record of enablement programs that measurably improved seller ramp, productivity, or win rates.

• Proven success as a player-coach in a lean environment: producing high-quality work personally while setting strategy and owning results.

• Experience owning a marketing budget and tying spend to pipeline and revenue outcomes.

• Strong understanding of the ad tech ecosystem, its participants and business models, and the value exchange among them, including programmatic buying, ad formats, creative, and measurement.

jobs.description:
Technical Leadership (DDR5 / DDR6)

• Own and guide the architecture, design, and implementation of DDR5 PHYs and contribute to DDR6-ready architectures.
• Provide technical oversight for critical analog and mixed-signal blocks, including:
• High-speed TX/RX datapaths
• Advanced equalization, termination, and training circuits
• DLL/PLL-based clocking solutions for multi-GHz operation
• Voltage, reference generation, and power-aware IO design
• Drive closure on timing, jitter, noise, SI/PI, and PVT robustness for aggressive DDR5/DDR6 data rates.
• Ensure compliance with JEDEC DDR5 specifications and alignment with evolving DDR6 standards and industry direction.
• Lead post-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and yield improvement, including lab and customer-system correlation.

People & Organization Leadership

• Build, lead, and mentor a team of analog and mixed-signal designers focused on high-speed memory interfaces.
• Set technical direction, performance expectations, and development plans for senior and principal engineers.
• Drive hiring, onboarding, and team scaling aligned with DDR5 production and DDR6 development needs.
• Foster a culture of technical rigor, ownership, and execution excellence.

Program & Cross-Functional Execution

• Own DDR5/DDR6 PHY execution balancing schedule, quality, and risk
• Partner closely with: Digital PHY and controller teams SoC integration and system architecture, Package, PCB, SI/PI, and validation teams, Product, program management, and customers
• Interface with foundries, IP vendors, and standards bodies as needed to ensure successful delivery and future readiness.

Methodology, Quality & Roadmap

• Establish robust design and signoff methodologies for next-generation high-speed PHYs.
• Drive continuous improvement in simulation accuracy, mixed-signal verification, and silicon debug efficiency.
• Lead long-term DDR5 sustainment and DDR6 technology roadmap planning, including architectural trade-offs and scaling strategies.
• Anticipate challenges from data-rate scaling, power efficiency, and advanced process technologies

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (PhD preferred).
• 12+ years of experience in analog/mixed-signal IC design with deep focus on high-speed memory interfaces.
• 5+ years of people-management and technical leadership experience.
• Proven hands-on delivery of DDR5 PHYs or late-stage DDR4 designs transitioning to DDR5
• Strong expertise in: High-speed IO design and signal integrity, PLL/DLL and low-jitter clocking architectures,Mixed-signal verification and silicon validation, Advanced CMOS process considerations for IOs

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct involvement in DDR6 architectural studies or early-stage development.
• Experience at advanced nodes (7nm, 5nm, and below).
• Background in multi-generation memory PHYs or scalable PHY platforms.
• Ability to lead teams delivering multiple concurrent tape-outs.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and executive audiences.

Leadership Profile

• High technical credibility with the ability to dive deep when needed
• Strong execution mindset with disciplined risk management
• Effective mentor and team builder
• Strategic thinker with a roadmap-driven approach to DDR evolution
• Comfortable balancing hands-on engagement with organizational leadership

jobs.description:
ABOUT INJECTIVE LABS

Injective Labs is trailblazing a new dawn for Web3 enabled finance. We are the core contributors to Injective, one of the fastest growing blockchains in the industry.

Injective provides an interoperable smart contracts platform that is optimized for building decentralized finance applications. Interoperability is at the core of Injective, which is natively integrated with chains such as Ethereum, Cosmos and Solana. Developers can rapidly launch premier financial applications suited for mass adoption using Injective’s infrastructure and specialized DeFi primitives such as the world’s first fully on-chain order book.

Our team has decades of experience spearheading the largest financial institutions and tech organizations. Injective is incubated by Binance and is backed by leading firms such as Jump Crypto, Pantera and Mark Cuban.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an accomplished DeFi Protocol Engineer with a strong background in financial systems who can fit into an existing highly skilled global dev team. Your role is to work closely with the protocol team to brainstorm, write specs, implement, and test chain features for our Injective DeFi modules, bringing real-world trading and exchange expertise to how they are designed. You also have the freedom to detect and take ownership to improve chain performance and scalability via kvstore optimization, processing logic, and the order matching engine.

If you're an autonomous engineer with strong financial experience who enjoys working with a high degree of ownership, and you're looking to make a real impact on one of the fastest-growing blockchains, this role is for you.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Build, maintain, and test core components on our Cosmos-SDK protocol, including our decentralized orderbook, trade execution coordinator, order matcher, and Layer-2 execution environment

 - Design and implement financial primitives on-chain (derivatives, margining, liquidations, pricing and risk logic), translating proven TradFi practices into robust protocol features

 - Develop and optimize core components of the Injective blockchain (consensus, state management, financial infrastructure and applications)

 - Take end-to-end ownership of features, from requirement gathering and specs through architecture, implementation, testing and deployment

 - Write open-source Golang clients that allow users to interact directly with our protocol and smart contracts

 - Contribute to the research and development of new blockchain features and technologies

 - Work closely with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers, back-end developers, and quality assurance engineers, to deliver comprehensive blockchain solutions

 - Collaborate with external partners and open-source communities to enhance our blockchain ecosystem

 


WHO YOU ARE:

 - Minimum of 3 years’ experience as a Blockchain Engineer

 - Strong prior experience in finance, ideally building trading systems, exchanges, or algo trading/derivatives platforms at a bank, trading firm, or exchange

 - Track record of building large, complex, and performant distributed systems in production

 - Worked on at least two production Golang codebases that are reasonably large and performant

 - Strong knowledge of Go idioms, libraries, and parallel processing

 - Strong knowledge of blockchain, DeFi & DEX concepts, consensus mechanisms, CosmWasm contract platform

 - Strong knowledge of CS fundamentals such as data structures and API design

 - Self-driven and comfortable owning problems end-to-end with minimal oversight

 - Ability to communicate technical concepts with other technical and non-technical team members

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Cosmos-SDK/Tendermint

 - Deep knowledge of financial instruments and markets (derivatives, credit, perpetuals, options)

 - Experience with low-latency or high-throughput trading infrastructure

 - Experience with cryptography libraries, including digital signatures and hash algorithms used by Ethereum and Cosmos

 - Experience with key-value databases, especially ones used by cosmos-sdk

 - Experience with Ethereum/Solidity

 


WHY WORK WITH US?

 - Competitive salary and INJ token award

 - Remote-friendly work environment with flexible hours

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Opportunity to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology in the finance industry

You're not managing a team — you're defining what good looks like on the product surface, and everyone else rises to meet it.  - Genuine fluency with AI design tools (Cursor, Claude, generative workflows) — not curiosity, actual working practice

 - Comfort operating without heavy process scaffolding — you define the process as much as you follow it

 - A clear point of view on what makes product design excellent, and the confidence to hold it

How success is defined here

 - In 60 days: You've mapped the current product surface, identified the biggest craft gaps, and shipped your first meaningful improvement

 - In 6 months: You own the design system end-to-end and have raised the visual standard of the app measurably

 - In a year: The Eight Sleep product experience is something designers in the industry reference — and you built that



Why join Eight Sleep?

Innovation in a culture of excellence

Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness.

Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth

From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments aiming for high standards.

Collaboration with exceptional talent

Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment

We extend equity participation to every full-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company. Pay grows rapidly as you accumulate experience with Eight Sleep and translate it into concrete impact.



Your own Pod - and other great benefits

jobs.title: Operational Excellence & Incident Response Manager, Predictions Markets
jobs.description:
About us
Crypto.com is building the regulated home for prediction markets and derivatives in the United States. Through Crypto.com Derivatives North America and OG.com we operate a CFTC-designated contract market and a registered clearinghouse. OG.com Prediction Markets lists event contracts on sports, politics, economics, culture, and crypto, including single-event contracts and combos.
 
The problem you'll solve
It's Saturday night in the US. A partner broker messages: their customers' orders are stuck, and their support queue is filling up. You do not yet know if it is our gateway, their routing, the market data feed, or the settlement logic. People who can fix it are in the US, in Asia, or asleep. Today, whoever sees the message first owns it. That is the gap.
You are the single owner of every production incident that touches OG.com Prediction Markets, the exchange, the clearinghouse, or our partner brokers, from the first alert to the final review. You do not write the fix. You decide who does, within minutes. You keep every affected partner current. You make the risk call on what happens in the next 20 minutes, the next 3 hours, and on Monday morning. Root cause is identified in the first 30 minutes. An issue does not sit open for four hours.
A platform failure usually hits many partners at once, not one. You run that room.
You report to the SVP of Product. You do not have a team on day one. Within 6 to 12 months, a person who is good at this builds the rotation and owns the partner relationships that come with it.
What you decide: severity, who gets paged, the live timeline, every partner update while the incident is open, and the recommendation to pause, halt, cancel, or keep trading. The on-call approver approves a pause or halt. Exchange Operations owns the listing and the settlement call. Engineering owns the code.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Front End
jobs.description:
SOFTWARE ENGINEER, FRONT END



About Atomic Vest

We are a fast-growing, mission-driven company powering the expansion of financial services and wealth creation, with billions of assets under management. We build critical financial infrastructure that allows consumer-facing companies to offer engaging investing experiences to their customers in a frictionless way. We host advanced investing capabilities ranging from ESG investing to multi-currency trading across 60 global markets. We are a team of financial empowerment enthusiasts who have come together from various industries, including tech, banking, finance, and law.

At Atomic, with billions of dollars in assets under custody, you will help build the front end that helps make it easier for ordinary individuals to secure their financial prosperity.  Come join an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact!



Location: Atomic is a remote company with offices in NYC and Mountain View, CA. For this position, it means that you can work remotely from any part of US / Canada.



About the role

You’ll be our lead front-end engineer and operate like a founding product engineer: owning our partner-facing web products end to end, shaping what we build as much as how, and working directly with product, design, and backend engineers. This role is for a self-starter who wants real ownership and is happy to step outside a narrow job description when the team needs it.



What you’d work on

 - Partner-facing web products, owning them end to end from design handoff through to release.

 - The embeddable onboarding module. This is the white-label, co-branded UI that fintech partners embed so their customers can open brokerage accounts, both individual and business. It covers multi-step application flows for business accounts, adding and verifying owners and signers, and identity and compliance checks. One codebase produces several apps and partner-specific builds.

 - The partner dashboard. Partners use it to view and manage their customers’ accounts: positions, statements, account reporting, joint and advisory account details, and settings such as notification contacts.

 - Self-service features that cut down on manual operations work, for example, letting partners edit business details or add participants to existing accounts without filing a support ticket.

 - Moving to a new version of our business-account API. That means rebuilding flows on a new data model in step with backend engineers.

 - Keeping two codebases healthy, including bringing the onboarding module’s dependencies up to date with the dashboard’s.

 

Our frontend stack

 - Core: TypeScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS

 - Components: Radix UI and React Aria, with Storybook for component development

 - Forms and data: React Hook Form with Zod, SWR

 - Server-side: Node.js (Koa) talking to our services over gRPC

 - Integrations: Plaid, Persona, Auth0, LaunchDarkly

 

What you will excel at

 - 4+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript.

 - Building complex, multi-step forms and data-heavy screens, with careful validation, edge cases, and error states.

 - Working in the Node.js server layer behind our web apps (Koa, gRPC, Postgres), not just the browser.

 - Agreeing on API contracts with backend engineers, and pushing back when an API makes the UI hard to build.

 - Working directly with design and product, turning Figma designs and product tickets into shipped features.

 - Owning the release process: our workflow runs from preview environments through UAT to production.

 

Who you are

 - A product engineer: you care about the user experience and the business problem, not just the ticket, and you’ll push back or propose a better approach.

 - A self-starter who is self-motivated and independent: you find the next most important thing and do it without waiting for direction.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and with wearing many hats. In a small team, that means picking up work outside your core area when it matters.

Nice to have

 - Fintech, brokerage, or banking experience, especially account onboarding with identity and compliance checks.

 - Experience building white-label or embeddable products for B2B customers.

 - Experience integrating fintech SDKs such as Plaid or Persona, or e-signature tools.

 - Comfort with AI-assisted development such as Claude Code, which the team uses heavily.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Consolidation & Reporting
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

We are looking for an Associate Manager, Consolidation & Reporting to own the end-to-end global consolidation and reporting process across multiple entities and systems, ensuring accurate, timely, and audit-ready financial reporting under US GAAP and parent company requirements. The role brings strong technical consolidation capabilities, fluctuation analysis, and financial storytelling while driving continuous simplification and automation across the close cycle.

Just as important, this role is expected to improve the consolidation system and reporting workflows, not only operate them. Partnering closely with Booking Holdings (our Parent Company), Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Enterprise Systems, and Center of Excellence (CoE) teams, you will eliminate manual steps, improve upstream data quality, and partner on transformation initiatives to build a faster, more scalable, and insightful reporting process.

This role will be required to work from our Norwalk, CT office at least 3 days per week.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL FOCUS ON:

Consolidation, Close & Reporting

 - Lead multi-entity consolidation, foreign currency translation, and month-end close in NetSuite and OneStream, meeting Parent Company timelines, including a five-business-day close.

 - Deliver accurate reporting packages, rollforwards, schedules, and commentary; resolve issues that affect reporting quality or close timelines.

Process Improvement, Systems & Data Quality with AI

 - Simplify, standardize, and automate close workflows; improve upstream data quality and address recurring issues at their source.

 - Enhance FloQast and other close tools; maintain the Chart of Accounts and coordinate OneStream mapping updates with Parent Company.

 - Use automation and AI-enabled tools (e.g., Glean, Claude, NetSuite Next) for analysis, reconciliations, and validation, checking outputs against source data and controls.

Controls, Analysis & Insight

 - Maintain end-to-end data accuracy, audit readiness, and clear process documentation; review key balance-sheet reconciliations and investigate unusual or recurring items.

 - Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual P&L and balance-sheet fluctuation analysis. Explain variances, trends, and risks clearly, connecting results to business and accounting drivers.

Intercompany & Business Partnership

 - Oversee intercompany and intracompany accounting, including eliminations, revaluation, reconciliations, and variance analysis; coordinate CoE deliverables and support related system transitions.

 - Partner across Finance, Tax, Operations, Enterprise Systems, and Parent Company teams on reporting inputs, tax provisions, equity and investment accounting, and ad hoc requests.

 - Coach your direct report, share knowledge, and keep leadership informed of close progress, risks, and improvement initiatives.





PLEASE APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

 - 6–8 years of progressive accounting experience, combining public accounting (Big 4 or equivalent) with industry; technology, SaaS, or high-growth company experience is a plus.

 - Strong experience in consolidation, close processes, and financial reporting within a multi-entity environment.

 - Proven ability to improve processes, implement automation, and support scalable finance operations.

 - Demonstrated experience with financial fluctuation analysis and variance investigation.

 - Systems-oriented mindset with experience using consolidation and close tools such as OneStream, FloQast, and BlackLine.

 - ERP experience required; NetSuite preferred, with a strong understanding of data structures and system workflows.

 - Understanding of intercompany and intracompany accounting, foreign currency, and global reporting considerations; experience with transfer pricing and revenue share transactions preferred.

 - Strong communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders.

 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

 - Self-starter with a proactive, curious, solutions-oriented, and ownership-focused mindset.




BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year.

 - Company-wide week off a year – the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

 - No meeting Fridays

 - Paid parental leave

 - Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

 - Paid volunteer time

 - Focus on your career growth:

 - Development Dollars

 - Leadership development

 - Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

 - Travel Discounts

 - Employee Resource Groups

 - Competitive retirement and health plans

 - Free lunch 2 days per week

 - Focus on mental health and well-being:

 - Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

 - Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Connecticut-based role is $115,000-$125,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

 


INCLUSION

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

Germany

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executives to join our Territory & Commercial Sales Team covering Germany. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).

As an Account Executive at Cloudflare, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you will be expected to leverage AI tools actively in your daily workflow — from account research and outreach to meeting preparation and pipeline management — using them as a genuine productivity multiplier, not an afterthought.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.

• Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.

• AI-Powered Sales Execution: Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you sell — applying them to account research, personalised outreach, executive meeting preparation, pipeline analysis, and follow-up drafting. Demonstrate the same AI-native mindset Cloudflare brings to its products in how you manage your own territory and time.

• Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.

• Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.

• Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.

• Digital Transformation Authority: Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.

• Compelling Value Creation: Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.

• Trusted Advisor & Coach: Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.

• Organizational Impact & Leadership: Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• 2+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).

• Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.

• Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams (e.g., Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.

• Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).

• Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context — account intelligence, outreach personalisation, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. You can speak specifically to how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective in a previous role.

• Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.

• Expert-level sales acumen: unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.

• Authority on digital transformation trends and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.

• Strong coaching and mentorship abilities, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.

• Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.

• Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).

• Bachelor's degree preferred, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.

• Ability to travel as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.

• Language Skills: German & English

Compensation

For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €124,000 - €171,000.

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

You'll win new customers, either from a named list of high-potential accounts or from companies that don't work with us yet, and you'll expand our business with existing customers.

Your target universe includes SaaS platforms, Fintechs, AI-native Scaleups and other comparable companies that are born in the cloud. Your customers move fast, make infrastructure decisions at the engineering level, and expect their vendors to keep up. The ideal candidate understands how digital-native companies actually buy: bottom-up product adoption, engineering influence, founder-driven decisions, and rapid procurement, and engages as a credible peer in conversations with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and technical founders.

As a Digital Natives Account Executive, you don't chase the next transaction, but are able to build a path on a strategic level with your customers to transform whole infrastructures. You will build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, community engagement, and ecosystem presence, convert developer-led adoption into commercial new logo wins, and position Cloudflare as the infrastructure partner of choice for the next generation of technology companies.

Above all, we are looking for true team players. We win together, not as lone wolves with sharp elbows. You share what works, ask for help when you need it, and celebrate your colleagues' wins as much as your own. You see your BDR, Solutions Engineers and specialists as real partners, not as support functions, and you bring the same care to working with your colleagues as you do to working with your customers. If you believe the best results come from people who make each other better, you'll feel right at home on our team.

Critically, you will use AI tools as an active and integral part of how you sell. Many of your buyers build AI products themselves and speaking their language is the key to being successful. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you are expected to leverage AI tools daily as a genuine force multiplier across your prospecting, pipeline, and preparation and not as an occasional aid.

Responsibilities

• Account strategy: For each key account, work out where the customer could be with Cloudflare in 6 to 18 months, and build a plan with them to get there. Look for the bigger infrastructure changes we can support, such as consolidating vendors or moving workloads to our network, rather than the next single product sale.

• New customers: Win new digital native customers, both from your named list of high-potential accounts and from companies that don't work with Cloudflare yet. Bring new logos onto the platform every quarter and hit or beat your targets.

• Pipeline generation: Own your pipeline. Build it through direct outreach, VC and accelerator networks, partners, and the startup and developer communities across DACH. Spot buying signals early and get to the right people quickly.

• Account growth: Grow existing customers by finding new teams, use cases and products where Cloudflare can help. Make sure new customers get off to a strong start, so they're set up to grow with us.

• Product-led growth: Find accounts where developers or teams already use Cloudflare on their own, and turn that usage into a commercial relationship before a competitor does.

• Technical buyers: Build trusted relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform leads and technical founders. Talk confidently about infrastructure, APIs, cloud architecture and security. Explain what Cloudflare changes for their business in a way that makes sense to engineers and to the people who sign the budget.

• AI infrastructure: Position AI Gateway, Workers AI, Vectorize and our security products for AI workloads with companies building AI products. Understand the problems they face, such as securing AI APIs and keeping inference costs under control as they scale.

• Teamwork: Work closely with your BDR, Customer Engineers and product specialists. Plan accounts together, bring them into customer conversations at the right moment and keep everyone up to date on where each deal stands. Work with Sales Ops and Deal Desk to keep deals moving.

• Full-cycle sales: Run the whole sales process across deals of different sizes and lengths. Qualify carefully, involve the right people and close with confidence, whether a deal takes two weeks or six months.

• Pipeline and forecasting: Keep your pipeline accurate and up to date, and give sales leadership forecasts they can rely on.

• AI in your daily work: Use AI tools every day for account research, personalised outreach, meeting prep, pipeline management and follow-ups. In the interview, we'll ask you how AI helps you get better results.

• Market insight: Share what you learn in the field with the wider team, such as how digital native companies build, buy and scale. This helps Cloudflare keep pace with a fast-moving market.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

Sales experience

• 3 to 5 years in B2B technology sales with a quota, for example in SaaS, cloud, security or developer tools

• Met or beat your annual quota in at least two of the last three years

• Closed deals worth six-seven figures a year, with sales cycles of several months

• Won new customers through your own outbound work, and grown existing accounts with additional products or usage

• Sold usage-based contracts and kept growing them after signature by selling developer-centric use cases. Working directly with engineering teams to bring new applications, workloads and products onto the platform, so spend grows from real adoption.

• Built multi-year account plans together with customers

• Sold to CTOs, VPs of Engineering or technical founders, ideally at digital native companies, startups or scale-ups

• Worked with a structured sales method such as MEDDPICC

Technical knowledge

• You can explain the basics of how the internet works: DNS, CDN, TLS, HTTP and APIs

• You understand common threats such as DDoS attacks, bots and API abuse, and how companies protect themselves

• You know the basics of modern cloud setups, such as public cloud, Kubernetes and serverless

• You have solid public cloud know-how. You understand how companies use AWS, GCP, Azure, including Kubernetes and serverless. What drives their cost and where Cloudflare complements or replaces them.

• You know how modern engineering teams ship software, including CI/CD and developer tooling such as GitHub, GitLab and AI coding tools like Claude Code.

• Knowing Cloudflare (Workers, R2, AI Gateway, Zero Trust) or a competitor such as AWS, Akamai, Fastly or Vercel is a plus

Tools and ways of working

• You use Salesforce or a similar CRM every day and keep your pipeline and forecast accurate

• You already use AI tools in your sales work, for example ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research and writing, or Clay for account research. Be ready to show us how.

• You've worked in a team with BDRs and pre-sales engineers

Other

• Startup or VC experience is a plus, either working at a startup or selling into VC-backed companies

• Fluent German and English, spoken and written

• Able to travel within DACH and to industry events

Compensation

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
