jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Executive
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.



OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

The Role

At Sunrise Robotics, this Enterprise Sales Executive role exists to bring intelligent robotic automation into complex manufacturing environments and drive our expansion across Europe.

You’ll work directly with senior stakeholders at manufacturing companies to understand production workflows and identify where automation can deliver meaningful operational and financial impact. You’ll build a pipeline through targeted outreach and time on-site, and lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through close. This is not transactional sales - you’re helping customers adopt a new category of flexible automation and guiding them through that shift.

In your first 6–12 months, your impact should be clear: a strong enterprise pipeline, successful live engagements, and closed deals that convert into long-term partnerships. You will be accountable for revenue generation in your region and for shaping how Sunrise goes to market as we scale internationally.

What You’ll Do

 - Build Sunrise Robotics’ commercial presence across Europe, developing new opportunities with manufacturers in complex production environments.

 - Generate pipeline through proactive outreach, deep account research, industry relationships, and meaningful time spent on customer sites.

 - Spend time on-site understanding factory-floor workflows and identifying where intelligent automation can drive measurable operational and financial impact.

 - Lead full sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and close, navigating multi-stakeholder decision processes with clarity and conviction.

 - Structure and manage pilot engagements with clearly defined success criteria, creating a repeatable path to scaled commercial rollout.

 - Grow and expand an existing customer base, increasing revenue and unlocking new long-term commercial opportunities.

 - Maintain strong pipeline visibility and forecasting discipline while collaborating closely with technical, product, and customer success teams to ensure successful deployments.

What You’ll Need

 - A track record of selling complex, enterprise solutions, ideally in early-stage or international market-launch environments.

 - Experience commercialising innovative, non-commoditised products where value had to be created, not simply compared.

 - Confidence operating in high-ambiguity environments with developing playbooks and a strong sense of ownership.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset, demonstrated through founding experience, rapid progression, or expanded scope and responsibility.

 - A strong work ethic and evidence of deep preparation, thoughtful account research, and initiative beyond the brief.

 - High curiosity and the ability to ramp quickly on robotics, manufacturing workflows, and technical concepts.

 - Comfort operating independently in the field while driving deals forward with discipline and structure.

 - Fluency in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

 - Willingness to travel frequently across Europe and spend meaningful time on customer sites.

What Makes You Stand Out

 - Experience selling into manufacturing, industrial automation, or robotics environments.

 - Experience with long sales cycles involving pilots, proofs-of-concept, or staged rollouts.

 - Background in early-stage or scaling companies entering new markets.

 - Experience working closely with product or engineering teams in technical sales environments.

 - Additional European languages beyond English.

Why Us

We’re building a new category of intelligent, flexible robotic automation with real deployments, real customers, and momentum across Europe.

 - High exposure: Work directly with founders and leadership on strategy, market entry, and key commercial decisions.

 - Career acceleration: Help define the enterprise sales motion for a category-defining robotics company while building deep expertise in industrial automation.

 - Real impact: Own deals that directly translate into deployed systems on factory floors, shaping revenue, product direction, and company growth.

 - Proven Product-Market Fit: Live deployments across Europe & a growing pipeline supported by a skilled SDR team.

Concentrate time and resources on the accounts and opportunities with the greatest potential for platform-wide adoption.

Executive Relationship Management: Build trusted relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level, often starting without an existing Cloudflare presence. Develop broad, multi-threaded executive networks within target accounts and act as a strategic advisor by bringing relevant market insight, a compelling point of view, and clear business value—not simply responding to RFPs.

Complex Sales Cycle Leadership: Lead sophisticated enterprise sales processes from initial engagement through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive buying centres simultaneously. Establish clear mutual action plans, maintain control of deal momentum, qualification, and next steps, and advance opportunities with precision and appropriate urgency.

Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect’s technology environment, including cloud strategy, network architecture, security posture, application landscape, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, and AI infrastructure. Map Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, positioning comprehensive platform adoption rather than isolated point solutions.

Align resources around a differentiated strategy, proactively remove blockers, and deliver a consistently excellent prospect experience throughout the sales cycle.

AI-Powered Sales Execution: Use AI tools deliberately and consistently to improve the quality and velocity of your sales execution. Apply them to account research, hypothesis development, stakeholder mapping, personalised executive outreach, meeting preparation, competitive analysis, pipeline inspection, and follow-up. Continuously experiment with new ways to make your territory management and customer engagement sharper and more effective.

Digital Transformation & AI Positioning: Serve as a credible partner to enterprises navigating digital, cloud, security, and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping infrastructure, compliance, security, and competitive dynamics. Position Cloudflare capabilities—including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads—as strategic enablers ofcustomers’ long-term transformation agendas.

Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Build and maintain sufficient high-quality pipeline to consistently achieve ambitious new business targets. Deliver accurate, evidence-based account and opportunity forecasts to sales leadership, with clear visibility into qualification, deal status, risks, stakeholder alignment, and required actions. Apply rigorous inspection and honest judgement across long and complex enterprise sales cycles.

Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Lead complex commercial and contractual negotiations with confidence and discipline. Construct compelling, outcome-linked value propositions tied directly to each customer’s strategic objectives. Secure commercially strong, sustainable agreements while protecting long-term customer value and Cloudflare’s position as a strategic platform partner.

Contribute to Cloudflare’s understanding of the German Majors market, partner with colleagues to improve execution, and elevate the performance of those around you through coaching, collaboration, and example.

• A consistent history of personal pipeline generation, including disciplined prospecting, executive outreach, account-based selling, and effective use of partners and industry networks to access senior decision-makers.

• Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), Connectivity, Developer Platforms, and Edge Computing, with the ability to engage credibly with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior infrastructure leaders.

• Proven ability to understand complex enterprise IT architectures and map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures, connecting technical differentiation to measurable business outcomes and platform-wide adoption.

• Demonstrated success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles across procurement, legal, information security, technical, financial, and executive buying centres.

jobs.title: SAR Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

• Over $300 million raised in funding

• 3,000 Tideans globally

• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

This role is a key element of our newly established Fincrime Intelligence and Reporting function.  You’ll be responsible for ensuring we put our genuine members first, through reporting potentially suspicious activity to authorities and taking measures to disrupt criminals.  You’ll have opportunities to be involved in wider Financial Crime projects which will help reduce risk to Tide and let our members get back to doing what they love.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an Investigative Reporting Analyst you’ll be:

• Achieve and maintain formal accreditation to carry out specific responsibilities on behalf of Tide’s Nominated Officer, including collating and evaluating internal reports for inclusion within reports to Law Enforcement and ensuring the accuracy and quality of external reports

• Collating information and writing comprehensive reports relating to all types of financial crime for inclusion within notifications to Law Enforcement Agencies, including SAR submissions

• Supporting in complex, proactive investigations by ensuring we report the right information at the right time to external partners

• Providing assurance by reviewing the outcomes and decisions of cases, determining whether the correct case outcome was achieved and correctly documented

• Providing feedback, leading workshops and training sessions

• Confident in calling out potential efficiencies in our tools and processes, making recommendations for process improvements to prevent future occurrences of fraud/financial crime offences

• Managing your own case load to meet performance targets

• Consistently reaching the targets for Productivity and Quality

• Establishing good relationships with various departments throughout the organisation to ensure good operational synergy

• Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

Here at Tide, we are looking for a proactively minded Investigative Reporting Analyst with a good understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime typologies and prevention measures. We need a passionate and proactive individual, who will help ensure Tide is taking all the relevant steps to report and enforce against all aspects of financial crime. The ideal candidate will have:

• 1 to 3 years of experience in a financial crime investigations, compliance or QA related role in financial services, specialising in business-related anti-money laundering/fraud investigations

• Previous experience in SAR writing, NCA submission and knowledge of relevant UK legislation (POCA, tipping off, DAML) is essential

• Ability to work well as part of a team; decisive; goal-oriented; proactive

• Strong stakeholder management skills and comfortable communicating with a wide range of associates

• A proactive and open-minded approach to finding effective solutions

• A genuinely curious mindset, asking the right questions at the right times, with a problem solving attitude

• A keen eye for process improvements, looking at how we can work leaner and more robustly

• Exceptional communication skills – written and verbal – and are able to communicate with our members, internal stakeholders & regulatory bodies if required

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

• 25 days paid annual leave

• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities

• Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company

• Personal L&D budget

• Additional health & dental insurance

• Mental wellbeing platform

• Fully covered Multisports card

• Food vouchers

• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office

• WFH equipment allowance

• Flexible working from home

• Sabbatical Leave

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:

• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.

• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Campaign Manager, Beauty (US/ ET, EST )
jobs.description:

Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.


CAMPAIGN MANAGER |  BEAUTY

Fully remote 

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm Eastern Time (ET)


We're looking for an experienced Campaign Manager to support one of our Beauty clients.

This is an immediate opportunity for someone who knows influencer marketing inside out, can hit the ground running and is confident owning campaigns from start to finish.



THE OPPORTUNITY

Our clients move quickly, and so do we. Briefs evolve, priorities shift and campaigns often need creative problem-solving along the way.


We're looking for someone who enjoys that pace, takes ownership and knows how to deliver great work without needing constant direction.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
JOIN THE SLEEP FITNESS MOVEMENT

At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 30 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, 2023, and 2026 and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger. 



Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up.




HIGH STANDARDS. NO APOLOGIES.

We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5. Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it.



The Role

Eight Sleep makes technology that responds to your body in real time. The app and product surface are where that technology lives for our customers — and this role owns that experience. We're looking for a staff-level IC who can set the craft standard for product design at Eight Sleep and carry it forward with minimal direction.

You'll work directly with the Executive Creative Director. The expectation is simple: your work is the benchmark. You're not managing a team — you're defining what good looks like on the product surface, and everyone else rises to meet it. With your craft and vision, you will set the standard for other product designers on the team.


Location: NYC 
Location Requirement: 3 days/week in-office, hybrid




What You'll Own 

 - End-to-end design of the Eight Sleep app and product UI — from interaction architecture through final visual polish

 - Own and evolve the product design system: components, patterns, tokens, and the rules that govern them

 - Translate complex health and biometric data into interfaces that feel clear, calm, and premium

 - Partner with product, engineering, and brand to ensure the in-app experience is coherent with the broader Eight Sleep aesthetic

 - Set the craft bar for the product surface — your output is the reference point for designers, contractors, and cross-functional partners

 - Prototype interactions and flows to validate concepts quickly before engineering investment



What You Will Need to Succeed

 - 8–12 years in product/UI design, with a portfolio that demonstrates mastery of both interaction design and visual craft

 - Experience designing for health, biometrics, or data-rich consumer apps — you know how to make complexity feel simple

 - Deep Figma fluency — as a design tool, a prototyping tool, and a system-building tool

 - Strong motion sensibility; you think in transitions, not just screens

 - Genuine fluency with AI design tools (Cursor, Claude, generative workflows) — not curiosity, actual working practice

 - Comfort operating without heavy process scaffolding — you define the process as much as you follow it

 - A clear point of view on what makes product design excellent, and the confidence to hold it


How Success is Defined

 - In 60 days: You've mapped the current product surface, identified the biggest craft gaps, and shipped your first meaningful improvement

 - In 6 months: You own the design system end-to-end and have raised the visual standard of the app measurably

 - In a year: The Eight Sleep product experience is something designers in the industry reference — and you built that



Why join Eight Sleep?

Innovation in a culture of excellence
Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness.

Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth

From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments aiming for high standards.

Collaboration with exceptional talent
Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment
We extend equity participation to every full-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company. Pay grows rapidly as you accumulate experience with Eight Sleep and translate it into concrete impact.

Your own Pod - and other great benefits
Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod, along with other benefits

jobs.title: Senior Vice President of Marketing
jobs.description:
About Cobalt

At Cobalt, we believe everyone deserves to live and work in a safer, more secure world. Founded in 2013 on the belief that penetration testing could – and should – be better, we set out to challenge the status quo and transform how organizations approach offensive security.

Today, we’re leading the way in transforming the offensive security market, bringing together world-class security expertise, innovative technology and a global community of security professionals to make security testing more seamless, effective and collaborative. Our diverse, fully-remote team partners with organizations of all sizes to help them OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

And we’re just getting started!

AI is fundamentally reshaping the cybersecurity landscape, creating new opportunities, new challenges and entirely new ways of thinking about security. At Cobalt, we’re not waiting to see what happens next; we’re helping define it. We’re challenging conventions, pushing boundaries and reimagining what’s possible in offensive security.

Customers can launch a pentest in as little as 24 hours through our SaaS platform and exclusive Cobalt Core community. With 500+ highly vetted security testers, representing just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core conducts thousands of tests annually, helping organizations identify and remediate risk across their evolving attack surfaces.

This is an exciting time to join Cobalt. We’re looking for ambitious, creative and agile leaders who thrive on change, think beyond traditional playbooks and have the vision to create new categories, shape markets and build what comes next. If you’re excited by the opportunity to make a real impact in a market undergoing significant transformation, we’d love you to be part of our journey.

Description

As SVP of Marketing, you will lead Cobalt's global marketing strategy, serving as a key member of the executive leadership team and taking accountability for marketing's contribution to the company's growth, market position and long-term commercial success.

You will shape and accelerate Cobalt's position as the leader in continuous offensive security testing building a differentiated global brand, strengthening our market influence and driving measurable impact across pipeline, revenue growth, customer acquisition and expansion. You will lead and scale a high-performing, marketing organization spanning brand, communications, product marketing, growth marketing, analyst relations, PR and events.

Working in close partnership with the CEO and executive leadership team, you will connect market strategy, customer insight and commercial priorities to create a competitive advantage and unlock new growth opportunities. This is an executive leadership role for a commercially driven, strategic marketer who can balance long-term brand building with measurable business outcomes, while fostering a culture of accountability, creativity, innovation and customer-centricity.

What You'll Do

• Own Marketing Strategy & Category Leadership: Define and lead Cobalt's global marketing strategy, establishing Cobalt as the recognized leader in Continuous Offensive Security Testing and autonomous testing. Shape market positioning, category narrative and competitive differentiation in support of the company's growth ambitions.

• Drive Commercial Growth & Revenue: Own marketing's contribution to pipeline, revenue and business growth through integrated demand generation, performance marketing, ABM and customer marketing strategies. Partner with Sales and executive leadership to accelerate customer acquisition, retention, expansion and market penetration.

• Build Brand & Market Influence: Elevate Cobalt's global brand and reputation through differentiated positioning, compelling storytelling, PR, corporate communications and analyst relations, including Gartner and Forrester.

• Lead Product Marketing & Go-to-Market Strategy: Partner with Product and Sales to drive product positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation and GTM execution. Influence product strategy, packaging and pricing to accelerate adoption and commercial success.

• Build & Lead a High-Performing Marketing Organization: Recruit, develop and lead a marketing team spanning brand, communications, demand generation, product marketing, content, and creative. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation and collaboration.

• Own Marketing Investment & Business Impact: Manage the global marketing budget and ensure investment delivers measurable returns. Establish clear performance metrics across pipeline contribution, revenue, CAC, LTV, conversion, retention, and expansion. Bring market intelligence and customer insights to executive decision-making, identifying opportunities for growth and international expansion.

You Must Have

• Executive & Global Marketing Leadership: 10+ years of progressive B2B cybersecurity marketing leadership experience, with a proven ability to influence company strategy, partner with executive leadership, lead cross-functional initiatives, and build high-performing, globally distributed teams. Combines strategic thinking with a creative, agile and hands-on approach to drive innovation, foster accountability and collaboration, and deliver measurable business impact.

• Proven Commercial Impact: A track record of scaling marketing organizations and driving measurable business growth, including pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition and market expansion. Experience supporting significant growth phases (e.g., $50M to $200M+ ARR).

• Category & Marketing Strategy: Experience building market categories, establishing differentiated positioning and leading integrated marketing strategies across brand, communications, product marketing, GTM, demand generation, ABM and customer marketing.

• Financial & Business Acumen: Experience managing significant marketing budgets, allocating resources strategically and demonstrating measurable ROI. Strong understanding of pipeline contribution, revenue performance, CAC, LTV and marketing efficiency.

• Market Influence & Communication: Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling market narratives and represent Cobalt at senior industry forums and major conferences.

• Global Cybersecurity & High-Growth Experience: Proven experience scaling marketing functions within global, high-growth cybersecurity businesses, with a strong understanding of the enterprise security landscape and key buyers (including CISOs, CTOs and security teams).

Why You Should Join Us

• Shape the Future of Cybersecurity: Help define the Continuous Offensive Security Market, build Cobalt's global brand and establish category leadership in a rapidly growing industry.

• Make a Strategic Impact: Work alongside an experienced executive team, influence company strategy and lead a global marketing organization through Cobalt's next phase of growth.

• Share in Our Success: Enjoy competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan, with the opportunity to share in the long-term value you help create.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Access retirement savings 401(k) in the US or pension in the EU, healthcare coverage and dedicated stipends for wellness, home office equipment, Wi-Fi and learning and development.

• Work Flexibly, Live Fully: Benefit from generous flexible paid time off and 12 weeks of paid parental leave, supporting your wellbeing and life beyond work.

Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only)

Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is $300,000 - $390,000 OTE + equity + benefits. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications.  The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities.

Cobalt (the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer, and we want the best available persons for every job. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company.

jobs.title: Partner Business Manager (EU)
jobs.description:
About Parsec

Parsec Automation, LLC (Parsec) is a trailblazing creator and provider of manufacturing operations management software. Consistently recognized by organizations like Gartner and IDC and a winner of numerous awards, including the Data Breakthrough Awards, American Business, and Best in Biz, Parsec exemplifies leadership in the dynamic, fast-paced manufacturing sector. With major companies such as Johnson & Johnson, Merck, Toyota, Proctor & Gamble, Eli Lilly, Hershey, Siemens, and DuPont leveraging its innovative TrakSYS™ platform to tackle even the most complex manufacturing challenges, Parsec’s solutions are actively optimizing efficiency, quality, and compliance at over 11,000 plants in more than 140 countries. Committed to customer success and driven by innovation, Parsec continues to fulfill its mission of making the management of manufacturing operations as simple as possible.

Parsec is backed by BVP Forge, a $780M fund in partnership with the $20B Bessemer platform that has backed industry-defining businesses such as LinkedIn, MindBody, Procore, Shopify, and Toast. BVP Forge combines Bessemer’s front-line industry insights, proven growth IP, and robust executive network with tailored resources for self-sustaining companies and the ForgeEdge™ operational program.

The Role

The Partner Business Manager is responsible for delivering their assigned Partner Revenue Production quota and the health, growth, and performance of the assigned group of Parsec partners in their region- System Integrators who deploy TrakSYS for customers, as well as Value Added Resellers who resell TrakSYS directly. The PBM is Parsec's face to the partner, responsible for ensuring partners have adequate training and enablement, building partner capability, driving demand generation, and accelerating both referral and resale business. This is a field partner development and sales role, with travel up to 60% of the time, onsite with partners, at customer sites, and at trade shows.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Development and Enablement

- Onboard new partners in region, ensuring they're enabled to sell and deliver TrakSYS successfully

- Assess partner capability and resource gaps, and coordinate training specific to those gaps

- Build and maintain account plans for each partner in the portfolio

- Run quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and monitor partner performance against plan

Business Development and Demand Generation

- Drive business development activity within the partners' regions

- Own demand generation efforts in partnership with the partner and Parsec marketing

- Attend and represent Parsec in collaboration with assigned partners at regional trade events

- Drive and support referral software business from SI partners to the Parsec direct pipeline

- Support and accelerate resale business with VAR partners, including co-selling as needed

- Own territory development: identify each partner's vertical and industry strengths and optimize their ability to deploy and / or sell in their region, while extending their reach and / or developing new partners to fill regional or vertical gaps

Internal Coordination

- Triangulate between internal sales, marketing, SMEs, and solution engineering resources to provide the appropriate support to each partner

- Serve as the primary internal advocate for assigned partners, escalating and resolving blockers

- Keep a pulse on active partner led implementations, supporting and escalating as needed to ensure accelerated time to value and implementation success for our clients

- Work in close alignment and partnership with Parsec Professional Services on partner capability, delivery quality, and implementation support

Technical and Market Fluency

- Understand the core capabilities of TrakSYS to the proficiency of delivering a high level platform overview demo

- Maintain a working understanding of each partner's business: their services offerings, verticals, target markets, and competitive position

- Use that understanding to identify where TrakSYS fits into the partner's existing customer relationships and service lines and supports their broader GTM strategy

Requirements

- Experience in partner management and channel sales/business development, ideally in industrial software, MES, or a related B2B technology space

- Comfortable presenting to, and building relationships with partner leadership, partner sales teams, technical teams, and end customers

- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills; able to manage through complex, sometimes ambiguous partner dynamics

- Ability to learn and present technical product concepts clearly without an engineering background

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 60% of the time, largely onsite with partners and clients and at trade shows

- Executive presence and polish; this role represents Parsec externally

Success Metrics

- Partner readiness and capability at required level (training completion, gap closure)

- Meet or exceed assigned VAR sales quota

- Meet or exceed assigned SI partner referral sales quota

- QBR cadence and account plan currency across the portfolio

- New partner onboarding velocity and quality

Benefits

- Remote work schedule

- Generous time off and flexible holidays

- Outstanding team environment

- Professional development and growth opportunities

At SanMar, the work you do makes a difference.

Position: Equipment Operator.

Schedule: 10:00PM-6:30AM.

Salary Range: $18.50-$27.50 +$2.00 differential.

What's the Short Version?

The Equipment Operator safely and efficiently locates product by using a radio frequency (RF) unit, manually pulls product from locations, and transports product to various departments and/or locations. They process a portion of customer orders throughout the production day and restock product into bins.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Restock, pick, and pack product for customer orders.

• Inspect assigned equipment daily at start of shift; is responsible for checking out equipment and returning in same condition on a daily basis.

• Follow procedures for proper care and use of equipment, to include keys.

• Adhere to all safety requirements and guidelines.

• Complete and maintain SanMar's Lift Operator Certification in compliance with OSHA guidelines every three years.

What Are We Looking For?

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• 1-3 years of lift operator experience

• Ability to read, write and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information

• Basic math skills in counting and quantity required

• Demonstrates ability to follow directions and change priorities or job duties as business needs require; rotate to other production functions as needed

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume environment while meeting deadlines

• Able to work both independently and within a team

• Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills

• Comprehend verbal and written instructions

• Essential days or overtime may be required

What's Our Offer?

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

• 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle

• Life insurance

• Short/long-term disability coverage

• Paid maternity/paternity leave

• Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced.The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

Why Work at SanMar?

Our people are at the heart of everything we do. They bring their talent, passion and dedication to work with them every day. Their hard work inspires us and gives us purpose. We love working here together.

Whether you work in our headquarters, from your home or in one of our distribution centers across North America, we believe that investing in you is just the right thing to do. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your health and well-being, life balance, career growth and (eventually) retirement.

SanMar works with brands you already know, like Nike, The North Face and Brooks Brothers, as well as providing industry-leading private label apparel and accessories. Our people come to work excited to do their part, providing clothing that helps people feel that they’re a part of something special.

Here’s your chance to be a part of this story. If you’re ready to work in a place where your participation matters and your growth is a priority, we’re ready for you.

SanMar is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, whoever you love or follow in faith, whatever your disability or superpower status, whichever ethnicity or gender you identify with, you are welcome at SanMar.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (gn) - More Nutrition Switzerland
jobs.description:
Start: immediately | Level: Intermediate | Location: Switzerland, remote | Working hours: Full-time (40h/week)

More Nutrition already has a very large presence in Switzerland with an 8-digit revenue, double digit growth and significant investment. Our presence has been anchored into the German-speaking part of Switzerland; we’re set to expand while growing our presence in Romandy.

As Marketing Manager, you will report into the VP, International, and will be responsible for developing and executing our brand strategy for More Nutrition in Switzerland, with a particular focus on Romandy. You will also start seeding the French market. Speaking French is MANDATORY.

In this role, you will create impactful campaigns, drive local marketing initiatives and ensure a consistent brand experience across all touchpoints. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, agencies and local stakeholders to significantly expand our presence in the Swiss market.

You’ve got a good understanding of cultural nuances between German-speaking Swizterland, Romandy and France. You’ve worked in a fast-paced consumer goods or FMCG environment, operating both with big retailers and direct online sales platforms. You’re comfortable in newly created roles, working with multiple functional stakeholders, and can roll up your sleeves to execute.

Your mission

· As brand guardian, you develop and implement the brand strategy for Switzerland, combining global guidelines with local consumer insights

· You define the marketing activation calendar and lead the planning and execution of omnichannel campaigns (incl. mass media, influencer marketing, TikTok and point of sale)

· You brief and manage agencies to create on-brand, locally relevant assets (in German and French) and ensure timely campaign delivery

· You track brand metrics (awareness, equity, engagement) and campaign KPIs and use this data for continuous optimisation

· You work closely with cross-functional teams to guarantee a consistent brand experience across D2C, pure play and point of sale

· You coordinate closely with the local commercial teams to align marketing activities with market and sales targets

· You help shape the local product portfolio based on the needs and potential of the Swiss market

Your experience & skills

· French speaking is mandatory Ideally you have experience working both in French-speaking Swizterland and France. You have some level of understanding of how the shopper may differ.

· You have 4–6 years of solid professional experience as a brand or marketing manager in FMCG / consumer goods, ideally in food & beverage

· You have proven experience leading or managing one or more brands in Switzerland or France with revenues of at least CHF 30 million

· You have solid experience managing a D2C business and omnichannel campaigns (incl. mass media, influencer marketing, social media such as TikTok and Meta, as well as point of sale + pure play)

· You stand out with a strong hands-on mentality, excellent project management skills and a genuine enthusiasm for cross-functional collaboration

· You have a data-driven mindset and are confident using digital marketing tools

· You are fluent in French and are confident using English for our internal communication. Speaking German is of course a definite plus.

Why us?

At The Quality Group, more than 1,200 people share a common mission: to rethink nutrition – healthier, smarter and with real added value for the community. We believe in team spirit, ownership and the courage to push boundaries. Every contribution counts, regardless of location or department. Depending on where you join us, you can look forward to various benefits, including:

· Attractive employee discounts on ESN & More products

· Flexible working hours & home office options

· Workation options and more

During the application process, you'll find out which specific benefits await you at your location and what it means to be part of TQG: a company shaping the future of nutrition with passion, quality and courage.

About us

The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products and has united the successful brands ESN and More Nutrition since 2021. ESN has been Germany's market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products such as protein powders, bars and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. More Nutrition, founded in 2017, stands for healthy, sugar-reduced nutrition products and offers solutions for mindful eating and weight management – without sacrifice. TQG's vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovative strength, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance and joy of life. With an agile corporate culture and exciting career opportunities, TQG is a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees. That's us – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it's your turn! We look forward to receiving your application! Regardless of gender, age, background or identity – what matters to us is who you are and what you bring. Join our team and grow with us.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant Energy - Pricing & Sourcing
jobs.description:
We are looking for a new colleague with experience in the commercial domain of the energy sector, i.e. at energy suppliers and/or trading organizations. As a consultant, you’ll directly start at one of our clients and play a role in the transition of the Energy sector towards the “New Energy Reality”. This new reality is characterised by new ways of energy generation, transportation, distribution, and changing customer behaviour. Energy suppliers and traders have to anticipate and tackle the challenges that this transition brings.

As a consultant you are ready for the next step in your career in the area of energy sourcing, pricing and portfoliomanagement, while using your business analysis and project management skills. You want to contribute to the commercial challenges that our clients face in this highly competitive market, and you are familiar with the activities that suppliers and traders undertake to anticipate the energy transition challenges. Being an expert on trading and portfoliomanagement, you are able to discuss these challenges with both business and IT.

At the client, you’ll work on projects related to (for example) improvement of the financial results of sales and sourcing departments, defining reorganisational improvements and vendor selection of relevant IT systems. You are contributing to the investment decisions that allow the business to deploy new activities or improve the efficiency of their business processes. The provided solution often requires a combination of business analysis, project management and stakeholder management. Preferably, you have already worked as a consultant (for an energy supplier/trading organisation) and are familiar with the challenges in this area.

You will work together with colleagues of the Energy team and (if applicable) the Data Science team, and leverage on your knowledge of the commercial Energy domain. You will have the opportunity to broaden your knowledge on other domains within the energy sector, like grid owners and regulators. Aside from your client mission, you will help to develop our team, by contributing to our strategy, business development, recruitment, knowledge sharing and training. This ensures a highly dynamic job with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop personally.

• You have completed your Master’s Degree, in which you developed your analytical skills well
• Passion for energy! You have at least 4 years of experience as a consultant.
• You have relevant experiences in the commercial domain of the energy sector, for example at energy suppliers and/or a trading organization
• Energy sourcing, pricing, trading and portfoliomanagement are familiar to you
• You have a good view on the challenges that client stakeholders face in this area, and are able to bring stakeholders throughout the organization together to add value to the client business process
• Good view of the developments in the energy market and the impact on actors in the value chain.
• You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
• English and Dutch communication and presentation skills, French & German is considered a plus.
• You are able to process information, identify problems and trends, and solve complex problems.
• You have an entrepreneurial mindset.
• You're a fast learner, communicative, flexible and entrepreneurial

What do we offer?

• Competitive salary with great extra advantages: a clear and structured yearly salary increase and bonuses.
• Flexible transport options that match your personal needs.
• Training plan to develop yourself as an expert in your discipline.
• You have the opportunity to work from home, the client or from our inspiring office in Amsterdam.
• Working in an international environment which creates opportunities to share knowledge and work together on international projects with colleagues all over the world.

Non-Dutch speaker will no be accepted

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant Energy System Planning
jobs.description:
We are looking for an energy system expert within our Energy & Utilities practice with

extensive knowledge or experience within the DSO or TSO domain. As a consultant, you’ll

directly start at one of our clients and play a role in the transition of the Energy sector

towards the “New Energy Reality”. This new reality is characterised by new ways of energy

generation, transportation, distribution, and changing customer behaviour. Grid operators

have to anticipate and tackle the challenges that this transition brings.

As a consultant, you are ready for the next step in your career in the area of integrated energy system planning, business analysis and project management. You get excited by the latest Dutch offshore wind targets (21GW in 2030), the infrastructural challenges that come with it, and the other necessary storage and conversion solutions to provide system flexibility. You want to contribute to the realisation of the energy transition, and you are familiar with the

activities that grid operators undertake to anticipate the energy transition challenges.

At the client, you’ll work on projects related to developing the ability and toolkit to deal with

issues like long-term grid planning, system integration (power and gas sectors), and shaping

energy policies. You are directly contributing to the grid planning decisions that address

costs, socio-economic welfare, and CO2 changes in the energy system. The work often

requires a combination of strong stakeholder management, business analysis, project

management, integrated energy system optimization, data analysis and reporting. Preferably,

you have already worked as a consultant (for a grid operator) and are familiar with the

concepts of integrated energy system planning.

You will have the opportunity to broaden your knowledge on different domains within the

energy sector. Aside from your client mission, you will help to develop our team, by

contributing to our strategy, business development, recruitment, knowledge sharing and

training. This ensures a highly dynamic job with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop

personally.

• Educational background in energy systems, sustainable energy technologies, or similar showing an in-depth and broad understanding of the energy system and the energy transition
• You have at least 4 years relevant working experience (or PhD)
• Understanding of the role of long term scenarios and visions in large scale projects and energy policy
• You have excellent analytical skills, numerical insight and a well-developed conceptual ability
• Good understanding of DSO and TSO business/operations
• You are a fast learner, communicative, flexible and entrepreneurial
• You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
• Professional Dutch and English language skills. If you also speak German fluently, that’s a great plus!
• Passionate about Energy!

• Training plan to develop yourself as an expert in your discipline.
• You have the opportunity to work from home, the client or from our inspiring office in Amsterdam.

jobs.description:
As a Senior Fund Accountant, you will be responsible for delivering accurate and timely fund accounting services to a portfolio of fund clients. You will prepare and review financial statements, NAV calculations, investor reports, and other key accounting deliverables while maintaining strong governance, compliance, and risk management standards. The role requires excellent stakeholder management skills, a strong client service mindset, and a commitment to driving process improvements and operational excellence within the Fund Accounting function.

What you will do

• You will prepare financial statements, investor reports, and Net Asset Value (NAV) reports while meeting strict accounting deadlines
• You will collaborate with the wider fund accounting team, including Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accounting Managers to support client portfolios and projects
• You will maintain accurate records, follow accounting procedures, and assist Compliance with client reviews and issue reporting
• You will deliver high-quality service to internal and external clients while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
• You will build commercial and regulatory knowledge and present financial information effectively to senior stakeholders

What we offer

• Competitive Rewards: Attractive compensation and benefits designed to recognise your skills, experience, and contribution
• Health and Wellbeing: Access to a range of wellbeing initiatives and employee benefits that support your physical, mental, and financial wellness
• Work-Life Balance: Flexible working opportunities and leave policies that help employees balance their professional and personal commitments
• Learning and Development: Ongoing training, career development opportunities, and the resources needed to support your professional growth
• Inclusive Culture: A collaborative and supportive environment where employees are valued, empowered, and encouraged to reach their full potential

• You will have proven experience of working in industry within a Fund Accounting role (this is a non-negotiable requirement)
• You will have a strong understanding of financial processes and controls
• You will have a strong commitment to delivering high-quality client service in a detail-oriented environment
• You will have excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional approach
• You will be technically proficient, adaptable to new systems, and skilled at managing multiple priorities under pressure
• You will hold a professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, FCA, CA(SA) or equivalent

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

As a forward-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 5,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, speaking 41 languages across 25 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support female managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing long-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Sales, Velocity is a key leadership role within the Sales division. You will build, develop and lead a global team of Account Executives who close high volume SMB deals. This is a coaching-first leadership role. Your team will be early in career, and your ability to grow them into confident, consistent performers is what drives results. You will shape the Storyblok Velocity sales motion, scale revenue across regions and own the plans, processes and people strategy behind it. You will also build the talent pipeline from which Storyblok’s next generation of sales leaders will emerge.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Lead, coach and scale a global team of Velocity Account Executives

• Build and run a structured coaching program covering call reviews, deal inspection, skills development and clear progression paths

• Design and refine the Velocity sales motion, including playbooks, qualification, pipeline coverage and sales cycle benchmarks for high volume SMB deals as well as graduating self-serve customers to enterprise and running signal based motion

• Own regional and global revenue targets for the Velocity segment, with accurate forecasting and clear accountability

• Define and track the activity, conversion and velocity metrics that drive performance, and act on them quickly

• Partner with Marketing, BDR, PLG, Partners, Sales Operations and Product to optimize lead flow, handoffs and the end-to-end customer journey

• Lead hiring, onboarding and ramp for new Account Executives so new hires reach productivity fast

• Build a high-performance, positive and inclusive team culture across time zones

• Create a clear promotion framework that moves top performers into Mid-Market and Enterprise roles

• Analyze sales data to spot trends, risks and opportunities, and turn them into action plans

• Continuously improve sales processes, tooling and automation to increase efficiency at scale

• Report on Velocity performance and insights to senior leadership on a regular cadence

• Stay close to market trends, competitor activity and SMB buyer behavior across regions

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field, or equivalent experience

• 8+ years of progressive sales experience, with at least 4 years leading sales teams, ideally in a high volume, transactional or SMB environment

• Proven track record of developing early-career sellers into top performers and building a coaching culture

• Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding revenue targets with a high velocity sales motion

• Experience leading distributed or global teams across multiple regions and time zones

• Experience scaling sales teams and operations in high-growth environments

• Strong command of pipeline management, forecasting and performance analytics

• Working knowledge of MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, adapted for short sales cycles

• Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and hold a junior team to a high standard

• Proficiency with CRM software and sales analytics tools

• A positive, can-do attitude and a drive to inspire your team to overcome challenges

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to use AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking

jobs.title: Finance Manager - Cyprus
jobs.description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Finance Manager owns finance, regulatory reporting and financial control for Bitvavo Europe Limited (BEL), Bitvavo’s operations in Cyprus.

You will take over the quarterly CySEC and IFR returns, the statutory accounts and audit, purchasing and approvals, and management reporting, building the local finance function as BEL resumes client operations.

You will report to the Head of Business Control in Amsterdam, and will work closely with the directors in Cyprus, Risk on the ICARA, Compliance, group Finance, Tax and Treasury, the external auditor and outsourced service providers.

As this is a local role, we are only considering candidates who are currently based in Cyprus and able to work from Limassol.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Regulatory Reporting

 - Prepare and submit the quarterly QST return to CySEC

 - Own the quarterly IFR prudential returns, covering own funds, K-factors, liquidity and concentration risk, preparing them in house or overseeing and approving the external compliance provider’s work before submission

 - Monitor own funds, capital headroom and liquidity against IFR requirements and flag breaches early to the Board and group Finance

 - Provide revenue and cost forecasts as input to the ICARA, which is owned by Risk

 - Calculate and settle CySEC annual fees and Investor Compensation Fund contributions

Statutory Reporting

 - Prepare BEL's annual financial statements under IFRS as adopted by the EU

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:



NIVODA: WHERE INNOVATION AND GEMSTONES MEET

At Nivoda, we help jewellery retailers and gemstone suppliers trade more easily. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery businesses of all sizes with global diamond and gemstone supply.

Nivoda has more than 400 employees across the world. Our platform helps buyers and sellers trade diamonds and gemstones securely, efficiently and at competitive prices.

The Role:

Nivoda is the B2B marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with the world's diamond and gemstone supply. You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed  everything before that moment is yours.

This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.

 - Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.

 - Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.

 - Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.

 - Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.

 - Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.
   

Who you are

 - 1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.

 - A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.

 - Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.

 - Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.

 - Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.
   

KPIs

Demos scheduled and held (primary), inbound response time / conversion rate, outbound activity volume and connect rate, show rate, lead-to-demo conversion.

Senior Customer Engineer, AI Factory
jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

The AI Factory Customer Engineer plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between customer modular AI-ready data center requirements and Armada's Product and Engineering teams. This role requires deep technical credibility, hands-on infrastructure experience, and strong interpersonal skills to translate complex AI infrastructure and data center architectures into clear, practical solutions for customers looking to deploy sovereign AI infrastructure at speed.

This role goes beyond traditional pre-sales. The Customer Engineer acts as the technical interface between high-profile customers and Armada Engineering, ensuring customer requirements, constraints, and feedback are accurately represented and incorporated into solution design and future platform evolution.

Armada's AI Factory serves a broad and growing set of customers across enterprise, industrial, and infrastructure-heavy verticals. A meaningful and growing subset of strategic targets includes AI-focused datacenter co-location providers and Neocloud operators which represent a primary segment where Armada's high-density, liquid-cooled modular solutions are a compelling fit for capacity expansion and rapid deployment. Additionally, renewable energy operators who own or control significant land, power, and stranded energy assets are increasingly positioned to host or operate AI compute infrastructure at scale.

The ideal candidate brings an engineering and customer-first mindset, strong data center and AI-ready infrastructure expertise, particularly around AI, HPC, liquid-cooling, modular data center solutions, Nvidia reference architectures, along with the energy, curiosity, and positivity required to operate in a fast-moving, hyper-growth environment. This role is instrumental in driving adoption, trust, and long-term success for Armada's AI Factory modular solutions.

What You'll Do — Key Responsibilities

Core Technical Customer Engagement

• Act as the primary technical interface between customers and Armada's Product and Engineering teams, translating real-world requirements into actionable technical inputs.

• Provide expert technical guidance to Armada's AI Factory customers, including Modular Data Center (MDC)solutions, high-density and liquid-cooled designs, and GPU-based reference architectures created with partners such as NVIDIA.

• Understand customer workloads and objectives deeply and advise on solution details including rack-level design, systems architectures, cooling and power draw advisory, and deployment strategy tradeoffs.

• Lead technical demonstrations and workshops, tailoring content to customer constraints and operational realities.

• Cultivate trusted-advisor relationships with customer engineering, infrastructure, IT, OT, and security stakeholders and teams

• Engage with solution partners and supply chain, including MEP, OEM, xPU vendors, in service to end-to-end customer solutions

• Enable field and sales teams by simplifying complex technical concepts into clear, customer-relevant narratives

• Support RFI/P and ongoing customer-facing technical documentation required to support lighthouse customer requirements

• Bring a high-ownership, self-starting mindset with the energy and curiosity to fill gaps, solve problems, and drive outcomes end-to-end.

AI Datacenter Co-Lo & Neocloud Engagement

• Engage AI-focused datacenter co-location operators and Neocloud providers as a critical customer segment, positioning Armada's AI Factory as a solution for rapid capacity expansion, modular overflow deployments, and high-density liquid-cooled compute environments.

• Develop sufficient familiarity with co-lo and Neocloud operational models — GPU cluster economics, high-density power and cooling requirements, multi-tenant compute, and deployment velocity expectations — to hold credible technical conversations and scope solutions appropriately.

• Collaborate with Sales to identify where AI Factory's modular, rapidly deployable infrastructure is most differentiated against co-lo and Neocloud alternatives, and tailor technical positioning accordingly.

Renewable Energy & Land-and-Power Operator Engagement

• Engage renewable energy operators, independent power producers, and upstream oil and gas companies (e.g., Chord Energy, Devon Energy, and similar) as a strategic and growing customer segment for Armada's AI Factory — helping them understand how their existing power generation capacity, land assets, and fiber infrastructure make them natural hosts for modular AI compute deployments.

• Articulate the value proposition of Armada's MDC platform to energy sector operators: rapid deployment timelines, self-contained power and cooling architecture, scalable capacity, and the ability to monetize stranded or excess power assets through AI compute hosting.

• Develop familiarity with the operational model of energy companies: power generation economics, land and lease structures, regulatory constraints, and the OT/IT boundary — and translate these into informed AI Factory deployment conversations.

• Navigate both the OT and IT stakeholder landscape within energy companies, building credibility with infrastructure, operations, and executive teams alike.

• Identify and communicate the specific deployment considerations relevant to energy sector environments: remote or off-grid locations, variable power availability, environmental and permitting requirements, and physical security constraints.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Strategy

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to support customer engagements, technical scoping, and solution design across all target verticals.

• Stay current on industry trends related to AI infrastructure, energy sector AI adoption, data center design, liquid cooling, and modular systems — and share insights internally to shape future product strategy.

• Attend industry events and conferences, representing Armada with customers, partners, and industry insiders

• Bring positive energy, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset to every engagement — this role values technical excellence and having fun while building something meaningful.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on engineering experience). Advanced engineering degrees are a plus.

• 10-15+ years of relevant experience in data center engineering, infrastructure engineering, pre-sales, sales engineering, or solution architecture roles.

• Strong understanding of compute, networking, and storage fundamentals, including AI and GPU-based systems

• Hands-on experience with mechanical, electrical, thermal, advanced cooling and networking components of data center solutionsFamiliarity with modular data centers (MDCs) landscape

• Engineering mindset with curiosity about what lives inside the rack, including openness to evolving beyond current AI and HPE reference designs (e.g., B300 / GB300) as architectures evolve.

• Familiarity with foundational cloud platforms, containerization, virtualization, and modern enterprise infrastructure.

• Ability to navigate and build credibility with technical infrastructure buying personas at all levels

• Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort operating in complex, live customer environments.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both highly technical engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel as required.

#LI-Remote

Compensation

$160,000—$235,000 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

• A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge

• A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude

• Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company

• A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda

• Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you
