Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

The Direct to Consumer (D2C) Data Science organization comprises Data Science, Data Engineering and ML Engineering practices. D2C Data Science helps PlayStation grow and operate its digital business across commerce, subscriptions, payments, lifecycle experiences and player-facing services. We partner with product, engineering, finance, marketing and operations teams to turn experimentation, forecasting, AI and production-quality measurement into better player experiences.

Role overview:

Within D2C Data Science, the D2C ML Engineering team is the center of excellence for machine learning engineering. We build and operate the in-house machine learning platform that powers production decisions across the D2C portfolio, including fraud detection, payment authorization optimization, and account security decisions.

This is a hands-on engineering role combining cloud infrastructure operations with software development for platform tooling, automation and integrations. You will maintain and improve our AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure alongside the team, taking ownership of defined components or improvements within our existing architecture. Working with ML engineers and data scientists, you will help keep the machine learning platform reliable, observable and easy to maintain.

This role follows a hybrid working arrangement, with work primarily performed remotely and attendance at the San Diego office as needed.

What you'll be doing:

• Develop and maintain backend services that support ML workflows and integrate the platform with other systems.

• Reduce manual operational work and improve platform reliability through automation, tooling and service integrations.

• Maintain and improve AWS infrastructure using Terraform within the team’s existing architecture, with a focus on repeatable deployments and maintainable configuration.

• Operate and improve our EKS/Kubernetes environments alongside the team to scale with demand and maintain high availability and reliability, meeting agreed service-level targets.

• Improve monitoring and alerting, investigate production issues, and implement fixes that reduce recurring incidents and manual work.

• Be part of a time zone-based on-call rotation (no nights) for the platform and the services it serves.

What we're looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 3+ years of relevant experience

• Strong software engineering foundations, with experience building, deploying and supporting production systems using Python or Java, including CI/CD, monitoring and troubleshooting.

• Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively, assess their output, and validate changes through appropriate testing and monitoring.

• Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes workloads and managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform, with practical knowledge of AWS.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work with engineers and data scientists across a globally distributed team.

Desirable skills:

• AWS certification (e.g. Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer).

• Experience with Snowflake or large-scale SQL analytics workloads.

• Interest in machine learning workflows and the infrastructure used to deploy and operate models.

• Interest in applying AI and agentic approaches to infrastructure automation and production operations.

jobs.title: Junior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Most GenAI never leaves the demo. We hire for the people who get it into production, and into daily use. The Forward Deployed Engineer closes that gap: a field engineer who builds GenAI applications (agents, RAG pipelines, copilots) and makes sure they get adopted, embedded in daily workflows, and deliver measurable value. You quickly grasp a client's operational challenges, design a tailored response, deploy it, and bring teams along in the transformation.

You will operate at the intersection of Data Science, ML/Platform Engineering, and client delivery, helping customers find the right level of sophistication, semantic search, RAG, agents, or fine-tuning, deliver measurable ROI in the most cost-effective way. Beyond crafting prompts, you will design and build robust, scalable products: benchmarking candidate Foundation Models across the model stack (from GPT-x, Claude, and Gemini to edge models like Mistral), rapidly iterating prototypes, and validating ideas directly with users using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, and pgvector.

We work closely with leading technology partners including Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, Databricks, and AWS. In practice that means early access to new model releases, direct engineering channels to the labs, funded certifications, and the freedom to pick the right tool, not just the one you're locked into.

What you'll actually do

• Spend time on client sites with a senior Forward Deployed Engineer, learning how their teams work and where AI can help.
• Help scope and build LLM-based solutions under guidance: RAG pipelines, tool-using agents, workflow automation, and chat interfaces.
• Connect these solutions to existing systems (APIs, databases, business tools) using established patterns and templates.
• Help apply data protection and AI regulation requirements (GDPR, EU AI Act, model licences) to your work, following the guidance your senior colleagues set.
• Support user adoption: prepare documentation, contribute to training sessions, and collect feedback on what works and what doesn’t.
• Measure how solutions perform in use, and suggest improvements to your senior colleagues.
• Share progress in clear written and verbal updates to both technical and business audiences.

You’ll thrive here if

• You hold a Master’s degree in computer science, AI, or a related technical field. What matters most is that you can build things, so strong projects alongside your degree count just as much.
• You have 0 to 2 years of experience, whether professional, from internships, or from a research or academic setting. We hire for potential, so recent graduates with solid LLM projects are encouraged to apply.
• You’ve built with LLMs in some form, through coursework, your thesis, internships, or personal projects. That includes prompting, RAG, basic agent workflows, and checking model outputs with simple evaluation sets or tests.
• You write Python that’s clean enough for a colleague to read, and you’re willing to learn whatever language a client’s stack requires.
• You’re comfortable calling APIs and connecting different systems, even if you’ve done it mainly in side projects.
• You’re starting to understand what makes a result useful to a client, and you can prioritise tasks with guidance.
• You enjoy explaining technical ideas to non-technical people, and you listen carefully so you can bring them along.
• You want to grow quickly, take on more responsibility over time, and learn from experienced colleagues in a fast-growing AI practice.
• You speak Dutch and English. German is a strong advantage. If you’re not there yet, we’ll support you in learning it.

Bonus points for

• Experience with applied AI frameworks or SDKs (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, etc.).
• Experience deploying a project to a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), even a small one.
• Familiarity with MLOps or LLMOps practices, such as version control for prompts, simple evaluation pipelines, or basic monitoring.
• A working understanding of vector databases and core concepts like embeddings.

Why join Sia

• You ship. Engagements are measured in weeks, not quarters. Your work goes live in front of real users and the client’s team, with a senior colleague alongside you.
• Range without job-hopping. You’ll work across several industries and architectures each year, which is one of the fastest ways to build judgement about what actually works.
• A practice that’s growing. The AI practice is young enough that you help shape how it delivers, and experienced enough that you’re never the only person who has solved a problem before.
• Direct exposure, with support. You’ll sit in on conversations with business decision-makers early on, with senior colleagues guiding you, which is one of the fastest routes to seniority.

What we offer

• A competitive salary and benefits, including a hospital insurance, performance-related bonus and more.
• A dedicated learning budget, funded partner certifications (Anthropic, AWS, Databricks), and paid conference time.
• Hybrid working from our Amsterdam office, with real flexibility on where the deep work happens.
• A named mentor from day one and a clear path from delivery engineer to lead engineer or client-facing architect.

We are unable to provide a work permit for this position.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper

jobs.description:
About Wheely

Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.

We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.

About The Role

As part of the Quality team in New York, reporting directly to the General Manager, you will be responsible for assessing the quality of the services provided by Wheely Chauffeurs across NYC.

A successful candidate will act as a Mystery Shopper, taking ownership of service quality and ensuring that every journey consistently delivers an exceptional, luxury experience that exceeds customer expectations.

Responsibilities

• Assess chauffeurs against Wheely Standards through regular mystery shops across New York City.

• Deliver constructive, on-the-spot coaching to chauffeurs, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.

• Uphold Wheely's high standards of customer experience by ensuring every chauffeur interaction consistently meets our expectations.

• Act decisively and follow established protocols when addressing service quality issues, including blocking chauffeurs who fail a quality assessment where necessary.

• Use the QC tool to provide detailed, accurate and consistent documentation following each inspection.

• Identify recurring issues and contribute insights to continuously improve Wheely Standards, training and service delivery based on observations and feedback gathered during inspections.

• Oversee operations at key locations, including airports, train stations and major events. This may involve advising on the ideal passenger experience, selecting appropriate in-app pick-up and drop-off points, and coordinating on-site security where applicable.

Requirements

You are someone who takes personal pride in high standards and believes luxury is delivered through consistency, discipline and attention to detail.

• 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing luxury environment, such as five-star hospitality, premium or private aviation, luxury services or high-end retail.

• Experience working in environments where service quality is measured, audited and non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to coach, influence and challenge others while maintaining trust and credibility.

• Excellent attention to detail, with the confidence to identify shortcomings and take action when standards are not met.

• Passion for luxury vehicles and knowledge of their specifications is a plus.

• Experience driving in New York City is a plus.

• Flexibility to work from the office and conduct mystery shops across New York City, including evenings and weekends when required.

What We Offer

• Base salary of $65,000–$85,000 per year, plus equity in a high-growth startup.

• Comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage and other benefits designed to support your wellbeing.

• Monthly credit for journeys with Wheely, allowing you to experience our service as a passenger and stay closely connected to the product.

• Professional development support, including subsidies for relevant training and learning.

All of your personal information will be collected stored and processed in accordance with Wheely’s Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs.description:
The role

We are looking for a Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer to join our Data Science & AI team as a consultant. This is a client-facing role first: most of your time is spent on client engagements, designing and building Azure infrastructure and platform solutions, advising on cloud strategy, and representing Sia's technical delivery capability directly to the client. Alongside that, you will get hands-on with AI on the side of the business: building demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry that support new client opportunities, rather than running or maintaining an internal platform. If you want client exposure plus a genuine way to build AI skills on top of your infrastructure expertise, this is a team where that combination is real.

What you will do

• Work directly with client teams and stakeholders as a consultant, explaining technical trade-offs and architecture decisions in plain language.
• Design and implement Azure infrastructure, including networking, compute, storage, and identity components (Azure AD/Entra ID, VNets, App Services, AKS).
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).

jobs.title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Payments
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

What you’ll do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.The team is looking for a payments optimization specialist with a proven track record of designing and deploying payment infrastructure for global enterprises. You will engage with customers as a thought leader in the advanced payments stack - helping them navigate multi-PSP environments, payment orchestration, adaptive pricing, and buy-now-pay-later integrations to maximize authorization rates, reduce costs, and improve conversion at scale.

Responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Optimized Checkout Suite, Adaptive Pricing, Managed Payments, Orchestration, and BNPL integrations to accelerate opportunities globally

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of global payment optimization - including local acquiring, intelligent routing, dynamic currency conversion, and authorization improvement strategies

• Develop expertise in designing multi-PSP and payment orchestration architectures, including how Stripe integrates alongside or replaces incumbent processors

• Advise customers on BNPL strategy, including product selection, regulatory considerations, and integration patterns across checkout and billing flows

• Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

• Create reference architectures that help customers design end-to-end payment infrastructure with Stripe at the core

• Partner closely with the Payments product sales team on Stripe's most complex OCS and Orchestration opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships

• Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization

• Identify and summarize trends in payment orchestration, cost optimization, and alternative payment methods, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales

• Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team

• Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

• Approximately 25% travel is anticipated

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in payments, fintech, or a closely related industry in a pre-sales, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role

• Strong working knowledge of global payment methods including cards, wallets, bank-based methods, and BNPLs - including regional preferences and regulatory context

• Experience designing payment optimization architectures for large enterprises, including multi-PSP environments and orchestration layers

• Knowledge of authorization rate improvement levers: local acquiring, network tokenization, 3DS, smart retries, and the technical and commercial tradeoffs between them

• Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners

• Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful payment APIs into web applications

• Knowledge of ISO payment standards and card network rules

• Experience with payment cost modeling, interchange optimization, or processor benchmarking

• Familiarity with marketplace and platform payment flows (Connect, multi-party transactions)

• Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

jobs.title: Staff Technical Writer
jobs.description:
At Reltio®, an SAP Company, we believe data should fuel your success in the enterprise AI era. Our  Context Intelligence Platform turns fragmented data into a trusted, connected context so AI agents and systems can act with expert-level judgement at enterprise scale. Reltio’s cloud-native SaaS platform harmonizes, unifies, and governs data across sources and formats—including unstructured data—in real time, turning them into data assets that can be mobilized in milliseconds to any application, user, or AI agent. Trusted by more than 200 of the world’s largest brands across industries such as life sciences, financial services, healthcare, and technology, we fuel frictionless operations and help enterprises accelerate  innovation and reduce risk.

At Reltio, our values guide everything we do. With an unyielding commitment to prioritizing our “Customer First”, we strive to ensure their success. We embrace our differences and are “Better Together” as One Reltio. We are always looking to “Simplify and Share” our knowledge when we collaborate to remove obstacles for each other. We hold ourselves accountable for our actions and outcomes and strive for excellence. We “Own It”. Every day, we innovate and evolve, so that today is “Always Better Than Yesterday”. If you share and embody these values, we invite you to join our team at Reltio and contribute to our mission of excellence.

Reltio has earned numerous awards and industry and analyst recognition for our technology, our culture and our people. Reltio was founded on a distributed workforce and offers flexible work arrangements to help our people manage their personal and professional lives. If you’re ready to work on unrivaled technology where your desire to be part of a collaborative team is met with a laser-focused mission to enable digital transformation with connected data, let’s talk!

Job Summary:

The successful candidate will be a writer who is:

• Shapes how documentation is structured and delivered across the Reltio platform

• Guides other writers on process, style, and priorities, and leads efforts to improve documentation quality

• Uses AI practically to move faster without giving up accuracy

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

• Define and own the information architecture for Reltio product documentation.

• Test product functionality hands-on before writing any UI, API, or CLI content.

• Author and maintain UI, API, and CLI documentation, including user guides, reference guides, API guides, release notes, and code samples.

• Coach writers on process and editorial style, and help them prioritize their work.

• Apply AI tools to draft, validate, and maintain content, and verify AI output for accuracy.

• Partner with product management, engineering, and QA to understand capabilities, usage, and limitations.

• Define and maintain style standards and review processes, including style guides, content templates, and peer and technical review checklists that keep content consistent across writers.

• Track documentation usage, search results, and customer feedback to find content gaps and prioritize what to write or update.

• Lead initiatives that improve content usage and quality.

• Estimate, plan, and track documentation work for releases and projects, including scope, dependencies, and timelines, and report progress to stakeholders.

Skills You Must Have:

• 10+ years of technical writing for enterprise SaaS, serving both end users and developers.

• Ability to set up a test environment and run what you document: UI workflows in the browser, REST calls with Postman or cURL, and CLI commands in a terminal.

• Taxonomy design, topic-based structuring, and content reuse.

• REST, JSON, and Open API/Swagger.

• Git with Bitbucket (branching, pull requests, reviews), and Markdown or DITA/XML.

• Style guides such as the Microsoft Writing Style Guide or Chicago Manual of Style.

• Working experience with LLM assistants and prompt design, and a repeatable way to check their results.

• Familiarity with documentation analytics tools and customer research methods.

• Prior experience as a team lead, reviewer, or mentor on a writing team.

• Excellent written and verbal communication.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience.

Skills That Are Nice to Have:

• CCMS experience (Heretto, Ixiasoft, Paligo, or similar).

• Style governance tools (Acrolinx, Grammarly, or similar).

• Federated search tools (SearchUnify, Coveo, or similar).

• Jira, Confluence, and Zendesk.

• Scripting or automation experience (Python or JavaScript).

• Screen capture, drawing, and video tools ( Snagit, Visio, Camtasia, and Captivate).

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. • Aligns, trains and motivates the site staff and principal investigator on the goals of the clinical trial program, protocol and patient treatment principles for the trial ensuring a trusted partnership.
• Conducts site evaluation, site training, routine, and site closure monitoring activities with compliance to the protocol and monitoring plans, in accordance with applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and quality standards, ensuring safety and protection of study subjects.
• Advanced understanding of site engagement and ability to customize site engagement strategy for assigned study (ies). Gather local/site insights and utilize site engagement tools such as the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool, to report/track progress and measure impact of that strategy.
• Advanced level of competency connecting the study protocol, scientific principles and clinical trial requirements to the day-to-day clinical trial execution activities. Evaluate and ensure effective recruitment and retention techniques/plans based on the patient disease journey. Develop solid knowledge of therapeutic area, asset and clinical landscape / patient journey to enable successful patient recruitment and overall protocol compliance.
• Possesses experienced level of competency to mentor and train less experienced CRAs on various aspects of work and provides input into their development. May participate in global/local task forces and initiatives. Responsible for activities as assigned by manager.
• Responsible for continuous risk-assessment proactively, and in collaboration with Central Monitoring team, monitor activities conducted by clinical sites to detect early overall study performance or patient safety issues.
• Advanced ability to think critically to resolve site risk signals while having robust understanding of site processes to drive study execution. Ensures preventative and corrective action plans are put into place, as needed, to mitigate risk and promote compliance using a customer centric approach.
• Identifies, evaluates and recommends new/potential investigators/sites on an on going basis. Potential sites may be identified through networking or internal AbbVie requests to assist in the placement of planned clinical studies with qualified investigators.
• Ensures quality of data submitted from study sites and assures timely submission of data, including appropriate reporting and follow-up for all safety events by site personnel. Ensures audit and regulatory inspection readiness at assigned clinical site at all times. Manages investigator payments as per executed contract obligations, as applicable.

• Appropriate tertiary qualification in health related disciplines (Medical, Scientific, Nursing) preferred.
• Minimum of 3 year of clinically related experience. Familiar with risk‐based monitoring approach, onsite and offsite monitoring.
• Knowledge of appropriate therapeutic area indications is preferred with the ability to understand and apply scientific concepts as they relate to the conduct of clinical trials.
• Advanced knowledge on existing and emerging local regulatory and legal requirements, ICH/GCP Guidelines and applicable policies.
• Demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration skills among internal and external stakeholders.
• Demonstrate strong planning and organizational skills and the ability to work effectively and efficiently in a dynamic environment with competing projects and deadlines.
• Advanced ability to leverage technology, tools and resources to provide customer centric support based on the health of the site.
• Strong interpersonal skills with excellent written, verbal, active listening and presentation skills, with ability to establish and leverage site relationships and trusted partnerships through engagement, motivation, and training.
• Ability to use functional expertise with appropriate guidance, leverage critical thinking skills and apply good judgement to address clinical site issues.
• Acts with integrity in accordance with AbbVie code of business conduct and leadership values. Self-motivated individual focused on delivering timely and quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Allround F&B Host
jobs.description:
From welcoming guests at Breman to hosting meetings, celebrations and events in The Apartment and Barbue, you’ll be one of the friendly faces making people feel right at home. No two shifts will look quite the same, and that’s exactly what makes this role fun.

The role

As our All-Round F&B Host, you’ll be right at the heart of the action, making sure every guest feels welcome, looked after and in good hands.

One day, you might be greeting guests, managing reservations and keeping things flowing at Breman. The next, you could be welcoming event organisers, setting up our event spaces and making sure everything runs smoothly from the first coffee to the final goodbye.

You'll work closely with our Restaurant, Events and F&B teams, bringing a personal touch, an eye for detail and a little Hox magic to every experience.

What you'll do…

• Give guests a warm, genuine welcome, whether they're joining us for breakfast, dinner, a meeting or a special celebration.
• Host at Breman, managing reservations, seating guests and keeping the guest experience running smoothly.
• Be a friendly and reliable point of contact for event organisers and guests in The Apartment, Barbue and our other event spaces.
• Help prepare event spaces, welcome organisers and make sure everything is ready to go before guests arrive.
• Support the smooth running of events, from coordinating with the team and responding to guest requests to assisting with food and beverage service when needed.
• Handle guest enquiries, payments and billing accurately, making sure everything is wrapped up smoothly at the end of an event or shift.
• Work closely with the wider F&B team, moving between the restaurant and events depending on where you're needed most.

What we're looking for…

• Some experience in hospitality, ideally in a restaurant, hotel or events environment.
• A natural host who enjoys meeting people and making them feel welcome.
• Great communication skills and the confidence to interact with guests, event organisers and colleagues.
• An organised approach, a good eye for detail and the ability to keep your cool when things get busy.
• A flexible, hands-on attitude. You're happy to jump in, help your teammates and do things a little differently.
• Comfortable communicating in English. Dutch is a bonus, but not a must.

Experience with reservation systems, POS systems or event operations is a plus, but don't worry if you haven't used ours before. We'll show you the ropes.

What's in it for you...

• Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences.
• This position is classified in scale 4 according to the Horeca CAO.
• 25 days holiday (including bank holidays), pension and life insurance.
• Enjoy a free night at The Hoxton and a meal for two when you first start with us.
• Training to get you settled into your role with ongoing development that helps you think, make and thrive to set you up for success at work.
• Time off to volunteer with one of our partner charities.
• Hox Hero and Nifty Fifty, our rewards for going the extra mile and living our values.
• An annual diversity and inclusion calendar of events creating opportunities for you to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact.
• Regular team get togethers, from our High Fives to our (pretty special!) team parties – we know how to have a good time!
• The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
• Join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that is shaking things up on the hospitality scene.
• Excellent discounts across The Hoxton and the global Ennismore family.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Security Engineering Manager

• Location: León - Hybrid - 4 days onsite, 1 remote

About Ebury

Established in 2009, Ebury is a London-based financial technology company specialising in cross-border financial services for SMEs. Our comprehensive suite includes international payments, foreign exchange risk management, business lending, and mass payment solutions, all delivered via an integrated digital platform.

Backed by Banco Santander (54% majority stake) and recognized in the Financial Times’ list of Europe’s Fastest-Growing Companies, Ebury employs over 1,700 professionals across 40+ offices in 25+ countries. Our success is powered by diverse, high-performing teams revolutionising global fintech.

Role Overview

Ebury is investing heavily in product and platform security across our global financial services ecosystem. Security Engineering is a deeply technical, hands-on discipline that partners directly with software and platform engineers to build security into every stage of the release lifecycle.

Scope distinction: This team focuses purely on core engineering challenges—not GRC, policy writing, IT desktop security (e.g., endpoint AV), or SecOps/incident response.

You will lead a distributed team of elite security engineers spanning cloud security, penetration testing, and software development. Your mandate covers high-impact engineering domains: vulnerability management, AI threat modelling, secure software development lifecycles (SSDLC), agentic SDLC workflows, disaster recovery planning (DRP), and cloud infrastructure hardening.

Reporting to the Engineering Director – Platform & Security, you will balance strategic architectural leadership with deep technical execution to safeguard our services in a high-scale, regulated fintech environment.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Security Architecture

• Team Leadership: Manage, recruit, and mentor a global team of security engineers, fostering technical excellence and clear career progression paths.

• Architecture Design: Define and implement high-level security architecture across existing systems and greenfield projects.

• Engineering Alignment: Partner with Software Engineering and Platform leadership to embed security requirements into roadmaps and sprint cycles.

• Technical Rigour: Stay actively hands-on—conduct architecture design reviews, review critical code, and act as the final decision-maker on complex technical security trade-offs.

• Executive Reporting: Deliver measurable, data-backed metrics and reporting on technical security posture to executive stakeholders.

Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) & AI Workflows

• Strategy & Tooling: Define and scale the SSDLC strategy, integrating automated security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA) seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines.

• Threat Modelling: Institutionalise continuous threat modelling across product teams.

• Agentic Workflows: Design and evolve guardrails and secure frameworks tailored for modern agentic software development and AI-assisted workflows.

Vulnerability Management & Red Teaming

• Programme Ownership: Direct the end-to-end vulnerability management programme, including continuous discovery, context-aware triage, remediation SLAs, and board-level risk reporting.

• Remediation Drive: Partner with engineering managers to resolve systemic and critical vulnerabilities, unblocking blockers and escalating when timelines slip.

• Next-Gen Tooling: Direct AI-assisted tooling strategies, including continuous scanning pipelines and internal automated red-teaming platforms.

Identity & Access Management (IAM)

• IAM Architecture: Direct identity and access management architecture across multi-cloud infrastructure and customer-facing microservices.

• Privileged Access: Ensure authentication, authorisation, least privilege, and Privileged Access Management (PAM) controls strictly satisfy compliance and internal audit benchmarks.

Cloud & Network Security Posture

• Platform Partnership: Collaborate closely with Platform Engineering to define security guardrails on AWS and GCP (network segmentation, perimeter defence, container runtime security).

• Change Governance: Review and sign off on high-risk architectural changes across platform and cloud network boundaries.

• Audit & Technical Assurance: Support technical external audits and close compliance gaps (ISO 27001, SOC 2, DORA) through direct engineering implementations rather than paperwork.

What You’ll Bring

Technical Leadership & Hands-on Depth

• 8+ years of total experience across software engineering, platform engineering, or security engineering, including 3+ years directly managing engineering teams.

• Former software engineer or technical security specialist who transitioned into engineering management while retaining deep technical fluency.

• Proven track record designing, building, and running security controls at scale across public clouds (AWS and/or GCP) and container orchestration systems (Kubernetes).

• Hands-on mastery of secure coding practices, modern DevSecOps integration, threat modelling, and federated identity protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML).

Execution & Stakeholder Management

• Proven ability to translate high-level business risk into prioritised, actionable engineering backlogs.

• Strong track record delivering multi-quarter technical initiatives from inception to measurable completion.

• Data-driven decision-maker comfortable defending technical positions to executives and engineers alike.

• Pragmatic delivery mindset: balancing ironclad security controls with engineering velocity.

Domain Knowledge & Soft Skills

• Professional experience within regulated financial services, fintech, or payment processing environments.

• Practical understanding of security frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS benchmarks).

• Exceptional written and verbal communication in English, with the clarity to articulate nuanced risk concepts to cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated success leading remote or distributed teams across multiple geographies.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

• Experience dual-running or migrating workloads across both AWS and GCP.

• Hands-on experience operationalising LLM/AI security models or agentic automation in software engineering.

• Industry certifications reflecting broad architecture and offensive depth (e.g., CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or hyperscaler Security Specialties).

About us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Important Security Notice for Job Applicants:
Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.

Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:
Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Ebury will not be responsible or liable for any placement fees or costs associated with unagreed candidate submissions or subsequent hires.

AI Transparency Statement:
Ebury uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools to help streamline certain parts of our recruitment process, however, these tools are strictly for administrative efficiency. All hiring decisions, including application reviews, shortlisting, and final selections are evaluated and conducted by human talent acquisition professionals and hiring managers.

jobs.title: Supervisor Order Operations - German Speaking
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Über das Team

Das europäische Order Operations Team ist für den gesamten Quote-to-Cash-Prozess verantwortlich und fungiert bei allen auftragsbezogenen Themen als zentraler operativer Partner für die Retail- und Corporate-Sales-Teams. Das Team verbindet Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, Production Control, IT, Finance, Tax und Accounting, um die korrekte Bearbeitung von Aufträgen und eine termingerechte Auslieferung sicherzustellen. Das Team verbindet die tägliche operative Umsetzung mit Performance-Management, Problemlösung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und trägt dadurch zur Genauigkeit des Auftragsbestands, zur Auslieferungsbereitschaft und zur Umsatzrealisierung bei.

Über die Position

Als Supervisor, Order Operations übernehmen Sie eine praxisorientierte Führungsrolle und sind für die tägliche Leistung des europäischen Order Operations Teams in Amsterdam verantwortlich. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Order Operations Specialists stellen Sie die konsistente Umsetzung des gesamten Order-to-Cash-Prozesses, die präzise Verwaltung des Auftragsbestands, die zeitnahe Bearbeitung von Eskalationen und eine koordinierte Auslieferungsbereitschaft sicher. Die Position ist zu annähernd gleichen Teilen auf die operative Mitarbeit und die Personalführung ausgerichtet. Dabei arbeiten Sie direkt an operativen Prioritäten und übernehmen zugleich die Führung, das Coaching und die Weiterentwicklung des Teams. Sie schaffen durch KPI und regelmäßiges Reporting eine klare Transparenz über die Leistung, stärken die Eigenverantwortung im Team und treiben die Standardisierung, Verbesserung und Automatisierung von Prozessen voran.

Da diese Position Stakeholder und operative Aktivitäten in verschiedenen europäischen Märkten unterstützt, sind fließende Englischkenntnisse sowie fließende Französisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse für die Position unerlässlich. Diese Sprachen werden regelmäßig bei der Führung des Teams, der Kommunikation mit internen Stakeholdern, der Bearbeitung von Eskalationen und der Unterstützung auftragsbezogener Aktivitäten eingesetzt.

Ihre Verantwortungsbereiche

• Tägliche operative Abläufe: Sie leiten die Order Operations Specialists und arbeiten eng mit ihnen zusammen, um eine konsistente tägliche Umsetzung, die Einhaltung von Standards und Fristen sowie die korrekte Anwendung von Richtlinien und Prozessen sicherzustellen.

• Eskalationsmanagement: Sie verantworten die Lösung komplexer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Aufträgen, der VIN-Zuordnung, Preisen, Fahrzeugkonfigurationen, Rechnungsstellung, Zahlungen, Rückerstattungen und der Auslieferungsbereitschaft. Kritische operative Risiken und Kapazitätsengpässe erkennen Sie proaktiv und eskalieren diese an die zuständigen Stellen.

• Auftragsbestand und Auslieferung: Sie gewährleisten die Genauigkeit des Auftragsbestands und die Auslieferungsbereitschaft, indem Sie die Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, die Zuordnung von VIN zu Auftrag, Bereitschaftsprüfungen, Auslieferungsmeilensteine und mögliche Hindernisse validieren. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit den Bereichen Delivery, Service und Logistics zusammen.

• Performance-Management: Sie definieren, überwachen und verantworten KPI, operative Berichte und Dashboards, die eine klare Übersicht über den Fortschritt im Order-to-Delivery-Prozess, bestehende Risiken und erforderliche Maßnahmen bieten.

• Prozessoptimierung: Sie identifizieren operative Ineffizienzen und leiten Initiativen zur Standardisierung, Automatisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen, einschließlich Benutzerakzeptanztests für Systemänderungen.

• Teamentwicklung: Sie coachen und entwickeln Teammitglieder durch strukturiertes Feedback, Wissensaustausch, Schulungsmaterialien und standardisierte Arbeitsanweisungen weiter und fördern dadurch Eigenverantwortung und operative Exzellenz.

• Workload-Management: Sie überwachen die Verteilung der Arbeitslast, die Teamkapazitäten und die operativen Prioritäten, um sicherzustellen, dass die verfügbaren Ressourcen auf die geschäftlichen Anforderungen und Auslieferungsverpflichtungen abgestimmt sind.

• Funktionsübergreifende Abstimmung: Sie arbeiten mit Sales, Delivery, Logistics, IT, Service, Production Control, Finance, Tax und Accounting zusammen, um operative Abhängigkeiten zu lösen, die Umsatzrealisierung zu unterstützen und Geschäftsinitiativen umzusetzen.

Ihr Profil

Erforderliche Qualifikationen und Kompetenzen

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Auftragsmanagement, im operativen Bereich, in der Supply Chain oder in einem vergleichbaren operativen Tätigkeitsfeld, einschließlich Erfahrung in der Personalführung oder als Teamleitung.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Coaching und in der Weiterentwicklung operativer Teams bei gleichzeitiger aktiver Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft.

• Fundiertes Verständnis der durchgängigen Order-to-Delivery- und Order-to-Cash-Prozesse.

• Eine proaktive und strukturierte Herangehensweise an die Steuerung komplexer operativer Prioritäten, Eskalationen und konkurrierender Fristen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

• Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, Problemlösungskompetenz und Erfahrung in der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Fließende Französisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Hierbei handelt es sich um eine wesentliche Voraussetzung, da die Position regelmäßig Stakeholder und auftragsbezogene Aktivitäten in französisch- oder deutschsprachigen Märkten unterstützt.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen und Kompetenzen

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von KPI, operativen Dashboards, standardisierten Arbeitsanweisungen und Schulungsmaterialien.

• Eine stark auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung ausgerichtete Denkweise sowie nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Identifizierung und Umsetzung operativer Effizienzsteigerungen.

• Erfahrung mit Salesforce und/oder SAP in einem Auftragsmanagement- oder operativen Umfeld.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint.

• Erfahrung in der automobilen Auftragsabwicklung, Fahrzeugauslieferung, Fahrzeugzuweisung, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Mobilitätsumfeld ist von Vorteil, aber nicht erforderlich.

• Bewerberinnen und Bewerber müssen beide sprachlichen Anforderungen erfüllen: Englisch sowie entweder Französisch oder Deutsch.

Anforderungen an den Arbeitsort

• Diese Position ist am Standort Amsterdam in den Niederlanden angesiedelt.

• Bewerberinnen und Bewerber müssen in der Lage sein, entsprechend dem für diese Position vorgesehenen Präsenzmodell am Standort Amsterdam zu arbeiten. Weitere Einzelheiten zum erwarteten Arbeitsmodell werden im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses mitgeteilt.

Diese Stellenausschreibung ist auch auf Französisch verfügbar. Bei Abweichungen zwischen den übersetzten Fassungen ist die englische Fassung maßgebend.

Lucid Motors verpflichtet sich, ein sicheres und vertrauenswürdiges Umfeld aufrechtzuerhalten. Daher kann im Rahmen des Einstellungsverfahrens eine Hintergrundüberprüfung erforderlich sein. Jede Hintergrundüberprüfung wird in Übereinstimmung mit den geltenden europäischen Datenschutzbestimmungen durchgeführt. Die Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden vorab informiert und um ihre Einwilligung gebeten, bevor die Überprüfung durchgeführt wird.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

À propos du poste

Le ou la Supervisor, Order Operations est un manager de proximité opérationnel, responsable de la performance quotidienne de l’équipe européenne Order Operations basée à Amsterdam. Travaillant aux côtés des Order Operations Specialists, cette personne veille à l’exécution cohérente de l’ensemble du processus Order-to-Cash, à la gestion rigoureuse du carnet de commandes, au traitement rapide des escalades et à la coordination de la préparation des livraisons. Ce poste repose sur un équilibre approximativement égal entre l’exécution opérationnelle et le management d’équipe.

Le ou la Supervisor intervient directement sur les priorités opérationnelles tout en assurant la gestion, l’accompagnement et le développement de l’équipe. Le ou la Supervisor établit une visibilité claire sur la performance au moyen de KPI et de rapports, renforce la responsabilisation de l’équipe et pilote la standardisation, l’amélioration et l’automatisation des processus.

Ce poste impliquant la prise en charge de parties prenantes et d’activités opérationnelles sur différents marchés européens, une maîtrise courante de l’anglais ainsi que du français ou de l’allemand est indispensable. Ces langues seront régulièrement utilisées pour encadrer l’équipe, communiquer avec les parties prenantes internes, gérer les escalades et accompagner les activités liées aux commandes.

Vos responsabilités

• Opérations quotidiennes : Diriger l’équipe des Order Operations Specialists et travailler à ses côtés afin de garantir une exécution quotidienne cohérente, le respect des normes et des délais ainsi que l’application correcte des politiques et des processus.

• Gestion des escalades : Prendre en charge la résolution des problèmes complexes relatifs aux commandes, à l’association des numéros VIN, aux prix, à la configuration des véhicules, à la facturation, aux paiements, aux remboursements et à la préparation des livraisons. Identifier de manière proactive les risques opérationnels critiques et les contraintes de capacité, et les faire remonter au niveau approprié.

• Carnet de commandes et livraisons : Garantir la fiabilité du carnet de commandes et la préparation des livraisons en vérifiant la disponibilité des véhicules, l’association entre les numéros VIN et les commandes, les contrôles de préparation, les étapes clés de la livraison et les éventuels blocages, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Delivery, Service et Logistics.

• Gestion de la performance : Définir, suivre et piloter les KPI, les rapports opérationnels et les tableaux de bord afin de fournir une visibilité claire sur l’avancement du processus Order-to-Delivery, les risques et les actions nécessaires.

• Amélioration des processus : Identifier les inefficacités opérationnelles et piloter les initiatives de standardisation, d’automatisation et d’amélioration continue des processus, y compris les tests d’acceptation utilisateur liés aux évolutions des systèmes.

• Développement de l’équipe : Accompagner et développer les membres de l’équipe au moyen de retours structurés, du partage de connaissances, de supports de formation et de procédures opérationnelles standardisées, afin de favoriser la responsabilisation et l’excellence opérationnelle.

• Gestion de la charge de travail : Suivre la répartition de la charge de travail, les capacités de l’équipe et les priorités opérationnelles afin de veiller à ce que les ressources soient alignées sur les besoins de l’entreprise et les engagements de livraison.

• Alignement transversal : Collaborer avec les équipes Sales, Delivery, Logistics, IT, Service, Production Control, Finance, Tax et Accounting afin de résoudre les dépendances opérationnelles, de soutenir la reconnaissance du chiffre d’affaires et de contribuer à la réalisation des initiatives de l’entreprise.

Votre profil

Qualifications et compétences requises

• Au moins cinq ans d’expérience dans la gestion des commandes, les opérations, la supply chain ou un domaine opérationnel comparable, y compris une expérience en tant que manager ou responsable d’équipe.

• Une expérience avérée dans l’accompagnement et le développement d’équipes opérationnelles, tout en restant directement impliqué dans l’exécution quotidienne.

• Une solide compréhension des processus de bout en bout Order-to-Delivery et Order-to-Cash.

• Une approche proactive et structurée de la gestion de priorités opérationnelles complexes, des escalades et d’échéances concurrentes dans un environnement dynamique.

• De solides compétences en analyse, en résolution de problèmes et en collaboration transversale.

• Une maîtrise courante de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

• Une maîtrise courante du français ou de l’allemand, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Il s’agit d’une exigence essentielle, car ce poste implique régulièrement d’accompagner des parties prenantes et de traiter des activités liées aux commandes sur les marchés francophones ou germanophones.

Qualifications et compétences souhaitées

• Une expérience dans l’élaboration de KPI, de tableaux de bord opérationnels, de procédures opérationnelles standardisées et de supports de formation.

• Un état d’esprit fortement axé sur l’amélioration continue, associé à une expérience avérée dans l’identification et la mise en œuvre de gains d’efficacité opérationnelle.

• Une expérience de Salesforce et/ou SAP dans un environnement de gestion des commandes ou dans un environnement opérationnel.

• Une excellente maîtrise de Microsoft Office, en particulier d’Excel et de PowerPoint.

• Une expérience dans les opérations de commandes automobiles, la livraison ou l’affectation de véhicules, la logistique ou un environnement comparable dans le secteur de la mobilité constitue un avantage, mais n’est pas indispensable.

• Les candidats doivent impérativement remplir les deux exigences linguistiques suivantes : maîtriser l’anglais ainsi que le français ou l’allemand.

Conditions liées au poste

jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Über das Team

Das europäische Order Operations Team ist für den gesamten Quote-to-Cash-Transaktionsprozess verantwortlich und fungiert bei allen auftragsbezogenen Themen als zentraler operativer Partner für die Retail- und Corporate-Sales-Teams. Das Team verbindet Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, Production Control, IT, Finance, Tax und Accounting, um die korrekte Bearbeitung von Aufträgen sicherzustellen und eine termingerechte Auslieferung zu ermöglichen. Dabei verbindet es die operative Umsetzung im Tagesgeschäft mit einem strukturierten Performance-Management, der Lösung von Problemen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Der Beitrag des Teams zeigt sich in der Genauigkeit des Auftragsbestands, der Auslieferungsbereitschaft, der Unterstützung bei der Umsatzrealisierung und einem zuverlässigen Erlebnis für interne und externe Stakeholder.

Über die Position

Die Position als Order Operations Specialist ist eine Fachposition ohne Personalverantwortung, die an den Supervisor, Order Operations berichtet und die Umsetzung der europäischen Order-to-Delivery-Prozesse von Lucid unterstützt. In dieser Rolle stellen Sie sicher, dass Kunden- und Fahrzeugaufträge den gesamten Transaktionsprozess präzise und effizient durchlaufen. Gleichzeitig bieten Sie den Sales- und Delivery-Teams eine zuverlässige operative Unterstützung. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für die tägliche Auftragsabwicklung, lösen proaktiv transaktionsbezogene Probleme, gewährleisten die Genauigkeit der Daten in den verschiedenen Systemen, identifizieren Verbesserungspotenziale und stellen sicher, dass Fahrzeuge, Rechnungen, Zahlungen und Kundendokumente für die Auslieferung bereit sind.

Da diese Position Stakeholder und operative Aktivitäten in verschiedenen europäischen Märkten unterstützt, sind fließende Englischkenntnisse sowie fließende Französisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse für diese Position unerlässlich. Diese Sprachen werden regelmäßig bei der Kommunikation mit internen Teams und bei der Unterstützung auftragsbezogener Aktivitäten eingesetzt.

Ihr Erfolg in dieser Position zeigt sich in präzisen Auftragsbestandsdaten, der zeitnahen Lösung von Problemen, einer klaren Kommunikation mit Stakeholdern und einer verbesserten operativen Konsistenz. Im Gegensatz zu einer traditionellen Position im Auftragsmanagement bietet diese Rolle direkte Einblicke in die Entwicklung und Skalierung der europäischen Auftragsprozesse im Automobilbereich. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, mit dem Wachstum des Unternehmens Einfluss auf Arbeitsabläufe, Systeme und neue Kaufszenarien zu nehmen.

Ihre Verantwortungsbereiche

• Auftragsabwicklung: Sie verantworten die präzise Bearbeitung und Pflege von Kunden- und Fahrzeugaufträgen von der Auftragserteilung bis zur Auslieferung und stellen sicher, dass erforderliche Änderungen korrekt und fristgerecht umgesetzt werden.

• Problemlösung: Sie untersuchen und lösen transaktionsbezogene Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Auftragskonfigurationen, Preisen, Rabatten, Fahrzeugzuweisungen, Rechnungen, Zahlungen und Rückerstattungen und koordinieren die erforderlichen Maßnahmen über verschiedene Teams und Systeme hinweg.

• Auslieferungsbereitschaft: Sie arbeiten mit Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service und weiteren operativen Teams zusammen, um auftragsbezogene Hindernisse zu identifizieren und zu beseitigen, damit Fahrzeuge und Kundendokumente für die geplante Übergabe bereitstehen.

• Genauigkeit des Auftragsbestands: Sie gewährleisten die Genauigkeit und Konsistenz von Auftrags-, Kunden-, Fahrzeug-, Preis- und Zahlungsdaten im Auftragsbestand und in den damit verbundenen Systemen. Abweichungen, die sich auf die Auftragsabwicklung, Rechnungsstellung oder Berichterstattung auswirken könnten, beheben Sie proaktiv.

• Fahrzeugzuweisung: Sie verwalten die Zuweisung und Freigabe von Fahrzeugen sowie die Bestandstransparenz, um zuverlässige Informationen über die Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit bereitzustellen und sicherzustellen, dass Aufträge den richtigen Fahrzeugen zugeordnet werden.

• Kommunikation mit Stakeholdern: Sie fungieren als zentrale operative Ansprechperson für Anfragen und Eskalationen im Zusammenhang mit Angeboten und Aufträgen und informieren klar und proaktiv über Auftragsstatus, Auftragsabwicklung, Rechnungsstellung, Fahrzeugbereitschaft und Auslieferung.

• Prozessoptimierung: Sie identifizieren und implementieren skalierbare Prozesse, Dokumentationen, Schulungsmaterialien, Systemverbesserungen und Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten, um die operative Effizienz, Konsistenz und Genauigkeit zu verbessern.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Sie analysieren wiederkehrende Fehler, Prozesslücken, Systemeinschränkungen und operative Risiken, um deren Ursachen zu ermitteln und gemeinsam mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern Korrekturmaßnahmen voranzutreiben.

Ihr Profil

Mindestqualifikationen und erforderliche Kompetenzen

• Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Auftragsmanagement, in Sales Operations, Supply Chain Operations, in der Auftragsabwicklung oder in einer vergleichbaren operativen Position.

• Gutes Verständnis von End-to-End-Prozessen von der Auftragserteilung bis zur Auslieferung sowie von deren Auswirkungen auf nachgelagerte operative Abläufe.

• Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Hochschulausbildung beziehungsweise eine gleichwertige relevante Berufserfahrung in Business Operations, Supply Chain, Logistik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Eine praxisorientierte und proaktive Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten, mit unklaren Rahmenbedingungen umzugehen und komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte operative Anforderungen in klare und umsetzbare Ergebnisse zu überführen.

• Ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten selbstständig zu steuern, Probleme konsequent bis zur Lösung zu verfolgen und in einem dynamischen Umfeld qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe transaktionsbezogene Arbeitsabläufe zu steuern, Abweichungen zu untersuchen und deren Ursachen zu ermitteln, wiederkehrende Probleme zu erkennen, konkurrierende Anforderungen zu priorisieren und über mehrere Systeme hinweg ein hohes Maß an Genauigkeit sicherzustellen.

• Eine auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung ausgerichtete Denkweise sowie die Fähigkeit, Trends, wiederkehrende Probleme und ineffiziente Prozesse zu identifizieren und praktische Verbesserungen zu empfehlen, die die operative Leistung und das Kundenerlebnis unterstützen.

• Ausgeprägte schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv mit den Bereichen Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, IT und Finance zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Fließende Französisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Hierbei handelt es sich um eine wesentliche Voraussetzung, da die Position regelmäßig Stakeholder und auftragsbezogene Aktivitäten in französisch- oder deutschsprachigen Märkten unterstützt.

• Bewerberinnen und Bewerber müssen beide sprachlichen Anforderungen erfüllen: Englisch sowie entweder Französisch oder Deutsch.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen, wachstumsstarken oder sich weiterentwickelnden operativen Umfeld, in dem Prozesse und Systeme noch aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt werden.

• Erfahrung in der Automobilindustrie, im automobilen Auftragsmanagement, in der Fahrzeugauslieferung, Fahrzeugzuweisung, Zulassung oder Rechnungsstellung ist von Vorteil, aber nicht erforderlich. Erfahrungen in einem anderen komplexen Umfeld aus den Bereichen Auftragsmanagement, Mobilität, Einzelhandel oder Logistik können ebenfalls relevant sein.

• Praktische Kenntnisse in Salesforce, SAP, Microsoft Excel, Outlook oder vergleichbaren CRM-, ERP-, Auftragsmanagement- und Berichtssystemen.

Anforderungen an den Arbeitsort

• Diese Position ist in Amsterdam, Niederlande, angesiedelt.

• Bewerberinnen und Bewerber müssen in der Lage sein, entsprechend dem für diese Position vorgesehenen Präsenzmodell am Standort Amsterdam zu arbeiten. Weitere Einzelheiten zum erwarteten Arbeitsmodell werden im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses mitgeteilt.

Diese Stellenausschreibung ist auch auf Französisch und English verfügbar. Bei Abweichungen zwischen den übersetzten Fassungen ist die englische Fassung maßgebend.

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. • Fiabilité du carnet de commandes : garantir l’exactitude et la cohérence des données relatives aux commandes, aux clients, aux véhicules, aux prix et aux paiements dans le carnet de commandes et les systèmes associés. Identifier et corriger de manière proactive les écarts susceptibles d’affecter le traitement des commandes, la facturation ou le reporting.

• Affectation des véhicules : gérer l’affectation et la mise à disposition des véhicules ainsi que la visibilité des stocks, afin de garantir la fiabilité des informations relatives à leur disponibilité et l’association correcte des véhicules aux commandes.

• Communication avec les parties prenantes : être le principal point de contact opérationnel pour les demandes et escalades relatives aux devis et aux commandes, en communiquant de manière claire et proactive sur le statut des commandes, leur traitement, la facturation, la disponibilité des véhicules et les livraisons.

• Optimisation des processus : identifier et mettre en œuvre des processus évolutifs, de la documentation, des supports de formation, des améliorations de systèmes et des solutions d’automatisation afin de renforcer l’efficacité, la cohérence et la précision des opérations.

• Amélioration continue : analyser les erreurs récurrentes, les lacunes dans les processus, les limites des systèmes et les risques opérationnels afin d’en identifier les causes profondes et de mettre en place les actions correctives nécessaires avec les différentes parties prenantes.

Votre profil

Qualifications et compétences requises

• Au moins deux ans d’expérience dans la gestion des commandes, les opérations commerciales, les opérations de la supply chain, le traitement des commandes ou une fonction opérationnelle comparable.

• Une bonne compréhension des processus de bout en bout, depuis la commande jusqu’à la livraison, ainsi que de leurs répercussions sur les opérations en aval.

• Une formation professionnelle ou supérieure achevée, ou une expérience professionnelle pertinente équivalente dans les opérations commerciales, la supply chain, la logistique ou un domaine connexe.

• Une approche pratique et proactive ainsi que la capacité à travailler de manière autonome, à évoluer dans un environnement parfois ambigu et à traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes ou encore peu définies en actions claires et concrètes.

• Un sens aigu des responsabilités et de la responsabilisation individuelle, avec la capacité à gérer ses priorités de manière autonome, à mener les problèmes jusqu’à leur résolution et à fournir un travail de grande qualité dans un environnement dynamique.

• Une capacité démontrée à gérer des processus transactionnels complexes, à analyser les écarts pour en déterminer les causes profondes, à identifier les problèmes récurrents, à hiérarchiser des demandes concurrentes et à maintenir un niveau élevé de précision dans plusieurs systèmes.

• Un état d’esprit axé sur l’amélioration continue, avec la capacité à identifier les tendances, les problèmes récurrents et les inefficacités, puis à recommander des améliorations concrètes favorisant la performance opérationnelle et l’expérience client.

• D’excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, ainsi que la capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, IT et Finance.

• Une maîtrise courante de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

• Une maîtrise courante du français ou de l’allemand, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Il s’agit d’une exigence essentielle, car ce poste implique régulièrement d’accompagner des parties prenantes et de traiter des activités liées aux commandes sur les marchés francophones ou germanophones.

Les candidats doivent impérativement remplir ces deux exigences linguistiques : maîtriser l’anglais ainsi que le français ou l’allemand.

Qualifications souhaitées

• Une expérience dans un environnement opérationnel dynamique, en forte croissance ou en constante évolution, dans lequel les processus et les systèmes sont encore en cours de développement.

• Une expérience dans l’industrie automobile, la gestion des commandes automobiles, la livraison ou l’affectation de véhicules, l’immatriculation ou la facturation constitue un avantage, mais n’est pas indispensable. Une expérience dans un autre environnement complexe lié à la gestion des commandes, à la mobilité, au retail ou à la logistique pourra également être pertinente.
