jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Responder
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

• Over $300 million raised in funding

• 3,000 Tideans globally

• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection & Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection & Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)

• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).

• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.

• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.

• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy

• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.

• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.

• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.

• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.

• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear

• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.

• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.

• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.

• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.

• Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.

• Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

• Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.

• Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.

• Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.

• An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don’t stop at “false positives” without understanding why.

• Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.

• Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.

• Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you’ve built.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

• 25 days paid annual leave

• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities

• Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company

• Personal L&D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year

• Additional health & dental insurance

• Mental wellbeing platform

• Fully covered Multisports card

• Food vouchers

• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office

• WFH equipment allowance

• Flexible working from home

• Sabbatical Leave

• Share options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

#LI-MP1

#LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:

• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.

• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Facility Manager Salesmarket Benelux
jobs.description:
As Facility Manager, you'll shape the environments where our colleagues and customers experience H&M Group every day. From stores to offices, you'll ensure our facilities are safe, efficient and ready to support the business today and in the future.

In this role, you’ll be part of our Facility Management team, working across the Sales Market, covering the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. Based in Amsterdam, you’ll work with two other Facility Managers in taking responsibility for the full Facility Management scope: Energy & Utilities, Cleaning, Waste & Pest Management, Technical Installations, Building Maintenance and Shopfitting Maintenance. Together, you’ll look after a portfolio of more than 170 stores and offices, making sure they are safe, efficient and ready for customers and colleagues.

You’ll combine strategic thinking with operational excellence, working closely with stores, suppliers and business stakeholders to optimise our property portfolio, drive sustainability initiatives and deliver high-quality facility services.

• Develop and deliver category strategies that drive efficiency, quality and long-term value.
• Build strong partnerships with suppliers by leading sourcing, contract management and performance reviews, ensuring excellent service delivery.
• Oversee the condition and performance of our property portfolio.
• Support store openings, refurbishments and lifecycle planning, and execute facility-related projects.
• Drive preventive and corrective maintenance programmes, creating safe, compliant and well-functioning environments across all locations.
• Ensure facilities meet internal standards and external requirements, including health, safety and security regulations.
• Partner with stores and cross-functional teams to understand business needs and turn them into practical, future-focused facility solutions.
• Use Planon and operational data to manage assets, monitor performance and support informed decision-making.
• Track budgets, service levels and quality measures, and identify opportunities to improve performance and optimise costs.
• Support H&M Group's sustainability ambitions through energy management, consumption monitoring and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate with local and global stakeholders, share best practices and contribute to the future development of Facility Management across H&M Group.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

As part of Construction & Facilities within the Expansion Department, you will play a key role in connecting teams across the business. You’ll work closely with Leasing, Store Operations, Store Teams, Visual Merchandising, Security, Retail Tech and external Facility Management partners to deliver efficient, reliable facility services across the Sales Market. You’ll also collaborate with Global Construction & Facilities to ensure alignment and consistency across markets.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with...

• Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.
• Minimum of 3 years' experience in Facility Management, Construction and/or Real Estate.
• Proven experience in supplier and contract management within a Facility Management environment.
• Experience working with multiple stakeholders in a cross-functional or matrix organisation.
• Experience in budgeting, operational planning and cost management.
• Experience working with CAFM systems, such as Planon, and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Strong knowledge of Facility Management operations and supplier performance management.
• Fluent English and Dutch communication skills, both written and spoken. French is meriting.
• Experience within the retail industry, international organisations and knowledge about energy-sustainable management systems like ISO50001 and SEDEX is considered an advantage.
• Facility Management or Project Management certifications are considered an advantage.

And people who are...

• Analytical and data-driven, with excellent problem-solving skills.
• Collaborative and confident in building strong relationships across different functions and external partners.
• Pragmatic and solution-oriented, with a strong focus on execution and continuous improvement.
• Well organised and methodical, using data to prioritise, plan and drive decisions.
• Resilient, flexible and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic business environment.
• Proactive, customer-focused and committed to delivering high-quality facility services that support business performance.

JOIN US​

This is a full-time position, starting as soon as possible. The role is based in Amsterdam and involves regular travel across Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg.

If you think your experience, skills and ambitions fit this position, please send your application as soon as possible.

Due to data privacy policies, we only accept applications via our career page.

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: Customer Success Adoption Specialist
jobs.location: Remote - CA; Remote - Chicago; Remote - Seattle; Remote - TX
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As an Adoption Specialist on our Mid-Market team, you are the technical expert our customers and our Account Managers call when a high-value feature needs to go from "purchased" to "running in the operation." You work on a project-scoped basis: each engagement has a defined goal, a timeline, and clear commitments from both Samsara and the customer. Think of the structure of a solutions architect team, delivered as part of the Samsara relationship rather than as a paid service.

You pair deep product and technical knowledge with project management discipline. You dig into a customer's use case, understand how their industry and operating procedures shape the way they use Samsara, and design a practical path to adoption. You translate highly technical concepts into plain language for non-technical audiences, and you hold customers accountable to the milestones that make a project succeed.

You are also a force multiplier for the broader Customer Success organization. Through research, documentation, and coaching, you help Account Managers learn new products and level up their product knowledge, and you work cross-functionally with Support, Product, and Engineering to solve problems and bring customer insight back to the teams building Samsara. Account Managers continue to own the customer relationship and the renewal; you own the project and the adoption outcome.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll be learning how a waste management company dispatches its routes and the next you may be digging into the inner workings of a food distribution center. You want to understand customer operating procedures well enough to shape our products around them.

• You thrive the most when solving technical problems: You enjoy diagnosing why something isn't working, researching workarounds, and building a solution that fits a customer's real-world workflow.

• You deliver to a deadline: You run projects with clear plans, owners, and dates, and you are comfortable having direct conversations when a customer or internal partner falls behind.

• You are a natural teacher: You can take a complex product concept and make it clear for a fleet manager, a safety lead, or an executive, and you enjoy helping teammates build their own expertise.

• You are the architect of your own career: This is a new role on a team that is still shaping its future. You will have plenty of autonomy and opportunity to define how the role works and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

• Be a deep Subject Matter Expert on the Samsara product, API, integrations and AI capabilities.

• Lead project-scoped adoption engagements with Mid-Market customers, from scoping and kickoff through delivery, to increase adoption of Samsara's technical features and drive measurable customer outcomes.

• Hold customers accountable to agreed-upon commitments, and escalate early and constructively when a project is at risk.

• Complete deep research into customer use cases, current workflows, and workarounds, and recommend practical, well-supported solutions.

• Develop a working understanding of the industries we serve and how Samsara's products are tailored to each industry and each company's operating procedures.

• Support the broader team in learning new products and upleveling product knowledge through training, documentation, and hands-on enablement.

• Work cross-functionally with Support, Product, and Engineering to troubleshoot complex issues, and share customer insights that inform the product roadmap.

• Capture what you learn in reusable playbooks, templates, and best practices so the team can scale the impact of each project.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 3 to 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as implementation, solutions engineering, technical customer success, or professional services, ideally in SaaS, IoT, technology, or logistics.

• Bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

• Strong technical aptitude, with a track record of quickly learning complex products and troubleshooting issues independently.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deliver to deadlines, with clear planning and follow-through.

• Proven track record of communicating technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical audiences, from day-to-day users to executives.

• Solutions-oriented with strong research and problem-solving skills.

• Strong communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.

• Comfort with a rapidly changing, high-growth environment.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Strong bias towards action, has the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.

• AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.

• API and Integration Experience: Experience building with APIs, and/or working with and building integrations.

• Project Management Experience: Experience running scoped, project-based customer engagements.

• Technical Proficiency: Experience with building deep knowledge of a suite of technical products (bonus points if familiar with integrating hardware with software solutions).

• Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$97,877.50—$148,050 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com.

As a Senior Backend Engineer you will design, build, and scale the backend systems that enable remote operators to monitor, support, and interact with our autonomous ground support equipment (AGSE) operating in live airport environments.

As our autonomous fleet expands across airports, remote assistance becomes a critical component of safe and reliable operations. You'll build the services that connect autonomous vehicles with remote operators, enabling real-time communication, vehicle monitoring, assistance requests, and operational decision-making.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time communication, and autonomous vehicle operations. You'll work closely with autonomy, platform, infrastructure, and operations teams to develop reliable, low-latency backend services that support an increasingly large fleet of autonomous vehicles.

You'll have significant ownership over system architecture, reliability, and scalability, building production systems where performance and availability directly impact real-world operations.


YOU WILL

 - Design, develop, and maintain backend services powering AeroVect's remote assistance platform for autonomous vehicle operations.

 - Build reliable, low-latency communication systems between autonomous vehicles, cloud infrastructure, and remote operators.

 - Develop APIs and cloud backend services that enable vehicle monitoring, remote assistance requests, operator interactions, and fleet coordination.

 - Design and implement real-time data streaming and cloud event-driven architectures to support vehicle state updates, telemetry, and operational events.

 - Build scalable systems to manage remote assistance sessions, including request routing, operator assignment, session state, and lifecycle management.

 - Ensure backend systems are resilient to network interruptions, latency, and intermittent connectivity in real-world airport environments.

 - Develop robust mechanisms for authentication, authorization, auditing, and secure communication between vehicles and remote operators.

 - Build monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities to identify issues and maintain high system reliability.

 - Collaborate with autonomy and platform engineers to integrate remote assistance capabilities with vehicle software and fleet management systems.

 - Optimize backend performance, scalability, and fault tolerance as the number of deployed vehicles and remote assistance sessions increases.

 - Take end-to-end ownership of backend services, from system design and implementation through deployment, testing, and production support.


YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, with a strong track record of designing and operating production-grade distributed systems.

 - Strong programming experience in Python, Go, C++, or similar backend languages.

 - Experience designing and building scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices architectures.

 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and fault-tolerant architectures.

 - Experience with real-time communication technologies such as WebSockets, gRPC, or similar protocols.

 - Hands-on experience with message brokers and event-driven systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or equivalent technologies.

 - Experience building and deploying cloud-native applications, preferably on AWS.

 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

 - Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, HTTP, connection management, and latency optimization.

 - Experience designing systems for high availability, observability, and production reliability.

 - Ability to independently own complex technical projects and make sound architectural decisions in an evolving environment.

 - Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across software, infrastructure, and product teams.


WE PREFER

 - Experience building backend systems for autonomous vehicles, robotics, teleoperations, or remote assistance platforms.

 - Experience working with vehicle telemetry, fleet management, or real-time operational monitoring systems.

 - Knowledge of video streaming technologies such as WebRTC, RTSP, or other low-latency media protocols.

 - Experience developing systems that operate across unreliable or bandwidth-constrained networks.

 - Familiarity with safety-critical systems, operational safeguards, and secure remote interactions with physical devices.

 - Experience with edge-to-cloud communication architectures.

 - Experience building dispatching, scheduling, or resource allocation systems.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced startup environment, building products and infrastructure from the ground up.

jobs.title: HRシステムエンジニア（AI駆動開発・データ基盤）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7600万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼People Analytics & AI Tech Officeの紹介
私たちは、PayPayの急成長を支える人と組織の意思決定を、データとAIテクノロジーの力で科学し、進化させる専門家集団です。
従来の人事オペレーションの枠を超え、People Analytics（データ分析）とAI Technology（技術実装）を融合させることで、事業成長および組織生産性の最大化への貢献を目指しています。

▼募集の背景

AIを世界一活用する企業を目指すソフトバンクグループの一員として、PayPayは今、圧倒的なスピードで事業拡大を続けています。 組織が拡大・複雑化する中で、旧来のオペレーションモデルでは対応しきれない課題が増加しており、特に「シンギュラリティ」を見据えた抜本的な業務プロセスの再発明が急務です。
2025年に新設されたPeople Analytics & AI Tech Officeでは、HR部門を横断して業務フローを解体・再構築できるプロフェッショナルを求めています。
特に、最新のAIエージェント技術やPython等を用いた高度な自動化を駆使し、採用・労務・組織開発など多岐にわたる人事業務を内製化・自動化・無人化・高度化できるプロジェクトをリードしてくださる方を募集しております。

＜参考情報＞
・第13回日本HRチャレンジ大賞受賞（テーマ：世界No.1のD&I企業へのチャレンジ）
・第11回HRテクノロジー大賞 人的資本経営部門優秀賞（テーマ：AI×人的資本経営で未来を拓き、グローバルNo.1へ）
・第8回HRテクノロジー大賞 イノベーション賞

【具体的な業務内容】

「HR領域の業務システム・AIソリューションの内製開発をリードしつつ、データ基盤構築まで一気通貫で担い、PayPayグループの組織推進力を最大化する」

急拡大・多様化するPayPayおよびグループ各社の組織課題・業務オペレーションをテクノロジーの力で解決するため、AI駆動開発を活用したHR業務システム・ツールの内製開発をメインミッションとしつつ、それらを支えるHRデータ基盤・パイプラインの設計・構築まで幅広くリードしていただきます。
HRの取り扱うデータ（従業員情報、健康情報、採用応募者情報など）はすべて機密レベルの高いものです。それらを安全・効率的に活用するためのセキュアなシステムを開発することが求められるポジションです。

※これまでのご経験・志向に応じて、以下の業務を担当いただきます。

1. HR領域のBPR・システム内製開発

• 採用、労務、評価、派遣管理などHR部門内および関連部門を跨ぐ業務フローの可視化・課題特定・要件定義

• 生成AI（ChatGPT / Gemini / Codex 等）やローコード（OutSystems / GAS）、Python等を活用した業務システム・AIエージェントの設計〜開発〜リリース（AI駆動開発）

• 導入後の保守運用、追加開発、および現場定着化支援（マニュアル作成、トレーニング、効果測定）

2. HRデータ基盤・パイプラインの設計・構築（データエンジニアリング）

• Snowflake / Databricks 等を活用したHRデータ基盤・データマートの設計・構築（ETL/ELTパイプライン整備）

• Workday等のHR基幹システムや各種社内ツールとのデータ連携・統合パイプラインの構築

• 従業員情報・健康情報等の機微データを安全に扱うためのセキュリティ・権限管理およびデータタグ付け・カタログ整備

• BIツール（Sigma）を用いたダッシュボード構築・データ可視化の支援

【開発・分析環境】
・生成AI：ChatGPT / Gemini / Codex 等
・言語・開発・ローコード：Python / SQL / Google Apps Script（GAS）/ OutSystems / GitHub
・データ基盤・クラウド：Snowflake / Databricks / Cloud Storage（GCP / AWS）
・BIツール：Sigma
・HR基幹システム：Workday

【過去開発事例】　※いずれもAI駆動開発による事例です。
・採用アシスタントAIツール
・派遣管理デスク請求チェックAIツール
・HRBP向けコンサルアシスタントAIツール
・PayPayグループ内公募アシスタントAIツールなど

▼本ポジションの魅力

• AI×人事の新たな仕組みづくり： 最新のAI技術を実際のHR業務に取り入れ、数千名規模の組織にインパクトを与えるプロダクト開発に携われます。

• 高い裁量とスピード感： 業務課題の特定から企画・開発・導入まで一貫して携わり、自らの技術力やアイデアをスピーディーに形にできる環境です。

• 技術交流と専門性の広がり： PayPay社内やソフトバンク・LINEヤフーグループとのAI活用事例の共有・勉強会などを通じて、技術的な知見を深めながら、HR領域の専門性も広げられます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下すべての経験・スキルをお持ちの方

• SE、アプリケーションエンジニア、社内SE、業務改善エンジニア等として、業務システム・自動化ツール・ローコードアプリなどの要件定義から設計・実装まで携わった経験

• 生成AI（ChatGPT、Gemini、Codex、Claude等）をシステム開発や業務自動化に活用し、設計から実装まで主体的に推進できるスキル

• 非エンジニア（人事・経営層等）と連携し、業務要件をシステム・データ設計に落とし込めるスキル

あると望ましい経験/スキル

以下いずれかの経験・スキルをお持ちの方

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager ( Anti Money Laundering/Transaction Monitoring)
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Product Manager  (Anti Money Laundering/Transaction Monitoring)

Product - FinCrime

Ebury Valencia Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

As we expand our capabilities across new verticals (i.e. embedded payments), new products (i.e. cards) and new payment rails (i.e. stablecoins ), Anti Money Laundering controls are becoming a more critical part of our product strategy.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Financial Crime Intelligence Product domain, owning Transaction Monitoring across fiat, crypto, card and hybrid payment flows as a domain lead.

You will own the Transaction Monitoring product area, working at the intersection of First Line, Compliance, Engineering and Data.

Your focus will be on building scalable, regulator-ready controls while enabling growth across traditional and digital asset payment rails considering different product and business vertical compliance frameworks.

This role reports to the Head of Financial Crime Intelligence Product.

What you’ll do

Product Ownership:

• Balance growth vs risk trade-offs.

• Use data and research to identify pain points, investigate anomalies, and deliver optimisations.

• Define the strategy for your area, ensuring alignment with overall Financial Crime Intelligence Product domain goals and company direction.

• Translate these into a clear, actionable roadmap across: fiat to fiat transactions, fiat to crypto transactions (mainly stablecoins), crypto to crypto transactions and card spends

• Define and evolve Transaction Monitoring rules, scenarios, risk typologies and predictive AI models aligned with different compliance frameworks, taking into account Crypto Travel Rule requirements.

• Drive improvements in False positive reduction, Alert quality, Operational scalability.

Stakeholder management:

• Partner with first line and second line operational and compliance teams to ensure controls are effective, explainable, audit-ready.

• Partner with Data Science teams on predictive AI models for transactions; model inputs, outputs, and thresholds (you are not expected to build machine learning models, but you must understand how predictive models behave in production).

• Support regulatory reviews and audits with strong product narratives.

Delivery & execution:

• Translate regulatory and AML requirements into clear product requirements.

• Work closely with Engineering on managing vendor integrations (e.g. blockchain analytics, travel rule), event schemas, transaction data models and system performance and scalability.

What you’ll need

• Previous experience in fintech, crypto, payments, regulated financial services.

• 4+ years’ experience as a Product Manager.

• 2+ years working on AML / Transaction Monitoring products. -Hands-on exposure to crypto transaction monitoring (in particular Stablecoins) or VASP compliance.

• Experience with blockchain analytics tools (e.g. Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic or similar).

• Experience with travel rule tools (e.g. Notabene, Sumsub or similar).

• Experience leading vendor evaluations, integrations, and performance management.

• Analytical thinking and proficiency with system design discussions.

• Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and geographies to drive alignment and execution.

• (Nice to have) Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field.

• (Nice to have) Experience building platforms that serve both B2B and B2B2C use cases.

What success looks like:

• Transaction Monitoring that scales across new products, verticals and rails.

• Measurable reduction in false positives without increased regulatory risk.

• Predictive models trusted by Compliance and regulators.

Why Ebury?

• Competitive Starting Salary with an annual discretionary bonus that truly rewards your performance from day one.

• Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

• Clear, Accelerated Career Progression: Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.

• Dynamic & Supportive Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.

• Generous Benefits Package: Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.

• Central Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.

Ready to launch your career with a global FinTech? Click the ‘Apply’ Today and discover your potential at Ebury!

#LI-HYBRID

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

jobs.title: Centralist
jobs.description:
🔒 Centralist

📍 Locatie: Amsterdam

📅 36 uur per week

✅ Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering, reiskostenvergoeding, pensioen, fietsplan, tot 30% korting op bijv. winkels en hotels via Benefits at Work.

Als centralist in het Securitas Operations Center (SOC) werk je in het hart van onze beveiligingsorganisatie. Vanuit onze alarmcentrale verwerk je 24/7 meldingen van klanten uit heel Nederland. Geen dienst is hetzelfde: je schakelt snel, blijft rustig en zorgt dat de juiste actie wordt ingezet.

Heb je nog geen ervaring in de beveiliging? Geen probleem. Bij Securitas kun je je laten omscholen. Je krijgt een goede inwerkperiode en leert stap voor stap hoe je meldingen beoordeelt en opvolgt.

Je helpt mensen, bewaakt locaties op afstand en ondersteunt collega’s in het veld. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan een veiligere wereld.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

• Ontvangen en beoordelen van alarmmeldingen zoals: inbraak-, brand- en overvalmeldingen.
• Het monitoren van camerabeelden en beveiligingssystemen.
• Afstemmen met mobiele surveillanten en andere hulpdiensten.
• Het registreren van meldingen en acties in de systemen.
• Bewaken van veiligheid op afstand via camera- en voertuigvolgsystemen.
• Het onderhouden van contact met klanten, hulpdiensten en collega’s van de mobiele surveillance.

• Je hebt je BOCA (Basisopleiding Centralist Alarmcentrale) of beveiliger niveau 2 diploma.
• Je woont in een straal van 40km rondom Amsterdam.
• Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en je vindt het prima om in een 24/7 omgeving te werken, incl. weekenden, ochtend-, middag- of nachtdiensten.
• Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed
• Je beschikt over mbo werk- en denkniveau.
• Je bent stressbestendig, analytisch en ziet iedere alarmmelding als een uitdaging.
• Je communiceert duidelijk en professioneel.
• Je kunt goed omgaan met verschillende systemen tegelijk.
• Je herkent je in onze kernwaarden: integriteit, waakzaamheid en behulpzaamheid

Een verantwoordelijke functie binnen een professionele en groeiende organisatie waar jouw ontwikkeling centraal staat. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

• Een bruto salaris per 4 weken tussen €2502,03 en €3140,87, afhankelijk van ervaring, opleiding en contracturen.
• Onregelmatigheidstoeslagen conform geldende arbeidsvoorwaarden. Het bedraagt gemiddeld €2,50 bruto per uur bij fulltime dienstverband. LET OP: De daadwerkelijke toeslag is afhankelijk van rooster, gewerkte uren en diensten.
• Een parttime of fulltime dienstverband.
• Jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast contract bij goed functioneren.
• Volop opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, via onze eigen Learning Hub.
• Pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding.
• Mogelijkheid tot deelname aan collectieve zorgverzekeringen.
• Voor deze functie geldt een loyaliteitsbonus.
• Benefits at Work app met hoge kortingen op allerlei winkels en dagjes uit.

Wil je blijven groeien? Dat kan! Via ons kun je de VOCA (Vakopleiding Centralist Alarmcentrale) volgen. Je ontwikkelt hiermee niet alleen je vakinhoudelijke kennis, maar zet ook een volgende stap in je loopbaan én salaris. Met de juiste ambitie en ontwikkeling kun je uiteindelijk doorgroeien tot Hoofd Centralist.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Developer Tools (Starcraft)
jobs.description:
We are hiring a software engineering manager with a passion for developer experience and build tooling to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks (OCI images).

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognized names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft. Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

Your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

This Engineering Management role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for developer experience to build a career with Canonical and drive the success of the business. If you have an affinity for open source development, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Location: This is a remote role, we are considering candidates in AMER time zones.

The role entails

• Leading your team to elevate the Linux developer experience.

• Demonstrating sound engineering principles through architecture, development and code reviews.

• Being responsible for planning, estimation and execution.

• Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders.

• Building and leading a distributed regional team of engineers.

• Offering coaching, mentoring, technical feedback and hands-on career development.

• Designing, embracing, and evangelizing great engineering and organizational practices.

• Being an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization.

• Engaging with the wider open source community for feedback and collaboration.

What we are looking for in you

• An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.

• Knowledge of modern high-level languages (Python, Go) as well as containerization technologies and primitives (Snaps, Docker, etc.).

• Experience in the design and architecture of command-line and server-side applications

• Software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.

• Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.

• A passion for technology and a drive to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.

• A track record of open source leadership and collaboration.

• Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.

• A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.

• Bi-annual compensation review.

• Company recognition rewards.

• 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.

• Maternity and paternity leave.

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Marketing Data & AI
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

• The work we do and the innovation we drive

• Our values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize a modern, cloud-based marketing data platform that powers analytics, AI, and data products. Beyond technical delivery, we want someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data, who applies common sense, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help shape business requirements, not just implement them as given.

The core objective of this role is to connect the marketing data platform to our existing unified and centralised business intelligence layer. Much of the work is about building bridges to existing models and layers, so we don’t reinvent the wheel each time. You will deliver high-quality curated datasets with robust governance, security, and observability, and prepare marketing data structures for AI consumption, including machine learning and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems.

You are likely to be the only data engineer in the team to begin with. You will have peers to collaborate and share knowledge with, but they sit outside your immediate team (for example, the sister website team with front-end and back-end developers). You will work closely with data analysts, marketing automation specialists, performance marketers, and marketing business owners.

Platforms

Our platform is currently built on Google Cloud (BigQuery), with Microsoft Fabric likely in the longer term. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in one cloud who are T-shaped: comfortable working across clouds and keen to broaden their platform experience.

Role responsibilities

Build & Data Platform Engineering

• Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines on GCP and BigQuery, adapting to Azure/Fabric as our platform evolves.

• Build ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for structured and unstructured marketing and sales data (e.g., social media, organic, web, CRM, CMS, email).

• Implement lakehouse/warehouse patterns and layered data modelling (e.g., medallion: bronze, silver, gold), ensuring reusable, scalable systems aligned with enterprise needs.

• Build integrations and “bridges” between the marketing data platform and existing centralised BI models, avoiding duplicated logic and rework.

Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products

• Deliver model-ready, production-grade marketing datasets for analytics, ML, and optimization.

• Structure data for AI consumption, including pipelines for GenAI use cases (LLMs, RAG, vector-based data flows) and agent-based architectures.

• Use ML lifecycle and catalog/governance tooling, with an emphasis on equivalent tooling for our platform (e.g., Vertex AI, Dataplex), or Databricks MLflow and Unity Catalog where relevant.

Data Modelling, Orchestration & Automation

• Design logical and physical data models focused on the marketing problem space, aligned with existing enterprise models.

• Orchestrate workflows with tools such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, dbt, Dataform, or equivalents (e.g., Azure Data Factory), with a focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability.

Architecture, Governance & Observability

• Apply event-driven and streaming architecture patterns where they fit the use case.

• Ensure data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC) using GCP Dataplex or equivalents (Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, AWS Lake Formation).

• Establish observability: data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence.

Data Serving, Integration & Optimization

• Enable serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) for downstream and upstream ML and AI platforms.

• Continuously optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost.

Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership

• Ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders want, but why.

• Bring a growth mindset and a willingness to translate business needs into scope and tasks that achieve objectives.

• Surface gaps and better alternatives rather than executing a brief as written.

Collaboration

• Work closely with data analysts, marketing automation specialists, performance marketers, and marketing business owners.

• Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices.

Must have qualifications

Technical skills

• Strong Python and SQL.

• Proven experience building batch and streaming pipelines and production-grade data platforms.

• Experience designing data structures for AI consumption.

• Experience working with marketing and sales data sources (e.g., social media, organic/SEO, web analytics, CRM, CMS, email platforms).

• Solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance.

Cloud & platforms (key requirement)

• Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with BigQuery and the GCP data stack (e.g., Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataform, Cloud Composer).

• Deep expertise in at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure/Fabric), plus demonstrable openness and ability to work across clouds. Candidates with strong AWS or Azure/Fabric backgrounds (Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse) are encouraged to apply, provided they are keen to work on GCP and Fabric.

Architecture & systems thinking

• Experience with modern warehouse/lakehouse architectures and distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance.

Mindset

• Keen interest or experience in the marketing problem space. You don’t need to be a marketer, but you should enjoy this part of the business and the challenge we are trying to solve.

• Naturally curious, with strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach in cross-functional teams.

• Comfortable challenging business requirements rather than taking them at face value.

• Adaptable and eager to work across platforms. Agile or consulting experience is beneficial.

Nice to have qualifications

• Experience with Salesforce and Marketo data integration.

• Hands-on experience across more than one cloud, or cloud migration experience.

• Experience with Microsoft Fabric.

• Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, or Databricks.

• GenAI and AI data systems (RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM data preparation).

• CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).

• Streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka), or ML/experimentation platforms.

• Experience building data products or large-scale analytics platforms.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

• Private health insurance We hope you will never need it, but nevertheless, we offer private health insurance to all our employees.

• Education program We never stop learning, that’s why we offer our employees an educational program with training and certification.

• Wellbeing program We all deserve to live a healthy and well-balanced life. It's not an option, it's a necessity!

• Free beverages Enjoy free coffee, drinks, and snacks at work, or join one of our famous company dinners.

• Events We enjoy spending time together, not only at work. Ski trips, carting, laser-tag, wine tasting, picnics, cooking classes… you name it – we’ve done it! There are plenty of cool events to join and to get to know your colleagues.

• Competitive conditions Besides a competitive salary and 24 days of vacation, you will join annual company events with the whole team.

• Challenging projects Ready for a challenge? We guarantee you'll find challenging projects at Valtech!

• Cool colleagues What's the most important thing in a job? Cool colleagues with whom you spent most of the time during the week. We have a lot of them!

• Honest feedback Honesty, openness and respect are among our core values. We encourage an open feedback culture in order to build trust and grow together.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

jobs.title: Sr. Coordinator Quality Control - tMart
jobs.description:
WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?

• Inbound & Putaway: Receive GRNs against POs, check quantity/quality/expiry/temperature, label and put away using FIFO/FEFO and slotting rules.
• Picking & Packing: Pick waves for store replenishment and customer orders using RF scanners; pack with correct dunnage and cold-chain handling.
• Dispatch & Handover: Stage orders by route/store, load vehicles, hand over to last-mile teams with full documentation (STNs/DOs).
• Inventory Control: Daily cycle counts, weekly reconciliations, investigate variances, manage near-expiry, damages, RTVs.
• Quality & Compliance: Maintain hygiene, HACCP/ISO 22000 checklists, temperature logs, pest control records, PPE, and 5S standards.
• Systems & Reporting: Operate WMS/RF devices, update statuses in real time; prepare simple shift reports (receipts, pick lines, shrink).
• Cross-Functional: Coordinate with Demand planning, Ops, and Transport on delivery schedules, priorities, and exceptions.

KPIs

• Receiving accuracy ≥99%; Pick accuracy ≥99.5%
• On-time dispatch (OTD/OTIF) ≥98%
• Inventory variance ≤0.2%, shrink % within target
• Hygiene & temperature log 100% compliance

WHAT DID WE ORDER?

• 1–3 years in warehouse/DC (FMCG retail, e-commerce, or darkstore preferred).

jobs.title: AI Brand Design Lead
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, on US working hours · Reports to: Chief Growth Officer


BACKGROUND

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics for brands like Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the last year we've built a brand we genuinely love https://nash.ai/blog/equilibrium-in-motion-introducing-the-new-nash-brand: a visual identity with real thought and meaning behind it, a motion system rooted in physics, a voice people notice, a website, a presence at the biggest trade shows in commerce.

We're already an AI-obsessed team. Now we want to see what happens when someone with real creative taste and flair pairs with the velocity we've built.


THE ROLE

We believe brand is one of the most important things a company builds, and the person in this seat has real creative authority. You will shape how Nash looks, moves, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Your taste sets the bar.

We are hiring an AI Brand Design Lead to take that brand and push it into territory that wasn't possible before AI. Not redesign it. Not maintain it. Push it: more expressive motion, tighter systems, higher craft, broader application, faster velocity, and new creative territory that only opens up when you treat AI as a core design tool.

Your superpower is taste. Your medium is AI. Your job is to make the two compound: taste sharp enough that AI finally gives you the velocity to match your ambition.

Just as importantly, you think about brand as a platform. You'd rather build a system that lets any marketer on this team, armed with Claude and the right prompts, produce something fantastic and on-brand than review every output yourself. You raise the ceiling for your own work. You raise the floor for everyone else's.

If you see AI as a threat to good design, this isn't the role for you. But if you believe that one person with real taste and the right tools can build a brand system that rivals teams ten times the size, and that the real unlock is making everyone on the team capable of shipping work with your standards baked in, we want to talk.

You'll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer (who spent his career building and leading marketing, growth, and product organizations at companies like Twilio, Plaid, and Salesforce). You'll work with our CEO, CTO, and a small, senior, fast-moving team across product, engineering, and growth.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Extend and refine the Nash visual identity across motion, web, print, environmental, campaign, and product surfaces

 - Build the brand platform: prompt libraries, LLM-readable brand documentation, component systems, and template kits that let the whole team produce on-brand work with AI

 - Own the marketing site (fully Claude-coded): evolve it, ship new pages, raise the bar for craft and interaction

 - Create the work that wasn't possible before: generative illustrations, interactive explainers, AI-driven animations, brand content that would have taken a full studio and now takes you and a prompt

 - Produce the visual layer of the growth engine: decks, one-pagers, customer materials

 - Own booth and experiential design for trade shows (NRF, Manifest, Shoptalk) where Nash shows up with installations, not just a banner

 - Set the standard for craft and fix the system when something falls short, not just the artifact


REQUIREMENTS

 - 6+ years in brand or visual design with a portfolio showing real range: identity, web, motion, campaign, systems

 - Has extended or evolved a brand at a high-growth technology company

 - AI-obsessed. Daily use of Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Cursor, or equivalent. Can show us the workflow, not just the outputs. If your portfolio is full of beautiful work but none of it involved AI, this is not the role

 - Systems thinker who can build a design kit, a prompt library, and a brand doc an LLM can reason against

 - Comfortable in Figma, After Effects, and Illustrator; bonus if you can ship a page with Claude Code

 - Treats taste as the skill that matters most, and AI as the tool that makes taste scale


HOW TO APPLY

We don't want your resume. We want to see your taste and how you apply it through tools.

Go to nash.ai https://nash.ai. Look at our brand: read how we built it https://nash.ai/blog/equilibrium-in-motion-introducing-the-new-nash-brand and explore the brand system https://nash.ai/brand. Then show us one example of how you would take something we already have and make it better. A tighter page. A motion concept. A campaign direction. An illustration style. A prompt template that generates on-brand output. Whatever catches your eye. Show us how you used AI to make it: the workflow, prompts, or system behind it, not just the output.

Send it however you want: a Figma file, a Replit prototype, a Loom, a PDF, a Claude artifact. No format requirements. Just the design idea.

Keep it small: an hour or two is plenty, and rough is fine. We're looking for your thinking and taste, not a finished deliverable. It stays yours.

A work sample is required to apply. Share it as a link or a file upload on the application form. Applications without one won't be reviewed.

More about Nash http://Nash.AI


NASH IS THE PLATFORM THAT POWERS MODERN LOGISTICS.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.




WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT US

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.title: QHSE Engineer
jobs.location: Al Obour City, Al-Qalyubia Governorate, Egypt
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Implement and monitor quality, occupational health, safety, and environmental requirements at the assigned site. Support safe working conditions, effective management systems, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement through inspections, risk assessments, audits, employee training, and follow-up of corrective actions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality and Integrated Management Systems

• Support the implementation and maintenance of the integrated management system in line with applicable ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and Sika requirements.
• Maintain controlled procedures, work instructions, inspection checklists, and QHSE records.
• Conduct internal audits and workplace inspections, document findings, and follow up on corrective actions with responsible departments.
• Support Quality and Production teams in investigating process nonconformities and recurring quality issues.
• Participate in internal, corporate, customer, and certification audits, ensuring that supporting records are complete and available.

2. Workplace Safety and Risk Assessment

• Conduct routine site inspections to identify unsafe conditions, unsafe practices, and opportunities for improvement.
• Prepare and update risk assessments and job safety analyses with the relevant departments, following the hierarchy of controls.
• Monitor compliance with safe working procedures, personal protective equipment requirements, and machinery safeguards.
• Verify the application of permit-to-work and energy-isolation procedures for activities such as hot work, work at height, and confined-space entry, where applicable.
• Monitor contractor and visitor compliance with site safety requirements, including induction and required work documentation.
• Intervene in unsafe activities, stop work presenting immediate danger in accordance with site procedures, and promptly escalate significant risks.

3. Incident Investigation and Emergency Preparedness

• Ensure prompt reporting and recording of incidents, near misses, injuries, spills, and other QHSE events.
• Participate in investigations, identify root causes, and follow up on actions to prevent recurrence.
• Support emergency response plans, evacuation arrangements, firefighting readiness, and spill response preparations.
• Coordinate emergency drills and inspections of emergency equipment with responsible teams and service providers.

4. Environmental Management

• Monitor waste segregation, storage, handling, and disposal arrangements, including hazardous waste where applicable.
• Inspect chemical storage, labelling, containment, and spill-prevention measures.
• Coordinate required environmental monitoring and maintain records relating to emissions, wastewater, noise, and other relevant environmental aspects.
• Support initiatives to reduce waste, water consumption, energy use, and environmental impact.

5. Occupational Health and Employee Awareness

• Identify occupational exposure risks, including chemicals, dust, noise, heat, and manual handling, and follow up on appropriate controls.
• Coordinate occupational health monitoring and required medical examinations with HR and authorized healthcare providers.
• Deliver QHSE inductions, toolbox talks, and awareness sessions for employees and contractors.
• Maintain training records and assess employees’ understanding of relevant workplace requirements.
• Promote timely hazard reporting, employee participation, and consistent safe working practices.

6. Compliance, Coordination, and Reporting

• Maintain the site’s register of applicable QHSE requirements and track assigned compliance actions, inspections, and permit renewal dates.
• Support governmental inspections and external assessments under the direction of the responsible manager.
• Prepare QHSE performance reports, highlighting findings, overdue actions, recurring issues, and improvement recommendations.
• Work closely with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Supply Chain, and HR to resolve QHSE concerns.
• Follow up on agreed actions and verify their effectiveness before closure.

Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, Agriculture, Environmental Science, or a relevant discipline.
• Two to five years of relevant experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably construction chemicals, waterproofing, or related chemical industries.
• Working knowledge of occupational hazards, risk assessment, incident investigation, and environmental controls.
• Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems.
• First aid and firefighting training; NEBOSH IGC or equivalent HSE training is an advantage.
• Internal auditor training is preferred.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Good written and spoken Arabic and English.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training.  We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
