jobs.title: QC/R&D MANAGER
jobs.location: Al Obour City, Al-Qalyubia Governorate, Egypt
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Lead the Quality Control and Research and Development functions to ensure consistent product quality, develop and improve construction chemical formulations, and support efficient manufacturing. Drive innovation, cost optimization, and technical problem-solving while ensuring that products meet approved specifications, customer requirements, applicable standards, and Sika’s technical and safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Control and Product Conformity

• Manage the inspection and testing of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediate products, and finished goods against approved specifications.
• Establish and maintain sampling plans, testing methods, acceptance criteria, and traceable quality records.
• Oversee material and finished-product release decisions within delegated authority, ensuring that nonconforming materials are identified, segregated, and controlled.
• Investigate quality deviations, batch failures, and recurring defects with Production and other relevant functions; verify the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.
• Monitor quality trends and recommend improvements to product consistency, testing reliability, and manufacturing processes.

2. Research and Product Development

• Lead the development, localization, and improvement of construction chemical products within the assigned portfolio.
• Translate market needs and customer requirements into defined development projects with Sales, Marketing, and Technical teams.
• Plan laboratory experiments, performance evaluations, application trials, and stability studies to validate new and modified formulations.
• Coordinate with Sika’s regional and global R&D teams on technology transfer, technical approvals, and knowledge sharing.
• Maintain a prioritized development pipeline with clear objectives, responsibilities, milestones, and progress reporting.

3. Raw Materials and Formulation Optimization

• Evaluate alternative raw materials and suppliers with Procurement to improve supply continuity, product performance, and cost efficiency.
• Lead formulation optimization initiatives while maintaining required quality, safety, application performance, and shelf life.
• Ensure that material substitutions and formulation changes are tested, documented, and approved before implementation.
• Support initiatives to reduce waste and environmental impact, with appropriate technical validation of resulting product claims.

4. Production Support and Industrialization

• Lead the technical transfer of approved formulations from laboratory trials to pilot and commercial production.
• Establish manufacturing instructions, process parameters, and quality checkpoints with Production.
• Support troubleshooting of processing difficulties and product performance issues, identifying sustainable technical solutions.
• Work with Technical Service and Sales to investigate customer complaints, conduct relevant testing, and recommend corrective actions.
• Provide technical training on product characteristics, testing requirements, and manufacturing controls.

5. Laboratory Management and Safety

• Manage laboratory capacity, workloads, equipment, consumables, and testing priorities to support production and development requirements.
• Ensure that instruments are calibrated, maintained, and suitable for their intended tests.
• Maintain effective sample identification, retention, storage, and disposal arrangements.
• Ensure safe laboratory practices, chemical handling, housekeeping, and waste management in coordination with EHS.
• Maintain reliable and complete experimental records and test results.

6. Quality Systems and Technical Documentation

• Maintain controlled formulations, specifications, test methods, manufacturing instructions, and technical records.
• Ensure that approved formulation changes are accurately reflected in bills of materials and relevant systems.
• Support ISO 9001 requirements and applicable internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits.
• Coordinate product testing and certification against applicable Egyptian and international standards.
• Support accurate product data, safety documentation, and labelling with the responsible functions.
• Protect confidential formulations, technical information, and intellectual property.

7. People Leadership and Department Management

• Set objectives, allocate responsibilities, and monitor the performance of QC and R&D employees.
• Coach and develop the team, assess technical competencies, and maintain training and succession plans.
• Prepare and control departmental budgets, including testing expenses, equipment requirements, and development resources.
• Report quality performance, development progress, savings, resource needs, and significant technical risks to management.
• Maintain effective coordination with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, EHS, Finance, and HR.

Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
• Suggested experience: at least eight years in construction chemicals or a closely related manufacturing sector, including three years in a managerial or supervisory role.
• Demonstrated experience in both formulation development and quality control.
• Strong knowledge of relevant product technologies, laboratory testing, industrial scale-up, and root-cause analysis.
• Working knowledge of ISO 9001, applicable product standards, and laboratory safety.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant ERP or laboratory systems; SAP experience is an advantage.
• Strong communication skills in English and Arabic.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training.  We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Finance
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.



 


THE ROLE

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead product direction for major AI Finance app areas.

 - Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 - Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 - Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 - Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 - Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 - Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 - Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 - Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 - Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 - Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 - Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 - Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.



THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT

 - Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 - Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 - Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 - Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 - Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 - People who cannot go deep into product details.

 - Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 - Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 - People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 


LOCATION

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in US.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Data Products & UX - Contract
jobs.description:
Role: Product Engineer (Data Products & UX), 1-year contract with potential to hire in a full-time role
Role Purpose: Design and build the interfaces on top of our data systems to turn Climate Cabinet's data into products that internal staff, lawmakers, and advocacy partners can use to advance climate policy.
Duration: 1-year contract starting in February 2027, with potential to extend or hire into a full-time role at the end of the term. Open to time commitment of between 25-40 hours per week. Project assignments will be adjusted to match capacity.
Location: Remote in the U.S.
Timeframe: Priority deadline for proposals is December 7, 2026. Target contract start date is February 2027.
Compensation: We anticipate a maximum monthly rate of ~$12,250/month, depending on experience and demonstrated skill level. We expect total contract value to vary based on hours and scope.

About Climate Cabinet

Climate Cabinet helps state and local champions win on climate. We support high-impact, under-the-radar offices who have “outsized impact” on our ability to solve the climate crisis - from clean energy buildout to zero-carbon transportation. These leaders drive progress regardless of who is in the White House.

We are a dynamic, passionate team of experienced climate experts with staff on-the-ground across the country and a remote-first workplace. We create a clear, kind culture of agency and growth—sharing expectations openly, giving space for initiative, and supporting one another as full people to build their climate movement leadership in service of our climate mission.

Role Summary

Climate Cabinet is growing, and we are leveling up our work to match more ambitious policy goals in 2027. The Product Engineer will drive that leveling up for our data interfaces: the tools, dashboards, and public-facing experiences that put our legislative, electoral, and district data in the hands of the people making policy decisions, both inside Climate Cabinet and among lawmakers, staffers, and coalition partners. This is a high-autonomy, end-to-end role for a strong technical and UX domain expert who can come in, ramp up quickly, and advance our capacity for delivering useful data-driven tools. This role sits on the Tech & Data Team, working closely with Product Management, Data Engineering, and policy and political staff.

You work with product management to understand what internal and external users need, make design and technical decisions, and use AI development tools to build, launch, and maintain the result. You will bring strong UX judgment and hands-on engineering skill to deliver polished, trustworthy user experiences quickly, with a generalist mindset.

Scope of Work

User-Facing Data Products and Interfaces: You will design, build, and ship interfaces and small applications on top of our database and data systems, for both internal staff and external audiences such as lawmakers, legislative staff, and coalition partners.

• Work with product management on needfinding and design, developing a deep understanding of the user preferences and workflows the end-product must match

• Make design decisions on information hierarchy, interaction, and visual presentation, with mobile compatibility built in from the start.

• Build and launch data-centric tools that support pro-climate policy action, using AI development tools to move quickly.

• Support Data Engineering by defining what the front end needs from the data layer (APIs, views, data contracts), and setting up systems that ensure data and interfaces work together smoothly.

• Design and implement access controls for tools that serve both internal and external audiences, enforced at the data/API layers as well as the UI.

UX Capacity and Standards: You will raise the team's overall ability to deliver strong user experiences for policy audiences by standing up new best practices and being a voice on the team for user-centered design.

• Work with product management to incorporate user research into interface designs, define how we measure adoption, and build measurability into the products.

• Establish shared design and front-end conventions, such as data viz guidelines, reusable components, and templates, so new tools look and feel consistent.

• Support decision-making and capacity-building in key areas the team will be tackling next year, including shifting to mobile-first design and establishing distinct user personas.

Operations, Maintenance, and Roadmap Contribution: You will keep our product suite well-documented and current across legislative cycles, and help shape what we build next.

• Deploy, monitor, and maintain interfaces with clear documentation and consistent release practices, so tools are stable and can be handed off cleanly to the team.

• Help establish good practices for AI-assisted development on the team, including code review, testing, and security, and support team training on them.

• Flag dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs early, and translate them into clear recommendations for planning conversations.

Sample Projects

• Build a public version of our District Data Explorer, which shows how climate issues like public transportation and clean energy impact every legislative district.

• Overhaul Climate Cabinet’s internal mobile app, which makes data about sitting legislators available to policy staff on-the-go.

• Add customization to Climate Cabinet’s Bill Explorer system, allowing partner organizations to track bills that are relevant to their specific priorities.

What success looks like for these projects:

• Climate Cabinet staff and external partners get access to new interfaces that fit their needs and workflows, turning our existing data into effective pro-climate policy decision-making. These new interfaces launch on time, with clear documentation, are polished enough to put in front of external audiences, and work well on mobile.

• Feedback from policy and political staff reliably turns into improvements, and the team has shared design standards that make each new tool faster to build, and the team can sustain and extend what is built after the engagement.

• Data products are adopted: policy staff use them weekly, external audiences (lawmakers, staffers, partners) reference them, and usage grows over time.

Applicant Requirements

You may be a good fit for this role if you have the following experience:

• End-to-end ownership: You have built, launched, and maintained products for real users, including external-facing ones with role-based access controls. You’re comfortable across the tech stack (front end, lightweight back end/APIs, deployment), without needing to be an expert in every layer.

• Front-end and UX emphasis: You have strong, hands-on experience building polished, data-centric web interfaces (dashboards, explorers, small applications) that work well on both desktop and mobile, with a portfolio or shipped work to show for it. You draw from strong judgment on layout, information design, and usability, and are comfortable making and explaining design decisions.

• Engineering security: You’ve implemented authentication and role-based access control in production apps, and you can explain how you’d prevent data leaking across roles (row-level security, server-side authorization, auditing). You review AI-generated code for security issues instead of trusting it.

• AI-assisted development: You are comfortable using AI development tools such as Claude Code to build and ship quickly while keeping quality, security, and maintainability high.

• Judgment and autonomy: You can come in as a strong technical and domain expert, ramp up quickly, and drive work forward with high autonomy. You know when to move independently and when to pause to check in with others, you flag blockers early and document work clearly. You are comfortable on a small team with a generalist mix of design and engineering work.

• Growth mindset: You have a track record of picking up new tools quickly and choosing progress over perfection.

Other beneficial experience:

• Familiarity with the legislative, political, and/or climate domains, and experience working with relevant data (bills, legislators, district demographics).

• Familiarity with relevant tools including Retool, Airtable, and Google Cloud Platform.

• Experience with data visualization, mapping, or public-facing data products, and with accessibility and performance for external audiences.

• Experience with user research methods such as interviews, usability testing, and analytics.

Application Process
We are accepting applications via Greenhouse on a rolling basis with a priority deadline of December 7, 2026. Include answers to our questions, a resume and a proposal (no more than 1-2 pages) that includes the following:

• Introduction and relevant experience What about Climate Cabinet and this engagement is appealing to you? A description of your experience and skills that satisfy the requirements of this role. Links to past work if available (e.g. personal Github). This is encouraged but not required.

• Availability: earliest start date and estimated hours per week

• Proposed rate and fee structure

jobs.title: Events Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE 



Factory is hiring an Events Lead to build and lead the events function.

You will not inherit a fully built team or playbook - you will define Factory's events strategy, build and lead the team, and own the full portfolio of programs: flagship experiences such as user conferences, Sales Kickoff, President's Club, and Tier-1 conferences like AWS re:Invent, alongside field marketing.

You will own the events strategy, global budget, operating rhythm, standards, and measurement, partnering closely with Marketing, Sales Enablement and Executive Leadership to ensure every program strengthens Factory's brand and drives measurable business outcomes.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will set the vision, build the organization, and define how Factory shows up through events - while staying close enough to execution to guarantee the most important programs are delivered at an exceptional standard. Over time, you will hire and scale the team needed to support Factory's growth.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Own Factory's overall flagship events strategy and portfolio, defining how Factory shows up through events so every program strengthens the brand and drives measurable business outcomes.

 - Build, hire, lead, and develop the events team.

 - Own and allocate the global events budget across the portfolio, including forecasting, prioritization, reconciliation, and ROI.

 - Set the annual events calendar and planning process across flagship programs and conferences.

 - Define and own the events operating model - standards, playbooks, production quality bar, and measurement frameworks - across the entire events organization.

 - Own portfolio-level agency and vendor relationships, including MSAs.

 - Provide executive oversight of flagship programs such as user conferences, SKO, President's Club, and Tier-1 conferences (eg: AWS re:Invent), ensuring executive-level quality and impact.

 - Partner cross-functionally across Marketing, Brand, Sales Enablement, People, Finance, Legal, and Executive Leadership.

 - Champion the Factory voice across the entire events portfolio.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building and leading an events function at a high-growth company, including hiring, managing, and developing high-performing teams.

 - Proven track record owning a portfolio of flagship programs (eg, SKO, President's Club, user conferences, Tier-1 industry conferences), managing multiple concurrent programs and stakeholders.

 - Experience owning large, multimillion-dollar events budgets, including allocation across programs, forecasting, and ROI measurement.

 - Strong track record aligning events to pipeline, revenue, and company priorities in close partnership with Sales and Marketing leadership.

 - Experience negotiating and managing agencies, production companies, venues, and strategic vendors at scale.

 - Excellent leadership, cross-functional influence, and executive communication skills.

 - Comfort with event and marketing tools such as Salesforce, event management platforms, and registration tools.

 - Willingness to travel for onsite production and execution of flagship events.



Location: San Francisco, CA or New York, NY (in office), or Remote

This role requires significant travel for onsite production and execution of flagship events.

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we're looking for you to join us on this mission!




💡 YOUR MISSION: BE THE CLINICAL VOICE OF VOIZE IN US SENIOR CARE

As our Clinical Expert, you are the senior clinical authority behind voize's in the US. You are an RN (licensed) and have run a nursing department, have a good understanding of how an EHR works (including having rolled one out at a facility), and you know how things work in Senior Care nursing in the US. You will advise Product on workflows and documentation requirements, join Sales in conversations with Directors of Nursing and facility leaders as a true peer, and guide customers on documentation and adoption. Your credibility opens doors and your judgment shapes what we build.




🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

 - Turn expertise into assets: use your experience to run rollout sessions with facility leadership

 - Advise Product on US nursing workflows, PCC documentation requirements and EHR constraints, and explain the "why" behind them so the roadmap fits real practice

 - Represent voize in the US senior care community through events, webinars and customer advisory input
   
   


🤝 YOUR SKILLSET - WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

Should-have experience (one of the two):

 - Clinical Experience and Licensure Registered Nurse (RN) or a comparable licensed healthcare professional with experience in a leadership role at a senior care facility.

 - EHR Experience Hands-on experience with electronic health records in an administrative capacity as a Clinical Informatics Specialist, Director of Nursing, or similar clinical leadership role. Advanced understanding of PointClickCare preferred.
   
   

What else you bring:

 - Deep knowledge of US nursing practice in senior care and skilled nursing, including documentation requirements, regulatory and reimbursement drivers, and staffing realities

 - Ability to bridge clinical practice and technology: You translate complex clinical workflows and documentation requirements into clear, actionable insights for Product and Engineering teams

 - Clinical credibility and professional presence: You can confidently engage with nursing leadership, facility administrators, and other stakeholders, using your clinical expertise to build trust, communicate effectively and influence decisions.

 - High autonomy and strong communication: you work well across Product, Sales, Customer Success and Training, and you are comfortable using AI tools in your daily work
   
   


🎯 OUR SUCCESS MINDSET - HOW WE WORK AT VOIZE

 - You are resilient - challenges are opportunities, not obstacles.

 - You work iteratively - test, learn, improve instead of waiting for perfection.

 - You lead with credibility and empathy, because for many facilities you are the first clinical peer they meet at voize.

 - You value open feedback and contribute to a positive, transparent team culture.


🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

 - We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

 - Be the founding clinical voice for our US market, with a path toward leading a broader US clinical function

 - Remote-first: work from anywhere in the US, with occasional travel to customer sites and events

 - We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events from our New York Hub.

We look forward to your application and can't wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!


Questions? Reach out to Brian Gallagher (Training & Onboarding) at brian.gallagher@voize.de.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 - Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 - Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 - Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 - Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 - Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 - Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 - Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 - Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 - Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 - Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Engineering or highly technical product background.

 - Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
   
    


OUTCOME

 - Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 - Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 - Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 - AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 - Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 - Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
   
    


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Intake Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner - PMHNP
jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As an Intake Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner at Blackbird Health, you'll play an essential role in delivering comprehensive psychiatric intake evaluations for children, adolescents, and young adults. You'll build meaningful connections with patients and families from the very start of their care journey, spending the necessary time to understand their needs and educate them about care options. Working alongside an interdisciplinary team, you'll be empowered to make a tangible difference in the lives of young patients and their families from day one.

Employment Options

W2 Part-Time (20 hrs/week) | Intake PMHNP

• Compensation:

• Base Salary: $72,500 base salary for part-time schedule.

• Incentive Pay: Earn $100 per completed clinical hour for additional sessions beyond your base caseload.

• Hours & Onsite Expectations:

• Commitment: 20 contracted hours per week (17 clinical direct-care hours).

• Core Schedule: Minimum 15 hours anchored in peak core windows (after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).

• Benefits: Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, generous PTO + 11 paid holidays, paid weekly clinical consultation, and covered liability insurance.

1099 Contractor | Intake PMHNP

• Compensation:

• Hourly Pay: $120.00 flat rate per completed clinical hour.

• Hours & Flexibility:

• Minimum Commitment: 15 open patient-care hours/week to support a target baseline of 12 completed clinical hours/week.

• Core Requirement: Hours anchored during peak core windows (after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).

• Perks: Full credentialing support, paid weekly clinical consultation, liability insurance covered, and reimbursement for client no-shows.

Why Blackbird & Your Impact

• Focus on Patient Care: Full administrative support—we handle credentialing, billing, insurance, and EHR administration so you can focus entirely on your clinical work.

• Guaranteed Patient Referrals: Start seeing patients right away with a predictable caseload.

• Grow as a Clinician: Paid weekly clinical consultation and peer support are built into your schedule for ongoing skill development.

• Integrated Care Model: Work closely alongside psychotherapists, speech therapists, OTs, and neuropsychology specialists to treat the whole child.

• Mission-Driven Culture: Join a collaborative, intelligent, and compassionate network of professionals shaping the future of pediatric behavioral health.

Who You Are

• Licensure: Active, unrestricted PMHNP/CRNP/APN license in Pennsylvania (PA), Virginia (VA), New Jersey (NJ), or Maryland (MD), along with active DEA registration and State Prescriptive Authority.

• Certification: Board Certified by ANCC or AANP (PMHNP-BC).

• Education: Master’s Degree from an accredited nursing program.

• Experience: 1+ years of independent psychiatric experience working under licensure (with direct experience serving children, adolescents, or young adults).

• Availability: Available during Blackbird's peak core hours (after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).

• Technical Skills: Tech-savvy and equipped with a computer, phone, high-speed internet, and proficiency in EHR systems and Google Suite.

• Whole-Child Integration: Collaborate with therapists to develop individualized treatment plans that address the root cause of behavior and ensure patients are matched to the right ongoing provider.

• Family Empowerment: Educate parents and caregivers during the intake process, helping them understand their child's diagnosis and navigate next steps in their mental health journey.

• Clinical Excellence: Oversee diagnostic testing and maintain thorough, HIPAA-compliant intake documentation.

Benefits

• Medical, Dental & Vision coverage

• 401K with company match

• Employer-paid life insurance coverage

• Generous paid time off

• Opportunities for career growth

• Diverse and experienced leadership team with a supportive work culture

Salary Range

$72,500—$160,000 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

jobs.title: 経営企画（FP&A）／事業分析・経営意思決定支援
jobs.description:
PayPayカードについて/About PayPay card

PayPayカード株式会社は、サービス開始からユーザー数7,500万人（2026年8月時点）を突破した「PayPay」の決済プラットフォームと融合させた形でこれまでのクレジットカード、クレジットサービスでは成し得なかったよりユーザーに身近で便利なフィンテックサービスを提供する為に2021年に誕生しました。

AIを駆使した開発と、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼組織・チーム紹介

経営企画本部は、事業の成長を支える「企業参謀」を目指す組織です。
経営課題や成長機会を自ら見いだし、新たな取り組みを構想・実行することを大切にしています。

クレジットカード・決済サービスに関する主要KPIや、売上・収益・コストの状況を分析し、事業計画・予算の策定、業績見通し・予実管理、新サービスや各種施策の収益性評価などに取り組んでいます。
経営層や各部門と連携し、数字の変化の背景にある事業課題を捉え、課題の特定から改善策の提案・実行まで主体的に進めることで、経営の意思決定を支えています。

▼募集背景

当社は「圧倒的No.1サービス」の実現に向け、グループ各社との連携や新たな施策を推進しています。
成長に向けた選択肢が広がるなか、主要KPIと収益・コストのつながりを捉え、施策の優先順位や将来の業績を議論するFP&A機能を強化しています。
そこで、これまでの数値分析や事業改善の経験を生かし、経営層・各部門とともに課題解決を進める仲間を募集します。

▼本ポジションへの期待

予実管理や業績見通し、主要KPI・収益性の分析を通じて、事業の状況や経営課題を明らかにし、改善策や成長施策を提案していただきます。
数値を集計・報告するだけでなく、数字の変化の背景や要因を捉え、経営層や各部門と議論しながら、施策の優先順位付けや課題解決を推進することを期待しています。
入社後は、これまでのご経験や強みを生かせる領域から担当いただき、当社の事業や部門全体への理解を深めながら、将来的には部門横断の取り組みやチームを牽引する役割も担っていただきます。

【具体的な業務内容】

数値分析を通じて経営課題を捉え、経営層や各部門責任者とともに、事業成長に向けた改善策の検討・推進に取り組んでいただきます。
入社後は、これまでのご経験や強みを生かせる領域から担当いただき、当社の事業や部門全体への理解を深めながら、課題の特定や改善提案にも取り組んでいただきます。

【具体的な業務内容例】

• 事業計画・予算の策定、月次の予実管理

• 業績見通しの作成、予実差異の分析

• 主要KPIと売上・収益・コストの関連分析

• 各種施策・プロジェクトの収益性・採算性分析

• 経営課題の特定、改善策の提案・推進

• 中長期戦略の企画・立案

• 経営層向けレポーティング、意思決定資料の作成

適性やご希望に応じて、部門横断の取り組みや、メンバー育成・マネジメント業務をお任せすることも想定しています。

▼本ポジションの魅力

【事業の数字を、経営の判断につなげる】
決済・金融サービスの事業構造を理解し、主要KPIと収益・コストを結び付けて分析します。自ら見いだした課題や改善策を、経営層・各部門と直接議論できるポジションです。

【提案から実行後の成果まで関われる】
施策の収益性評価や効果検証に加え、改善策の提案・推進まで携わります。自分の分析や提言が事業の成長や収益性向上にどのようにつながったかを実感できます。

【FP&Aの専門性とリーダーとしての経験を広げる】
業績管理に加え、管理会計やデータ活用の仕組みづくりにも取り組めます。経験や志向に応じて、部門横断プロジェクトの推進やメンバー育成にも関わり、専門性とチームを牽引する力を磨けます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下の経験をお持ちの方

• 売上・利益・コスト・事業KPIなどの数値を分析し、変動の背景や要因を整理・説明した経験

• 分析結果をもとに事業課題を特定し、改善策の提案や施策の企画・推進に携わった経験

• 関係部門や経営層などの関係者と議論・調整し、合意形成を図りながら課題解決を進めた経験

※経営企画・事業企画・管理会計に加え、マーケティングやコンサルティング領域において、数値分析から改善提案・施策推進まで経験している方もご活躍いただけます。

あると望ましい経験/スキル

以下のいずれかの経験・スキルを歓迎します。すべてを満たす必要はありません。

勤務時間

jobs.title: Sales, Engineering - TOLA
jobs.description:
Meter is building the modern networking infrastructure that businesses like Lyft and Reddit rely on to stay connected. As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you will partner with our Enterprise Sales team to bring better networks to more customers by using your technical expertise to win over the hearts and minds of IT and network engineers alike.

You will be an integral part of an early team of Enterprise SEs that will design and build the technical engine needed to chase down the legacy vendors in a giant industry that hasn’t seen a successful new entrant in decades.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first few weeks, you’ll start to build relationships with the teams you’d work with on a regular basis: the Sales team, both sales reps and leaders that you’d support; your peers on the Sales Engineering team; the teams designing and manufacturing our hardware and software products; and the teams deploying and maintaining these networks for our customers. Building these relationships will allow you to establish a role as a trusted advisor internally.

You’ll also begin to hone your networking skills across routing, switching, wireless, and security, with the ultimate goal of becoming a Subject Matter Expert across the entire Meter portfolio. This will help you establish credibility and confidence when working with customers and partners.

As you build up your Meter product expertise, you will also quickly join sales calls, and contribute to an immediate increase ($1M+) in our committed quarterly Enterprise revenue by leading technical discovery calls, and designing technical solutions for prospects that help our Sales team win deals.

Once you’ve gained more exposure, you’ll help the Sales Engineering team build more process and structure. You will design and build new assets that cover common Enterprise use cases (e.g., EVPN-VXLAN reference architectures or 802.1X integration guides) and standardize documentation and training for core networking areas, which will ultimately allow the sales team to accelerate deal cycles by at least a week and increase win rate.

As we build the standards needed for a successful Sales Engineering team and drive significant revenue for the Sales team through your partnership, you will have a clear path into becoming a Principal Sales Engineer, specializing in a new vertical, or moving into a leadership track. You can specialize in leading our most strategic accounts or have the opportunity to hire, mentor and define the onboarding for the next cohort of Sales Engineers at Meter.




WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

Your days will be a mix of selling, building assets and standards and product translation, supporting both the Sales and Product teams.

About 60% of your day will be spent on deal execution. This will include:

 - Leading technical discovery calls to understand what customers find painful or frustrating about their current legacy solutions.

 - Delivering world-class demonstrations that inspire, getting buy-in across multiple stakeholders, from office managers to CIOs.

 - Building solutions, removing obstacles, and closing deals through work with customers and partners.

 - Partnering directly with the Account Executives on your team to create urgency and drive deals forward.

25% of your day will be spent building assets and standards. This involves creating new internal training, designing assets for Sales, and standardizing our approach to more complex technical use cases.

The other 15% of your day will be spent on product translation. You’ll collect customer feedback from complex deployments and translate their requirements directly to the Product team, which will influence our hardware and software product roadmap.




WHO YOU ARE

You are an elite Sales Engineer who knows that enterprise networking can be complex, rigid, and is prime for disruption. You’re tired of selling marginal upgrades on legacy infrastructure. You don’t want to do things the way they've been done before. You want to help be on the forefront of innovation and offer the change your customers and partners have been asking for. You’re excited about working with a vertically integrated solution that can deliver effortless and resilient connectivity that can be delivered as simply as any other utility.

Building and growing the business with highly motivated technical Sales Engineers at a fast pace is a refreshing change you’ve been looking for. You’ve seen success as a high performing SE at high growth companies, but you want the opportunity for your voice to be heard and influence the trajectory of a company. You are obsessed with networking and hate losing more than you love winning. You come up with creative solutions and will remove any roadblocks to not only meet the customers where they are, but bring them forward into the future of wired, wireless, and cellular networking.

You have expert knowledge in TCP/IP, 802.11ax/be, TLS, DHCP, DNS, NAT, 802.1X, VPNs, SD-WAN, IDS/IPS, Multicast, OSPF, BGP & EVPN-VXLAN. You take your professional development seriously, and ideally have completed several standard industry certifications, such as CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, CWNA, CWDP, CWSP, CWDE, JNCIA, JNCIS, JNCIE, Network+, Security+, etc




WHY METER?

The internet runs the world. Every purchase you make, video call you join, it's all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.

We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale.  Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.

Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.




COMPENSATION

 - The estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $190,000.

 - Additionally, this role is eligible to earn commissions and to participate in Meter’s equity plan.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Infrastructure (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description:
THE MISSION

More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2.6 billion and 12.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people.

AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data.

What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk.

Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences.

We run these experiments in an AI-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature.

It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised ~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way.

The opportunity is generational. We're building the first scaled engine for real human biological data, and using it to know which drugs will work in people before they ever reach a trial.


YOUR SKILLS

Must be an expert in infrastructure for an AI-first stack; you must be especially be an expert in data stores and data infrastructure designed for agentic queries.




Parallel Bio is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.

직무 소개

OPEX팀은 고객 감동 실현을 목표로 Middle mile과 Last mile 전반의 물류 프로세스를 설계하고 개선하는 조직입니다. 본 포지션은 쿠팡 물류 프로세스를 데이터 기반으로 분석하여 운영 효율과 서비스 수준을 동시에 향상시키는 역할을 담당합니다. 현장 실행 가능성을 중심으로 개선안을 도출하고, 실제 운영에 정착될 수 있도록 유관 부서와 긴밀히 협업합니다. 다양한 프로젝트와 테스트를 통해 쿠팡의 물류 경쟁력 강화를 직접적으로 이끌어갈 수 있는 기회를 제공합니다.

자격 요건

우대 사항

개인정보 처리방침

jobs.title: Sales, Engineering - Midwest
jobs.description:
Meter is building the modern networking infrastructure that businesses like Lyft and Reddit rely on to stay connected. As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you will partner with our Enterprise Sales team to bring better networks to more customers by using your technical expertise to win over the hearts and minds of IT and network engineers alike.

You will be an integral part of an early team of Enterprise SEs that will design and build the technical engine needed to chase down the legacy vendors in a giant industry that hasn’t seen a successful new entrant in decades.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first few weeks, you’ll start to build relationships with the teams you’d work with on a regular basis: the Sales team, both sales reps and leaders that you’d support; your peers on the Sales Engineering team; the teams designing and manufacturing our hardware and software products; and the teams deploying and maintaining these networks for our customers. Building these relationships will allow you to establish a role as a trusted advisor internally.

You’ll also begin to hone your networking skills across routing, switching, wireless, and security, with the ultimate goal of becoming a Subject Matter Expert across the entire Meter portfolio. This will help you establish credibility and confidence when working with customers and partners.

As you build up your Meter product expertise, you will also quickly join sales calls, and contribute to an immediate increase ($1M+) in our committed quarterly Enterprise revenue by leading technical discovery calls, and designing technical solutions for prospects that help our Sales team win deals.

Once you’ve gained more exposure, you’ll help the Sales Engineering team build more process and structure. You will design and build new assets that cover common Enterprise use cases (e.g., EVPN-VXLAN reference architectures or 802.1X integration guides) and standardize documentation and training for core networking areas, which will ultimately allow the sales team to accelerate deal cycles by at least a week and increase win rate.

As we build the standards needed for a successful Sales Engineering team and drive significant revenue for the Sales team through your partnership, you will have a clear path into becoming a Principal Sales Engineer, specializing in a new vertical, or moving into a leadership track. You can specialize in leading our most strategic accounts or have the opportunity to hire, mentor and define the onboarding for the next cohort of Sales Engineers at Meter.




WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

Your days will be a mix of selling, building assets and standards and product translation, supporting both the Sales and Product teams.

About 60% of your day will be spent on deal execution. This will include:

 - Leading technical discovery calls to understand what customers find painful or frustrating about their current legacy solutions.

 - Delivering world-class demonstrations that inspire, getting buy-in across multiple stakeholders, from office managers to CIOs.

 - Building solutions, removing obstacles, and closing deals through work with customers and partners.

 - Partnering directly with the Account Executives on your team to create urgency and drive deals forward.

25% of your day will be spent building assets and standards. This involves creating new internal training, designing assets for Sales, and standardizing our approach to more complex technical use cases.

The other 15% of your day will be spent on product translation. You’ll collect customer feedback from complex deployments and translate their requirements directly to the Product team, which will influence our hardware and software product roadmap.




WHO YOU ARE

You are an elite Sales Engineer who knows that enterprise networking can be complex, rigid, and is prime for disruption. You’re tired of selling marginal upgrades on legacy infrastructure. You don’t want to do things the way they've been done before. You want to help be on the forefront of innovation and offer the change your customers and partners have been asking for. You’re excited about working with a vertically integrated solution that can deliver effortless and resilient connectivity that can be delivered as simply as any other utility.

Building and growing the business with highly motivated technical Sales Engineers at a fast pace is a refreshing change you’ve been looking for. You’ve seen success as a high performing SE at high growth companies, but you want the opportunity for your voice to be heard and influence the trajectory of a company. You are obsessed with networking and hate losing more than you love winning. You come up with creative solutions and will remove any roadblocks to not only meet the customers where they are, but bring them forward into the future of wired, wireless, and cellular networking.

You have expert knowledge in TCP/IP, 802.11ax/be, TLS, DHCP, DNS, NAT, 802.1X, VPNs, SD-WAN, IDS/IPS, Multicast, OSPF, BGP & EVPN-VXLAN. You take your professional development seriously, and ideally have completed several standard industry certifications, such as CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, CWNA, CWDP, CWSP, CWDE, JNCIA, JNCIS, JNCIE, Network+, Security+, etc




WHY METER?

The internet runs the world. Every purchase you make, video call you join, it's all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.

We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale.  Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.

Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.




COMPENSATION

 - The estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $190,000.

 - Additionally, this role is eligible to earn commissions and to participate in Meter’s equity plan.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Growth Engineer (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description:
THE MISSION

More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2.6 billion and 12.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people.

AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data.

What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk.

Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences.

We run these experiments in an AI-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature.

It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised ~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way.

The opportunity is generational. We're building the first scaled engine for real human biological data, and using it to know which drugs will work in people before they ever reach a trial.


YOUR SKILLS

Must have experience in high-scale B2C Growth (Acquisition, Activation, and Retention) and be able to design AI-powered growth loops

Parallel Bio is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Sales, Channel - Regional Partners (Pacific Northwest)
jobs.description:
For decades, Value-Added Resellers (VARs) and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) have been stuck on the same treadmill. They resell boxes from the big legacy networking vendors, fight over shrinking hardware margins, and start from zero every refresh cycle.

Legacy network providers built their channels around large upfront capital expenditure, or CapEx, deals. That model rewards one-time transactions and leaves partners with little that is recurring, little that is differentiated and little that is truly theirs.

Meter breaks that model. We deliver a vertically integrated, end-to-end networking stack, including hardware, software, deployment and support, as a single monthly subscription focused on customer outcomes. For VARs and MSPs, that means turning one-time hardware deals into durable, recurring revenue and owning a modern network offering that their customers actually want.

Meter is one of the only full-stack networking platforms that VAR and MSP partners can bring to their customers as a service. The channel will be a primary engine of our growth, and you will be the one building it in your region.

Meter is a 100% channel organization, and our commitment to the channel is unwavering. Our number one priority is the success of our channel partners. If you want to make a real difference in a channel program, this is the place for you.

 


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Your mission is simple: drive closed won revenue sourced through VAR and MSP partners.

You will make an impact fast. In your first few weeks, you will tap your network across the VAR and MSP partner community to put Meter in front of the partners that matter and win them over to a better way to sell networking.

Whatever you have sold before, you will get sharp on core networking quickly and become dangerous in front of partners, able to show any VAR or MSP why Meter beats the legacy stack for their business and for their customers.

You will partner with the Enterprise and Major reps serving the Pacific Northwest region. You will embed yourself in that team, earn their trust and be the person they count on to bring partner-sourced pipeline. At the same time, you will recruit, enable and activate VAR and MSP partners to generate new opportunities.

We are early in building Meter's VAR and MSP channel, and the upside is massive. The right person will help define how this channel is built. Over time, you will have the opportunity to own strategic partner relationships or lead a regional partner sales team.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

You will be the bridge between Meter's sales team and our partners' sales reps and leadership. You will keep deals moving, track progress and blockers with the Meter team, support partners on the deals they register and clear operational roadblocks across quoting, contracting and deployment.

We have early wins with VAR and MSP partners, but brand awareness and trust are still the name of the game. That means showing up in person. Expect to spend real time on the road at in-region partner events, trainings, summits and partner offices, building relationships and turning them into pipeline.

You will grow the channel by recruiting and onboarding new partners while going deeper with top performers. You will work hand in hand with our Partner Marketing and Partner Enablement teams on incentives, MDF programs, summits and webinars.

 


WHO YOU ARE

You know the VAR and MSP world inside and out, likely from years selling networking, security, infrastructure or managed IT services through or alongside VAR and MSP partners. You know the key players, you know the distributors behind them and you know exactly who to call to get things moving.

You have a proven track record of driving partner-sourced revenue through VARs and MSPs, consistently beating your number, often during periods of hypergrowth.

You are comfortable with technical products and can ramp fast on networking fundamentals (routing, switching, WiFi, security) to speak with credibility to partner engineers, sales teams and end customers.

You move fast and you close. Relationships matter, but you measure yourself by deals registered and deals won.

You are comfortable with 50%+ travel and genuinely love the face-to-face side of partner management.

You thrive in ambiguity and constant change, and ideally you have helped build a channel at a high-growth tech company or startup.

 


WHY METER

The internet runs the world. Every email you send, purchase you make, video call you join — it's all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven't changed for decades. They're brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.

We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, and Reddit rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.

Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable businesses to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.

 


COMPENSATION

 - The estimated salary range for this role is $132,000 - $162,000.

 - Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Meter's equity plan.

By applying to this job, you acknowledge that you've read and understood Meter's Job Applicant Privacy Notice https://www.meter.com/careers/job-applicant-privacy.

jobs.title: Principal Product Success Architect
jobs.description:
The GAIL (Get AI Live) program deploys engineers directly into strategic customer engagements to drive real AI adoption and measurable value realization. The GAIL Core Team is the permanent engine behind that program: the stable foundation of institutional knowledge, tooling, and senior expertise that makes every engagement, and every rotating engineer, better than the last.

As a Principal Product Success Architect on the GAIL Core Team, you set the strategic direction for how the program scales, own the hardest engagements and escalations, and build the infrastructure and knowledge systems that raise capability across the entire practice. This role bridges technical delivery and program strategy. You lead by example on the most complex deployments while shaping how the program evolves to handle harder problems and reach more customers.

What you get to do in this role:

• Own the most complex, escalated GAIL and Go-Live Support engagements — large-scale enterprise deployments, acquisition integrations, and high-stakes go-lives where program reputation is on the line.
• Set the strategic direction for GAIL tooling and infrastructure — defining the next-generation capabilities the program needs and owning the roadmap to build them.
• Own and evolve the GAIL playbook and quality standards across the entire practice — defining what great looks like and holding the line on it program-wide.
• Drive systemic improvements across customer engagements — identifying patterns in failure modes, complexity, and escalations, and translating them into playbook changes and tooling investments.
• Mentor and develop the Core Team engineers and high-potential rotators — actively raising the capability of the people around you and shaping the next generation of leaders.
• Partner deeply with product, engineering leadership, and customer success to translate field signal into product and program improvements.
• Represent the program in customer-facing strategic conversations and executive engagements.

To be successful in this role, you have:

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, with substantial depth in both enterprise product work and hands-on customer or field delivery.
• Expert-level coding ability in JavaScript and one or more additional languages (Java, Python, or equivalent), with a proven track record of shipping and scaling production systems.
• Deep experience deploying and integrating AI features and GenAI models, including Now Assist, AI Agents, or equivalent platforms, across multiple customer environments and deployment patterns.
• Strong judgment on prompt engineering and non-deterministic model behavior, including the ability to advise on reliability, production readiness, and edge cases.
• A strategic mindset about standards, tooling, and scalability — you balance pragmatism with the long-term health of the program.
• Proven ability to build, own, and scale shared infrastructure and platforms that multiple teams depend on.
• Strong mentoring and coaching capability — you actively develop the engineers around you and leave them better than you found them.
• Excellent communication and presence across technical and non-technical audiences, including customer executives and internal leadership.
• Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change at a program or organizational level without formal authority.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $190,900 - $334,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Work Personas

jobs.title: Sales, Channel - Regional Partners (North Central)
jobs.description:
For decades, Value-Added Resellers (VARs) and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) have been stuck on the same treadmill. They resell boxes from the big legacy networking vendors, fight over shrinking hardware margins, and start from zero every refresh cycle.

Legacy network providers built their channels around large upfront capital expenditure, or CapEx, deals. That model rewards one-time transactions and leaves partners with little that is recurring, little that is differentiated and little that is truly theirs.

Meter breaks that model. We deliver a vertically integrated, end-to-end networking stack, including hardware, software, deployment and support, as a single monthly subscription focused on customer outcomes. For VARs and MSPs, that means turning one-time hardware deals into durable, recurring revenue and owning a modern network offering that their customers actually want.

Meter is one of the only full-stack networking platforms that VAR and MSP partners can bring to their customers as a service. The channel will be a primary engine of our growth, and you will be the one building it in your region.

Meter is a 100% channel organization, and our commitment to the channel is unwavering. Our number one priority is the success of our channel partners. If you want to make a real difference in a channel program, this is the place for you.

 


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Your mission is simple: drive closed won revenue sourced through VAR and MSP partners.

You will make an impact fast. In your first few weeks, you will tap your network across the VAR and MSP partner community to put Meter in front of the partners that matter and win them over to a better way to sell networking.

Whatever you have sold before, you will get sharp on core networking quickly and become dangerous in front of partners, able to show any VAR or MSP why Meter beats the legacy stack for their business and for their customers.

You will partner with the Enterprise and Major reps serving the North Central region. You will embed yourself in that team, earn their trust and be the person they count on to bring partner-sourced pipeline. At the same time, you will recruit, enable and activate VAR and MSP partners to generate new opportunities.

We are early in building Meter's VAR and MSP channel, and the upside is massive. The right person will help define how this channel is built. Over time, you will have the opportunity to own strategic partner relationships or lead a regional partner sales team.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

You will be the bridge between Meter's sales team and our partners' sales reps and leadership. You will keep deals moving, track progress and blockers with the Meter team, support partners on the deals they register and clear operational roadblocks across quoting, contracting and deployment.

We have early wins with VAR and MSP partners, but brand awareness and trust are still the name of the game. That means showing up in person. Expect to spend real time on the road at in-region partner events, trainings, summits and partner offices, building relationships and turning them into pipeline.

You will grow the channel by recruiting and onboarding new partners while going deeper with top performers. You will work hand in hand with our Partner Marketing and Partner Enablement teams on incentives, MDF programs, summits and webinars.

 


WHO YOU ARE

You know the VAR and MSP world inside and out, likely from years selling networking, security, infrastructure or managed IT services through or alongside VAR and MSP partners. You know the key players, you know the distributors behind them and you know exactly who to call to get things moving.

You have a proven track record of driving partner-sourced revenue through VARs and MSPs, consistently beating your number, often during periods of hypergrowth.

You are comfortable with technical products and can ramp fast on networking fundamentals (routing, switching, WiFi, security) to speak with credibility to partner engineers, sales teams and end customers.

You move fast and you close. Relationships matter, but you measure yourself by deals registered and deals won.

You are comfortable with 50%+ travel and genuinely love the face-to-face side of partner management.

You thrive in ambiguity and constant change, and ideally you have helped build a channel at a high-growth tech company or startup.

 


WHY METER

The internet runs the world. Every email you send, purchase you make, video call you join — it's all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven't changed for decades. They're brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.

We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, and Reddit rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.

Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable businesses to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.

 


COMPENSATION

 - The estimated salary range for this role is $132,000 - $162,000.

 - Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Meter's equity plan.

By applying to this job, you acknowledge that you've read and understood Meter's Job Applicant Privacy Notice https://www.meter.com/careers/job-applicant-privacy.

In addition to base salary, Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefits package and a variety of programs designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and success.

Real Chemistry reserves the right to update compensation and benefits programs at any time.

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.
