Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive (NY/LA)
jobs.description:
At Tapcart, we believe every brand needs a direct relationship with their customers - one they actually own.

We are the mobile commerce engine that powers shopping for Shopify's fastest-growing brands. $15B+ in revenue processed. 200M+ shoppers worldwide. Brands like Princess Polly, Béis, Forever 21, and Young LA rely on us to power a large portion of their revenue.

We're a lean team with minimal management and big autonomy. Everyone here builds and code is core to what we do - engineers, product, leadership. We use our own platform, we talk to merchants daily, and we ship constantly. Backed by Shopify, Silver Lake and other top VCs. Profitable and growing

If you want a place where you own real outcomes, not just tickets, you'll fit in.


The Role

You’ll sell Tapcart to the biggest brands on Shopify.

Your pipeline comes from two places: strong inbound demand from brands that come to us, and the brands you go after yourself through LinkedIn, events, your network and whatever creative path gets you to the right person.

What matters most is the demo. You’re an expert pilot of our product, and you’ll use what you learn in discovery to run a live demo built around each brand’s goals, moving through the platform with ease and showing the results in real time, with no deck needed.

You’ll start with a handful of open deals and build from there.

What you’ll do

 - Run discovery and live demos for inbound leads, tailored to each brand.

 - Build your own pipeline by connecting with founders, CMOs and ecommerce leaders on LinkedIn.

 - Meet brands at events, and turn those conversations into deals.

 - Master our AI and product suite, so every demo shows the brand’s own problems being solved live.

 - Manage your deals in HubSpot and keep your pipeline up to date.

 - Forecast accurately, and contribute in team meetings.

 - Use AI every day to sharpen your research, outreach and process.

What success looks like in your first 90 days

 - You give excellent live demos of the full product.

 - You personalize every demo around what you learned in discovery.

 - You use AI daily to improve your processes, scripts and results.

 - You bring positive, high energy, and you’re great to work with.

 - You focus on outcomes and find a way to hit them.

 - You’ve tapped your own network for brands that could be a fit.

 - Your pipeline is organized and up to date, and nothing slips.

 - You’ve closed your first deal.

You have

 - 5+ years selling SaaS to Shopify Plus brands.

 - A record of closing $70–150K+ annual deals with senior buyers.

 - A track record of building your own pipeline, not just working what you’re handed.

 - Deep Shopify fluency: you know the platform, the ecosystem and how brands run on it.

 - Strong live-demo skills, and the confidence to move in and out of a product, and between platforms, without a script.

 - Comfort working with AI tools like Claude, including connecting them to your other tools (MCP).

 - Executive presence: founders and CMOs trust you quickly, on video and in person.

Nice to have

 - Experience selling to smaller Shopify merchants, too.

 - Experience selling mobile, retention, personalization or AI products.

 - A network in the Shopify ecosystem: brands, agencies or app partners.

Don’t apply if

 - You only want to work inbound, or only want to hunt. This role does both.

 - You rely on slides instead of showing the product live.

 - You don’t use AI tools every day to work faster and smarter.

 - Ecommerce is new territory for you. Our prospects expect you to understand their business.


Location: Los Angeles, New York (preferred), or remote US.

Compensation: $240,000–$280,000 OTE (50/50)



Benefits

Competitive salary and equity. Medical, dental, vision. 401(k). Flexible PTO. Remote-friendly. Home office stipend. Quarterly merchant stipend. Lots of swag drops.

jobs.description:

Atlas is the concierge and credit card built for those who expect more — unlocking coveted access across dining, travel, and lifestyle while making spending seamless.

Our members are discerning, busy individuals who rely on Atlas to deliver insider access, curated service, and unmatched reliability.

You’ll work across the stack to build reliable, performant infrastructure—integrating with third-party APIs, scaling backend services, and shaping the foundation of Atlas’s most critical systems. What We’re Looking For

 - 3+ years working with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure

 - Experience with SQL and relational databases (Postgres preferred)

 - A strong understanding of software reliability, observability, and performance optimization

 - Comfort owning large projects end-to-end and collaborating closely with product and ops

 - A bias for clean, well-tested code and thoughtful abstractions
   

Why Join Atlas

 - Real impact: You’ll help define how AI changes luxury travel, payments, and experiences for the most discerning customers in the world.

 - Early stage, no bureaucracy: We’re lean, well funded, growing fast, and moving faster.

 - Creative, high-caliber teammates: Our team comes from places like Shopify, Apple, Y Combinator startups — but what matters most here is what you build.

 - Solid compensation: Competitive salary and meaningful equity — you’re helping build the foundation of Atlas.

 - Fun problem space: Every day involves designing tech that makes luxury travel, dining, and payments feel seamless.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Forward Deploy AI Engineer (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description:
THE MISSION

More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2.6 billion and 12.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people.

AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data.

What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk.

Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences.

We run these experiments in an AI-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature.

It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised ~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way.

The opportunity is generational. We're building the first scaled engine for real human biological data, and using it to know which drugs will work in people before they ever reach a trial.


YOUR SKILLS

Must be an customer-centric and AI-pilled Forward Deploy Engineer with a unique mix of technical and customer skills




Parallel Bio is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
ABOUT DEPTHFIRST AI

We believe that software is the foundation of modern civilization. Yet vulnerabilities threaten its integrity, security, and resilience. We are on a mission to secure the world’s software.

depthfirst is building intelligence to detect and remediate critical software vulnerabilities. We are training and scaling security AI agents to discover zero-day vulnerabilities across large customer codebases and popular open source software.

Our founding team brings deep expertise in data, infrastructure, security and AI, with leaders from DeepMind, Databricks, Square, and Faire. We're looking for thoughtful, driven people excited to work at the intersection of AI, Security, and Infrastructure.

A core focus of the role will be managing members of the C-suite’s calendars ensuring their time is well organized, meetings run smoothly, and coordination with internal and external partners is timely and professional. Your responsibilities will also span executive support, office operations, company events, and coordination of external meetings and events.  - Comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment

WHAT WE OFFER

jobs.title: Montessori Assistant Teacher: Denton, TX
jobs.description:
As Montessori Assistant Teacher (internally titled Assistant Teacher II) for Bezos Academy, you share our passion for early childhood education and the Montessori method, drawing your energy from working in a child-initiated learning process. Your responsibilities will include assisting lead teachers in developing and implementing a program that promotes the cognitive, language, emotional, social, and physical development of each child. Drawing on your previous experience working with young children, you will support lead teachers in a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori-inspired preschool at no cost to families.

LOCATIONS

We are actively hiring for a Montessori Assistant Teacher for our preschool in Denton (1820 Frame Street Denton, TX 76209).

SCHEDULES, BENEFITS, AND COMPENSATION

• School schedules vary depending on community needs but generally range from 8am-5:30pm, with teachers staggered across these hours with varying start and end times totaling no more than 8 hours per day. Your specific schedule will be determined with your school leader when considering all staff, classroom, and community needs.

• This is a full-time (40 hours per week), benefits-eligible, non-exempt/hourly position.

• Compensation for this position is $23-$32 per hour (~$39,000 - $56,000 annually). The upper third of the compensation range is typically reserved for existing employees who have been in the role for multiple years and demonstrate strong performance over time. Starting compensation will vary with prior experience and qualifications but is expected at $26-$29 per hour.

• This role includes 32 paid days of scheduled breaks, 3 paid days of personal time off, 9 paid days of sick (care) time, 10 paid holidays, and additional time off if required by applicable law. Benefits for this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, a 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution match, paid parental leave, an employer-matched flexible spending account for dependent care, and more. Please see here for details.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Meet one of the following criteria: Four years of professional experience as an aide, assistant, or lead teacher of children from infancy through third grade Two years of professional experience as an aide, assistant, or lead teacher of children from infancy through third grade AND an associate’s degree in a relevant field (i.e., child development, early childhood education etc.) Bachelor’s degree

• Primary Montessori teaching credential from a MACTE-accredited institution or on track to obtain one within two years of hire If you do not hold a Primary Montessori teaching credential from a MACTE-accredited institution, you will be eligible to complete the Bezos Academy Montessori Primary teacher coursework, provided at no cost

• Ability to pass background checks, tuberculosis screenings, and trainings required by the state of Texas required to supervise children independently

• Ability to independently supervise, communicate effectively with, and care for young children safely, including ability to lift a minimum of 40 lbs

• Access to reliable transportation to and from work and ability to consistently attend work as scheduled to ensure proper staff-to-child classroom ratios and support smooth school operations

This role requires a Primary Montessori teaching credential from a MACTE-accredited institution. If you do not currently have this credential, your employment in this role is provisional until you successfully obtain one. You must obtain this credential within two years of your start date to remain in this role. Upon hire, you may elect to obtain a credential through the Bezos Academy Montessori Credential Program (MCP), offered at no cost, or through any other MACTE-accredited program at your own expense.

Participation in MCP is voluntary and unpaid. MCP activities may occur during periods that overlap with scheduled working hours or scheduled breaks, including summer break. To the extent that participation in MCP overlaps with your regular working hours, those working hours will be paid. To the extent participation overlaps with scheduled breaks for which you are eligible, those scheduled breaks will remain paid.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Associates degree or higher in education or related field

• Experience teaching in a Montessori preschool

• Professional experience working with young children with special needs

• Experience working with children and families in low-income areas

RESPONSIBILITIES

*NOTE: The combination of responsibilities may vary based on the needs of the school site, students, and prior experiences of the Montessori Assistant Teacher. Some Montessori ATs will provide support across an entire school rather than be assigned to a single classroom.

Instructional

• Support the lead teacher in preparing and delivering instructional activities that facilitate active Montessori learning experiences

• Assist in presenting individual and small-group Montessori lessons, adapting activities to meet each child’s developmental stage and interests

• Observe each child daily to assess skills, interests, and needs and use this information to facilitate learning and growth

• Encourage the development of early literacy, math, and problem-solving skills through hands-on, purposeful work that supports kindergarten readiness

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Full-Stack AI Engineer/Researcher (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description:
THE MISSION

More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2.6 billion and 12.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people.

AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data.

What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk.

Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences.

We run these experiments in an AI-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature.

It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised ~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way.

The opportunity is generational. We're building the first scaled engine for real human biological data, and using it to know which drugs will work in people before they ever reach a trial.


YOUR SKILLS

Must be able to operate across the entire AI stack: evals, agentic harnesses, and models

Parallel Bio is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Commitment to Our Team

At Pipe17, our values aren’t just words on a wall. They’re how we operate every day.

We are a high-performance team built around ownership, urgency, curiosity, and a strong bias for action.

We set bold goals, hold ourselves accountable, and move fast to solve customer problems. Every team member owns their decisions and drives outcomes. No one waits for permission.

We operate with urgency, but not recklessly. We focus on what matters most, take initiative, and course-correct quickly when needed. We value people who speak up, follow through, and take pride in their work.

Curiosity is how we get better. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and stay open to new ideas. We don’t default to “how it’s always been done.” We explore, test, and learn. That mindset helps us adapt quickly, solve harder problems, and continuously raise the bar.

We also embrace AI as a force multiplier. We believe great operators don’t compete with AI - they partner with it. We use AI to move faster, think deeper, and remove friction from our work, while still applying human judgement, creativity, and context where it matters most. Thoughtful use of AI is part of how we scale ourselves and our impact.

Finally, teamwork is at our core. We win together, support each other, and celebrate our shared victories. Collaboration across functions is a daily practice, not just something we talk about. We learn from each other, improve constantly, and rally around our mission: unify commerce after the buy button.

If these values resonate with how you like to work, you’ll fit right in.

Type: Individual Contributor · Location: Remote (US) · Reports to: VP Marketing
Experience: 3–5 years · Target OTE: $105k–$115k

This is a hands-on build role, and acts as the connective tissue to our cross-functional GTM team. You will work daily with Sales and Partnerships, because the programs you build feed their pipeline across mid-market brands, enterprise order management, and 3PL.

About the role

Pipe17’s Order Operations Platform is the connected OMS that unifies orders, inventory, products and fulfillment across selling channels (DTC, B2B, retail and agentic), ERPs and fulfillment locations. We sell a technical product to operators, their bosses and the rest of the enterprise buying group, and generic marketing does not work on them.

We need someone who can build the systems that put the right message in front of the right account at the right moment, then run those systems without babysitting. You are part engineer, part marketer: comfortable in APIs, automation platforms, and LLM tooling, and equally comfortable judging whether a play will actually grow qualified pipeline. You will be the only person in this function, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, with the latitude to build what does not exist yet.

What you'll do

Run account-based marketing execution.

• Build the named account lists for our enterprise and 3PL programs, and map the people inside each account.

• Keep account evidence current, built with agents rather than by hand: what each account runs, who runs it, what it costs them, and what changed.

• Run the mechanics: multi-touch sequences, executive outreach, dinner and event invitations, gifting, and follow-up.

• Own event and conference follow-up as a system. Target list and meetings booked before anyone travels, follow-up inside 72 hours.

• Give Sales and Partnerships what they need to work each account, when they need it.

Build custom nurtures. Replace the single nurture track with custom paths, where treatment rises with intent and decays with time. High-intent visitors get a human fast, light engagement gets agent-drafted outreach keyed to what they did, and stalled or previously-too-small accounts get re-scored and re-contacted on a schedule.

Own HubSpot. Own the roadmap and the admin. Fix the data model so it matches how we actually sell across three segments, clean up source attribution so we can say what produced pipeline, and build reporting the business trusts. Keep the stack small. We are not looking for someone who adds tools.

Build the outbound engine.

• Build automated outbound end to end: signal detection, enrichment, sequencing, reply handling, and CRM sync, using the tools we have in house today (HubSpot, Clay, Propensity, Artisan, Gong).

• Detect the events that mean an account is in play: a replatform, an ERP migration, a 3PL change, a new channel, a second warehouse, a bad peak season, a new operations or technology leader.

• Use LLMs and agents to personalize at volume, grounded in real research about each account.

• Make it run without babysitting, and make it measurable.

Must-have qualifications

• 3+ years in marketing operations, demand gen operations, GTM operations, or revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company.

• You have built an outbound engine from scratch, and can tell us what it produced in meetings or pipeline.

• You have run account-based programs, including building the target list when it did not exist, and are familiar with implementing and enabling use of ABM platforms.

• You have built custom nurtures with differentiated paths, and can show what they did to conversion.

• Deep HubSpot. You have designed the data model around how a business sells, and you are happy doing the admin yourself.

• You build. APIs, data manipulation, LLM tooling, and real depth in automation platforms such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, or Make. You can read API docs and debug when something breaks.

• You did it unprompted. You saw the gap and shipped the fix before anyone asked.

• Commercial instinct. You understand pipeline and conversion, and why reps ignore tools that technically work.

• A doer. Comfortable as the only person in the function, with direct exposure to the founders.

• Fluent in using AI to do the work, not just to talk about it.

Nice to have

• Experience in ecommerce, retail technology, or logistics.

• Enterprise account-based marketing into retail or supply chain buyers.

• Agents or LLM workflows in production against a pipeline outcome.

• Built the function from nothing at a Series A to C company.

• Ran a long enterprise cycle and a fast mid-market cycle in the same system.

• Supported a partner or channel motion, including partner-sourced attribution.

About Us

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform for brands and 3PLs. We replace the fragmented stack of iPaaS, middleware, and legacy OMS with one unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions across every channel and partner.

With 300+ managed connectors, AI-powered workflows, and an industry-first MCP Server for agentic commerce, Pipe17 lets brands go live in weeks, scale into new channels in days, and run post-checkout operations without developer dependency or systems integrators.

Our customers reduce operational costs by up to 85%, cut fulfillment errors by 99%, and launch new channels in days instead of months. Pipe17 is trusted by enterprise brands including Estée Lauder, Allbirds, e.l.f. Beauty, Made In Cookware, Wyze, Olly, Black Rifle Coffee Company, and Dude Wipes, as well as leading 3PLs including Ryder, FedEx, and Barrett Distribution.

Pipe17 is a venture-funded software company headquartered in Seattle, WA with a significant presence in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company is backed by GLP Capital Partners, a leading investor in ecommerce logistics, and with Series A funding.

ABOUT CLIPBOARD

This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own up leveling the design of our core experiences across our worker and workplace apps.

You'll partner closely with product and engineering to define vision, build roadmaps, and solve real problems for our customers. You'll talk to customers regularly and use what you learn to form a clear point of view on how to build solutions for their needs. You'll explore multiple directions, design user flows, visuals, and interactions, build detailed prototypes to test them with customers, and iterate until what ships is polished, intuitive, and impactful.

This is an opportunity to build products in an industry that delivers real impact for our workers and workplaces and, enables better care outcomes for their patients. Beyond the features you own, you'll be working with other designers to dramatically raise the craft of everything we build. Sharper visual design, tighter interactions, more consistency across surfaces, and more care in the details throughout the experiences our customers use every day.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own design for core features end to end across the worker and facility apps, from research and problem definition through specs and launch.

 - Serve as the primary experience voice for your team, framing ambiguous problems clearly enough that partners can see the vision and build from it.

 - Partner with PMs on planning and prioritization, using user needs and business context to decide what gets built and when.

 - Set a high bar for craft and push visual and interaction quality across everything you design in our products.

 - Build detailed, high-fidelity prototypes that show how an experience looks, moves, and feels.

 - Design within our design system and contribute back to it, working with other designers and engineers to get new components and patterns built into the codebase.

 - Talk to customers regularly to understand their problems, and use research and data to shape the experiences that solve them.

 - Integrate AI throughout your process, from synthesizing research and analyzing competitors to generating concepts, writing copy, and building working prototypes.

 - Take accountability for quality at every stage of a project, and above all for what ships.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED

 - 5+ years of product design experience and a portfolio of shipped work that shows strong visual and interaction craft and clear end-to-end thinking.

 - Experience owning a product area with little oversight, taking ambiguous problems from definition through launch and iteration.

 - Deep attention to typography, layout, hierarchy, color, spacing, motion, and interaction detail.

 - Fluency in Figma and AI-powered prototyping tools, with experience designing for iOS, Android, and web.

 - Experience working within and contributing to a design system, including partnering with other designers and engineers to get changes built in code.

 - Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design for interconnected flows and complex existing systems.

 - Experience talking directly to customers, and using research and product data to inform design decisions.

 - Credibility with engineering and product partners, built on clear communication and the ability to explain design rationale and influence direction.

 - Clear, proactive written and verbal communication, with the ability to present work confidently and explain design rationale.

 - Fluency with AI tools and a track record of using them to speed up your design work.

 - Openness to feedback, with the ability to take critique, adjust, and keep work moving.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or products where both sides of a transaction depend on each other.

 - Experience designing for healthcare, operations-heavy, or other high-stakes real-world domains.
   
   
   


LOCATION

 - Preferred: San Francisco CA/Bay area

 - Open to: US remote

• Developed the backend and user interface for personalized Airbnb gift cards.

A typical day:

During the 12-week internship, you’ll experience what it’s like to be a Software Engineering partner at Airbnb. You’ll be integrated into a team and contribute to challenging projects that make a real impact. We offer the support, mentorship, fun, and hands-on experience you need to accelerate your learning. You can expect to:

• Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team meetings.

• Participate in intern programming, workshops, and community events.

Your expertise:

We recognize that excellent engineers come from diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you’re passionate about learning, solving problems, and working with others, we encourage you to apply:

• Foundational awareness of AI concepts — such as supervised learning, model evaluation, or working with APIs backed by large language models (LLMs) — gained through coursework, personal projects, or internships

• An understanding of responsible AI principles — including fairness, privacy, and safety — and a curiosity about how these apply to real-world product development

• Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, with curiosity to learn new technologies.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Effective time management and adaptability in fast-paced environments.

• Leadership experience, teaching, mentoring, or community involvement is a plus!

• Authorization to work in the United States is required. Please note: This role is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

Your location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in San Francisco, CA to be able to conduct their work. Interns are expected to work from the San Francisco office three days per week. Additional in-person attendance for team meetings or offsites may be required as needed. Domestic relocation support will be provided.

How we’ll take care of you:

Our job titles may span more than one career or degree level. This role may also be eligible for benefits and Employee Travel Credits.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Integrations & AI Agents
jobs.description:
Mirantis is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and build the integration and AI agent layer behind our business applications. You'll own custom integrations between enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, ITSM, collaboration tools), help build the middleware that connects them, and develop AI agents, skills and the infrastructure they run on.

You'll work across the full lifecycle: gathering requirements with business stakeholders, designing the architecture, building, testing, deploying and supporting it in production. This is a hands-on senior role with real ownership and influence on how the company adopts agentic AI.

Main Responsibilities

Custom Integrations

• Design, build and maintain integrations between enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, ITSM, HR and collaboration platforms) using REST, GraphQL, webhooks and event-driven patterns
• Gather and document integration requirements with business stakeholders and translate them into technical designs
• Own data mappings, synchronization logic and error handling across systems
• Troubleshoot and resolve integration failures and data issues in production

Middleware and Integration Layer

• Contribute to the design and build-out of the middleware layer: shared services, API gateways, message queues and reusable connectors
• Define integration standards, patterns and API contracts used across the team
• Ensure scalability, observability and reliability of integration flows: logging, monitoring, alerting and retries

AI Agents and Agent Infrastructure

• Design and build AI agents that automate business workflows and interact with enterprise systems
• Develop and maintain MCP servers and connectors that give agents secure access to internal systems
• Create and maintain agent skills: reusable instructions, tools and workflows for specific business tasks
• Build and operate the infrastructure agents run on, including LLM gateways and proxies, access control, usage tracking and cost monitoring
• Evaluate agent quality: build test sets, monitor accuracy and unexpected behavior, and iterate
• Track the evolving AI tooling landscape and recommend which tools and patterns to adopt

Quality, Security and Operations

• Write tests for integrations and agents, and participate in code reviews
• Apply security best practices: secret management, OAuth2 scopes, least-privilege access, PII handling and audit logging
• Automate deployments with CI/CD and infrastructure as code
• Document architecture, API contracts, runbooks and agent behavior
• Mentor junior engineers and interns

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
• 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years building enterprise integrations
• Strong programming skills in Java and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security)
• Deep knowledge of REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, JSON and event-driven architecture
• Experience with integration platforms, middleware or message brokers (for example, MuleSoft, Workato, Kafka or RabbitMQ)
• Hands-on experience integrating CRM and ERP systems
• Practical experience building LLM-based applications or AI agents: tool calling, prompt design, RAG and agent frameworks
• Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar approaches to connecting agents to enterprise systems
• Experience with cloud platforms, Docker and Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
• Strong knowledge of authentication and authorization (OAuth2, SAML, JWT, API keys) and of API security risks
• Solid SQL skills
• Understanding of responsible AI use: hallucination risks, data privacy and output validation
• Ability to work directly with business stakeholders and turn ambiguous requests into working solutions

Why you’ll love Mirantis

• Work with an established leader in the cloud infrastructure industry.
• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.
• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
• Receive a competitive compensation package with strong benefits plan.
• We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com

jobs.title: Senior Brand Content Strategist
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our get-it-done culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact and excel in a culture of collaboration.

This role is equally operational and demands extensive project management, systems building, stakeholder management and AI workflow experience. If you’re ready to join a fast-paced company in a creative role and love to build incredible content, systems and AI workflows at the forefront of the data revolution, this is your dream job. 

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area. 

In this role you will:

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

Project Engineer

The Project Engineer designs and deploys first-of-a-kind mining and refining technologies at our Moab site. In this role, you will work across our process development, software, plant engineering, project execution, and operations teams to plan, build, and deliver the cross-functional projects that move our plant forward. You’ll be a true generalist, moving between hardware, process, and data analysis depending on what the plant needs. The work varies week to week, from scoping a project and sizing equipment to standing beside the mechanic and electrician during startup. You will own projects from idea to handover and build new skills along the way. This role is based full-time at our Moab site, with no travel between locations.

Responsibilities

 - Scope, design, and lead process improvement and capital projects from concept through commissioning

 - Develop process flow diagrams, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, and equipment specifications

 - Size and select pumps, tanks, piping, and other process equipment

 - Use plant data to find bottlenecks, improve recovery, and cut costs

 - Work with the project mechanic and project electrician on installs, checkout, and startup

 - Partner with controls and operations teams on control strategies and operating procedures

 - Lead hazard reviews and management of change, and keep projects compliant with site safety standards

 - Manage project scope, schedule, and budget, including vendor and contractor coordination

Qualifications & Experience

 - Hands-on experience taking projects from design through commissioning and startup

 - 4+ years of process or mechanical engineering experience in mining, chemical, oil & gas, or other heavy industrial operations

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (preferred) or a related engineering discipline

 - Comfort reading and producing P&IDs, PFDs, and equipment datasheets

 - Strong data skills; experience with process data historians, Python, or similar tools is a plus

 - Experience with hydrometallurgy, leaching, solvent extraction, or electrowinning is a plus

 - Able to work independently and willing to jump into unfamiliar problems

 - EIT or PE certification is a plus

Schedule

 - Monday–Friday, typically 7am–4pm or 7am–5pm

 - Occasional weekends based on project needs

Working Environment & Physical Requirements

 - Plant work in all weather, with exposure to dust, fumes, solvents, sulfuric acid, and other hazardous materials

 - Stand, climb, bend, and kneel for long periods, including at heights and in tight spaces

 - See and hear well enough (with correction if needed) to work safely around equipment

 - Lift 50+ lbs

 - Wear required PPE at all times on site
   
   


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

jobs.title: Account Executive: Distributors
jobs.description:
ABOUT PARSPEC

Parspec helps distributors grow sales, improve profitability, and deliver a better customer experience by making it easier to quote, submit, and manage project work.

Founded in 2021, we combine AI and product data across millions of products to simplify work that has historically lived across spreadsheets, PDFs, email, and disconnected systems. We help teams spend less time finding information and rebuilding documents, and more time winning business and supporting their customers.

We’ve raised more than $31 million from investors including Innovation Endeavors. Our team brings together technology expertise and firsthand experience in the construction supply chain, with a shared focus on solving practical problems for the people who keep this industry moving.

We’re building a business that can meaningfully change how this industry operates. This role will be an important part of that growth.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring a full-cycle Account Executive to grow Parspec’s business with national and regional distributors across the electrical and plumbing trades.

These customers run substantial project businesses alongside their everyday inventory sales. Their teams are managing complex quotations, product selections, submittals, and project requirements, often using tools that weren’t designed for that work. Parspec brings those workflows together through an AI-powered platform spanning CPQ, quoting, submittals, and project management.

Your job is to understand how each customer operates, identify where we can make a meaningful difference, and build a business case that earns their commitment.

You should be as comfortable discussing growth and profitability with a divisional president as you are working through a quoting process with a branch team. You’ll need to connect those conversations-and be clear about both the value Parspec can deliver and the work required to get there.




YOUR IMPACT

You’ll own a territory, win new customers, and grow those relationships over time. That means building credibility with the people doing the work, the leaders accountable for the results, and the technology teams supporting the business.

A customer may start with one branch, division, or application. Your responsibility is to understand the broader opportunity from the beginning: what success looks like, who needs to support it, and how an initial deployment can become a company-wide decision.

Expansion should come from demonstrated results and executive alignment-not from starting the same sales process over at every branch.

You’ll also work with customer IT teams and Parspec’s technical resources to define ERP & other core system integration requirements, confirm scope, and align rollout expectations. The business case you sell needs to hold up through implementation, adoption, and renewal 12 months later.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the full sales cycle. Lead prospecting, discovery, demonstrations, business-case development, pricing, negotiation, and close.

 - Build your territory. Generate approximately 60% of your own pipeline alongside marketing-sourced opportunities. Use targeted outreach, customer relationships, industry trade shows, and regional events to create new business.

 - Land with a plan to expand. Identify the right starting point, build relationships across the organization, and grow adoption across branches, divisions, and Parspec’s applications.

 - Run a disciplined sales process. Keep opportunities moving, establish clear next steps, maintain accurate CRM data, and deliver a forecast grounded in what is actually happening in your accounts.

 - Stay engaged after the sale. Partner with implementation and customer success to maintain executive alignment, resolve roadblocks, and ensure the customer gets what they bought.

 - Bring useful feedback back to the business. Work with product and marketing to explain customer priorities, competitive dynamics, and adoption barriers. Know the difference between a product gap and a workflow that requires training or change management.


WHAT THE WORK LOOKS LIKE

 - Deal sizes: Annual contract values typically range from $15,000 to $500,000, with broader organizational rollouts and multi-product expansions at the upper end.

 - Sales cycles: Approximately two to eight weeks for a single region or department, and three to six months for larger, multi-branch deployments.

 - Buyers: Branch managers, quotations and estimating leaders, operations and market leaders, divisional presidents, and customer experience and IT executives. You’ll often need alignment across several of these groups within the same account.

 - Opportunity volume: You’ll manage dozens of active opportunities at once. Prioritization, consistent follow-through, and a repeatable system are essential.

 - Travel: Approximately 15–25%, primarily for customer meetings, onsite deployments, and industry events.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - At least three years of quota-carrying sales experience, with a track record of meeting or exceeding your targets.

 - The ability to create your own opportunities. You know how to identify the right accounts, start relevant conversations, and turn outreach into qualified pipeline.

 - Strong discovery and business judgment. You can understand a customer’s operating challenges, connect them to business outcomes, and make a clear case for change.

 - The discipline to manage a high-volume pipeline. You can work multiple stakeholders and competing timelines without losing momentum or letting opportunities go quiet.

 - Clear, credible communication. You listen well, write clearly, and can earn trust with frontline teams and executive decision-makers.

 - A practical, customer-focused approach. You solve problems, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable being direct about what will-and will not-work.

A degree or equivalent relevant experience is required. A bachelor’s degree is preferred, but demonstrated capability and results matter most.




EXPERIENCE THAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED

 - Experience working in or selling into wholesale distribution, particularly electrical, plumbing, HVAC, or industrial supply.

 - Familiarity with distributor quoting, submittal, and project workflows, including systems such as Epicor Prophet 21, Epicor Eclipse, Infor, NetSuite, and DDI System Inform.

 - Experience selling CPQ, ERP, CRM, or data management solutions, especially where integration and process change are part of the buying decision.

 - A track record of expanding accounts across multiple branches or locations, supported by a structured sales approach such as MEDDIC or Sandler.

 - Proficiency with CRM systems (HubSpot preferred), AI tools, and general sales collateral building and organizational tools.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

You’ll have ownership of your business and a direct role in shaping how Parspec grows. Your customer conversations will influence how we sell, how we position the platform, and where we invest in the product.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, a generous equity package, and the opportunity to grow with the company.

We’re looking for someone who wants to build a territory, earn lasting customer relationships, and turn strong execution into meaningful growth-for our customers and for Parspec.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

We are looking for a Sales Engineer to join our rapidly growing team and play a vital role in driving sales by communicating a deep understanding of the technical requirements for enterprise health systems and how Abridge technology can be incorporated seamlessly. This individual will operate at the intersection of our Sales, Implementation, Partner Success, and Product Engineering to ensure security reviews are successful and customers are positioned for success. With a deep understanding of EMRs, and the technical landscape of the enterprise healthcare organizations that use them, you will respond to information security questionnaires and RFPs, highlight Abridge’s platform features in the Sales motion, and serve as a trusted resource for the Commercial segment of our Sales team. As a Solutions Consultant, we’re looking for someone who is energized by the opportunity to contribute to Abridge’s growth and can thrive in a cross-functional role.

 - Work cross functionally with Product Management and Engineering teams to improve Abridge’s technology by providing insight into your experience with customers

What you’ll bring:

 - Solid technical background with deep understanding of and/or hands on experience with multiple Electronic Health Record (EHR) / Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, preferably Oracle/Cerner, Athena, Meditech, and others.

 - Ability to creatively explain and compellingly present complex concepts in an easy-to-understand manner, across all levels of an organization

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Eagerness to answer questions and solve challenges

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Our AI team builds the models, agents, and platforms behind Robinhood's products and the tools our employees use every day. We work in small groups where product, engineering, and research sit together and ship in weeks, not quarters. We partner closely with design, data science, legal, and compliance, because financial products need to be useful and safe. We value clear writing, direct feedback, and decisions backed by data. It's an exciting time to join us!

As a Staff Product Manager, AI, you will set the product direction for a core AI area, from the first problem statement through launch and measurement. You will decide which problems are worth solving, write clear specs, and define how we know a model or agent is working, including quality, speed, cost, and safety. Every day, you will work with engineers, researchers, designers, and data scientists to turn early prototypes into products customers trust. You will also coach other product managers and raise the bar on how the team plans and evaluates AI work. We can't wait to see what you build!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Own the strategy and roadmap for an AI product area, and explain the plan clearly to senior leaders in writing and in person

• Turn open-ended problems into specs with goals, success metrics, and launch criteria

• Define how AI features are evaluated, including accuracy, response time, cost per request, and safety, and work with engineers and researchers to improve each one

• Ship in small steps with engineering, design, and data science, and learn from how customers use each release

• Partner with legal, compliance, and security so AI features meet financial regulations and Robinhood's standards

• Track product metrics and run experiments, then use the results to decide what to build, change, or stop

• Mentor other product managers and help set shared standards for AI product work

What you bring

• 8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years shipping AI or machine learning products, such as features built on large language models, agents, recommendations, or ML platforms

• A track record of taking a product from idea to launch and growing its use, with results you can describe in numbers

• Working knowledge of how large language models are built, evaluated, and deployed, and the ability to discuss tradeoffs with engineers and researchers

• Strong written communication, including explaining technical choices to people outside engineering

• Comfort with data, including SQL or a similar tool, experiment design, and metric definition

• Experience leading work across several teams without direct authority

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have:

• Experience in fintech, brokerage, payments, or another regulated industry

• Experience building AI agents or internal AI platforms

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

• Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.

• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.

• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

$168,000—$198,000 USD

jobs.title: CEO - AI Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.



 


ABOUT THE ROLE

The CEO - AI Finance will build and own our AI-native finance business. The role will identify where AI can fundamentally improve how consumers manage money and build products across spending, saving, investing and other everyday financial needs.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Define the AI Finance product strategy, roadmap and business model.

 - Identify financial workflows where AI can materially improve the user experience, cost or speed.

 - Build AI-native financial products from concept through launch and scale.

 - Own P&L, customer growth, revenue, unit economics and operating performance.

 - Work deeply with product, engineering and AI teams on product capabilities and user experience.

 - Build the core team across product, technology, operations and commercial functions.

 - Expand into new financial products and markets as the business scales.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 - Strong experience building consumer fintech, financial services or technology products.

 - Direct ownership of a meaningful product, business or P&L.

 - Strong understanding of consumer finance, business models and unit economics.

 - Strong product judgement and understanding of how AI can change existing financial workflows.

 - Experience building products and teams in high-growth technology environments.

 - Hands-on operating style - able to work directly through product, AI capabilities, economics and customer problems.
   
   


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.



 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.



 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.



THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to run hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK scales globally.

Hiring sets the pace here. How quickly we build the team decides how quickly everything else moves.

You will run multiple roles at once and close them in weeks rather than months. That only works when one person owns the full cycle, so you do: post, source, screen, assess, interview, offer. Coordinators and assessors support the individual steps. The outcome is yours.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Run recruitment end to end for your assigned roles.

 - Take proper briefs from hiring managers, and tell them when the profile does not match the market.

 - Source and screen directly through LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards and outreach. Inbound and outbound both matter, and neither fills a role on its own.

 - Map the market and build pipelines before the role opens.

 - Keep the ATS accurate and give hiring managers a straight read on where each role stands.

 - Run interviews and scheduling so candidates get a fast, clear process.

 - Improve how we hire: screening quality, process, employer brand.



THE RIGHT FIT HAS

 - 2 to 5 years in talent acquisition, in-house, agency, executive search or staffing.

 - You have run several roles in parallel against a deadline, not one at a time.

 - Real sourcing skill. You can find people who are not looking.

 - You move fast because your process is good, not because you work late.

 - Hiring experience across more than one function, corporate and tech.

 - You read candidates well and can defend a call to a skeptical hiring manager.

 - Startup, high-growth or agency experience preferred. Slow environments will not suit.

 - Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Your roles close on time, and hiring managers know where each one stands without having to ask.

 - Every role you run draws strong volume, because you treat the job post as something to be tested and improved rather than published once.

 - Shortlists hold up. Hiring managers interview the people you send and rarely ask for a different batch.

 - Candidates move through the process quickly. Nothing sits waiting on you.

 - Offers get accepted, not just issued.

 - Hiring works better a year from now than it does today, because of changes you made.



WHY JOIN BJAK

 - Above-market remuneration.

 - Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.

 - Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.

 - Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

 - High ownership, autonomy, and responsibility from day one.

 - Meaningful work that directly contributes to the growth and success of the business.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Electronics
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive hardware development for Apollo. You will drive planning and execution across Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Systems, Quality, and Manufacturing, taking custom electronics from concept through board bring-up, validation, and production release.

This is a deeply technical role. You will engage directly in design reviews and root-cause investigations, manage board spins and firmware releases as one integrated plan, and serve as the primary point of contact for program status, technical risk, and external development and manufacturing partners.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Cross-Functional Program Leadership: Program lead for cross-functional engineering teams; proactively drive planning and execution across Electrical Engineering (EE), Firmware (FW), Systems, Quality, and Manufacturing teams.

• Hardware-Software Co-Design: Drive end-to-end alignment between EE and FW teams to ensure seamless hardware-software co-design, board bring-up, signal integrity, and system-level debugging.

• Electronics Execution: Oversee technical execution and lifecycle deliverables for Apollo's custom electronics, including actuator and motor driver boards, power distribution, embedded compute, microcontrollers, and sensor interfaces.

• Technical Point of Contact: Act as the primary technical point of contact for program status, clearly communicating architecture trade-offs, technical risks, schedule dependencies, and mitigation strategies.

• Roadmaps & Planning: Develop and execute detailed program roadmaps, including HW board spins, FW sprint milestones, risk management, and resource allocation.

• Development Lifecycle Deliverables: Lead engineering deliverables through each hardware build phase (EVT, DVT, PVT), including EE/FW architecture specifications, DFMEA and risk analyses, design verification, and V&V execution against applicable safety and compliance standards.

• Release & Revision Tracking: Establish and run the tracking for firmware releases, hardware revision cycles, and sprints using Jira, Confluence, and Agile/Scrum practices, with clear ownership and accountability for every deliverable.

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership during design reviews, circuit/firmware root-cause problem solving, and risk assessments using deep engineering fundamentals.

• Risk & Bottleneck Management: Proactively identify program bottlenecks, hardware lead-time risks, and firmware resource gaps, driving immediate technical solutions to ensure timely milestone delivery.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

• Electronics & Firmware Depth — Strong technical background in electrical engineering, embedded firmware, electronics architecture, and understanding of V&V activities for electromechanical systems.

• External Partner Management — Serve as a key point of contact for external consultants and contractors, including development and manufacturing partners and suppliers.

• Program Tooling — Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools such as Jira, sprint planning, and task tracking, including creating trackers, dashboards, and reporting.

• Cross-Team Influence — Experience and influence in establishing work relationships across multi-disciplinary teams and with partners in different time zones, building trust and demonstrating critical thinking and thoughtful leadership.

• Standards & Quality Systems — Knowledge of industry standards, safety requirements, and quality systems relevant to hardware and electronics.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (e.g., Electrical, Computer, or related field) required

• 7-10+ years of program management or engineering leadership experience spanning hardware concept development to production release

• Preferred: Experience in robotics, autonomous systems, or other complex electromechanical products

• Preferred: Hands-on experience with motor control, power electronics, or high-speed digital design

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

• Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times

• Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

• Hearing and speech to communicate

*This is a direct hire.  Please, no outside Agency solicitations.

Apptronik provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Power Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

The Senior Power Procurement Manager will lead utility tariff and power purchase negotiations from first engagement through execution, owning a portfolio of medium- to high-complexity deals across one or more ISOs/RTOs. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports: the person will draft and negotiate term sheets and definitive agreements, build and pressure-test deal models, coordinate cross-functional inputs, and serve as the day-to-day point of contact with utility counterparts. They will lead complex, multi-site negotiations, pilot new commercial constructs, and are expected to become Antora's recognized expert for a region.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Deal Execution & Negotiation Lead day-to-day negotiations and the overall close plan for utility tariffs, energy service agreements, and PPAs. Draft and negotiate term sheets; lead definitive agreement negotiations alongside counsel; negotiate standard tariff rate changes per playbook. Support capacity and power sales origination, including preparing and negotiating MOUs, term sheets, and off-take agreements with utilities, hyperscalers, and other large-load customers. Help shape deal structures that fit Antora's unique load profile. Coordinate Finance, Legal, Policy, Business Development, and Engineering inputs; run cross-functional working sessions to align positions, timelines, and technical constraints. Own financial model architecture for deals: select modeling approaches, set key assumptions, run sensitivities and stress tests, validate inputs, and QA models built by others. Utility & Counterparty Relationships Serve as the primary point of contact with utility managers and directors. Build deep regional knowledge of priority ISOs/RTOs, utilities, and tariff landscapes, growing into a go-to resource for at least one region. Partner with Business Development to qualify and advance opportunities, ensuring smooth handoffs from early engagement to active negotiation. Regulatory Support & Team Contribution Support regulatory work by drafting comments, exhibits, and data responses; may represent Antora in staff workshops and by testifying in regulatory forums. Surface patterns across deals (common counterparty objections, emerging tariff structures, regulatory shifts) and propose playbook language updates for senior review. Informally mentor junior team members on models, redlines, and negotiation prep.

Key Qualifications

• 6–12+ years of experience in power procurement, energy origination, utility negotiations, or energy commercial roles.

• Demonstrated deal track record of leading successful Power Procurement Agreement or Electric Service Agreement negotiations.

• Solid working knowledge of utility tariff design, wholesale power markets, and the commercial mechanics of how large loads contract for energy and grid services, with depth in at least one region or ISO.

• Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating term sheets and definitive agreements alongside counsel.

• Strong financial modeling skills, ability to build, stress-test, and QA deal models and translate results into negotiation positions.

• Sound commercial judgment within guardrails: knowing which terms to hold, which to trade, and when a deviation needs to be escalated.

• Clear written and verbal communication; able to write decision memos and present recommendations to internal leadership with minimal editing.

Additional Qualifications Desired

• Experience with energy storage, thermal storage, or flexible load commercial structures.

• Exposure to capacity sales or hyperscaler energy procurement.

• Experience in high-growth or start-up environments where commercial processes are still being built.

• Working relationships with utility procurement/rates teams and ISO/RTO stakeholders in MISO, SPP, ERCOT, or PJM.

• Experience supporting regulatory proceedings (comments, data responses, staff workshops).

Work Location:  Remote, USA

Salary Range:  $158,000 USD - $225,000 USD

Salary Basis:  Annual

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR
