jobs.title: Fleet Maintenance Detailing Assistant - Part-Time/Contract
jobs.description:
About Avride

Avride is a U.S.-based autonomous vehicle startup headquartered in Austin, TX, with additional R&D hubs around the world. Our company develops and operates both autonomous cars and delivery robots that share technologies and mutually benefit from each other’s advancements—a unique approach in the industry. Since 2017, Avride has been building expertise in autonomous technologies to create solutions that address current needs and anticipate future demands.

About the Role

We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Fleet Maintenance & Detailing Assistant to support the cleaning, charging, and basic upkeep of our autonomous vehicle fleet in Austin, Texas.
This is an entry-level, hands-on position working alongside our Fleet Maintenance and Operations teams to help ensure vehicles are clean, properly maintained, and ready for daily operations.
No previous professional automotive experience is required. Training and supervision will be provided for vehicle inspections and basic maintenance tasks. This is a non-driving position.
This is a contract position through HireArt. The selected candidate will be employed by HireArt and assigned to work onsite with Avride.

What You'll Do

• Wash, clean, and detail vehicles inside and out, including windows, interior surfaces, and cargo areas.

• Connect vehicles to charging equipment and confirm charging status using established procedures.

• Perform basic vehicle checks, including tire pressure, lights, fluid levels, and windshield wipers, after receiving training.

• Assist trained technicians with simple maintenance tasks, such as replacing wiper blades or topping off fluids, under supervision.

• Identify and report visible vehicle damage, mechanical concerns, or safety issues to the appropriate team.

• Maintain accurate records of vehicle cleanings, inspections, and completed maintenance tasks.

• Keep tools, supplies, equipment, and work areas clean and organized.

• Follow established workplace safety and environmental procedures.

• Support additional non-driving fleet maintenance and operations activities as needed

What You'll Need

• High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

• No previous professional automotive experience required.

• Willingness to learn basic vehicle systems, maintenance procedures, and safe tool use.

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform hands-on work in garage and outdoor environments.

• Strong attention to detail, dependability, and a willingness to learn.

• Ability to follow instructions, ask questions, and work collaboratively with team members.

• Commitment to following established safety procedures

Benefits:

• Pre-tax commuter benefits

• Employer Subsidized Healthcare Benefits thru our 3rd party employer of record partner

• Flexible Spending Account for healthcare-related costs

• Short and long-term disability and life insurance thru our 3rd party employer of record partner

• 401k package

Commitment: This is a full-time, ongoing contract position staffed through our trusted Employer of Record partner, who manages payroll, benefits, and local compliance on our behalf. You will work day-to-day with the Avride team and be fully integrated into our culture and operations. This job is onsite and available to local candidates.

Candidates are required to be authorized to work in the U.S. The employer is not offering relocation, sponsorship, and remote work options are not available.

Avride is an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities to ensure they have equal access to employment opportunities. Avride complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), if you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with the application or hiring process, or to perform the essential functions of a job, please email jobs@avride.ai.

jobs.title: Bilingual SMB Sales Manager
jobs.description:
About Goodshuffle:

Have you ever been to a wedding and really noticed everything in the space? The flowers, tables, lighting, and dance floor didn’t just appear. Dozens of businesses worked behind the scenes to make it happen. Those are the businesses Goodshuffle serves.

They’re creative, operationally complex, and deeply invested in their work. Too many have had to run their businesses on spreadsheets at best and memory at worst. We think they deserve better tools.

Our mission is to bring joy to the business of events.

The Role:

Goodshuffle is at a pivotal stage in our sales evolution. We have a strong inbound engine, deep customer clarity, persona-specific playbooks, an AI-first rep workflow, and a growing foundation of performance data. We’ve also proven that outbound sales works.

Now, we are ready to scale outbound into a predictable, highly repeatable revenue driver.

In this role, you’ll partner directly with our Director of Sales to translate growth targets into rigorous execution, clear team standards, and reliable outcomes. As a Manager, you will own the performance of our early-career, full-cycle Account Executives—driving qualified pipeline, rep ramp velocity, funnel conversion, team quota attainment, and forecast reliability.

What You'll Inherit:

You will begin with a tight-knit pod of direct reports and quickly hire and onboard additional AEs as the outbound motion expands. Within our agreed strategy, you will have high operational autonomy: running daily coaching interventions, setting team cadences, designing outbound experiments, and executing deal-level pipeline inspection.

You'll inherit our sales process, persona playbooks, AI-powered workflows, and initial analytics. Our Director of Sales has managed the dual responsibility of strategist and frontline coach. You are joining to take full ownership of the operating system of scaling so our AE engine can grow far beyond what any single leader can oversee.

For macro-level shifts in methodology, headcount, or team structure, you will bring data-backed recommendations to leadership. You will isolate variables, inspect call quality and execution, test systemic changes, measure the impact, and bring back actionable decisions.

Together you'll solve complex commercial and operational questions by marrying rigorous quantitative analysis with sharp deal intuition.

What You’ll Build:

1. The Operating Model & Forecast

• Establish benchmark funnels for junior AEs, rep capacity models, and pipeline coverage ratios.

• Implement a weekly reporting cadence that flags pipeline risks early in the quarter.

• Own and defend your team’s forecast through rigorous, deal-by-deal inspection.

• Leverage HubSpot, performance data, AI, and automation to maximize rep productivity without treating headcount as the only solution for growth.

2. People & Performance Development

• Hire and onboard top-tier early-career sellers using a repeatable, testable candidate profile.

• Build a structured, measurable ramp program that accelerates time-to-quota.

• Coach reps using a dual lens: objective funnel data paired with deep inspection of recorded calls and deal execution.

• Identify root-cause performance bottlenecks, address underperformance early through direct feedback, and execute timely performance decisions when expectations are not met.

• Develop a deep understanding of the event industry to coach reps on the real operational friction points our software solves.

3. The Next Layer of Leadership Architecture

• Document and standardize your operating systems so they can be easily taught to future frontline managers as the team expands

• Design the operating model, playbooks, and systems that future frontline managers will inherit

• Transition over time from managing individual sellers to developing and mentoring the next layer of frontline sales leaders

What Success Looks Like:

With you leading this motion, Goodshuffle will achieve:

• Predictable Outbound Pipeline: Our outbound motion shows strong promise, but requires the mathematical modeling to make it predictable. You will help us define that blueprint, one that leadership relies on and trusts.

• Calibrated Metrics: Clear, data-backed benchmarks for rep capacity, ramp time, stage conversion, and coverage.

• Improved Performance: Because our AEs run the full cycle, you will inspect performance across every touchpoint: initial outreach, discovery, demo, trial, and close.

• Consistent Quota Attainment: A higher percentage of fully ramped reps hitting and exceeding quota.

• Defensible Forecasting: Forecasts that accurately mirror deal mechanics and pipeline reality.

• Targeted Coaching: Coaching frameworks tied to specific behavioral changes and measurable improvement.

• Proactive Talent Management: Hiring and performance decisions made early enough to safeguard team results.

• Scalable Infrastructure: Teachable management systems that allow new frontline teams to plug in seamlessly.

You’ll Love This Role If You Have:

• Proven Management Experience: 3+ years of direct frontline sales management experience in B2B software, SMB SaaS, or vertical SaaS, with a track record of hiring, coaching, and delivering quota.

• Outbound Architecture Track Record: Proven experience building, scaling, or meaningfully optimizing an outbound sales motion, backed by an understanding of unit economics and funnel math.

• Analytical & Data-Driven Rigor: The ability to move fluently between detail-level data inspection and executive-level strategic decisions.

• High Talent & Performance Standards: A commitment to developing people, holding a high bar for execution, addressing underperformance decisively, and building systems that operate smoothly in your absence.

• Technical & Analytical Fluency: High proficiency with CRM architecture (HubSpot preferred), advanced spreadsheet modeling, and AI-enabled sales enablement tools. Spanish or French language skills are a plus.

How We Work

Everyone at Goodshuffle operates on three primary colors: High Effort. High Vulnerability. High Accountability.

We give feedback in daily conversations, speak up early, ask for help when we need it, and care about leaving the system better than we found it.

Compensation and Benefits

OTE: $180K–$220K
Base salary: $120K–$160K

(Final base/variable placement within this range is determined by candidate experience and internal leveling calibration)

Variable compensation is tied to pipeline creation, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and team quota attainment. Final compensation depends on experience and internal leveling.

Benefits: Fully covered health; dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) match; commuter benefits; unlimited PTO; 10 holidays; paid family leave.

jobs.title: Operations Associate, Temporary Part-Time - Greenwich
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter and winning a Best Carbon Footprint award, we have big goals like being Climate Positive by 2025, Circular by 2030, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in Drapers and Sourcing Journal, and TIME wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own sustainable factory in LA. We innovate across categories like accessories, swimwear, and sleepwear, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this, this and this.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

Work Location/ Schedule:

• Available to work a minimum of 20 hours per week,

• Available to work a minimum of 3 days per week, weekends included.

• Able to work flexible schedule (days, nights, weekends, & holidays if required to meet the needs of the business).

Operations Associate:

As an operations associate at Reformation, your primary role will be to provide support in daily operations, standardize processes in store, merchandising, and maintaining a clean and organized store environment. You will support both the store’s goals and your responsibilities will include assisting with inventory control supporting the store’s success , while creating a positive shopping experience.

What You’ll Do:

• Support the operational efforts required to achieve store goals.

• Maintain seamless store operational procedures.

• Consistently use and understand processes and procedures to track in store inventory accurately.

• Track, receive and process all inbound inventory shipments.

• Complete inventory related tasks as necessary with an elevated attention to detail, including inbound and outbound store transfers, shipment, and omni channel order processing.

• Complete shipment processing - receiving, hanging, steaming, tagging (when applicable) and organizing in the back of house.

• Support the process of completing markdowns when applicable.

• Submit facilities tickets to ensure maintenance, presentation and organization.

• Organize store supplies.

• Ensure the back of house reflects the brand and concept standards at all times.

• Prepare and deliver all customer fitting rooms quickly and accurately.

• Prepare and support all customer purchases in alignment with brand standards, preparing, folding and bagging products.

• Replenish the sales floor when products are sold to ensure visual presentations and inventory levels meet brand standards at all times.

• Support execution of visual merchandising tasks as new products are received, including adjusting visual merchandising when products are sold out or sold through.

• Execute visual displays and mannequins when directed.

• Receive extraordinary customer experience feedback and scoring on service evaluation.

• Contribute to Loss Prevention in all areas of the business.

• Uphold time and attendance policy.

• Bring an ambitious and passionate attitude to work daily.

• Help ensure that the store environment is inspiring and our product is easily accessible.

• Understand the core values and culture of Reformation and reflect these in all efforts.

• Maintain and uphold a professional, healthy, and productive work environment.

What You’ll Bring:

• 1+ years relevant experience in a fastpaced, creative service environment.

• Familiarity with the user functionality of desktop, mobile, tablet and digital technologies.

• Experience working with a sales or retail organization and/or operationally intensive business.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced setting.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with diverse personalities.

• Driven approach to take on new challenges with the self-motivation for your work and career.

Compensation:

At Reformation, we believe in transparency and equity when it comes to compensation. For this role, the anticipated base hourly range is $17 – $19 per hour, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

Benefits & Perks:

• Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.

• We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.

• We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds.

• We’re a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you’ll get to collaborate with people all around the world.

• You’ll get access to fertility care support through Carrot, and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.

• We care about the causes our employees care about so we donate to community efforts on a yearly basis.

• We offer a clothing discount, culture events (like our annual Ref Values week and Volunteer Time Off), you know, all the meaningful and fun stuff!

Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the world we want to live in. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status—in accordance with applicable international, federal, state, and local laws.

If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to ensure you have what you need to show up as your best self.

Still don’t know if you should apply? We get it—studies show that many women and individuals from historically underrepresented communities hold back from applying unless they meet every single requirement. At Reformation, we’re all about growth, not gatekeeping. If you’re passionate about the role and excited about making fashion more sustainable, we’d love to hear from you. If this role doesn’t totally excite you, consider applying to our general application.

jobs.title: Group Financial Reporting Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Stamford, CT. Hybrid arrangements will be considered, with occasional attendance at the Stamford office as business needs require.

About The Lockwood Group:

We are a leading medical communications group, committed to the precise and effective dissemination of scientific and medical content to global healthcare communities. Our collaborations with innovative pharmaceutical companies are instrumental in translating complex scientific data into clear, impactful narratives that advance healthcare knowledge and practice. Our corporate culture emphasizes precision, collaborative synergy, and continuous professional development.

Summary:

We are seeking a Group Financial Reporting Manager to help strengthen our consolidated financial reporting process. This hands-on role is suited to an accounting professional with 3–5 years of experience who wants to build on strong financial reporting fundamentals in a multi-business environment. You will bring together financial information from across the Group, prepare consolidated financial statements, and own the preparation and continued development of our standard financial reporting package and related bank reporting.

Working closely with business finance teams and senior finance leadership, you will help deliver accurate, timely reporting while improving how financial information is collected, consolidated, analyzed, and presented. Standardization, automation, and process improvement are central to the role, with increasing ownership of the Group reporting process as your knowledge of our businesses and systems develops.

Key Responsibilities:

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements and supporting schedules by coordinating business reporting packages and bringing together financial information from across the Group.

• Reconcile and validate consolidated results, perform reasonableness checks, and work with local finance teams to resolve reporting differences, unusual items, and missing information.

• Prepare and maintain the Group’s standard financial reporting package, analyze significant or unusual movements, and support clear explanations of financial performance.

• Work with business finance teams to establish consistent reporting definitions, templates, and submission requirements and improve the quality and timeliness of financial information.

• Prepare recurring bank and lender financial information, compliance schedules, and supporting documentation; coordinate complete, timely submissions and assist with follow-up requests from banks, lenders, and internal stakeholders.

• Maintain consolidation workpapers, schedules, templates, and documentation, and help strengthen reporting procedures and controls.

• Simplify, standardize, and automate recurring consolidation and reporting activities using Excel and other reporting tools. As familiarity with the ERP develops, design, build, and maintain custom financial reports to support Group reporting and reduce manual effort.

Experience & Qualifications

• 3–5 years of relevant accounting or financial reporting experience, ideally in a multi-entity organization or public accounting environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, with a strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and the financial close process.

• Hands-on experience preparing consolidated financial statements or combining financial information from multiple businesses, entities, or reporting systems.

• Strong Excel skills and experience organizing, reconciling, and analyzing financial data from multiple sources.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies or missing information and manage recurring deadlines.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with finance teams across the organization to resolve reporting issues.

Preferred Experience

• Experience preparing management, bank, lender, or other recurring financial reporting packages.

• Exposure to ERP reporting tools, consolidation systems, Power BI, or similar tools, ideally with experience building or modifying financial reports and improving reporting processes.

• Experience working in a private equity–owned portfolio company is a plus.

• CPA, progress toward CPA certification, or another relevant professional accounting qualification.

Why Join Us

This role offers broad exposure across a multi-business organization and the opportunity to deepen your experience in consolidation, Group reporting, bank reporting, financial analysis, and automation. You will make a practical impact by delivering accurate, timely consolidated statements, a reliable Group reporting package, and complete bank and lender reporting, while improving consistency and reducing manual effort. As you grow, you will expand your responsibilities and take greater ownership of the Group financial reporting process.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition - Associate Director (NY)
jobs.description:
Position Title: Talent Acquisition - Associate Director (NY)

Entity: KBRA Holdings LLC

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: New York, NY

Summary/Overview:

The Associate Director, Talent Acquisition will be responsible for managing full-cycle recruitment for assigned business areas, partnering closely with hiring managers to identify, attract, and hire top talent. This role is ideal for an experienced, hands-on corporate recruiter with 7+ years of recruiting experience, preferably within financial or professional services.

The successful candidate will independently manage requisitions from intake through offer, build relationships with hiring managers, and provide guidance throughout the hiring process. In addition to recruitment execution, this individual will support the talent acquisition team to improve recruiting processes, support change initiatives, and influence effective hiring practices.

Job Responsibilities:

• Independently manage full-cycle recruitment for assigned requisitions, including intake meetings, sourcing, screening, candidate assessment, offer management, and onboarding handoffs.

• Partner closely with hiring managers to understand staffing needs, manage the candidate and hiring manager experience, ensure clear communication and influence to drive timely hiring decisions.

• Develop effective sourcing strategies for assigned requisitions and proactively source and engage qualified candidates, building talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

• Build strong relationships with hiring managers and internal stakeholders, using effective communication and influence to drive timely hiring decisions and consistent recruiting practices.

• Manage the candidate and hiring manager experience, ensuring clear communication, timely follow-up, and a professional and efficient recruitment process.

• Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows, tools, and processes, and actively support the implementation and adoption of process enhancements and change initiatives.

• Maintain accurate candidate records, requisition activity, and pipeline tracking within the Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse).

• Collaborate with the broader Talent Acquisition and HR teams to support recruiting priorities, share best practices, and ensure alignment with business needs.

• Track recruiting activity and metrics to identify challenges, communicate progress, and recommend improvements to hiring processes.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

• Bachelor's degree required.

• 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in an in-house corporate recruiting function within financial or professional services.

• Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple requisitions and deliver results across different functions and levels through a hands-on recruitment process.

• Strong relationship management, organization and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility, influence hiring managers, and effectively navigate competing priorities.

• Strong sourcing and candidate engagement skills, including experience identifying and attracting passive candidates.

Preferred Skills

• Prior in-house recruiting experience within financial services, credit ratings, or a related professional services environment.

• Experience supporting recruiting process improvements, technology enhancements, or change management initiatives.

• Familiarity with recruitment metrics, pipeline reporting, and data-driven recruiting practices.

• Experience using an Applicant Tracking System; experience with Greenhouse is a plus.

• Familiarity with Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, data insights, and general productivity is a plus.

Salary Range:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 to $160,000. Offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience, skills, geography, and other job-related factors.

Benefits:

• A hybrid work schedule (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday in the office)

• Competitive benefits and paid time off

• Paid family and disability leave

• 401(k) plan, including employer match (100% vested)

• Educational and professional development financial assistance

• Employee referral bonus program

About Us:

Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC (KBRA) is a full-service credit rating agency registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission as an NRSRO. Kroll Bond Rating Agency Europe Limited is registered as a CRA with the European Securities and Markets Authority. Kroll Bond Rating Agency UK Limited is registered as a CRA with the UK Financial Conduct Authority pursuant to the Temporary Registration Regime. In addition, KBRA is designated as a designated rating organization by the Ontario Securities Commission for issuers of asset-backed securities to file a short form prospectus or shelf prospectus. jobs.title: Software Engineer, iOS/Mobile
jobs.description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. jobs.title: Bilingual Health Partner
jobs.description:
Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark’s comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care.

Daymark’s groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation’s foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Health Partners are core members of the Daymark care team, supporting integrated, whole-person care for our patients. In this role, you will coordinate social and logistical aspects of care, spending time connecting with patients and caregivers by phone, video, and occasionally in the home. You will help patients navigate community-based and social services, ensure follow-up appointments are scheduled, and support seamless coordination between Daymark and external providers.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment. Success requires strong prioritization, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver high-quality work at speed.

Note: This is a full time position required to be onsite 5 days a week in The Long Beach, CA office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Conduct structured social needs assessments (SDOH) and connect patients with community resources, which may include transportation, financial assistance, food, medical equipment, or emotional support programs.

• Support development of patients’ care plans and participate in case conferences to ensure quality care delivery.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for virtual visit readiness and basic technology troubleshooting.

• Coordinate and schedule care for patients, including scheduling follow-up visits and facilitating referrals.

• Own structured chart preparation to ensure providers are visit-ready, including accurate contact, insurance, and care team information.

• Track completion of our Symptom Survey, complete all appropriate follow ups, and escalate clinical concerns as needed.

• Document social interventions, tasks, and care coordination activities in the electronic health record in a timely and standardized format.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Experience. You have at least 3 years of experience in healthcare navigation or patient support, or related experience in a clinical or care coordination setting.

• Comfort with Technology. You’re comfortable using Slack, Zoom, the Google Suite, and EHR systems to ensure accurate appointment scheduling and management and support patients virtually.

• Bias to action: You don’t wait for someone to tell you what to do. You know how to identify and prioritize your initiative’s needs and you do what it takes to ensure that urgent and important needs are acted on immediately.

• Comfort with change and ambiguity: You may not always have direction in your work, and that’s OK, because you’re comfortable figuring out what needs to be done and a path forward.

• Strong relational skills. You have an uncanny ability to establish rapport and work effectively with diverse populations including health care providers, clinical staff, patients, and family members.

• Organized & Communicative. You are incredibly organized and sweat the details. You keep your team in the loop with what you’re working on and the challenges you’re facing and are proficient in collecting patient clinical and demographic data and documenting appropriately in a timely manner.

• Open to working from Daymark's local office: You're comfortable working out of our office in Long Beach, CA 5 days of the week, and occasionally, visiting patient's homes.

• Bilingual: Spanish speaking is required.

Compensation Range: $60,000 - $65,000 USD
Location: Fully onsite (5 days a week) in Long Beach, CA; 8:30am - 5:00pm.

All roles that require in-home visits to patients must provide proof of a valid driver's license.

jobs.title: Scientist II
jobs.description:
The Scientist in Malta Genotyping lab will execute protocols related to genotyping data generation in a state-of-the-art lab. The protocols could include DNA extraction, Library preparation, PCR, and sequencing.  Support of documentation development and maintenance, and inventory consumable management.

The role also involves basic maintenance of lab equipment, lab process improvement review, and cost reduction efforts. The Scientist will interact with peers across the different regions where sample submitters and other genotyping labs are located.

Accountabilities:

• Prepare DNA libraries for sequencing
• Perform PCR activities
• Extracting DNA from samples: (Leaf and/or Seeds)
• Adding chemical buffers to sample plates, operating sample grinders, and liquid handling machines.
• Complete scheduled protocols within required time limit, keeping all test plates organized to maintain sample identity.
• Update tasks electronically via LIMS.
• Learn the background of experiments and plant breeding projects. Participate in meetings and share relevant information with others.
• Train and support lab members and contractors.
• Communicate and implement process improvement ideas.
• Fast-paced lab environment with accountability for quality and speed of lab work completed each day
• Function as a member of a diverse project team and successfully collaborate across teams to analyze and troubleshoot data quality issues.
• Additional job duties include but not limited to: unloading consumables (sample plates, tips for machines, chemicals, etc.) from pallets. Un-packaging consumables from boxes then place them in the proper lab spaces. Discarding unused seed materials. Autoclave materials as needed. Cleaning of lab ware. Keep laboratory space clean.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture, Biology, Genetics or related field required.
• Solid understanding of basic laboratory procedures and equipment
• Must be authorized to work for Syngenta in the United States without work authorization sponsorship
• Preferred Requirements
• 2 – 5 years of experience working in a professional laboratory preferred.
• Experience operating and providing general maintenance on the following laboratory equipment: (Tecan, Biotek Multiflos, centrifuge and sequencers) is highly preferred
• Experience working with chemical buffers highly preferred
• Previous DNA extraction or PCR experience highly preferred

What We Offer:

• A culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members. Offers flexible work options to support your work and personal needs.
• Full Benefit Package (Medical, Dental & Vision) that starts your first day.
• 401k plan with company match, Profit Sharing & Retirement Savings Contribution.
• Paid Vacation, Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, Education Assistance, Wellness Programs, Corporate Discounts, among other benefits.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Accounting Manager — Job Description

About Tin Can

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.

We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to reach more families both at home and abroad, we’re looking to bring on an Accounting Manager to help make it happen.

The Role

Every Tin Can that reaches a family has to be accounted for, cleanly and on time. That’s true whether it’s ordered from our site, picked up off a store shelf, or shipped to a family overseas. As we bring Tin Can to retail partners and new countries, the books behind it get more interesting: more entities, more currencies, and more ways a phone finds its way home. We’re looking for an Accounting Manager to build the accounting foundation that makes that growth possible.

Reporting to our Controller, you’ll keep our day-to-day accounting operations running smoothly. You’ll support a timely, accurate monthly close and own multi-entity accounting and consolidation, intercompany, the accounting behind our retail channel, inventory, and audit readiness. You’ll also help us move from QuickBooks Online Advanced to a full-scale ERP and set up processes that will serve us for years to come. You’ll be the person who knows exactly how every number got there.

What You’ll Do

 - Support the monthly close — reconciliations, accruals, and journal entries

 - Own multi-entity accounting — intercompany, foreign currency, and consolidations

 - Build the accounting for our retail channel — retailer terms, deductions, chargebacks, and receivables

 - Account for inventory across warehouses, retail partners, and in transit

 - Help with our ERP implementation, from mapping current workflows to migrating data cleanly

 - Assist the Controller in designing and documenting the controls that keep our books trustworthy

 - Support our annual audit and tax filings, including indirect-tax and local requirements in new countries

 - Prepare entity-level reporting that gives the management team a clear, current picture of the business

 - Find the manual work in our processes and automate it

What We’re Looking For

 - 5+ years of accounting experience with a strong US GAAP foundation; a mix of public accounting and corporate accounting is ideal, CPA preferred

 - Hands-on multi-entity and international accounting; you’ve handled intercompany, consolidations, and foreign currency across entities

 - Experience accounting for a retail or wholesale B2B channel; you know your way around retailer terms, deductions, and chargebacks

 - You’ve been part of an ERP implementation, and you know the decisions that matter most happen long before go-live

 - Fluency using AI as a multiplier across reconciliation, analysis, and documentation; this is how we work, not a nice-to-have

 - A clear communicator; you can explain the “why” behind a number to teammates who don’t live in spreadsheets

 - Hands-on and scrappy; you’ll dig into the details yourself while keeping an eye on how the process should work at scale

 - Low-ego and collaborative vibes; you share credit and pitch in on problems that aren’t yours

 - Bonus: experience at a consumer products or DTC company; inventory-heavy businesses; or standing up the books for a brand-new entity

Why Join Tin Can

 - We’re building tech that protects childhood: We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.

 - You’ll build the books we grow on: New entities, a retail channel, and a new ERP are all landing at once. You’ll shape how each one is accounted for from day one, setting the foundation the whole company relies on.

 - Small, high-trust team: Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one. We work together in our Seattle office four days a week.

 - Room to explore, not just execute: You’ll have the space to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and build processes that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.

If you’re excited by the idea of building the financial foundation that helps bring Tin Can to more families, in more places, please reach out. We can’t wait to meet someone who’s ready to jump in, sweat the details, and help us grow.

jobs.title: Robot Learning Research Intern
jobs.description:
We seek research interns who combine strong scientific judgment with the initiative to take ownership of an ambitious research project. Working closely with their mentors and collaborators, interns will formulate compelling research questions, critically assess prior work, develop and implement new methods, and design experiments that produce clear, defensible scientific insights.

Successful candidates will bring strong foundations in machine learning and robotics, with depth in one or more of the following areas:

• Generalization and transfer: learning multimodal representations and robot policies that transfer across tasks, objects, environments, and embodiments, including settings with limited demonstrations or deployment data.
• Policy learning and robot foundation models: imitation learning, reinforcement learning, generative policies, and the training, fine-tuning, or post-training of vision–language–action and other embodied foundation models.
• Learning at deployment: test-time adaptation, policy steering, failure detection and recovery, and agentic frameworks for reasoning, skill composition, and continued improvement.
• Data and simulation: combining human demonstrations, robot trajectories, and synthetic data; developing simulation or world-model-based pipelines for training, evaluation, and transfer to physical robots.
• Effective implementation: translating research ideas into reliable software, implementing and debugging neural policies, and using efficient training, inference, and distributed GPU workflows where appropriate.
• Rigorous evaluation: selecting informative baselines and ablations, diagnosing failures and distribution shifts, examining dataset biases, and characterizing robustness, data efficiency, and generalization.

Interns will collaborate with teammates to develop research contributions for publication at leading venues and contribute to invention disclosures and patent applications arising from their work.

Tasks

• Define a focused research problem with mentors and collaborators, connecting an important scientific question to a meaningful robotics or automation challenge.
• Critically review relevant literature, identify limitations in existing approaches, and articulate a testable research hypothesis.
• Develop an R&D plan specifying the proposed methods, data sources, experimental settings, evaluation metrics, milestones, and target publication venues.
• Design and implement the proposed approach, maintaining reproducible code, documented experimental configurations, and clear records of results.
• Evaluate methods in simulation and on physical robots through quantitative comparisons, targeted ablations, qualitative analysis, and theoretical analysis where appropriate.
• Share progress, relevant literature, experimental findings, and open challenges in weekly discussions; refine the research plan as evidence emerges.
• Prepare a research manuscript with collaborators for submission to venues such as CoRL, RSS, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICRA, IROS, Science Robotics, IJRR, T-RO, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, etc., and contribute to associated technical reports and patent materials.

Required Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a Ph.D., or a recent postdoctoral researcher, in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
• Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale, or equivalent.
• Strong foundations in machine learning and robot learning, including representation learning, policy learning, optimization, and experimental design.
• Hands-on experience training or adapting modern robot policies and foundation models, such as vision-language-action (VLA) transformers with autoregressive action-token prediction or diffusion/flow-matching action heads for continuous action-chunk generation, or world action models (WAMs) that jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Relevant training experience includes multi-task pretraining or behavior cloning/supervised fine-tuning with action-token cross-entropy, diffusion denoising, conditional flow-matching, or joint video-action prediction objectives; or offline or online reinforcement learning post-training using actor-critic or policy-gradient methods.
• Strong Python programming skills; experience implementing, debugging, and evaluating neural models using PyTorch or a comparable framework; and hands-on experience using coding agents to develop, test, and maintain robotics and machine learning software, including reviewing and validating agent-generated code.
• Practical experience with physical robot platforms, including robot data collection, policy deployment, and closed-loop experimentation.
• Ability to design rigorous evaluations using appropriate baselines, ablations, and diagnostic analyses to characterize generalization, robustness, and failure modes.
• Demonstrated research ownership, supported by publications, preprints, or substantial research projects, together with clear technical communication and effective collaboration.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience training or adapting robot foundation models using heterogeneous human demonstrations, robot trajectories, and synthetic data, including data curation, quality assessment, and cross-embodiment transfer.
• Experience integrating large language models, vision–language models, or other multimodal foundation models into robot perception, planning, control, or evaluation workflows.
• Experience with test-time adaptation, policy steering, embodied memory, failure detection and recovery, or agentic systems that generate, execute, and refine robot skills.
• Experience in dexterous or contact-rich manipulation, including learning from visual, tactile, force, proprioceptive, or acoustic feedback.
• Experience with simulation, generative world models, digital twins, or Real2Sim2Real pipelines for policy training, evaluation, and transfer.
• Experience with multi-GPU or multi-node training, efficient fine-tuning and inference, and reproducible workflows encompassing versioned datasets, experiment tracking, and checkpoint management.
• Proficiency developing robotics and machine learning software on Linux, using version control and maintainable software practices.
• Theoretical depth in areas such as transfer learning, reinforcement learning, optimization, uncertainty estimation, or safe learning and control.
• A strong publication record at leading robotics, machine learning, or computer vision venues, particularly contributions demonstrating methodological depth and careful empirical validation.

We Are Bosch.

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our areas of activity are every bit as diverse as our outstanding Bosch teams around the world. Their creativity is the key to innovation through connected living, mobility, or industry.

Let’s grow together, enjoy more, and inspire each other. Work #LikeABosch

• Reinvent yourself: At Bosch, you will evolve.
• Discover new directions: At Bosch, you will find your place.
• Balance your life: At Bosch, your job matches your lifestyle.
• Celebrate success: At Bosch, we celebrate you.
• Be yourself: At Bosch, we value values.
• Shape tomorrow: At Bosch, you change lives.

Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

Company Overview:
At Mantra Health, we're dedicated to revolutionizing student mental health care. Partnering with a variety of universities and colleges across the country - including Columbia University, Texas Tech, and the University of Minnesota school system - our mission is to provide universal access to high-quality mental health services for students.

Since our founding in 2018, we've built a comprehensive treatment service for young adults with various mental health conditions. We've raised over $34 million to work with students at universities and colleges nationwide. We're particularly proud that nearly two-thirds of students with access to Mantra report that our program helped them stay in school.

From comprehensive teletherapy to wellness coaching to tele-psychiatry, our diverse team is dedicated to ensuring that students not only survive but thrive. Our students see meaningful improvements in their mental health during treatment with us, reinforcing the impact of our work.

Opportunity for Impact:
We are seeking a Part-Time ConnectNow Crisis Line Provider to provide direct services to students utilizing Mantra’s ConnectNow service, an in-the-moment crisis/emotional support line for college students. In this role you will use active listening and solution-focused approaches to collaboratively engage students seeking support with mental health concerns. In cases of high risk, you will assess the situation and recommend appropriate crisis interventions for implementation by individual students, campus staff, and community helpers. We’re excited to meet folks of all backgrounds who are inspired about our mission to solve the mental health crisis for young adults.

This is a W2 part-time non-benefit eligible position. The expected pay for this position is $30/hour.

What You’ll Do:

• Provide warm, empathetic responses to incoming calls from students needing support or who may be in crisis

• Complete risk assessments and de-escalate crisis intensity to prevent self-harm or harm to others.

• Collaborate with students to develop a plan for safety and recommend next steps.

• Initiate follow-up calls to check on client welfare and encourage service linkage.

• Maintain clinical documentation, ensuring detailed and accurate logging of user sessions.

• Proven ability to work well under pressure while maintaining professionalism and maturity

• Ability to exercise excellent independent judgment with minimal direct supervision

• Schedule flexibility with openness to work a non-traditional schedule that may include evenings and/or weekends

And the following would be nice

• Hold an independent, unrestricted licensure to practice counseling and/or psychotherapy (state equivalent of LCSW, LPC, LMFT, Licensed Psychologist etc.)

• 2+ years of experience practicing mental health counseling and psychotherapy

• Ability and interest in picking up extra shifts as needed to cover team member’s PTO

Why Choose Mantra:

• Potential to shape and lead clinical functions within a mission-driven organization.

• Collaborate with a passionate, dedicated, and innovative team focused on transforming mental healthcare.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Singapore, or Sydney, Australia

About the Department

The Technical Account Team plays a crucial role in ensuring a seamless experience for Cloudflare users, ranging from individual developers to Fortune 500 enterprises. By providing expert technical guidance, proactive support, and complex issue resolution across multiple channels, the team enhances customer satisfaction, strengthens customer trust, and drives product improvement.

At Cloudflare, Technical Account Managers serve as trusted advisors to our top Enterprise customers. TAMs deliver high-touch technical guidance, customer advocacy, and operational support across the customer lifecycle. Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, TAMs capture valuable customer insights and work closely with internal teams to influence service enhancements and future product development.

What You'll Do

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the post-sales technical support experience for Cloudflare's largest Enterprise customers across the Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJC) region, based in Singapore or Sydney. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customers, helping them operate Cloudflare solutions successfully, resolve complex issues, and continuously improve the security, reliability, and performance of their environments.

You will act as an architectural governance partner, continuously mapping customer environments against industry best practices and Cloudflare's Well-Architected framework. By proactively identifying security gaps, single points of failure, configuration drift, and performance bottlenecks, you will help prevent incidents before they impact production. Working closely with Customer Success, Account Teams, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Partners, and Customer Support, you will align technical solutions with customer roadmaps and business objectives. This role requires a strong mix of technical expertise, customer service excellence, executive communication, and strategic problem-solving to ensure high customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

For TAMs specializing in Network Services, you will focus on optimizing customer Cloudflare configurations and ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of their network infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary technical support and escalation contact for assigned Enterprise customers across the APJC region.

• Build trusted technical relationships with customer stakeholders, including technical teams, operational leaders, and senior executives.

• Communicate effectively in English with enterprise customers and stakeholders across the APJC region.

• Collaborate in English with global Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Account Teams, Professional Services, and Partners.

• Own and drive the post-sales technical support experience, ensuring timely, high-quality support outcomes.

• Troubleshoot complex technical issues across Cloudflare products and customer environments.

• Manage support interactions, drive escalations, coordinate internal response, and ensure clear customer communication during incidents.

• Provide clear written and verbal updates, including technical recommendations, incident summaries, escalation updates, RCA follow-ups, and post-incident reports.

• Maintain a comprehensive understanding of customer environments, architectures, and Cloudflare deployments to support proactive issue resolution and long-term optimization.

• Develop and maintain a rolling Technical Risk & Gap Register for each enterprise account, tracking architectural drift, legacy configurations, operational risks, and emerging security threats.

• Prioritize remediation plans with customer stakeholders and help customers align their environments with security, reliability, and performance best practices.

• Conduct Quarterly Support Reviews, including SLA adherence, incident reviews, ticket trend analysis, top support drivers, resilience planning, capacity planning, and proactive feature adoption.

• Partner with the account team to support strategic customer engagements, including technical planning, roadmap alignment, renewal support, and incident response.

• Provide actionable customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to help shape product improvements.

• Partner with Cloudflare's Threat Intelligence and Product teams to proactively evaluate customer environments against newly discovered vulnerabilities, zero-days, and emerging DDoS vectors.

• Ensure defensive configurations and recommended mitigations are deployed ahead of potential exploits where appropriate.

• Establish continuous drift-detection workflows to ensure customer configurations do not deviate from established security baselines, compliance standards, or optimal performance thresholds.

• Leverage AI-driven tools and workflows to optimize daily operations, including incident summarization, case prioritization, support trend analysis, and automated handover documentation.

• Utilize AI-powered analytics to conduct proactive configuration health checks and architectural reviews, identifying systemic risks and strategic infrastructure optimization opportunities.

• Streamline the creation of technical documentation, including HLDs, LLDs, technical recommendations, customer-facing summaries, and post-incident reports.

• Deploy AI-assisted incident management workflows to improve communication precision, including impact assessment, automated status updates, and rapid synthesis of complex technical event details.

• Act as a point of escalation during APJC business hours and provide backup support for global TAMs in other time zones when required.

• Work one weekend per month as part of the TAM coverage model.

• Travel up to 25% of the time to support customer engagements across the region.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a highly motivated, customer-focused technical expert who can combine deep technical knowledge with strong customer advocacy, communication, and business judgment.

Technical Expertise

• Strong understanding of networking concepts, including Layer 7 technologies and routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IPSec, and GRE.

• Experience with security technologies, including Firewalls, IPS, DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application security controls.

• Experience with cloud, SaaS, CDN, edge networking, or security platforms.

• Knowledge of system integration, multi-vendor environments, and data center deployments.

• Proficiency with diagnostic and troubleshooting tools, including traceroute, Wireshark, dig, cURL, logs, packet captures, and browser developer tools.

• Familiarity with the OSI Model, proxies, HTTP, DNS, TLS/SSL, application security, and network security.

• Ability to analyze complex technical issues, identify root causes, and provide practical remediation guidance.

• Passion for Cloudflare's products and a strong desire to help customers succeed.

Customer & Business Acumen

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a customer-facing technical support, technical account management, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or account management role.

• Proven ability to work with Enterprise and Fortune 500 customers.

• Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong customer-facing written communication skills, including the ability to produce incident summaries, technical recommendations, executive updates, and post-incident follow-ups.

• Ability to manage multiple customer priorities, escalations, and internal workstreams at the same time.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment.

• Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Strong ownership mindset, customer empathy, and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Cloudflare's Enterprise customer experience across the Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJC) region. As a Technical Account Manager, you will help some of the region's most important businesses improve their network performance, security posture, resilience, and operational maturity while directly influencing the future of Cloudflare's products and services.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

We are a rapidly growing Health Media company who celebrates those that sing off key against the beat, who are unfamiliar with convention, and not satisfied with the status quo.   If you’re one who can see the million shades of green in a field of grass, one who doesn’t sit back and do what has already been done, you are welcome here.  If you are one who sees a challenge as an opportunity, and jumps at the chance to be rewarded for your performance, we want to get to know you.

Everyone here is an innovator or an innovator-to-be.  At IDEOlogy Health, you can share your ideas and watch them grow.  That happens here because everyone of us strives for a common goal, working together to make people’s ideas stronger.  We recognize and value the impact each employee makes because ultimately, that impact is felt by physicians and the patients they treat.

• Identify, cultivate and maintain long-term relationships with key opinion leaders across oncology and hematology.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maritime Manufacturing Technology team is responsible for rapidly developing and implementing manufacturing technologies and processes for cutting-edge defense hardware, including deployable static and moving surface, undersea and sea to air vehicles and scaling these products in our new manufacturing facilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Santa Ana, CA. The Quality Engineer for our Maritime team is a critical role responsible for ensuring our autonomous offerings are built to the most stringent standards, blending the speed and innovation of a technology company with the discipline and rigor required for national security.

This role focuses on collaborating and driving engagement with our design teams and suppliers to meet our quality requirements the first time. Everything comes down to clarity and action with our suppliers and partnering with them for world-class results across the supply chain. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing, supply management, supplier development, sub-system performance criteria, metrology, and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes with suppliers, work hands-on with engineering, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

You will be the authority on quality for programs that operate in the harshest environments on Earth. This role requires a hands-on, first-principles approach to developing and enforcing quality systems that meet and exceed AS9100 and specific Naval Sea Systems Command (NavSea) standards. You will not just be checking boxes; you will be building the quality foundation for the next generation of naval technology.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Drive the supplier quality development processes throughout the product development stages with the product engineering team through design reviews, supplier process development, testing, and qualification for components and sub-assemblies. Review supplier processes and capabilities to ensure alignment to product requirements can be achieved.

• Drive supplier quality readiness by analyzing key and critical characteristics for drawings and supplier specifications, develop measurement systems, and lead supplier qualification activities (PPAP, FAIR, audit, inspection development, etc.).

• Own the elimination of supplier risk to improve quality and reliability across the product lifecycle. Utilize audits, readiness reviews, and training and documentation to ensure compliance.

• Develop, implement, and sustain a robust Quality Management System (QMS) that is compliant with AS9100 and tailored to include specific NavSea requirements for maritime hardware.

• Champion quality on the manufacturing floor. Implement and monitor statistical process controls (SPC), conduct Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and lead continuous improvement initiatives to increase first-pass yield and reduce scrap.

• Act as the subject matter expert for interpreting and flowing down NavSea standards and technical publications (e.g., material traceability, welding certifications, testing protocols) into actionable manufacturing and inspection processes.

• Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) to disposition non-conforming product. Drive the Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) process using methodologies like 8D and 5 Whys to prevent recurrence.

• Partner with the supply chain team to qualify, audit, and manage suppliers of critical components and special processes (e.g., welding, coatings, pressure testing), ensuring compliance with all prime contract and regulatory requirements.

• Develop comprehensive inspection plans, work instructions, and criteria for receiving, in-process, and final inspection. Lead First Article Inspections (FAIs) in accordance with AS9102.

• Plan and execute internal and supplier audits to ensure system-wide compliance and identify opportunities for improvement. Serve as a primary point of contact during customer and third-party audits.

• Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for quality. Analyze data to identify trends, report on QMS performance to leadership, and drive strategic improvements.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience in a Quality Engineering role within a manufacturing environment for aerospace, defense, or other regulated industries.

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

• Experience in scaling supplier capabilities and quality from prototype and proof-of-concept parts to low-rate production to high-rate production. Experience performing source inspection at manufacturing suppliers, particularly in aerospace and defense, is a plus. Experience flowing down source control requirements to suppliers.

• Experience driving supplier performance and evaluation. Experience with Statement of Work (SOW), quality clauses, intellectual property (IP), and government regulations such as ITAR.

• Demonstrated, hands-on experience implementing, maintaining, and being audited against an AS9100 certified Quality Management System.

• Proficiency in root cause analysis methodologies (8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.) and implementing effective corrective actions.

• Experience leading First Article Inspections (FAIs) per AS9102.

• Strong understanding of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) and the ability to interpret complex engineering drawings.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Direct, hands-on experience with NavSea standards and requirements (e.g., SUBSAFE, NAVSEA S9074-AQ-GIB-010/248 for welding, material control specifications, technical publication adherence).

• Experience in the production of maritime systems, including unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs), autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs), or related pressure vessel and submersible hardware.

• Experience with quality control for special processes such as composite fabrication, welding, complex electro-mechanical assembly, and environmental/pressure testing.

• ASQ certification (Certified Quality Engineer - CQE, Certified Quality Auditor - CQA) or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification.

• Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

• Experience in a fast-paced, high-mix, rapid development environment where speed and rigor must coexist.

• Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software.

US Salary Range

$117,000—$154,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. jobs.description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.



Role Overview

We are seeking a Staff Backend Software Engineer to design, build, and scale the backend systems that power our flight safety platform. In this role, you will take ownership of backend services, APIs, and data pipelines, balancing hands-on development with technical leadership. You’ll work closely with product and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable systems that support mission-critical, real-world applications.

What You’ll Do

 - Architect, build, and maintain backend services and distributed systems that support mission-critical applications.

 - Design and implement secure, scalable APIs for internal and external integrations, including real-time data streaming and support for web and mobile clients.

 - Build and optimize data pipelines for efficient ingestion, processing, and access to time-series and multimedia data.

 - Own backend system reliability, performance, and scalability in production environments.

 - Lead technical design discussions and contribute to code reviews and architectural decisions.

 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex backend and cloud infrastructure issues to ensure high availability.

 - Take ownership of backend features or systems from concept through delivery, working closely with product and cross-functional partners.

What Will Make You Successful

 - 9+ years of experience designing and implementing backend services, APIs, and distributed systems in production environments.

 - Fluency in modern backend languages such as Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js http://node.js).

 - Proven experience building, scaling, and operating backend infrastructure.

 - Strong ownership mindset, with experience driving end-to-end systems and features from design through deployment.

 - Ability to operate effectively in evolving environments while maintaining high standards for quality and reliability.

 - Experience building or working with data pipelines and backend systems handling large-scale or real-time data.

Bonus Points

 - Passion for aviation and a desire to improve air travel efficiency and safety.

 - Familiarity with machine learning workflows or data-intensive systems.

 - Experience working with big data tools or large-scale data processing frameworks.

 - Background in DevOps or DevSecOps, including automating infrastructure and improving system reliability and security.

Work Location
This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.
