jobs.title: Customer Service Rep(02604) 1918 165th St
jobs.description:
Customer Service Rep  Job Description

ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

• Must be 18 years of age or older
• Must be willing and able to work all stations in-store, such as making menu items, assisting customers on the phone and in-store, and expediting orders from the cut table

REQUIRED FUNCTIONS, SKILLS, AND DUITIES FOR ALL POSITIONS:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone communication skills to take and process orders.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Operate all store equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare products.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

WORK  CONDITIONS MAY INCLUDE EXPOSURE TO:

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions.

In-store temperatures ranging from 33 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in the work area and while outside.

Fumes from artificial and natural scents or odors from food, gases, air fresheners, etc.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Confined spaces, such as a walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces, tools, and products from the oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

REQUIRED MENTAL AND PHYSICAL ABILITIES (Including, but not limited to the following):

SENSING

The ability to speak, hear, and understand verbal communication on telephone and in person is necessary.

Near and mid-range vision is used for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception in necessary for all positions.

Personnel must have the ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

Far vision and night vision are needed for delivery personnel.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions is necessary throughout shifts.

STANDING

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking surfaces include ceramic tile, concrete, or linoleum in some food process areas.

Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

WALKING

Walking is frequently required for short distances and short durations.

Personnel must travel between the store and customer vehicles.

Delivery personnel must travel between delivery vehicles/e-bikes and from the delivery vehicle/e-bike to the customer's location.

SITTING

Paperwork is normally completed while sitting.

Driving to and from deliveries or meetings requires sitting.

LIFTING

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team members on duty during the deliveries.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from the floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

CARRYING

Dough trays weigh approximately 12 pounds, cases of products weighing up to 25 pounds, and prepped items may need to be carried from the walk-in cooler to the make-line.

Items such as cases of pizza sauce, weighing 30 pounds, may occasionally need to be carried from the storage area to the prep area, and from the prep area to the front of the store.

During delivery, carrying products while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties may be required.

PUSHING/PULLING

This may be required to move trays or products placed on dollies, or to move empty trays or trash cans.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

CLIMBING

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change air fresheners, clean walls, or perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

BENDING/CROUCHING/SQUATTING

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is generally less than one minute and may be repeated frequently.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking items.

REACHING

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven, heat lamp, or television controls, and to lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reach down to perform tasks such as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

HAND TASKS

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Activities frequently require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the different pizza cutters.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter, the pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPTMENT, AND WORK AIDS

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutters, and pizza peels, and scales.

A24 is seeking an attorney to join our Legal and Business Affairs team to lead the legal work behind the financing of our film and television projects. We are looking for a motivated self-starter with a strong interest in film and television finance, distribution, and intellectual property, as well as general corporate legal matters. This role will work closely with A24’s finance and production teams and the broader Legal and Business Affairs team, providing clear, efficient, and contextualized legal counsel. Additionally, you will build strong working relationships with A24’s key external partners, including banks and co-financiers. This role is based in Los Angeles or New York.

Initial Responsibilities

• Manage all legal aspects related to the financing of the company’s film and TV projects, including its credit facilities

• Draft and negotiate key film and TV agreements, including co-financing agreements, distributor notices of assignment and tax incentive agreements

• Provide practical, day-to-day business and legal advice to internal business teams, including finance, production, accounting, and A24 Labs

• Manage or actively participate in internal initiatives and committees relating to intellectual property, technology and AI

• Help develop and streamline legal processes and templates to support A24’s fast-paced environment

• Contribute toward improving deal parameters, deal memo templates, long-form agreements, contract management and precedent-tracking systems and other departmental resources, processes and procedures

• Establish and maintain key internal and external stakeholder relationships with regular, effective and timely communications concerning deal negotiation and business strategy

Qualifications

• J.D. Degree; Member in good standing of New York or California bar

• 5+ years of transactional experience (with at least 2 years in the corporate/transactional department of a major US law firm and 2 years working in-house at an entertainment, media or technology company)

• Demonstrated experience working in the area of film and television finance, including with credit facilities and equity co-financing arrangements

• Outstanding written and oral communication skills across a wide range of seniority levels and styles in a fast-paced environment (including the ability to explain legal concepts to internal and external partners)

• Business-minded, collaborative, adaptable, and proactive approach

• Sound judgment, strong interpersonal and organizational skills, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

• Ability to pick up new concepts quickly and thrive in a fast-paced, creative environment

• Knowledge of intellectual property as it relates to entertainment

• Humble, diligent, resourceful

We are looking for diverse perspectives. A24 is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages applications from all kinds of candidates.

Our target salary range for this role is between $200,000 to $230,000. We do not use formal job titles internally and similarly named positions may have different compensation levels. Actual starting salary within the range will depend on various considerations, including: work experience, skills, specializations, and training. This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, including both cash and equity components, competitive healthcare, as well as other employee benefits.

A24 is an acclaimed global entertainment company known for producing and distributing films, television series, documentaries, music, publishing, and consumer products. Established in New York in 2012, A24 has cultivated a library of over 150 films and 50 TV series, earning critical and commercial acclaim with more than 21 Oscars, 20 Golden Globes, and 19 Emmys. Renowned for groundbreaking hits like Moonlight, Everything Everywhere All at Once, Backrooms, and You Can See Everything as well as television successes such as Euphoria, Beef, and Ramy, A24 has developed a passionate fanbase and expanded into ventures like Half Magic and the Cherry Lane Theatre.

jobs.title: General Manager(04476) - 10555 NC Highway 8
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically general managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance& punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile"bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Chorus Innovations is a fast-growing healthcare technology company with an adaptive platform as a service (PaaS) that enables the rapid development of mobile, desktop, text messaging and interactive voice applications. Chorus’ platform currently powers transformative healthcare, biomedical research and community health projects across institutions and public health agencies nationwide. We believe every community should have world-class health technology so they can thrive.

Our mission is to improve the lives of people and communities by democratizing technology development in health and research.

About the Role

Chorus builds an AI-first healthcare SaaS platform for behavioral health specialists and beyond. We are hiring Staff Platform Engineers who treat that opportunity seriously: apply modern LLM and agent-harness techniques without trading away systems correctness.

You are a hands-on technical backbone for the platform. You design durable, multi-tenant systems. You ship them across the stack. You encode how they work — RFCs, engineering docs, Skills, Runbooks, and agent context — so hungry engineers (and midtier coding agents) can move fast without creating vibe-coded slop.

This is documentation-first, not code-first. Syntax is cheap. Understanding the problem, designing the contract, and leaving a system that others can learn and extend is the job. You get high leverage from midtier models (for example Cursor Auto, Haiku/Sonnet-class, Composer-class) through strong harnesses — not by blasting maximal models for high-speed volume.

Your impact shows up as velocity with correctness: reusable platform building blocks (modules, SDKs, UI kits, Skills/Runbooks) that make the next engineer (and the next agent session) 10x — not heroics that only you can repeat.

This role carries a high mentorship burden. You are a primary technical guide for Senior Platform Engineers and for Implementation Engineer (IE) teams across the product line squads. You still ship hard yourself — and you spend real time raising others’ ceiling through pairing, review, design coaching, and durable docs.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Own platform systems end-to-end: Design, build, and maintain shared platform capabilities that product teams and tenants depend on — data models and migrations, NestJS/GraphQL BFFs, ui-kits and control-plane (ACP) surfaces, tests, and rollout safety. You work full-stack when the system requires it.

• Carry high mentorship load for Seniors and IEs Guide Senior Platform Engineers on systems design, documentation-first delivery, and AI harness craft. Guide Implementation Engineer teams on how to reuse shared modules, SDKs, and UI kits safely: permissions, lifecycle, tenant vs platform lanes, and when to escalate to an RFC. Expect substantial time in pairing, design review, and PR review — mentorship is part of the job, not an afterthought.

• Design before you code Define the problem and the correctness properties first (permissions, lifecycle, view-state, layouts, auth boundaries). Write RFCs and contracts that other engineers can implement against. Prefer durable abstractions over one-off feature patches.

• Encode knowledge at discovery Leave systems easy to learn. Capture decisions in engineering docs, Skills, Runbooks, and agent_context so humans and agents enforce the same rules. Prefer machine-readable enabling constraints over tribal knowledge.

• Practice AI harness craft Use AI-assisted development as a force multiplier with judgment. Use and improve Skills/Runbooks; contribute new harness artifacts when work recurs. Prompt and review with security, performance, and domain correctness in mind. Teach Seniors and IEs the same discipline. Reject high-speed slop — volume without understanding is not velocity.

• Force-multiply the organization Ship reusable platform building blocks — shared modules, SDKs, UI kits, generators, and Skills/Runbooks — so product and IE teams do not reinvent the same capability. Coach through pairing, heavy review, and durable artifacts. Make yourself replaceable in specific domains by teaching patterns, not by gatekeeping them.

• Operational excellence across tenants Own reliability for what you ship: migrations, authz, observability, staged rollouts, and recovery. Healthcare and multi-tenant blast radius are first-class concerns.

• Cross-functional technical leadership Translate tradeoffs for product, clinical solutions, QA, and delivery. Align on domain vocabulary (care objects, programs, roles, statuses) so the platform stays coherent as it grows

What We’re Looking For

• Deep systems experience 9+ years building and operating complex systems. Proven ownership of cross-cutting platform work — not only feature tickets in a single app layer.

• Systems design + strong writing You define the problem accurately, write clear design docs, and treat documentation as part of delivery. You can explain complex models in plain language without hiding the complexity.

• Full-stack platform fluency Comfort across backend service design, relational data modeling, GraphQL/API boundaries, and pragmatic React UIs for staff and admin users. You bring opinions grounded in production experience.

• AI-forward with craft, not theater Experience (or clear aptitude) driving delivery with AI coding tools under a real harness: Skills, Runbooks, review discipline, and midtier-model leverage. You optimize for maintainable outcomes, not token throughput.

• High-bandwidth mentor for Seniors and IEs Proven ability to level up Senior engineers and Implementation / delivery engineers at the same time you ship. You leave pairing, reviews, RFCs, and harness docs — not advice that disappears when the chat ends. You are energized by a high mentorship burden, not drained into pure people-management.

• Change agent with judgment You escalate based on triggers (recurrence, blast radius, cognitive load, correctness, governance drift), then build infrastructure that prevents the class of problem — per The Chorus Engineer doctrines.

• Domain curiosity Interest in healthcare SaaS, behavioral health workflows, and regulated multi-tenant platforms is a strong plus. You do not need to be a clinician; you do need respect for clinical vocabulary and access control.

Expected Technical Stack

We expect Staff Platform Engineers to be comfortable working across the full stack and to bring strong opinions grounded in experience. This role requires disciplined software design, a strong grasp of object-oriented and modular architecture, and comfort working in dependency-injected systems.

Backend

• Node.js with TypeScript

• NestJS for service and API development, with a strong understanding of dependency injection and inversion of control patterns

• Mastery of SOLID principles, including how they apply in real production systems rather than as theoretical concepts

• Experience designing systems using DI/IoC-driven architectures, including: Proper service boundaries Interface-driven design Testable and replaceable components

• PostgreSQL with strong relational modeling practices (3NF/BCNF) and attention to data integrity, constraints, and normalization

• MikroORM for schema definition and migrations, with an understanding of how ORM abstractions map to real SQL behavior

• GraphQL APIs, including schema design, resolver composition, and performance considerations

• REST APIs where appropriate for infrastructure concerns, integrations, or simpler service boundarie

• Python + DLT (data load tool) for creating and managing data pipelines when platform data movement requires it

Frontend

• React with TypeScript

• Material UI and Emotion for component development and styling

• Strong understanding of component composition, state management, and performance considerations

• Comfort building staff-facing and admin/control-plane UIs that encode platform configuration

Platform and Tooling

• Nx monorepo tooling

• Docker and Kubernetes for local and deployed environments

• AWS infrastructure including managed databases, identity, and networking

• CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar

• Agent harnesses: Skills, Runbooks, MCP-backed workflows, and repo agent context

Engineering Practices

• Domain-driven design concepts and practical application

• Documentation-first delivery (RFC/ADR → implementation → encode for agents and humans)

• Strong SQL fundamentals and database design

• Testing at multiple levels, including unit and integration / DB-backed tests

• Experience designing systems meant to be extended by other teams and by AI agents under human authority

Nice to Have

• Computer-science fundamentals Deep computer-science fundamentals (systems, data structures, concurrency, networking) — whether from a CS or related degree or equivalent self-directed study. Formal CS education is a plus; self-trained candidates who already know how computers work are welcome.

Why Join Us?

• Work on important, meaningful problems in healthcare

• Shape the foundation of a platform that will power dozens (eventually hundreds) of applications

• Collaborate with a team that values design, pragmatism, and velocity

• Competitive compensation, equity, and full benefits

jobs.description:

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask. You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come.  You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got.

Apply now!

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From assistant manager to general manager, general manager to franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value, and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential. .

Operate all equipment. Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler. Prepare product. Receive and process telephone orders. Take inventory and complete associated paperwork. Clean equipment and facility approximately daily. Training Orientation and training provided on the job. Communication Skills Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions. Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person. Essential Functions/Skills Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change. Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen. Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area. Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks. Exposure to cornmeal dust. Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler. Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher. Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts. Standing

Walking

Sitting

• Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Carrying

• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Climbing

• Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Crouching/Squatting

• Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
• Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

• Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. ABOUT THE ROLE

Skydio is seeking an experienced physical security professional to join our team as Solutions Engineer – Commercial Site Security. Commercial Solutions Engineering is the technical arm of Skydio's commercial go-to-market motion. We sit between the customer and the product: translating industrial and security problems into deployable programs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are integrated and flown at scale across sites that were never designed with drones in mind.

Coverage is tiered by customer size rather than by territory, so the team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion inside existing accounts, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Account Executives, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of commercial sUAS programs. Internally you are, in every sense, the voice of the customer.

This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 50 to 75% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

This role reports to Senior Manager, Commercial – Site Security.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Commercial Solutions Engineering is the technical arm of Skydio's commercial go-to-market motion. We sit between the customer and the product: translating industrial and security problems into deployable programs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are integrated and flown at scale across sites that were never designed with drones in mind.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Validate supported VMS, intrusion detection, and access-control workflows with enterprise customer IT and integration partners.

 - Own site assessment quality for accounts. Solutions Engineers are the responsible individual for verifying dock placement prior to deployment along with power and networking requirements.

 - Coordinate operating approvals and BVLOS, multi-drone, and other waiver requirements for the airspace and operations your customer falls under.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GOOD FIT

 - 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial security operations, security systems integration, or customer-facing technical roles serving enterprise security teams.

 - Practical understanding of perimeter protection, alarm verification, SOC/GSOC workflows, guard operations, and incident response.

 - Experience deploying and supporting physical security technology, with the ability to troubleshoot hardware, connectivity, video, and configuration issues.

 - Strong understanding of drone technology, sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance.

 - Excellent problem solving skills and the ability to think critically in high-pressure situations.

 - Ability to manage concurrent opportunities within a Sales organization, prioritize technical effort, and coordinate customer and partner commitments.

 - Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with Dock based drone security operations, dock based remote operations, or counter-UAS programs

 - Hands-on experience with enterprise VMS platforms such as Fusus, Genetec, or Milestone and alarm or access-control integrations.

 - Experience with security analytics, thermal imagery, API’s, or event-drive integrations.

 - Familiarity with technical limitations of detection systems and the regulatory limits on counter-drone mitigation.

 - Experience deploying security programs across multiple facilities or working with managed security and drone service providers.


WHAT IS REQUIRED

 - FAA Part 107 Certificate or obtained within 60 days of hire.

 - Ability to travel 50% to 75% of the time.

 - Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAN FRANCISCO COMPUTE

San Francisco Compute (SFC) exists to give ambitious teams large scale supercomputers without taking on a catastrophic balance sheet risk. We are building the next generation of AI infrastructure, making large-scale GPU computing more accessible, flexible, and financially sustainable.

Unlike traditional GPU cloud providers, SFC combines supercomputer development and operations with an innovative compute marketplace, giving customers the flexibility to scale without the risks of rigid, long-term contracts.

We are a fast-growing team of ambitious, technically driven people working to shape the future of AI infrastructure.  Our leadership team brings deep experience from Lambda, Crusoe, AWS, DigitalOcean, Hut 8, and Voltage Park, with a track record of deploying 8GW of data center capacity and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

There has never been a more critical moment in history, and it is up to us to shape it on behalf of those who come after us. If you're excited by complex challenges, bold ideas, and meaningful impact, we'd love to meet you.

About The Role

We're looking to hire a product engineer who ships end-to-end: someone who understands our customers, decides what's worth building, and takes it from rough idea to polished, production-ready experience. You care about quality and craft, but you're just as energized by figuring out what to build and why. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and design to ship features that move the business forward, and you'll have real ownership over the problems you take on.

What You Will Do

 - Own features and product areas end-to-end, from understanding the customer problem through shipping and iterating

 - Partner closely with product and design to turn rough ideas into shippable, delightful experiences

 - Build high-quality interfaces with attention to interaction, visual detail, and performance under real usage

 - Work across the stack where needed to deliver the full experience, not just the UI layer

 - Use customer feedback, usage data, and business context to decide what to build next and what to cut

 - Make sound technical decisions that scale with the product, and raise the bar for quality on the team

Who You Are

 - You have 8+ years experience in Engineering

 - You think in terms of customer problems and business outcomes, not just tickets

 - You've shipped meaningful product features end-to-end and can describe the impact they had

 - You have strong opinions about product quality and can point to specific things you'd fix in products you use every day

 - You're comfortable moving between frontend and backend to get something shipped

 - You have solid expertise in a modern JS framework (React, Vue, Svelte, or SolidJS) and are comfortable in a typed backend language

 - You have good product judgment and can make sensible tradeoffs with limited direction, and you know when to ask for help

 - You care about craft: your work is functional and also genuinely good

Nice To Have

 - Startup or early-stage experience where you wore a product-thinking hat alongside an engineering one

 - Experience shipping to external customers and connecting that work to business goals

 - Experience in developer tools, infrastructure, or technically-dense product spaces

 - Strong frontend craft in areas like motion, real-time data, or complex interactions




BENEFITS





GENEROUS EQUITY GRANT

Team members are offered a competitive salary along with equity in the company




RETIREMENT MATCHING

We match 401(k) plans up to 4%




MEDICAL, DENTAL & VISION

We offer highly competitive medical, dental, vision insurance for employees and dependents.




TIME OFF

We offer unlimited paid time off as well as 10+ observed holidays




PARENTAL LEAVE

We offer biological, adoptive, and foster parents paid time off to spend quality time with family




DAILY LUNCH

We cover lunch daily for employees




UNLIMITED OFFICE BOOK BUDGET

You can buy as many books for the office as you want



The San Francisco Compute Company is committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment.



We make employment decisions based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, belief, national origin, social or ethical origin, age, physical, mental, or sensory disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, HIV status, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status including pregnancy, or any other status protected by law.



We welcome the opportunity to consider qualified applicants with prior arrest or conviction records. Our commitment to diversity includes hiring talented individuals regardless of their criminal history, in accordance with local, state, and federal laws, including San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance and California’s ban-the-box laws.

jobs.description:

Location: Tennessee | Hybrid (In-Person & Telehealth)

BUILD YOUR PRACTICE. WE'LL HELP YOU GROW IT.



What if you could build your own BCBA caseload without having to find clients, recruit RBTs, or manage the administrative work behind every case?

At Tellos ABA Therapy, we're a BCBA and parent-founded organization helping BCBAs build and grow their practices with clinical autonomy and a dedicated operations team behind them.

You choose which available cases to accept, how many clients you take on, and how quickly you want to grow. Whether you're looking for a few additional clients or a full caseload, we help you find families, recruit your RBT team, and handle the operations.

This hybrid opportunity combines in-person services with telehealth when clinically appropriate and permitted by payer requirements.




YOU LEAD THE CLINICAL CARE

 - Choose your cases, caseload size, and schedule based on your availability and clinical interests.

 - Conduct assessments and develop individualized, evidence-based treatment plans.

 - Make clinical decisions, monitor progress, and adjust programming based on client needs and data.

 - Select, supervise, and mentor the RBTs supporting your cases.

 - Collaborate with caregivers through ongoing communication and parent training.

 - Maintain timely clinical documentation and uphold BACB ethical standards.




WE HANDLE THE OPERATIONS

 - Client Referrals: Connect you with families seeking ABA services and manage the intake process.

 - Dedicated RBT Recruitment: Actively source, screen, and present RBT candidates for your open cases. You make the final decision on clinical fit.

 - RBT Onboarding & Payroll: Coordinate onboarding, employment administration, and payroll for your RBT team.

 - Credentialing & Authorizations: Manage insurance credentialing, authorizations, and reauthorizations with your clinical input.

 - Billing & Claims: Handle claims submission, insurance follow-up, and payment processing.

 - Administrative Support: Provide scheduling coordination, technology, and operational support.

There's no fee, buy-in, or upfront investment required to begin partnering with Tellos.




COMPENSATION

 - Earning Potential: $125,000+ annually, depending on caseload volume, reimbursement, and services delivered. 

 - BCBA Services: Earn a share of insurance reimbursement for eligible services you personally provide.

 - RBT Services: Earn additional compensation tied to eligible direct therapy hours delivered by RBTs on your team.

You can partner with Tellos as an individual contractor or through your own LLC.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Active BCBA certification in good standing with the BACB.

 - Master's degree in ABA, Psychology, Education, or a related field.

 - Tennessee behavior analyst licensure, or eligibility to obtain it before providing services.

 - Completion of the BACB's 8-hour supervision training, or willingness to complete it before supervising RBTs.

 - Based in Tennessee and available for in-person services within the applicable service area.

 - Experience conducting assessments, developing treatment plans, and supervising RBTs.

 - Strong clinical judgment, communication, documentation, and organizational skills.

 - Commitment to ethical, family-centered, evidence-based care.






READY TO BUILD YOUR PRACTICE?

You lead the care. We help you build everything around it.

Apply today to learn what your practice could look like with Tellos.

We believe in hiring people, not resumes. If you’re excited by Tellos’s mission but unsure if you meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply, we’d love to learn what you’d bring to the team.

Title Customer Service Rep

Job Description
ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
Prepare product. Receive and process telephone orders
Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

Additional Job Details PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 4.

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 - 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

 - Experience supporting production ramp-ups and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, ideally within a startup or high-growth technology company.

jobs.title: Global Investigator, Asset Recovery
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Scam Investigations team is TRM’s tip of the spear against pig butchering syndicates, romance fraud networks, and investment scam operations that steal billions from victims each year. The team operates an integrated workflow — from AI-supported complaint triage to time-sensitive investigation, escalation, and recovery support for victims.

As a Global Investigator, you will work at the recovery-focused layer of scam investigation. You will validate high-priority blockchain leads, conduct forward and backward tracing, assess whether funds touch regulated platforms or other actionable endpoints, and produce clear investigative documentation that supports time-sensitive escalation and victim-centered recovery outcomes.

The impact you will have here:

 - Support time-sensitive asset-preservation workflows with regulated platforms and ecosystem partners.

 - Own the recovery side. After a freeze, run the backtrace that ties frozen funds to specific victims and produce the documentation that drives restitution. The freeze is the start. Victim recovery is the goal.

 - Trace victim funds end-to-end — forward to the wallets that consolidate them, backward to the platforms they came from. Your work feeds directly into the legal packages that recover them.

 - Validate time-sensitive blockchain signals and move high-confidence matters through the appropriate escalation workflow. Speed and accuracy both matter.

 - Continuously learn new issues in crypto

 - Support other teams on time sensitive issues that might be unforeseen

 - React timely to the movement of funds during an ongoing investigation

What we’re looking for:

 - Location / citizenship / clearance — placeholder, varies by region (NA seats: US Citizenship required, ability to obtain Public Trust clearance, US-based). EMEA / APAC seat requirements TBD by region.

 - AI fluency (required) — you use AI tools in your workflow to synthesize returns, draft outputs, and accelerate analysis, with examples of how AI has impacted your work.

 - Blockchain / cryptocurrency tracing (required, gating) — forward-then-backward trace, exchange attribution, co-mingling handling, multi-hop VASP tracing, and LIFO/FIFO backtrace for recovery work. Non-negotiable.

 - Creative tactical thinking — demonstrated ability to pivot from a single point to a network view, identifying operators behind operations.

 - Experience producing investigative packages that can support formal legal, compliance, or enforcement workflows.

 - You think in outcomes, not lanes. If “that’s not what I was hired for” is a sentence you reach for, this isn’t the seat.

 - You don’t need a checklist to start. Handed something you’ve never seen, you figure out the first move and take it. When the playbook stops, you keep going.

 - 3–5 years of cryptocurrency investigations or asset-recovery experience — law enforcement crypto units, blockchain analytics firms, exchange compliance investigations, or equivalent. You understand how regulated platforms behave under request, including the difference between voluntary cooperation and formal process, and you treat getting money back to victims as part of your job rather than a downstream handoff.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Surge availability expected during time-sensitive disruption windows

 - All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

 - Weekly team syncs

 - Daily shift handoff call

 - Daily monitoring shift

Team operating rhythms:

 - High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy — work directly with engineering, analysts, legal counterparts, and partners who depend on the team’s output.

 - Distributed, async-first via Slack and Notion, with structured syncs for alignment.

 - Follow-the-sun rotation — the team runs investigators across NA, EMEA, and APAC for around-the-clock coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

 - Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

 - Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. jobs.title: Turbomachinery Design Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Role:

As a Turbomachinery Design Engineer, you will own the mechanical design of turbomachinery components and assemblies for Antares nuclear reactors. You will develop hardware from early layouts and architecture trades through detailed CAD, drawings, manufacturing, assembly, and testing. You will work closely with turbomachinery engineers, analysts, manufacturing engineers, and suppliers throughout development.

The ideal candidate has experience designing complex mechanical hardware and strong skills in CAD, engineering drawings, GD&T, materials, and manufacturing processes. You can make practical design tradeoffs that balance performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and schedule.



Roles & Responsibilities:

 - Own the mechanical design and detailed definition of turbomachinery components and assemblies.

 - Develop 3D CAD models, assemblies, and production drawings for rotating and stationary turbomachinery hardware.

 - Support architecture and packaging trades through rapid iteration of 2D and 3D layouts.

 - Evaluate materials, manufacturing processes, interfaces, assembly methods, and design concepts during early development.

 - Work with aerodynamic, structural, rotordynamics, thermal, manufacturing, and test engineers to develop integrated designs.

 - Work directly with suppliers and internal manufacturing teams to resolve producibility, inspection, assembly, and nonconformance issues.

 - Improve existing designs to reduce cost, lead time, part count, and manufacturing complexity.

 - Incorporate lessons from manufacturing, assembly, and test into design updates.

 - Support the design of test hardware, tooling, fixtures, and development rigs.

 - Contribute to turbomachinery design practices and standards for CAD, drawings, producibility, and reliability.

Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline.

 - 3+ years of professional experience designing complex mechanical hardware and assemblies.

 - Strong proficiency in 3D CAD and engineering drawing creation.

 - Strong working knowledge of GD&T and ASME Y14.5.

 - Ability to perform first-principles engineering calculations to support mechanical design decisions.

 - Experience working directly with manufacturing engineers, machinists, suppliers, or inspectors to resolve hardware issues.

 - Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information clearly.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - Master’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline.

 - Experience designing turbomachinery for gas turbines, turbochargers, rocket engine turbopumps, or similar high-performance applications.

 - Expert proficiency with NX for 3D CAD design and drafting.

 - Experience performing tolerance stack-up analysis and defining fits, clearances, and assembly interfaces for precision rotating machinery.

 - Proficiency with ANSYS Mechanical.

 - Knowledge of manufacturing processes including turning, milling, drilling, grinding, EDM, brazing, welding, casting, and additive manufacturing.

 - Experience supporting suppliers through manufacturing development and production.

 - Strong organizational and communication skills.

Additional Requirements:

 - Flexibility to support hardware development milestones, including occasional weekend or long-hour pushes.

Salary Range:

 - Turbomachinery Engineer II - $118,000 - $155,000

 - Senior Turbomachinery Engineer - $155,000 - $205,000

Leveling is determined during the interviews and can change over time. 



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.

jobs.title: Senior IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
About Arkestro

Arkestro's Predictive Procurement Platform applies AI, game theory, and behavioral science to enterprise negotiations. It moves teams away from reactive supplier bidding toward data-driven offers that reduce friction and help both buyers and suppliers reach better outcomes faster.

Arkestro helps procurement teams influence more enterprise spend and uncover savings that traditional sourcing approaches often leave behind by applying predictive intelligence to how sourcing events are designed and executed.

We’re a hyper-growth company looking for people who take ownership and are comfortable working through complexity. This is a tremendous opportunity if you want to do meaningful work and help shape how large enterprises run procurement… Arkestro is a place where you can have a big impact. See Arkestro in action at arkestro.com.

About This Role

We're looking for a proactive and detail-oriented individual who can own day-to-day IT support and operations - joining our growing team of people as we scale. This role is critical to enabling our team to work efficiently and securely. You'll work closely with our Lead Security Engineer and VP of Engineering.

Responsibilities

Device & Asset Management

• Manage end-to-end laptop lifecycle using Rippling including procurement, configuration, deployment, and retirement

• Maintain accurate asset inventory and tracking across all company devices

• Configure and deploy standardized device images with security controls and required software

• Coordinate device shipping and logistics for our remote-first team

• Handle device troubleshooting, repairs, and replacements

User Support & Access Management

• Process access requests through Jira Service Desk with appropriate approval workflows

• Perform user onboarding and offboarding procedures including account provisioning and deprovisioning

• Handle password resets, account lockouts, and basic user support issues

• Maintain accurate user directories and access controls across all systems

• Lead the rollout of single sign-on (SSO) across all company applications, including SAML and OIDC integrations and SCIM provisioning

• Provide technical support and guidance to team members as needed

General IT Support

• Deploy and manage SentinelOne across all endpoints with proper configuration and monitoring

• Plan, deploy, and maintain the company VPN, including client rollout, access policies, and documentation

• Implement and maintain security policies and procedures

• Monitor and respond to security alerts and incidents

• Assist with security audits and assessments

• Ensure proper access controls on sensitive data repositories

• Monitor and audit data access and sharing practices

• Maintain data inventory and processing records for compliance purposes

• Own projects to improve our data security e.g. review and implement policies around PII (Personally Identifiable Information); data classification and retention policies etc.

Process Improvement & Automation

• Drive completion of IT-related tasks across the organization through effective communication and follow-up

• Plan and lead IT projects as they come up, from scoping and vendor selection through rollout to employees

• Identify opportunities to automate routine IT processes and workflows

• Maintain documentation for IT procedures, policies, and system configurations

• Participate in incident response and business continuity planning

Technologies and tools we use

• Device Management: Rippling for laptop lifecycle management and configuration

• Security & Compliance: Drata for SOC 2 and ISO27001 compliance, SentinelOne for endpoint security

• Service Management: Jira Service Desk for access requests and IT ticketing

• Collaboration: Google Workspace (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Meet), Zoom; Office 365

• Communication: Slack, with integrations across our tech stack

• Identity & Access: Single sign-on (SSO) and multi-factor authentication (MFA)

• AI: ChatGPT, Claude

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or IT operations roles

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with device management platforms (Rippling preferred, but Jamf, Intune, or similar acceptable)

• 3+ years of experience with Google Workspace administration

• 2+ years of experience with endpoint security solutions (SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, or similar)

• Proven experience with IT service management principles and advanced ticketing system workflows (Jira Service Desk)

• Strong background in access management, identity governance, and user lifecycle management

• Hands-on experience deploying and administering a company VPN and network infrastructure, including firewalls, DNS, and DHCP

• Hands-on experience implementing SSO across SaaS applications using SAML, OIDC, and SCIM provisioning

• Demonstrated ability to lead IT initiatives and drive process improvements

• Excellent communication skills with experience training and mentoring non-technical team members

• Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities

• Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments

Bonus Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in high-growth SaaS companies or technology startups

• Experience with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) and implementation

• Advanced scripting and automation experience (Python, PowerShell, Bash)

• Background in vendor management and IT procurement processes

• Experience with enterprise-grade backup and disaster recovery solutions

Pay Range

$110,000—$140,000 USD

Arkestro is committed to providing our employees with a benefits package designed to give you the flexibility you need to ensure a healthy life/work balance. Arkestro offers our employees great benefits and perks, including, but not limited to:

• Competitive salary and startup equity

• Medical, Dental, Vision insurance premiums covered up to 100% (employee only)

• 401K discretionary employer matching

• Unlimited PTO

• A remote-first team with regular opportunities to get together in person for team building, design sprints, and customer visits

• Annual budget of $1,000 for learning and professional development

• Diverse, inclusive, highly collaborative, and vibrant culture

Arkestro is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Disclaimer

Please note this job description may not be inclusive of all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described and that additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands. Arkestro reserves the right to change duties, responsibilities and activities at any time with or without notice.
