jobs.title: Senior Piping Stress Design Engineer (PCS)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Role

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Antares, you will own the design, analysis, and integration of high-temperature, high-pressure piping systems within our Power Conversion System (PCS). Your scope includes the piping connecting turbomachinery, heat exchangers, and other major components of our closed Brayton cycle, ensuring structural integrity, thermal compatibility, and reliable operation across all operating conditions.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience in piping design and stress analysis, understands the challenges of thermal expansion, vibration, and pressure loading, and is comfortable taking designs from initial layout through detailed engineering, manufacturing, and testing.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the design, layout, and mechanical integration of PCS piping systems, including piping specifications, supports, expansion joints, and component interfaces.

 - Perform piping stress and structural analyses under sustained, thermal expansion, transient, vibration, and fatigue loading conditions.

 - Evaluate piping loads on connected equipment, including turbomachinery, heat exchangers, pressure vessels, and supporting structures.

 - Develop detailed piping designs, engineering calculations, specifications, drawings, and documentation in accordance with applicable ASME codes and standards.

 - Work closely with thermal, mechanical, structural, and systems engineers to optimize piping configuration, pressure losses, manufacturability, and overall system integration.

 - Support hardware procurement, fabrication, assembly, testing, and troubleshooting, including working directly with suppliers and technicians.




BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

 - 5+ years of relevant experience for Senior level; 8+ years for Staff level.

 - Experience designing high-temperature and/or high-pressure piping systems for industrial or power generation applications.

 - Proficiency in piping stress analysis, including thermal expansion, support reactions, and equipment nozzle loads.

 - Familiarity with piping design codes such as ASME B31.3 or B31.1.

 - Experience developing and reviewing piping layouts, P&IDs, engineering drawings, and fabrication documentation.




PREFERRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Experience in Nuclear, Power Generation, Oil & Gas, Aerospace, or other high-performance thermal-fluid systems.

 - Proficiency with piping stress analysis tools such as CAESAR II, AutoPIPE, or equivalent, and familiarity with FEA tools.

 - Experience with piping vibration, pulsation, acoustic loading, water hammer, and fatigue assessment.

 - Experience designing pipe supports, flexible connections, expansion joints, and high-temperature piping interfaces.

 - Familiarity with ASME BPVC requirements, including Section III, and applicable nuclear quality standards.

 - Hands-on experience supporting fabrication, installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of complex piping systems.

 - Experience working in a fast-paced hardware development environment.

Location:

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000-square-foot, brand-new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access

Salary Range:

 - Senior Mechanical Engineer - $155,000 - $205,000



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.  - Define the mechanical arrangement, maintenance architecture including skid or module arrangement, supports, anchors, and alignment of the rotating machinery, accounting for thermal growth, machinery loads, safety, transport, and seismic conditions.

 - Manage mechanical interfaces to major PCS components, reactor, and safety systems.

 - Experience designing hardware for elevated-temperature or high-stress service, including material selection

 - Experience working the mechanical interfaces between multiple components integrated into a single assembly

Location:

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, New York
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We are seeking a dynamic Manager, Sales for the Tech & Telco verticals to join our growing sales team at Discord. This role is a people leadership position, responsible for leading a team of Account Executives while also driving strategic initiatives and revenue growth within Tech & Telco clients.

As a Manager, Sales you will play a critical role in coaching and developing your team, developing and executing sales strategies, managing senior-level client relationships, and working cross-functionally to advocate for Tech & Telo needs. You will also be active in the market, representing Discord at key industry events and working directly with clients to help them achieve their marketing goals using our ad solutions.

This role is ideal for a highly motivated leader with a strong background in digital advertising, media sales, and account strategy who thrives in a fast-paced, zero-to-one environment.

What you'll be doing:

Leadership & Team Management

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Account Executives to achieve individual and team revenue goals. Team size may grow based on business needs.

• Establish a high-performance sales culture with a focus on coaching, collaboration, and professional growth. Partner with the Sr. Director, Sales to refine sales processes, set KPIs, and optimize team performance.

Sales & Revenue Growth

• Own and drive revenue goals for the Tech & Telco sales team, ensuring the successful execution of sales strategies.

• Support team in identifying new business opportunities while deepening relationships with existing clients and agency partners. Guide and support the team in negotiating and closing high-value deals.

• Assist team in upfronts and Joint Business Planning with strategic accounts

Industry & Market Engagement

• Serve as a thought leader within the Tech & Telco industry, actively participating in industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities.

• Represent Discord’s ad solutions and value proposition in external forums and discussions.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive dynamics, sharing insights with the team and cross-functional partners.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Product, Marketing, RevOps, and other internal teams to align sales efforts with product offerings and market needs.

• Provide feedback on ad solutions and customer needs, helping shape the future of Discord’s advertising business.

• Partner with Marketing to develop go-to-market strategies, case studies, and client success stories.

What you should have:

• 8+ years of experience in digital advertising, media sales, or brand marketing, with at least 2 years of leadership experience (team lead, manager, or similar).

• Strong track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and driving successful sales strategies.

• Experience managing and coaching sales teams, with a focus on performance, growth, and culture.

• Deep understanding of advertising and media buying dynamics, particularly within the Tech & Telco industry.

• Proven ability to build and nurture senior-level client and agency relationships.

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance team leadership and individual contributions.

• Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, adapting quickly to new challenges and opportunities.

• Willingness to travel for industry events and key client meetings.

This position is US-based only. We are seeking candidates located in the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties), Los Angeles Metropolitan Area, or the New York Metropolitan Area, or who are willing to relocate. Relocation assistance may be available.

This position is commission-based and is eligible for variable incentive. The On Target Earnings (OTE) range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid vacation, sick time, and holidays; and paid parental, medical, and caregiver leave. Our ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the On Target Earnings only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

On Target Earnings

$272,000—$306,000 USD

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption

jobs.title: Senior Microfluidics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us:

Shennon Biotechnologies is developing precision immunotherapies for solid tumors through an integrated technology platform spanning target discovery, ultra-high-throughput microfluidics-driven functional screening, computational binder design and predictive safety assessment. In particular, where conventional discovery tests binders sequentially over months, our functional screening platform TCELERATOR profiles more than 10 million single-cell interactions at once, identifying functional leads in a single experiment. The unified engine is supported by proprietary human tumor datasets and an expanding network of academic and clinical collaborators. We are developing both antibody-based and TCR-based T-cell engagers designed to address surface and intracellular cancer targets. Our initial oncology pipeline includes programs in small cell lung cancer, ovarian cancer and hepatocellular carcinoma. We are based in the dogpatch neighborhood of San Francisco with 6000 sqft of lab space, with a fully equipped cleanroom and all the microfluidics engineering tools in the attached engineering lab. For more information, visit www.shennonbio.com.

The Role:

The Senior Engineer of Microfluidic Applications should be an experienced scientist/engineer with hands-on expertise in droplet-based microfluidic applications (such as droplet-based sequencing and/or droplet-based screening), who can think across biology and engineering to develop solutions in functional biology. This person is expected to execute and expand the platform applications towards ShennonBio’s vision. This person will work with other team members to develop applications based on our droplet-based microfluidics platform, and to further expand the capabilities of this platform. This person will play a critical role in ensuring the company’s competitive differentiation. We expect this person to be a master of the engineering platform and to actively develop applications to better understand functional biology.

ShennonBio envisions this role being filled by an experienced scientist/engineer who has an adaptive and self-starter attitude, and a strong background in both engineering and biology. This person shall also be fluent with data structures that go into training AI models. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of droplet-based applications to know what is possible, what are the current boundaries and how to push them eventually.

You will work with an interdisciplinary team and solve problems with a first principle approach from many different disciplines.

Responsibilities:

• Continue the further development of the droplet-based microfluidics platform and more importantly its applications

• Actively talk with the biology team and assess what problems can be addressed with the platform

• Define projects and timelines for applications following ShennonBio’s vision to better understand functional biology.

• Drive and execute independent projects, and ensure the delivery of results within set timelines to meet Company’s goals

• Work closely with other engineers and biologists.

• Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and deep scientific rigor.

Qualifications and Experience:

• Ph.D. in an engineering or physical science field (Electric Engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, Bioengineering, Biotechnology or Mechanical engineering and Chemical Engineering preferred) with expertise in droplet-based functional biology applications supported by publications in peer-reviewed journals

• Have delivered droplet-based microfluidic solutions for functional biology applications, with hands-on experience in designing droplet-based microfluidic chips, manufacturing microfluidic chips, designing and executing droplet-based biological assays. You must have worked on the whole process end-to-end yourself and understand the opportunities and challenges of droplet-based microfluidics.

• Multi-disciplinary in training, with experience across disciplinary boundaries, can think across biology and engineering, has worked in a multi-disciplinary team

• 0-2 years of work experience in industry, demonstrated adaptability and maturity in aligning with the company's directions and needs.

• Awareness of one’s own strength and weaknesses, low ego, growth mindset, comfortable changing course as priorities evolve

• Understands and appreciates the unique characteristics of a startup environment

• Ability to present clearly and concisely to internal and external audiences

Company Culture:
Our culture is centered around Collaboration, Ownership and Authenticity.

Collaboration: We work best as a team, sharing context openly and celebrating wins together. We all work on-site to ensure this close collaboration, coupled with a flexible time-off policy to support life outside of work, especially family.

Ownership: We trust you to take initiative and see things through, with the support to learn along the way. We provide mentorship, lots of growth opportunities, and merit-based promotions.

Authenticity: We want you to show up as yourself, giving honest feedback with kindness and being transparent about both successes and mistakes. Only by being authentic, can we grow individually and as a team.

Compensation:

• $130,000 - $140,000 base + 4% 401K match + 10% performance bonus + sizable equity

• Total cash comp $156,000 - $168,000 (including bonus, 401K match, lunch allowance, commuter allowance, excluding equity)

Benefits:

• Daily lunches; Commuter Benefits; Unlimited snacks and drinks.

• Medical, Dental, Vision; 100% Premium Covered.

• Disability Insurance, Life Insurance; Workplace Insurance

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Lab Automation
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Iambic Therapeutics is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help build our Lab of the Future at our San Diego headquarters. You will connect laboratory automation with the software and data systems that drive drug discovery, working closely with experimental scientists, software engineers, and our Agentic AI team. This hands-on role combines strong software engineering with an understanding of high-throughput experimentation (HTE), turning scientific workflows into reliable, increasingly automated cycles of design, execution, and analysis.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Partner with scientists to translate experimental needs into software and automated workflows across the Design-Make-Test-Analyze (DMTA) cycle.

 - Build Python services and integrations connecting laboratory schedulers, robotics, instruments, and our discovery platform; work with vendors to test and troubleshoot interfaces.

 - Design and operate APIs, databases, and AWS services that track experiment requests, samples, plates, execution status, and results.

 - Develop pipelines to parse, validate, and ingest instrument exports and assay data, preserving sample identity, experimental context, units, and provenance.

 - Make laboratory workflows reliable through testing, monitoring, and recovery procedures that account for instrument failures, partial runs, and manual intervention.

 - Partner with the Agentic AI team to expose well-defined laboratory capabilities to AI-driven workflows, with validated inputs, traceable actions, and appropriate human oversight.

 - Own technical projects from design through deployment and support; contribute code reviews, documentation, and mentoring, and explain tradeoffs clearly to scientific and technical colleagues.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - Minimum of 10 years of related experience (building software for scientific or laboratory environment) with a bachelor's degree; or 8 years and a master's degree or equivalent experience.

 - Strong Python skills and a record of delivering tested, maintainable production software using version control, code review, and automated testing.

 - Experience building web services and APIs, designing relational data models, working with SQL, and deploying and operating software on AWS.

 - Practical experience with laboratory automation and familiarity with HTE workflows, including plate-based experiments, liquid handling, instrument integration, and laboratory scheduling.

 - Enough chemistry or biology fluency to work with scientists on assay requirements, metadata, controls, and data quality, and translate those needs into software.

 - Ability to independently scope and deliver projects, troubleshoot across software and laboratory systems, and communicate clearly across disciplines.

 - An automation mindset: identify repetitive work, build reusable capabilities, and use sound judgment about validation, failure recovery, and when a scientist should remain in the loop.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with platforms such as HighRes Cellario, Celltrio, or comparable automation and analytical systems; expertise in every platform is not expected.

 - Experience with scientific data ingestion, workflow orchestration, or integrating laboratory systems with shared data platforms.

 - Experience building or evaluating LLM-based agents or other AI-assisted workflows, especially where software interacts with experiments or scientific tools.



ABOUT IAMBIC THERAPEUTICS
Iambic Therapeutics (Nasdaq: IAM) is a technology and clinical-stage life sciences company headquartered in San Diego. By utilizing molecular superintelligence — integrating proprietary AI with automated, scalable chemistry and biology experimentation — our platform is designed to address the totality of drug discovery and development. At Iambic, we are building an engine that is designed to power the future of medicine. Learn more at iambic.ai http://iambic.ai.

MISSION & VALUES
Our mission is to make better technology for better medicines. Three values guide how we work:

 - Bold. We are courageous, take thoughtful risks, and approach challenges with tenacity.

 - Innovative. We are creative and find new solutions that deliver impact.

 - Collaborative. We respect one another and partner with integrity.

We value the range of perspectives our people bring, and we work to build an environment where every team member can contribute and grow.

PAY AND BENEFITS
The pay range for this role is listed above. Actual pay depends on factors including experience, skills, and location. Eligible employees in the U.S. receive company-paid medical coverage, flexible spending accounts, voluntary life insurance, 401(k) matching and flexible time off. We are in a brand-new state-of-the art facility in beautiful San Diego with a community gym, dining, and easy access to great places to live and play.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Iambic is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Sustainability matters to us! At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Quantum Applications Research
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary:

PsiQuantum has one of the leading research efforts focused on developing and optimizing algorithms for fault-tolerant quantum computers (FTQC). Our research aims to make early generation hardware useful for scientific and commercial applications. To accelerate our researchers’ efforts, PsiQuantum’s application software team develops FTQC tools, including Construct, a software platform for developing fault-tolerant quantum algorithms.

As part of PsiQuantum’s Product Management team, this Product Manager will work closely with the application software team and our FTQC algorithm researchers. The role will include two areas of focus:

First, the Product Manager will develop a deep understanding of PsiQuantum researchers’ goals, workflows, and challenges to uncover opportunities to improve existing FTQC tools and create new tools that accelerate our research. The Product Manager will also explore creative ways to use generative AI to support our research efforts.

Second, the Product Manager will build expertise in PsiQuantum’s algorithmic research and use that research to demonstrate how Construct can accelerate the development of useful FTQC algorithms. These demonstrations will take the form of new Construct products, which the Product Manager will design and launch with the software engineering team.

To work effectively with internal and external quantum algorithm researchers, the ideal candidate will have a strong background in quantum computing and software engineering.

Responsibilities:

• Work closely with PsiQuantum’s algorithms research team to understand its research goals, workflow bottlenecks, and opportunities to use new tools and generative AI to accelerate its work.

• Partner with PsiQuantum’s algorithms research team to identify opportunities to use selected PsiQuantum research to create polished demonstrations or software products for external researchers.

• Define use cases, requirements, and product designs for new internal tools and external offerings and oversee their launch. Partner with internal and external users to support successful adoption.

• Be an active user of our products and build prototypes of new ideas using generative AI tools.

Experience/Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Quantum Information Science or equivalent experience.

• Research experience in quantum computing, with a focus on algorithms and applications, in academia or industry.

• 2+ years of product management or software developer experience building software products across major stages of product development, from initial MVP through product launch. Strong preference for experience turning scientific research ideas into polished software products.

• Comfort with Python and generative AI tools for creating product prototypes.

• Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.

• Ability to work effectively across teams, sites, and time zones.

• Detail oriented, data driven problem solver with an analytical mindset.

• Ability to work independently and contribute in a fast moving startup environment.

Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

Notion’s Field Marketing team owns the in-person moments that move our target sales assisted accounts forward. We design world class hosted events, executive experiences, and third-party activations that open new relationships, deepen the ones we have, and turn interest into pipeline.



As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execute tier 1 field events that drive pipeline and contribute meaningfully to Notion’s business.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Use data to guide field investments, combining quantitative results and qualitative feedback to evaluate what’s working. Measure both pipeline impact and top-of-funnel awareness, including reach and engagement with target audiences, and use those insights to improve future programs.

 - You love both strategy and execution. You can turn Sales priorities into a thoughtful field plan and roll up your sleeves to bring each event to life.

jobs.title: Sales and Design Consultant (full-time)
jobs.description:
About Ernesta:

Ernesta is on a mission to bring gorgeous, design-focused custom rugs to homes and places of gathering through an enjoyable, frictionless, and affordable experience. At the same price as a store-bought standard-sized rug, a custom-cut rug from Ernesta will not only be a better fit, but also a better buying experience.  We believe that high-quality custom design shouldn't be out of reach for consumers and aim to address this need in the multi-billion dollar global rug industry.

Driven by our collective mission, our team is hungry, hardworking, and highly ambitious. We’re problem solvers, innovators, design enthusiasts, and executors. We are relentlessly focused on creating and delivering beautiful and delightfully simple solutions and experiences for our customers. Together, we are excited and humbled by the opportunity to expand the market for custom rugs and allow more people to live in elevated design settings.  Put simply, we believe more soft surfaces mean happier homes.

About the Role:

Ernesta is looking for an experienced Sales and Design Consultant (who we call a Design Assistant) to join the Retail team in the our retail showroom located on the Upper East Side of Manhattan.  You will be a key hire to help build an enjoyable, frictionless, and industry-defining rug buying experience. This is an opportunity to join a small but visionary team - a high impact role pioneering a new age of customer experience. As a Design Assistant you will wear two hats. First, you will educate and advise customers on rug selection, material selection, and spatial planning. Second, you will be a customer champion – delighting customers and assisting with inquiries, concerns, and matters related to orders, delivery, and more. In each interaction, you will take pride in building strong relationships with customers and ensuring their happiness and loyalty at every touchpoint.

What You’ll Do:

• Advise customers on floor plan layout, material selection, and custom rug measurements

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Integration (BHI) Program Director
jobs.description:
About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, Ohio, Kentucky, Mississippi, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Role Summary

The BHI Program Director leads Ennoble Care's Behavioral Health Integration program — a Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) embedded in our home-based primary care for medically complex, homebound older adults. This is a clinical leadership role: the Program Director directs a large, growing behavioral health care management (BHCM) team of 20+ staff and is accountable for the full BHI lifecycle — patient identification, enrollment, measurement-based behavioral health care management, collaboration with the psychiatric consultant, and time-based billing — while driving the program toward its enrollment, penetration, and billed-rate goals.

As a licensed clinician, the Program Director provides clinical oversight and quality assurance across the BHCM caseload, ensures safe and effective treatment-to-target care, and serves as the program's primary liaison to providers. Success in this role requires equal strength in clinical judgment, large-team leadership, and operational execution.

Key Responsibilities

• Team Leadership & Workforce Management

• Lead, structure, and develop a large behavioral health care management team (20+ staff), including any team leads or supervisors who report into the role.

• Build the supervisory structure and operating routines needed to manage at scale — caseload reviews, coaching, performance management, and regular one-on-ones.

• Set caseload standards and manage team productivity to the program's minutes-per-FTE guardrail, balancing volume with quality of care.

• Own workforce planning and the hiring ramp as the program grows, onboarding and training new care directors each quarter.

• Foster a culture of accountability, clinical excellence, and support across a distributed team.

• Clinical Oversight & Quality

• Provide clinical oversight of the BHCM team's care within the Collaborative Care Model, ensuring measurement-based, treatment-to-target practice (e.g., PHQ-9, GAD-7).

• Establish and monitor clinical quality and documentation standards; conduct chart audits and case reviews.

• Ensure risk and safety protocols are in place and followed — including screening for suicidality and clear escalation pathways for high-acuity patients.

• Direct the psychiatric consultant relationship and the systematic caseload consultation that anchors the care model.

• Program Operations & Growth

• Direct the end-to-end BHI workflow — identification and eligibility, enrollment, care management, and discharge — across a high-volume caseload.

• Drive the program toward its enrollment, penetration, and monthly billed-rate targets, scaling the active census while protecting quality.

• Ensure qualifying care management time is captured and documented so it converts to compliant, billable claims.

• Identify and remove bottlenecks in referral intake, caseload assignment, and escalation that slow enrollment or billing.

• Provider Engagement & Education

• Act as the program's clinical ambassador to primary care providers — building referral relationships and integrating behavioral health into the primary care conversation.

• Deliver provider education that explains the collaborative care model, reduces stigma, and clarifies how and when to refer.

• Serve as the ongoing clinical point of contact for provider questions about behavioral health patients and the program.

• Performance, Productivity & Analytics

• Maintain BHI performance dashboards covering enrollment, billed rate, and team productivity, and report to program leadership.

• Track team and individual productivity against the minutes-per-FTE standard and intervene where caseloads or output drift.

• Use program data to forecast staffing needs and to target enrollment and billing improvements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Billing/RCM to ensure clean, timely BHI claims and to resolve denials or documentation gaps.

• Coordinate with primary care, the psychiatric consultant, and clinical operations to keep the care model running smoothly.

• Regulatory & Compliance

• Ensure BHI documentation, consent, and time-based billing comply with CMS and payer requirements.

• Maintain the policies, audits, and clinical standards that uphold compliance and patient safety.

Qualifications

Required

• Active, unrestricted RN license OR a master's-level behavioral health license (LCSW, LPC, or LMFT) required.

• 6+ years in healthcare or behavioral health, including 3+ years directly supervising staff, with demonstrated experience leading a large team (15–20+ employees).

• Hands-on experience with the Collaborative Care Model, behavioral health integration, or clinical care management.

• Proven ability to manage team productivity and clinical quality at scale.

• Working knowledge of CMS Behavioral Health Integration / Collaborative Care billing and Medicare documentation requirements.

• Strong presentation skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with providers and clinical teams.

• Highly proficient with data analysis, with a track record of translating data into operational decisions and tracking KPIs

• Excellent organizational and communication skills; able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, on-site environment.

Preferred

• Experience standing up or scaling a behavioral health or care management program.

• Experience in home-based primary care, geriatrics, or CMS innovation / value-based care models.

• Familiarity with behavioral health registry tools and EHR / clinical platforms.

• Background working with geriatric or chronic-condition patient populations.

Competencies

Clinical Leadership: Provides credible clinical oversight and quality assurance across a behavioral health caseload.

Leading at Scale: Structures, develops, and holds accountable a large, distributed care management team.

Operational Execution: Converts goals into caseload routines, productivity standards, and measurable enrollment and billing outcomes.

Provider Partnership: Builds referral relationships and integrates behavioral health into primary care.

Analytical Rigor: Tracks KPIs, productivity, and clinical quality, and drives rapid-cycle improvement.

Mission-Driven Mindset: Passion for improving behavioral health care for vulnerable, medically complex seniors.

Performance Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

• Enrolled census and program penetration against quarterly and annual targets.

• Share of enrolled patients with a billed visit each month.

• Team productivity against the minutes-per-FTE standard, alongside clinical quality measures.

• Caseload coverage and care director retention across a large team.

• Provider referral volume and the number of actively referring providers.

Compensation:  $110k-$125k Base +$15k-25k bonus

Location: Hybrid Remote/On-site 3 days per week at an Ennoble Care office

Full-time employees qualify for the following benefits:

• Medical, Dental, Vision and supplementary benefits such as Life Insurance, Short Term and Long Term Disability, Flexible Spending Accounts for Medical and Dependent Care, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity.

• Paid Time Off

• Paid Office Holidays

All employees qualify for these benefits:

• Paid Sick Time

• 401(k) with up to 3% company match

• Referral Program

• Payactiv: pay-on-demand. Cash out earned money when and where you need it!

Candidates must disclose any current or future need for employment-based immigration sponsorship (including, but not limited to, OPT, STEM OPT, or visa sponsorship) before an offer of employment is extended.

Ennoble Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to hiring the best team possible, and does not discriminate against protected characteristics including but not limited to - race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.

jobs.description:
Mission Graduates is a nonprofit organization that increases the number of K-5th grade students in San Francisco who are prepared for and complete a college education. We work towards fulfilling our mission through a wide range of after-school support and services that serve over 4,800 children, youth and families each year.  Our vision is to transform the culture of our neighborhoods so that college becomes the expectation for families, rather than the exception.
 
Program Overview:
The Mission Graduates Bessie Beacon is centered in the heart of the SOMA Community, and is a program model that includes afterschool and summer programming, school-day support, and parent engagement through a collaboration of program partners. For youth, we seek to create a sense of safety, promote skill mastery, develop supportive relationships, and demonstrate growth in youth development and academic measures. In addition, we work with the whole family to help parents gain the information and practice needed to be more effective advocates for their children’s education, and to connect them with resources that support the family's overall wellness. 
 
In order to accomplish this work, the Bessie Beacon Program draws on the strength and experience of both Mission Graduates Beacon Team and the Bessie Carmichael Day Admin team
 
Position Overview:
This position requires someone passionate about student health and wellness supporting the whole student. As the Wellness Coordinator you would report directly to the Beacon Director at  Bessie, but will also include regular support during school day hours and in the wellness center. The Wellness Coordinator will also collaborate with day time staff at  Bessie Carmichael, including the Principal, Assistant Principal, school social worker, and others. The position would include regular support during school day hours as well as after school.  In the school day you will be in the wellness center focused on student support needs , within the after school portion of the day you will be expected to support on site with program day to day and classroom management.

jobs.title: Director of Investor Relations
jobs.description:
About the Job

As Splitero's Director of Investor Relations, you will drive Capital Markets business development by prospecting new investors. You will lead all outreach, ensure prospects are followed up with efficiently, and build relationships with future investors, all with the support of the Vice President of Capital Markets. You bring existing relationships and can also create new ones through persistent, credible engagement.

In this role, you will:

• Educate prospective investors about Splitero's Home Equity Investment (HEI) offering, product, and forward flow agreements.

• Work alongside Capital Markets leadership to ensure investor conversations are progressing effectively through the sales pipeline.

• Optimize and own the Capital Markets sales process, from initial prospecting through signed agreements.

• Help build out and maintain our CRM system, ensuring accurate tracking of investor outreach and pipeline activity.

• Create and maintain external-facing materials that clearly explain Splitero's product and opportunity to investors.

• Maintain investor relationships over time through consistent, credible follow-up.

• Represent the company at conferences and in-person meetings.

The on-target earnings for this position are $220,000 - $240,000, inclusive of a base salary and biannual bonus based on company, team, and individual success. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

About You

• 7+ years of experience in institutional sales, capital formation, or investor relations

• Experience working with private credit funds, hedge funds, insurance companies, and/or pensions with existing relationships in the field to draw on

• Entrepreneurial and hands-on, with the ability to work autonomously and willingness to build the function while personally handling its day-to-day work

• Commercial and relationship-oriented, with the ability to understand investor needs and earn trust over time.

• High emotional intelligence: reads a room well and builds strong relationships

• Intellectually curious, with the ability to learn Splitero's product quickly and explain complex asset-backed transactions

• Self-aware, collaborative, and resourceful

• High integrity, good judgment, and discretion

• Preferred: Proficiency with Salesforce

• Desire to participate in a fast-paced early-stage startup

• Adaptability: Embraces changing circumstances with resiliency and positivity

• Team-Oriented: Prioritizes collaboration, inclusivity, and teammate support

About Us

Millions of homeowners in today’s economy are sitting on substantial home equity they are unable to access due to rising interest rates and strict qualification requirements of traditional lenders. That means millions of homeowners can’t convert their hard-earned equity into cash to pay off debt, start a home renovation, or pad their retirement to better their lives.

Splitero co-founders Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler witnessed the problem firsthand throughout their real estate careers. They set out to create a win-win product that could help those homeowners access their home equity but not make monthly payments like traditional financing options. And thus, Splitero was born.

As part of our team, you will join our quest to revolutionize the real estate industry while helping families in need. We offer a suite of benefits designed to help you thrive in all areas of life.

• OneTeam Culture - We foster a culture of transparency, innovation, and inclusivity, where every voice is heard and every team member is valued. We believe in celebrating our successes, doing the right thing, and helping each other so we grow as a team and as individuals.

• Generous Resources - We want to ensure you are set up to do your best work. In addition to a solid tech stack, and access to any WeWork location, you will receive a monthly cell and internet stipend.

• Premium Healthcare - We offer comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family, which employees are eligible for on their first day.

• Flexible PTO and Parental Leave - We offer a generous PTO and encourage employees to take time off to recharge. We're proud to offer a parental leave policy that allows you to welcome your new addition without worry.

We are a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities. In keeping with our commitment to inclusion, we will ensure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are required when applying, interviewing, or performing the essential functions of this position, please contact People Operations, at peopleops@splitero.com.

jobs.title: Software Architect – Adobe Commerce (Magento)
jobs.description:
This hands-on software architect role is responsible for designing, developing, and guiding the implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise web and internal application solutions. The position operates across both Adobe and dotnet ecosystems, with a primary focus on Adobe platforms and a supporting focus on dotnet-based internal applications and services. Working within a collaborative agile environment, this role translates business needs into practical technical solutions, defines implementation patterns, evaluates integration approaches, and contributes production-ready code. The role also supports DevOps functions related to build, release, and deployment processes. The role partners with development teams, business stakeholders, and technology leaders to ensure solutions align with organizational architecture standards, security requirements, performance expectations, and strategic initiatives.

What Would You Do? The Specifics.

• Design, develop, and guide implementation of application solutions using Adobe Commerce (Magento), leveraging PHP, MySQL, Magento's service-oriented architecture, object-oriented programming principles, dependency injection, and established design patterns to deliver extensible, performant, and maintainable solutions.
• Architect and develop solutions using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) as a Cloud Service and Edge Delivery Services (EDS), leveraging AEM component architecture, content modeling, EDS-compatible content pipelines, API integrations, and edge-optimized delivery patterns.
• Provide hands-on development and solution design for internal applications using dotnet, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and container-based application patterns, ensuring internal systems integrate effectively with Adobe platforms and other enterprise services.
• Develop, maintain, and optimize Azure DevOps Pipelines to support build, validation, release, and deployment processes across Adobe and dotnet application portfolios.
• Configure, manage, and support Octopus Deploy release processes, deployment variables, environments, and promotion workflows to ensure reliable and repeatable application deployments.
• Define technical approaches for integrations across websites, order management capabilities, reporting tools, customer-facing services, and internal business applications.
• Write production-quality code while also establishing reusable patterns, technical standards, and implementation guidance for development teams.
• Evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend practical architecture decisions that balance scalability, performance, maintainability, security, delivery timelines, and business value.
• Support and optimize integrations with external third-party services, platforms, APIs, and tools.
• Support application observability, monitoring, and performance insight using New Relic or similar platforms.
• Ensure application designs and implementations follow secure coding practices, organizational security standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to understand requirements, identify constraints, and shape solutions that meet operational and strategic needs.
• Lead technical quality assurance activities throughout the project lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, testing strategy input, performance validation, and release readiness support.
• Contribute to architecture documentation, technical decision records, system diagrams, integration specifications, and implementation plans.
• Mentor and support developers through technical guidance, pairing, troubleshooting, and review of architectural and coding practices.

Work Experience

• 2-4 years of experience contributing to solution architecture, technical design, integration patterns, platform standards, or system modernization efforts (Required)
• Education
• Two years of college or equivalent experience. (Required)

Additional Skills

• Strong hands-on development experience in Adobe Commerce (Magento) (Required)
• AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services, or related Adobe enterprise platforms (Preferred)
• Proficiency with PHP for Adobe Commerce development, MySQL for Adobe Commerce data management, and practical working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript as needed for Adobe platform delivery (Required)
• Experience designing and developing dotnet applications, APIs, services, or internal enterprise systems (Preferred)
• Experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MariaDB/MySQL for relational data design, query development, and application data access (Preferred)
• Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, service-oriented architecture, API-first design, and modern application development principles (Required)
• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable technical solutions (Required)
• Experience with cloud-ready application design, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Octopus Deploy, CI/CD workflows, and Git-based development practices (Required)
• Ability to use AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve productivity, research, drafting, and implementation support while maintaining human ownership of technical reasoning, validation, security, and final decisions (Required)
• Experience integrating with external third-party services, platforms, APIs, and tools (Preferred)
• Experience with application observability, monitoring, and performance insight using New Relic or similar platforms (Preferred)
• Experience working with healthcare data and systems subject to HIPAA regulatory requirements (Preferred)
• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical partners (Required)
• Ability to guide developers through technical design, code review, troubleshooting, and implementation planning (Required)
• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, practical problem-solving ability, and commitment to maintainable engineering practices (Required)

Taking Care of our People!

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager (East Texas)
jobs.description:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.

About the role:

As a Regional Sales Lead at Halter, you will lead a team of Territory Managers on the front lines of transforming livestock management across the U.S. This is a deeply hands-on role: you’ll spend most of your time in the field coaching reps, joining customer conversations, and removing barriers to their success.

You’ll shape regional performance, uphold rigorous pipeline and Salesforce standards, and ensure your team executes with consistency and excellence. We’re looking for a leader who brings energy, high standards, and a strong sense of culture. Someone who cares about people, thrives in fast growth, and can operate equally well in strategy discussions and day-to-day execution.

This role covers East Texas and the preferred location is San Antonio. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead, coach & develop Territory Managers through frequent in-field work (~60% travel), ongoing feedback, role-plays, and hands-on sales training to ensure strong execution and skill development.

 - Own regional revenue performance by driving consistent activity, supporting both new sales and account expansion, and ensuring TMs meet input and output targets.

 - Maintain world-class Salesforce hygiene & forecasting, reviewing pipelines weekly, ensuring accurate data, and acting as deal support on structure, escalations, and critical opportunities.

 - Serve as the regional voice - surfacing customer insights, product feedback, and operational issues to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer teams, and broader leadership.

 - Localize national strategy into regional execution plans, run lightweight team rhythms (1:1s, check-ins), and align closely with U.S. commercial leadership on performance and priorities.

 - Recruit and develop high-performing talent, helping scale Territory Manager teams as Halter grows rapidly across the U.S.
   
    


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong Frontline Sales Leadership: Experience leading and developing field sales reps, ideally in high-growth or high-velocity environments, with a track record of coaching reps to consistently improve performance.

 - Hands-On, Field-First Mindset: Comfortable spending the majority of your time on the road - joining customer visits, modeling best practices, and staying deeply connected to real-world customer challenges.

 - Expertise in Sales Process & Methodology: Proficiency in modern sales practices (e.g., consultative/challenger sales models, role-plays, discovery techniques) and the ability to coach Territory Managers to master them.

 - Pipeline, Salesforce, & Forecasting Discipline: Strong operational rigor with CRM hygiene, pipeline management, input metrics, and forecasting accuracy - especially important in a hardware + software environment.

 - Direct, Supportive People Leadership: A leadership style built on clarity, accountability, empathy, and high support - someone who cares deeply, sets high expectations, and builds strong team culture.

 - Comfort With Ambiguity & Fast Growth: Thrives in dynamic, evolving environments; adaptable, resourceful, and motivated by building systems, processes, and habits in a rapidly scaling U.S. business.



OUR BENEFITS

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $200,000 - $225,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Contract and Billing Specialist - USA
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Billing errors, concession requests, and cancellation or return exceptions currently land with CSMs, CS managers, and several partner teams, each holding part of the picture. As our customer base and billing complexity have grown, these cases take too long, repeat for the same reasons, and pull CSMs away from adoption and renewal work. As the Contract and Billing Resolution Specialist, you will be the single owner of complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts.

You will take a customer's report that something is wrong with their bill, work out what happened across systems and teams, choose the right path to fix it, and see it through, keeping the customer informed. It is part detective, part project manager, part customer advocate. You will also tell the teams who own the underlying systems and processes what keeps breaking.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Customer Success Managers, Sales, Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal. This is a new role, and you will help shape the case record, the root-cause tags, and the monthly read-out that define how Customer Success resolves billing and contract cases at Samsara.

This is a remote  position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

• You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

• You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

• Own complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts, from the first report to a confirmed fix, and keep the customer informed in plain terms, including accounts that are delinquent or facing suspension.

• Reconstruct the full story behind a billing error across contracts, order forms, segment or ownership changes, reprocessing, and invoicing, including cases with several AE handoffs and no clean record of what was promised.

• Separate a correction of a Samsara error from a concession, a return, a reprocess, and a contract amendment, and choose the path that fixes the customer's billing, not only the immediate complaint.

• Drive Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to execute the fix.

• Evaluate and prepare concession requests: confirm whether Samsara was at fault, size the request against policy and the approval matrix, write a short case summary (what happened, root cause, options considered and ruled out, recommendation, and risk), route it to the right approver, and confirm the credit is applied and the customer told.

• Support cancellation, return, and ETF exceptions: validate eligibility (purchase and renewal dates, trial history, Return ACV, financing partner, documentation), prepare the case for the approving team, act as the Customer Success fallback when the first approver does not respond within the window, and make sure approved outcomes are processed.

• Be the front door for billing, concession, and cancellation requests: log every request in a single case record, including those that arrive via Slack, email, or Gainsight; redirect them to the right path; and coach CSMs and AEs on what a complete request looks like.

• Fix repeat causes: tag the root cause on every case, separate one-offs from systemic failures, and deliver a monthly read-out to the teams that own the systems and processes involved.

• Carry forward the billing improvement work with Support, Finance, and Product, including earlier detection of billing problems that threaten renewals.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's operating principles, including Keep a High Bar, Be Intellectually Honest, and Solve Problems Together, as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 4+ years of experience in billing operations, order to cash, revenue operations, deal desk, contracts, or a similar finance and operations role.

• This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.

• Strong investigative skills: you can rebuild a timeline from incomplete or conflicting information across CRM, billing, and contract systems, including when the people involved have left.

• Sound financial judgment about credits, concessions, reprocessing, and refunds, and a clear way of explaining your recommendation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agentic Systems - Moveworks
jobs.description:
The Role

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This is not an ML role. This is a distributed systems engineering role at the heart of the agentic AI wave.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.

What you get to do in this role:

• Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
• Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using DynamoDB conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
• Event-driven message pipeline — SQS FIFO queues for ordered delivery, Kafka consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
• Structured concurrency — Python asyncio TaskGroups running multiple concurrent tasks per session (message polling, lease heartbeats, output publishing, orchestrator execution) with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
• Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
• Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

To be successful in this role you have:

You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:

• Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
• Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
• Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
• Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
• Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
• gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

Required:

• 0-2+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems
• Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)
• Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale
• Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions
