jobs.title: Senior Manager, Accounting
jobs.description:
Join d-Matrix and help build the future of AI inference. We’ve pioneered a memory-centric architecture that brings compute directly into memory, making AI faster, more energy efficient, and accessible on a global scale. From chips and software to rack-scale systems, our team is tackling some of AI infrastructure’s hardest challenges — and shipping breakthrough technology today. If you want to create what comes next and help make infinite inference possible, we’d love to hear from you.

Our culture is built on respect, collaboration, and direct communication. We value humility, we believe our different perspectives lead to better solutions, and we’re looking for people who are driven by execution and energized by hard problems.




ROLE OVERVIEW

At d-Matrix, we are unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the next transformation of technology, pushing the boundaries of software and hardware innovation.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Accounting to own our monthly close process and help build the accounting infrastructure of a fast-growing, venture-backed company. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, you will take direct ownership of the company’s books and partner cross-functionally with Finance, FP&A, and business leaders as one of our dedicated accounting hires.

This is an excellent opportunity for a public accounting professional ready to move from the audit side into industry. On a lean team, you will have broad scope and visible impact on how d-Matrix scales its financial operations, controls, and systems.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own the end-to-end monthly, quarterly, and year-end close, including journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and variance analysis.

 - Manage the general ledger in NetSuite, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all close activities.

 - Prepare and review financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) in accordance with US GAAP.

 - Oversee AP, AR, payroll accounting, and revenue recognition, stepping in hands-on where needed.

 - Partner with the Corporate Controller to design, document, and implement accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls suited to a scaling startup, and remediate control and process gaps as the company grows.

 - Support the year-end audit as a key contact for external auditors and tax advisors.

 - Support cash management, including bank reconciliations and cash flow monitoring, and partner with FP&A on budget-to-actual analysis and reporting for leadership and the board.

 - Research and document technical accounting positions for non-standard transactions (e.g., revenue, acquisitions, equity, debt, leases).

 - Evaluate, implement, and optimize accounting systems and tools (NetSuite modules, expense management, bill pay).

 - Mentor and help build the accounting team as d-Matrix grows, and take on special projects across accounting, finance operations, and compliance.


WHAT YOU WILL BRING

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

 - CPA license, or actively pursuing.

 - 8+ years of relevant accounting experience, including 5+ years of audit experience at a Big 4 accounting firm.

 - Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP, with experience researching and documenting complex accounting topics.

 - Experience managing reviews or audits of quarter-end and year-end close processes for clients.

 - Familiarity with internal control design and evaluation (SOX or private-company control environments).

 - Strong Excel skills and comfort working with data across systems.

 - Excellent communication skills, including explaining accounting concepts to non-finance stakeholders.

 - A high degree of ownership, attention to detail, and adaptability, with comfort in ambiguity.

 - Eagerness to transition from public accounting into a hands-on industry role.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with NetSuite.

 - Knowledge of equity accounting, venture financing transactions, revenue recognition, and acquisitions.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

d-Matrix is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication, and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

d-Matrix does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individuals interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of all applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

jobs.title: Customer Development Manager - Specialty Retail
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

• The Customer Development Manager is responsible for growing and developing the total Links Snacks sales and profitability within the Specialty Retail channel. This role is responsible for developing strategic customer relationships, managing broker and distributor partners, and identifying opportunities to grow Jack Link’s presence across a diverse landscape of specialty retail customers and channels including Travel Retail, Sporting Goods, Campus Retail, Office Supply, Healthcare Retail, Theater and other Specialty Retail segments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Execute the strategy of the Specialty Retail Channel to deliver top and bottom-line sales and profit goals with a significant focus on growing the business across existing and new customers.
• Develop multi-year plans for channel-specific business opportunities focused on expanding Jack Link’s presence in existing outlets and gaining new distribution.
• Build and maintain effective relationships throughout customer and distributor organizations and at various levels, including Executive Management, Operations, Merchandising, Supply Planning and Marketing.
• Manage broker and third-party sales partners to ensure alignment with Link Snacks’ strategies, priorities and business objectives. Conduct broker trainings and business reviews as needed.
• Manage trade spending to drive profitable business, including the use of the trade promotion management (TPM) system.
• Collaborate with internal functions to develop customer-specific programs, items and point-of-sale materials to build the business.
• Accountable for the development and accuracy of sales forecasts by customer and product to support demand and production planning.
• Provide business updates to Senior Sales Management on sales results, opportunities and key business initiatives.
• Understand and report back on competitive landscape and activity within the Specialty Retail channel.
• Identify new distribution opportunities and develop strategies to expand Jack Link’s presence across key specialty retail segments.
• Manage deduction and accounts receivable issues on applicable accounts.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor’s degree in business or related field is preferred.
• 5+ years of sales experience within the CPG or foodservice industry.
• Experience managing customer, broker, distributor and/or other third-party sales partner relationships at a HQ level.
• Strong analytical capabilities with a demonstrated track record of identifying trends, opportunities and business insights.
• Strong business acumen, including experience with P&L management, trade management, syndicated data, forecasting and demand planning.
• Experience working across a diverse customer base and multiple retail channels preferred.
• TPM and CRM systems experience preferred.
• Strong skill level in Microsoft applications.
• Ability to travel as needed (approxamately 30-50%)

The pay for this role is $120,000 - $145,000 (Per Year). Actual wage will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Link Snacks Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. The Team Member is required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms and lift for extended periods while conducting store audits, setting up promotional displays, or attending trade shows. Must be able to regularly lift, carry, and maneuver 25 or more pounds of product cases, display materials, and sales supplies during retail visits and industry events. jobs.title: Reseller Sales Specialist - Austin, TX
jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Reseller Sales

Location:  Must live within Austin, TX area

Compensation:  $175,000 – $185,000 on target earnings with a 60/40 split plus equity

What You’ll Do:

Huntress is looking for a Reseller Sales Development Specialist to join our new reseller sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and managing new reseller partnerships in North America to support Huntress' continued growth and expansion. This is a front-line, hunter role built for someone who lives to recruit, activate, and scale channel partners at pace. You’ll own the recruitment, onboarding, and early growth of new broad channel partners across the US who transact through distribution. Your mission is simple: find them, sign them, enable them, and drive revenue through their preferred distributor.

You’ll work closely with distribution partners, marketing, and the wider channel team to turn raw partner interest into productive, revenue-generating relationships.

Responsibilities:

• Proactively identify, recruit, and onboard new reseller partners (VARs, IT providers, etc) across North America who buy through distribution

• Qualify prospective partners quickly and move fast from first contact to onboarding with a heavy focus on time-to-first-deal

• Build a strong bench of net-new, first-time Huntress partners

• Drive partner recruitment and growth through Huntress distribution relationships, working hand-in-hand with distribution partners to co-sell, co-market, and accelerate pipeline

• Own the first 90–180 days of the partner journey

• Ensure partners understand how to buy, quote, and transact efficiently via distribution

• Deliver foundational enablement on Huntress value, positioning, and use cases

• Identify expansion opportunities and hand off mature partners at the right time

• Build strong relationships with key decision-makers at reseller and distributor companies, ensuring they are actively promoting our products and addressing any concerns they may have

• Provide resellers with the tools, resources, and ongoing training necessary to effectively present and sell our products to their customers

• Oversee the process of registering sales opportunities with resellers/distributors to ensure proper attribution and margin allocation

• Track reseller sales performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching to maximize their sales potential

• Represent Huntress at industry events, partner days, and other related conferences

• Bring real-time market and reseller/distributor feedback back to the business

What You Bring To The Team:

• 2-5+ years of experience in a combination of channel sales, partner development, and/or distribution-led roles

• Proven track record of partner recruitment or high-velocity sales

• Experience working with US distribution (tech, security, SaaS, and/or Microsoft strongly preferred)

• Demonstrated knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including different product categories, technical capabilities, and industry trends, particularly in the SMB and Commercial customer segments

• Proven track record of identifying, recruiting, and quickly activating resellers, including an understanding of partner dynamics and incentive structures. Existing key reseller relationships are highly preferred.

• SMB and Commercial mindset with a bias for action and execution

• Experience and knowledge of MSFT licensing and Security solutions are highly preferred

• Confident, credible communicator who can open doors and build trust quickly with key decision makers at reseller companies and foster long-term partnerships

• Comfortable working remotely and managing a wide geographic territory

• Willingness to travel as needed

What We Offer:

• 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015

• Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans

• 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution

• Life and Disability insurance plans

• Stock options for all full-time employees

• One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office

• Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance

• $75 USD/month digital reimbursement

• Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

Please note that non-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response.

These AI tools support our human recruiters in the initial review process, but do not make final hiring decisions without human involvement. jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Buildkite

Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Canva, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both - giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence.

About the Role

As a Senior CSM at Buildkite, you'll be a senior individual contributor responsible for driving measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of Buildkite’s Enterprise customers. You are the customer’s strategic partner in value realization - accountable for the adoption of Buildkite, the outcomes the customer achieves with it and the long-term health of the partnership.

You’ll co-own each account with an Account Executive. The AE drives the growth of the partnership and owns the commercial relationship. You own the value the customer gets from what they’ve already purchased. You’ll work alongside a Technical Account Manager, who leads technical advisory on the customer’s current solutions, while the AE partners with a Solutions Architect on what the customer is evaluating next. You and the AE both build relationships at every level of the customer’s organization, each at your own angle.

You’ll join a small, senior team while Buildkite’s Customer Success function is maturing quickly and you’ll help shape the playbooks and operating model that come next. We are looking for someone who wants to improve the role, not just fill it.

What You'll Do

Strategic Account Leadership

• Post-Sale Ownership: Own the post-sale state of your named Enterprise accounts: health, adoption, retention and spotting expansion opportunities. You do this in partnership with your Account Executive, who owns the commercial side of the relationship.

• Value Realization: Drive measurable business outcomes from the Buildkite investment by aligning each account’s success plan to the customer’s core engineering and business goals.

• Account Team Partnership: Work as one account team with your AE, TAM and Solutions Architect. Bring in Product, Support and Engineering when the account needs them, so the customer experiences one cohesive Buildkite.

• Cadence Design: Determine when and how to engage each account based on the value it returns to the customer — right-sizing engagement so every interaction earns its place on the customer’s calendar.

• Operating Model Contribution: Help shape the playbooks, processes, and operating model of a maturing CS function — and mentor new team members as the team grows.

Executive Influence and Customer Partnership

• Executive Engagement: Cultivate and maintain trusted relationships with customer C-suite, VP, Director, and program-owner stakeholders — including the executive sponsor accountable for the Buildkite investment.

• Business Translation: Translate technical adoption and platform health into the business outcomes that matter to executive sponsors, and into the language they use with their own leadership.

• Executive Business Reviews: Lead the EBR cadence with the AE and TAM — bringing the value narrative, customer readiness, and forward-looking strategy that keeps the partnership on track.

• Customer Advocacy: Amplify the voice of the customer inside Buildkite, ensuring Product, Engineering, and Support stay focused on what matters most to the accounts you own.

Risk, Renewal, and Expansion Readiness

• Account Health: Maintain a live view of technical, commercial, support, and relationship signals across your portfolio — surface risk early, mobilize the right Buildkite resources, and prevent escalation through proactive partnership.

• Renewal Strategy: Partner with the Account Executive on renewal strategy by driving the value narrative, customer readiness, and account health that underpin every commercial conversation.

• Expansion Sourcing: Identify and source expansion opportunities through the Customer-Sourced Qualified Lead (CSQL) process — turning customer outcomes into growth.

• Onboarding: Partner with the Technical Account Manager on the first 90 days, and sustain the joint CSM/TAM cadence that drives customers from go-live to long-term value.

This Is You If...

• You have 5+ years in Customer Success, strategic account management, or a senior post-sale role at a B2B SaaS company, owning Enterprise accounts as the person accountable for value, retention, and expansion

• You bring direct experience at a CI/CD, DevOps, developer tools, or technical infrastructure SaaS company — enough domain fluency to navigate engineering conversations and the CI/CD problem space credibly, without trying to be the technical expert

• You have a demonstrable track record of driving retention and expansion outcomes on a named Enterprise book

• You communicate with exceptional executive presence — comfortable engaging VP, CTO, and C-suite stakeholders, and translating technical work into the business outcomes their leadership cares about

• You're able to handle objections, navigate complicated discussions, and drive alignment across customer and internal stakeholders — with persistence in the face of adversity

• You have experience orchestrating across Sales, Solutions, Support, Product, and Marketing to deliver a coherent customer experience across complex, multi-stakeholder accounts

• You bring strong commercial instincts — you understand how your work connects to renewal health, churn risk, and expansion, and you operate effectively alongside AEs and Renewals

• You're a strong autonomous operator who wants to help shape the role, not just fill it — you are comfortable improving the playbook as you run it and contributing to the operating model of a growing team.

Bonus Points If...

• Hands-on familiarity with Buildkite or comparable CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Harness, GitLab CI) — enough to navigate a customer’s CI/CD architecture conversation without needing translation

• Experience partnering with Technical Account Managers or Solutions Architects in a model where the technical and relationship roles are explicitly separated

• Familiarity with CS platforms (Vitally, Catalyst, Gainsight, Totango, or similar) and modern revenue stacks (Salesforce, Avoma, ChartMogul, or equivalent)

• Background contributing to a CS function mature and scale, not just executing within an established one

Benefits

• Work from anywhere in the world for up to 6 weeks a year, on top of a fully remote setup — great work doesn’t have to happen from one desk.

• 20 days paid annual leave plus 10 days sick & carer's leave — actively encouraged, we want you to be at your best and time off is a part of that.

• 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers (6 for secondary) — becoming a parent is life changing and we’re committed to supporting you and your family through it.

• A remote-work allowance for home-office kit, co-working, or working elsewhere — we want you to have everything you need to be set up for success in your role.

• Confidential EAP & mental health support — sometimes life gets hard. You should be able to access the resources and support you need.

• Support for learning and growth — with time and budget for conferences, courses, and coaching so you have the opportunity to grow, improve your craft, and build mastery.

• Retirement and health coverage (based on your region) — build towards your future, your way.

Exact benefits may vary slightly by country. We'll walk through the specifics for your location.

Compensation

This role offers On-Target Earnings (OTE), split between base salary and sales commission. The base salary range is $155,000 - $170,000 USD. Compensation is determined based on geographic location, relevant experience, and qualifications.

🌈 Equal Opportunity Employer

At Buildkite, we value diversity and celebrate all types of skills, backgrounds, and experiences. We’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment and providing reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process.

If you need any accommodations or support during the application or interview process, please reach out to us at accommodations@buildkite.com.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Reseller Sales

Location:  Must live within the Chicagoland area

Compensation:  $175,000 – $185,000 on target earnings with a 60/40 split plus equity

What You’ll Do:

Huntress is looking for a Reseller Sales Development Specialist to join our new reseller sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and managing new reseller partnerships in North America to support Huntress' continued growth and expansion. This is a front-line, hunter role built for someone who lives to recruit, activate, and scale channel partners at pace. You’ll own the recruitment, onboarding, and early growth of new broad channel partners across the US who transact through distribution. Your mission is simple: find them, sign them, enable them, and drive revenue through their preferred distributor.

You’ll work closely with distribution partners, marketing, and the wider channel team to turn raw partner interest into productive, revenue-generating relationships.

Responsibilities:

• Proactively identify, recruit, and onboard new reseller partners (VARs, IT providers, etc) across North America who buy through distribution

• Qualify prospective partners quickly and move fast from first contact to onboarding with a heavy focus on time-to-first-deal

• Build a strong bench of net-new, first-time Huntress partners

• Drive partner recruitment and growth through Huntress distribution relationships, working hand-in-hand with distribution partners to co-sell, co-market, and accelerate pipeline

• Own the first 90–180 days of the partner journey

• Ensure partners understand how to buy, quote, and transact efficiently via distribution

• Deliver foundational enablement on Huntress value, positioning, and use cases

• Identify expansion opportunities and hand off mature partners at the right time

• Build strong relationships with key decision-makers at reseller and distributor companies, ensuring they are actively promoting our products and addressing any concerns they may have

• Provide resellers with the tools, resources, and ongoing training necessary to effectively present and sell our products to their customers

• Oversee the process of registering sales opportunities with resellers/distributors to ensure proper attribution and margin allocation

• Track reseller sales performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching to maximize their sales potential

• Represent Huntress at industry events, partner days, and other related conferences

• Bring real-time market and reseller/distributor feedback back to the business

What You Bring To The Team:

• 2-5+ years of experience in a combination of channel sales, partner development, and/or distribution-led roles

• Proven track record of partner recruitment or high-velocity sales

• Experience working with US distribution (tech, security, SaaS, and/or Microsoft strongly preferred)

• Demonstrated knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including different product categories, technical capabilities, and industry trends, particularly in the SMB and Commercial customer segments

• Proven track record of identifying, recruiting, and quickly activating resellers, including an understanding of partner dynamics and incentive structures. Existing key reseller relationships are highly preferred.

• SMB and Commercial mindset with a bias for action and execution

• Experience and knowledge of MSFT licensing and Security solutions are highly preferred

• Confident, credible communicator who can open doors and build trust quickly with key decision makers at reseller companies and foster long-term partnerships

What We Offer:

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Product Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.


YOUR ROLE

Procurement is high-stakes, document-heavy, and unforgiving: a mis-routed approval, a misread invoice, or a missed contract clause lands on a real company's books. Tech Leads at Zip own a major product area end to end, from technical direction to production quality, on teams across the Zip platform, in areas like approvals, invoice automation, and contract management. We will match you to the team that fits you best during the interview process.

These are strategic products for large enterprise customers. The scope spans approval routing and workflows, invoice ingestion, extraction, and ERP sync, and contract workflows, review, and signatures. You will set direction, turn ambiguous problems into plans, grow engineers, and still write code. The scope is Staff-level, and you will report to your team's Engineering Manager.




WHY YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE:

 - Own something that matters. The approvals that run every workflow at Zip, the invoice lifecycle from inbox to ERP, or contracts from draft to signature. When you ship, customers feel it.

 - High-stakes problems. A mis-routed approval is a SOX issue for customers like Block, General Mills, Visa, and Anthropic, and invoices have to be processed close to perfectly.

 - AI, used deliberately. Zip is an AI-first product. We built our own AI agent harness in house, and every product surface is powered by AI.

 - Small teams, big trust. Focused teams where engineers own parts of the product, with a 24-hour review SLA and leaders who back you when you block a risky PR.

 - Room to grow. Staff-level scope from day one, with a path to keep growing as a hands-on technical leader or to move into management if you want it.


YOU WILL:

 - Mentor and coach engineers, grow other technical leaders, and help hire as the team grows.

 - Set the technical direction and make the architecture calls for a major product area.

 - Turn fuzzy problems into plans with product and design, and lead them through launch and production quality.

 - Stay in the code: design, build, and ship regularly.

 - Hold the quality bar and own your team's health: bugs, test coverage, and on-call load, plus modernizing legacy code.

 - Review specs for other teams that build on yours, and work the hard escalations from enterprise customers.

 - Put AI to work in the product and in your own workflow.

 - Partner with your manager, product, and design, and raise risks early.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - You have been a Tech Lead or Staff-level engineer, ideally at a fast-growing startup, and led a team through a substantial product initiative

 - You are technically strong: great at system design, you ship code regularly, and you can lead design reviews and evaluate architecture proposals.

 - You have owned a production system with real customer traffic, ideally one where reliability or compliance matters.

 - We care more about what you have built than where you have worked.

 - You take ambiguity from requirements to launch and own the outcome.

 - You grow people and hold a high quality bar, including the courage to say no.

 - You communicate clearly across teams, share knowledge openly, and raise risks early.

 - You do not stick to the job description, and you are curious about Zip as a whole.

 - You are comfortable using AI tools heavily in your engineering work.

 - Strong product intuition and cross-org influence.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience shipping AI-powered product features, with strong AI knowledge and practical skills.

 - Enterprise SaaS experience, especially complex workflow or document products.

 - Experience taking a product from 0 to 1 and then scaling it.

 - Experience working directly with customers and with Support or Customer Success.

 - Domain experience in procurement, finance, or contract management.



The salary range for this role is $200,000 - $300,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

 


PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

 - 🍽️ Catered breakfast, lunch, & dinner

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

 - 🚍 Monthly commuter benefit

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 💻 Home office stipend

 - 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

 - 🍼 Paid parental leave

 - 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend

 - 💸 401k plan

 - 🤖 AI token usage

 

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Territory Manager (Southern California)
jobs.description:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.



YOU’LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.



BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

 - Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

 - Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.



OUR BENEFITS

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: B2B Ecosystem Lead, Partner Growth
jobs.description:
About the Team

We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We work across the B2B ecosystem, including software vendors, technology platforms, and services partners, to help them bring useful AI offerings to market and reach more business customers. Working closely with Sales, Product, and partner programs, we build channels and repeatable go-to-market approaches that expand customer choice and adoption of OpenAI’s models and products.

About the Role

As a B2B Ecosystem Partnerships Lead focused on Partner Growth, you will own the onboarding, activation, and growth of a partner portfolio across OpenAI’s expanding ecosystem programs, including marketplace and Sign in with ChatGPT. This is a hands-on individual contributor role centered on partner management, joint go-to-market execution, and commercial growth. Your portfolio may span ISVs, technology platforms,, and other B2B partners as opportunities evolve. You bring a generalist’s range across relationships, business analysis, deal execution, and operational problem solving. You will build repeatable ways to support a growing partner base and take on selected strategic partnerships.

In this role, you will:

 - Identify and recruit partners across B2B segments for ecosystem programs and joint go-to-market opportunities, prioritizing customer needs, product fit, commercial potential, and readiness to participate and grow.

 - Own day-to-day relationships across your partner portfolio, tailoring engagement to partner needs and opportunity while using repeatable approaches to support a growing partner base.

 - Develop practical business and account plans with partners and Sales, with clear use cases, target customers, owners, milestones, and adoption and commercial goals.

 - Negotiate product and commercial agreements with Legal, Finance, and Product, and lead selected high-touch strategic opportunities in coordination with other partnership owners.

 - Guide partners through program onboarding, technical evaluation, integration, and activation; coordinate enablement and resolve barriers to launch, sustained usage, and expansion.

 - Execute co-selling, joint marketing, and marketplace opportunities with account teams; coordinate with cloud and other ecosystem partners where they help customers buy and deploy solutions.

 - Run regular partner reviews, identify inactive or stalled partners, and execute growth plans that improve participation, product adoption, customer demand, and relationship health.

 - Track onboarding completion, time to activation, active partners, product usage, pipeline contribution, and commercial results with Sales and Operations; use the data to focus effort.

 - Improve onboarding materials, enablement, and partner engagement practices with program and product teams; turn recurring partner issues into fixes that help the broader ecosystem scale.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 8+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, partner or account management, enterprise sales, or related commercial roles in technology.

 - Experience managing and growing a portfolio of B2B partners or accounts, with measurable results in onboarding, adoption, retention, or commercial expansion.

 - An understanding of B2B business models, partner channels, and how companies bring products and services to market. Experience with ISVs, technology platforms, services partners, or cloud marketplaces is a plus.

 - Strong business judgment and analytical skills: you can assess partner economics, prioritize a portfolio, and build repeatable processes that help more partners succeed.

 - Ability to work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance, build trust with partner teams, and drive progress without formal authority.

 - A generalist mindset, curiosity about AI, and the ability to learn new products and markets quickly. You can discuss integrations with technical teams and connect capabilities to customer value.

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Approvals
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

The Approvals team owns the approval and task framework that runs every workflow at Zip: routing, conditions, recalculation, approver assignment, and the Approvals experience, including the request details page, AI Summaries, and mobile. Other teams, including payments, risk orchestration, and contracts, build on top of what we ship, so our work reaches every customer.

Approvals have to be correct. If an approval doesn't fire, or goes to the wrong person, it becomes a SOX compliance issue for enterprise customers like Block, General Mills, Visa, and Anthropic. We focus on two areas: governance, so customers and their auditors can trust the platform, and procurement automation, where we are bringing AI into approvals. For example, we are building on Zip's AI chat to help customers understand why a request was assigned to someone, or why an approval did or didn't trigger.

We are hiring a Tech Lead for the governance and automation side of the team. You will set the technical direction for our governance and compliance roadmap and our AI initiatives, working with the Engineering Manager and product to turn open-ended problems into a vision, milestones, and a plan, and then lead the technical delivery. You will partner with another tech lead on the team who leads our experience work, including the request details page and our new mobile app. This is a Staff-leaning scope with more leadership than a typical senior role: you will be evaluated on the results of the team and the initiatives you lead, and you will still write code. You will report to the Engineering Manager, Approvals.

Why you'll love this role:

 - Own the foundation. Every Zip product team builds on Approvals, so making it faster and easier to build on helps teams across the company launch faster.

 - High visibility. We own some of Zip's most important pages. The request details page we recently redesigned is seen by every customer every day, and leadership cares about it.

 - Real technical depth. Performance and correctness at scale for enterprise customers, plus the chance to modernize a legacy framework we own.

 - Shape our AI roadmap. Bring AI into approvals and procurement automation, with room to define what we build next.

 - Lead a growing team. The team is nine engineers today and growing to 10 or 11, with a path to bigger scope or into engineering management if you want it.

 - A team that listens. We run monthly retros and make process changes with everyone's buy-in. We take quality seriously, with code owners on critical areas, a 24-hour review SLA, and leadership that backs engineers who block low-quality PRs.




YOU WILL

 - Lead, mentor, coach, and grow the Approvals engineering team through design discussions, code reviews, and hands-on guidance, giving engineers room to take ownership.

 - Set the technical direction and make architecture and design decisions for our governance and compliance roadmap and our AI initiatives.

 - Turn open-ended problems, like procurement automation, into a vision, milestones, and a resourcing plan with product and design, then lead the technical delivery.

 - Own the quality bar for the team: bug volume, test coverage, and on-call health.

 - Work through escalations from enterprise customers, such as requests for more granular permissions: judge feasibility, say yes or no with clear reasoning, and design solutions that scale instead of becoming brittle.

 - Review specs and design docs for other teams building on Approvals, and help them understand how their needs interact with our framework.

 - Stay hands-on: design, build, and ship code, and lead projects from ambiguous requirements through rollout and production quality.

 - Improve the performance and latency of conditions and workflow recalculation at scale, and modernize our legacy framework through quality initiatives.

 - Cut on-call load by spotting patterns in tickets and building automation, so the team spends less time on tickets.

 - Escalate risks and resourcing needs to leadership early, and partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams like Support and Customer Success to shape what we build.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience as a Tech Lead or Staff-level engineer, ideally at a fast-growing startup or a company that serves businesses with compliance requirements, with a track record of mentoring engineers and caring about their career growth.

 - A personality that rallies the team: someone people respect and want to work with, and who champions the culture.

 - Strong backend engineering and system design skills. This role is mostly backend, and frontend experience is not required.

 - Experience improving the performance and latency of production systems, and caring deeply about quality, reliability, and test coverage.

 - Ownership: you own a technology area, have strong opinions about it, and can explain why something can or cannot be done to product and design.

 - Experience leading a team of about five or more engineers, with influence across teams. You can review other teams' designs and understand how their needs fit with ours.

 - Experience on critical enterprise systems where governance, compliance, or reliability matter, and a deep understanding of how sensitive they are.

 - Strong communication: you share knowledge openly, give credit generously, and raise risks early.

 - Initiative: you look beyond your own responsibilities to find opportunities, spot problems early, and bring solutions.

 - Comfort using AI tools heavily in your engineering work.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience working directly with customers and with functions like Customer Success and Support, and interest in collaborating with them.

 - Domain knowledge in procurement or adjacent spaces such as workflow, finance, or compliance products.



The salary range for this role is $200,000 - $300,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst, Aviation (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS OPERATIONS ANALYST, AVIATION (STARLINK)

We are rapidly accelerating our transformation of the airline passenger experience and are seeking individuals with a track record of solving complex technical challenges with partners and customers. Starlink designs, builds, tests and operates all of the technology utilized in our solutions for airlines. Our mission is to put Starlink on everything that flies and bring the Starlink experience to millions of passengers globally. To accomplish this, we are creating deep technical alignment with our airline partners across the areas of passenger experience, mechanical and electrical integration, network performance and measurement and application-level features and functionality.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform in-depth analyses of metrics using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities

• Develop forecasting models for growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators

• Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement

• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and account management teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning

• Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis

• Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making

• Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree

• 1+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations

• 2+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field

• Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization

• Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)

• Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)

• Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention

• Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)

• Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams

• Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed

• This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00
Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.title: B2B Ecosystem Lead, Business Development
jobs.description:
About the Team: 

We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We develop strategic and product partnerships across the B2B ecosystem, bringing together OpenAI’s capabilities and partners’ technology, expertise, data, workflows, and customer relationships. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales, we turn these opportunities into useful offerings and new ways for businesses to adopt and benefit from OpenAI.

About the Role: 

As a B2B Ecosystem Lead, you will identify, develop, and execute strategic and product partnerships across B2B segments. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning opportunity assessment, partnership design, commercial negotiation, and execution. You will own the partner work behind product initiatives, from defining partner needs through launch and sustained adoption at scale. These may include Sign in with ChatGPT and industry-specific offerings. You bring a generalist’s ability to connect product priorities with partner capabilities, build a business case, and align teams around a practical path forward. You will remain accountable after signing and launch, including for selected high-touch strategic partnerships.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Identify strategic and product partnership opportunities across B2B segments; translate product priorities and customer needs into partner plans, joint value propositions, and a focused set of prospective partners.

 - Own the partner work stream for assigned product initiatives, aligning requirements, commitments, milestones, and ongoing responsibilities with Product, Engineering, and partner teams.

 - Develop business cases and negotiate product and commercial partnerships with Legal, Finance, and Product, including selected high-touch strategic deals in coordination with other partnership owners.

 - Take partner initiatives from pilot through launch and scale, defining readiness criteria, coordinating integrations, and expanding successful offerings to more partners and business customers.

 - Work with Sales and partner teams on target accounts, referrals, joint selling, and customer introductions, with clear responsibilities for follow-up and opportunity tracking.

 - Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Security, Policy, and Operations to resolve launch and adoption barriers, with clear ownership and handoffs into ongoing partner programs.

 - Maintain partner relationships after launch and bring customer feedback, integration gaps, and adoption barriers back to Product and Engineering; help turn early implementations into repeatable offerings.

 - Define success measures with product and go-to-market teams, track activation, sustained usage, customer outcomes, and commercial impact, and drive follow-up when an initiative falls short.

Qualifications:

 - 8+ years of experience in business development, strategic or product partnerships, or related roles developing commercial opportunities in technology or other B2B businesses.

 - Experience developing B2B partnerships and taking a product, integration, or partner initiative from concept or pilot through launch and sustained adoption, working closely with product and technical teams.

 - A broad business perspective and the ability to learn unfamiliar industries, evaluate partner capabilities and strategic fit, and turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear business case and partnership plan.

 - Understanding of how businesses use software, data, and services, and how product integrations, distribution, and complementary capabilities create value. Experience across B2B sectors and business models is a plus.

 - Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to assess economics, prioritize competing opportunities, and use performance data to guide decisions.

 - Ability to build relationships with partner practitioners and leaders, work effectively across technical and business teams, and move projects forward without formal authority.

 - Clear writing and communication, curiosity about AI, and a willingness to do the detailed work of growing partnerships. You combine initiative and adaptability with disciplined follow-through.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.title: Gameday Stage Manager (Seasonal)
jobs.description:
At Angel City FC, we are building a world-class organization that uses sport to drive equity. One of the most valuable women’s sports teams in the world, we are redefining how sport, entertainment, and purpose intersect.

Our vision is to create engaging and unique experiences that bring our mission to life while building a sustainable, high-growth business. We lead with passion, innovation, and a commitment to doing things differently.

We are stronger together, have more impact together, and have more fun together.

We are seeking Seasonal Gameday Stage Managers to support the Game Presentation department in delivering an engaging, seamless matchday experience. Reporting to the Game Presentation Manager, Stage Managers coordinate talent, oversee assigned production areas, and execute live entertainment and scripted elements throughout home matches.

Responsibilities

• Support the execution of pregame, in-match, halftime, and postgame programming, ensuring assigned elements run accurately and on schedule.

• Assist with rehearsals, sound checks, talent preparation, and production setup.

• Coordinate field-level entertainment and activations, including the national anthem, sponsor integrations, giveaways, interviews, presentations, youth soccer activities, and special ceremonies.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned talent, vendors, players, executives, and guests, communicating arrival instructions, positioning, timing, and cues.

• Follow the run of show and communicate updates, timing changes, and production issues promptly to the producer, director, and appropriate crew members.

• Serve as a liaison between on-field officials and the production team as assigned.

• Assist with postgame activities, including penalty kick experiences, sponsored photo opportunities, and production breakdown.

Qualifications

• Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills, with close attention to detail.

• Ability to follow production cues, manage multiple assignments, and meet tight timelines in a fast-paced live event environment.

• Proactive, resourceful approach to problem-solving, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances.

• Professionalism when working with talent, players, staff, executives, fans, children, and VIP guests.

• Collaborative mindset and commitment to Angel City FC’s mission and values.

• Ability to lift and move production equipment and materials weighing more than 35 pounds.

• Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including heat and cold.

Experience

• 1-2 minimum years of experience working in live sports entertainment, TV/Film production, live event management, or other relevant production/coordination experience preferred.

• Soccer knowledge and passion is a plus.

Compensation:

The role is seasonal, hourly and pays $22.00 an hour.

Flexible schedule; able to commit to 80% or more of Angel City FC home games (all Stage Managers are not required to work all home games – games are scheduled on a rotating basis).

Angel City FC is committed to building an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity and fosters belonging. We believe our differences make us stronger, and we are proud to build a team that reflects the communities we serve.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Services
jobs.description:
Who is Trace3?

Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate.

Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it!

Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco.

Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

Come Join Us!

Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times

We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems.

Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover

We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart

We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

JOB SUMMARY:

Under the direction of the General Manager and Account Executive and in close partnership with the Strategic Account Managers, the Managing Director, Services is responsible for accelerating services growth across the FSG client base. This leader identifies, shapes, and advances consulting-led opportunities spanning Management Consulting and IT Services, including managed services and capabilities across Security, Data and Analytics, Cloud, Networking, Infrastructure, and adjacent technology domains. The role brings a management consulting approach to client discovery, executive alignment, solution development, pursuit leadership, and commercial strategy, connecting client business priorities to measurable outcomes and executable services engagements. This is a services sales leadership role, not an account ownership or day-to-day delivery management position. Account Executive and Strategic Account Managers retain account ownership, while this role leads the services strategy and selling motion in partnership with them.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Services Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

• Develop and execute account-level services growth strategies in partnership with the General Manager, Account Executives, and Strategic Account Managers.

• Identify, qualify, shape, and advance Management Consulting and IT Services opportunities within existing clients and selected prospects.

• Create demand by connecting client business priorities, operational challenges, risk exposure, and transformation goals to relevant consulting and technology services.

• Lead complex, multi-workstream services pursuits from early discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Build, maintain, and forecast a qualified services pipeline with clear next steps, decision criteria, competitive positioning, and close plans.

• Meet or exceed assigned bookings, revenue, gross profit, and pipeline objectives.

Executive Client Engagement & Consultative Selling

• Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders, including C-suite executives, transformation leaders, security leaders, data leaders, infrastructure leaders, and procurement stakeholders.

• Lead executive discovery sessions and working meetings to clarify business problems, desired outcomes, priorities, constraints, and investment rationale.

• Use hypothesis-driven, outcome-oriented consulting techniques to frame opportunities and build consensus across business and technology stakeholders.

• Translate complex client needs into clear problem statements, value propositions, roadmaps, and services recommendations.

• Position Trace3 as a long-term advisory and services partner rather than a transactional technology provider.

Management Consulting & IT Services Portfolio Leadership

• Drive sales across Management Consulting offerings such as strategy, operating model, organizational change, program leadership, maturity assessments, roadmaps, governance, and transformation planning.

• Drive sales across IT Services, including managed services and project-based services in Security, Data and Analytics, Cloud, Networking, Infrastructure, and related technology domains.

• Partner with consulting, managed services, engineering, architecture, delivery, and domain leaders to assemble integrated solutions across multiple practices.

• Identify opportunities to expand from advisory work into implementation and managed services, and from technical engagements into broader consulting relationships.

• Maintain sufficient knowledge of the services portfolio, delivery models, commercial constructs, and relevant partner capabilities to credibly lead executive sales conversations.

Pursuit Leadership, Solution Development & Commercial Strategy

• Orchestrate pursuit teams, establish win strategy, define roles, and maintain momentum across complex sales cycles.

• Lead the development of proposals, statements of work, presentations, business cases, and executive-level recommendations in collaboration with solution and delivery leaders.

• Ensure proposed scope, assumptions, outcomes, staffing model, pricing, timeline, and delivery approach are aligned before client commitment.

• Partner with account leadership, legal, finance, operations, and delivery teams on pricing, risk review, contracting, and negotiation.

• Conduct effective handoffs to delivery leadership while preserving client context, intended outcomes, commercial commitments, and expansion opportunities.
