JOB SUMMARY:

In this role, you will work closely with client personnel, facility operations, laboratories, and waste management vendors to evaluate waste streams, interpret analytical data, prepare waste profiles, coordinate sampling, and identify compliant and cost-effective treatment, recycling, and disposal options. The successful candidate will apply knowledge of Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) requirements, hazardous waste determinations, chemical processes, and industrial waste management practices to support sound, defensible waste management decisions. This is an excellent opportunity for an environmental professional who enjoys solving technical challenges and supporting environmental compliance in an active chemical manufacturing environment.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Characterize and classify hazardous and nonhazardous waste streams generated from chemical manufacturing, laboratory, maintenance, remediation, and other industrial operations.
• Perform hazardous waste determinations and provide technical guidance on RCRA, state-specific regulations, generator requirements, and land disposal restrictions.
• Review process information, safety data sheets (SDSs), historical records, laboratory reports, and analytical data to support waste characterization decisions.
• Develop sampling strategies, coordinate sample collection and laboratory analysis, and interpret results to establish appropriate waste management requirements.
• Prepare, review, and maintain waste profiles, Waste Profile Numbers (WPNs), hazardous waste determinations, and supporting documentation.
• Evaluate waste acceptance criteria and recommend appropriate treatment, recycling, recovery, transportation, and disposal options.
• Support waste segregation, compatibility evaluations, packaging, labeling, storage, accumulation, and shipment preparation in accordance with regulatory requirements and client procedures.
• Provide technical support for specialty waste streams, including laboratory packs, chemical waste collections, process residuals, contaminated equipment, tank and vessel cleaning wastes, sludges, wastewater treatment residuals, and off-specification products.
• Respond to client and facility inquiries regarding waste classification, sampling and analytical requirements, handling, container selection, and disposal options.
• Coordinate with environmental, health and safety (EHS), operations, laboratory, engineering, procurement, and waste management personnel to resolve waste management challenges.
• Maintain accurate waste characterization records and data in client and company tracking systems.
• Support environmental audits, regulatory inspections, internal assessments, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Identify opportunities to reduce waste generation, improve segregation, increase recycling and recovery, and enhance waste management efficiency.
• Prepare technical reports, memoranda, procedures, and other client deliverables documenting waste characterization and management decisions.
• Support project execution through schedule coordination, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), and client reporting.
• Follow all applicable health, safety, process safety, PPE, and site-specific requirements.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Chemistry, Geology, Biology, or a related field and 2+ years of relevant environmental experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• A valid driver’s license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.
• Due to the nature and location of the work, United States citizenship or naturalized United States citizenship is required.
• Must successfully pass a pre-employment substance abuse test and medical screening.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Working knowledge of RCRA hazardous waste identification and management requirements and applicable federal and state environmental regulations.
• Experience supporting hazardous and nonhazardous waste characterization, environmental compliance, or industrial waste management activities.
• Ability to communicate technical findings effectively and coordinate with clients, laboratories, waste management vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
• Experience supporting waste characterization and management activities within chemical manufacturing, petrochemical, refining, or other industrial environments.
• Familiarity with RCRA hazardous waste identification requirements under 40 CFR Part 261, including listed wastes, hazardous waste characteristics, and state-specific regulations.
• Experience reviewing laboratory analytical data, supporting hazardous waste determinations, and preparing waste profiles or Waste Profile Numbers (WPNs).
• Familiarity with hazardous waste generator requirements, accumulation practices, labeling, packaging, transportation, and disposal documentation.
• Experience coordinating waste sampling, laboratory analysis, and interpreting results to support waste classification and management decisions.
• Knowledge of specialty industrial waste streams, including laboratory packs, chemical process residuals, sludges, contaminated equipment, and wastewater treatment residuals.
• Experience using waste characterization databases, environmental management systems, or client-specific waste tracking software.
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accurate records and meeting deadlines.
• Demonstrated commitment to safe work practices in chemical manufacturing and other industrial environments.

• Sponsorship is not offered for this position now or in the future.
• This position offers the opportunity to support a complex chemical industry client by applying technical expertise to challenging waste characterization and environmental compliance needs. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting defensible waste determinations, consistent facility practices, regulatory compliance, and responsible waste management throughout industrial operations.

jobs.title: Full Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT HUDU:

Hudu is a fast-growing SaaS platform built exclusively for IT professionals and Managed Service Providers (MSPs). We give teams a single, secure, and beautifully simple place to store, organize, and share everything that keeps modern IT environments running: passwords, network documentation, processes, assets, client knowledge, and more. By replacing scattered spreadsheets, outdated wikis, and a dozen disconnected tools with one unified, customizable solution, Hudu helps thousands of IT teams save time, reduce risk, deliver better service, and scale with confidence.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a full-stack Rails engineer who enjoys building things from the ground up. You’ll own work end to end, from the data model to the interface customers use every day, and help shape how new capabilities are designed and built across our platform.

This role suits someone who likes ownership and early-stage work: making architecture decisions, scoping first versions with product and design, and improving quickly based on what customers tell us. You’ll work alongside the engineers behind Hudu and Radar, with the support of a mature engineering team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lay the foundations for new capabilities, making and documenting architecture decisions on data models, background jobs, and service boundaries that will hold up as they grow.

 - Ship features end to end across the stack: database, models, controllers, APIs, and user interface.

 - Design and build RESTful APIs, including integrations with Hudu's existing products and third-party platforms.

 - Turn designs into responsive, accessible interfaces using Hotwire (Turbo Frames, Turbo Streams, and Stimulus).

 - Partner with product and design to shape requirements, scope early versions, and iterate based on customer feedback.

 - Write well-tested code using test-driven development, and give and receive thoughtful code reviews.

 - Help set up the product's deployment pipeline, monitoring, and error tracking, and own its performance and reliability once it's in customers' hands.

 - Keep the team informed on progress, tradeoffs, and blockers in a remote, async environment.

 - Help set up deployment pipelines, monitoring, and error tracking, and own performance and reliability once your work is in customers’ hands.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 4+ years of experience building production applications with Ruby on Rails.

 - Strong full-stack skills: ActiveRecord and relational database design, routing, controllers, service objects, and background jobs, plus modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

 - Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs.

 - Experience with Hotwire or a similar server-rendered front-end approach, and a track record of turning UI/UX designs into polished, user-friendly interfaces.

 - A history of shipping features with real ownership, from idea to production.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: you can make pragmatic tradeoffs early in a product's life and know when to revisit them.

 - A habit of writing clean, well-tested, maintainable code, and experience with Git and pull-request-based review.

 - Clear written and spoken communication in English, especially in a remote team.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building a new product, or working as an early or founding engineer.

 - Experience building software for IT professionals, MSPs, or other technical users.

 - Experience with our tools: RSpec, Swagger/OpenAPI, GitHub Actions, Docker, and Sentry.

 - Experience with Dart and Flutter.

 - Experience using AI tools such as Claude in your development workflow.

 - Experience building new products or capabilities from scratch, or working as an early or founding engineer.




OUR TECH STACK

 - Our existing products are built with the latest Ruby on Rails and Hotwire.

 - We use RSpec and practice test-driven development.

 - Our APIs follow REST and are documented with Swagger.

 - We use GitHub for pull request review and GitHub Actions for our deployment pipeline.

 - We use Sentry for error reporting and Docker for development and production.




WHY WORK AT HUDU:

 - Innovation & Impact : Rapid product evolution with regular feature updates and new tools. Building tools that solve real pain points for users.

 - Customer Focus: High user satisfaction with ease of use, powerful documentation capabilities, and strong product support.

 - Growth Mindset: A high-growth, startup environment where team members can wear many hats, innovate, and grow with the company.

 - Benefits & Perks:
   
   - Health Insurance
   
   - 401k plan with company matching
   
   - Paid time-off
   
   - Flexible work hours
   
   - Work Life Balance

Compensation for this role will be determined on several factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, education, and job-related qualifications. If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred qualifications, we still encourage you to apply!



Hudu is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing an inclusive workplace environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request throughout the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Clever is on a mission to connect every student to a world of learning. As the leading identity platform for education, more than 111,000 schools worldwide use Clever to power secure digital learning experiences. With Clever’s layered security solutions, schools can protect access and identities for all staff, teachers, and students. With a secure identity platform for schools and a network of leading application providers, Clever is committed to advancing education with technology that works for students everywhere. Clever, a Kahoot! company, has an office in San Francisco, CA, but you can visit us at clever.com anytime.

About the Team & Opportunity

The Admin Dashboard team at Clever builds the mission-control center for school administrators. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will focus on accelerating the adoption of Clever’s products by building the tools administrators use to securely connect data and manage educational applications at scale. We are hiring because our administrative experience is a cornerstone of Clever’s success; you will work in a highly collaborative environment to ensure that the "back office" of digital learning is efficient, secure, and user-friendly.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• The problem you’ll solve: You will build the features that help school leaders manage thousands of teacher and student accounts and app connections, turning complex data configurations into simple, intuitive administrative workflows.

• Who you’ll partner with: You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, and fellow engineers to build intuitive UIs and robust backend services.

• What success looks like: Success is measured by the delivery of high-quality, maintainable code and the successful launch of features that simplify the administration, renewal and discovery process for our school partners.

• Key projects you’ll lead: You will develop new UI enhancements and Go-based microservices and help ensure we provide the best international experience.

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills & Experience (Must-Haves)

• Engineering Foundation: 2+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer with a strong foundation in software engineering principles and full-stack development.

• Problem Solving: Proven ability to architect solutions for various product and data needs and a track record of leading small projects within a team environment.

• Quality & Reliability: A strong commitment to writing simple, high-performing code that is easy to maintain long-term, with practical experience generating and automating tests (unit and end-to-end).

• Cultural Alignment: A commitment to understand and prioritize the Clever engineering culture (see our blog post on Defining Clever's Engineering Culture).

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)

• Technical Stack: Experience with our tech stack which includes Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React, using AWS services such as lambdas and step functions, and databases/storage such as DynamoDB, S3, OpenSearch, and MongoDB.

• User-Centric Design: A desire to build products that specifically cater to administrative power users and curriculum leaders.

• System Stability: Comfort with participating in a team on-call rotation to support the schools that rely on our platform daily.

• AI Development Tools: Familiarity with leveraging AI coding tools (such as Claude Code or Cursor) to enhance development workflows, productivity, and code quality.

Benefits & Perks

• Competitive salary

• Flexible PTO and Paid Parental Leave

• Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage

• Mental healthcare services

• Professional development budget

• Annual company retreat + team events

Salary Transparency

The range of our base salary cash compensation for this role for candidates living in the United States, besides NYC and San Francisco, CA, is between $115,000-$135,000. For candidates living in NYC and San Francisco, CA, it's between $126,000-$148,000. All final offers are determined using multiple factors, including experience and level of expertise.

Inclusion & Belonging

Clever believes classrooms and our company should be diverse and inclusive. We celebrate actions that build diverse teams, include every voice, and create safe spaces for everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

Clever does not conduct interviews via text or Telegram. We will never ask for your financial information or reimbursement of equipment of any kind. If you receive any communications regarding employment with Clever that you think might be a scam, please email recruitingscam@clever.com.

jobs.title: Director, Solution Architecture, Commercialization and Corporate systems
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Revolution Medicines is seeking a Director of Solution Architecture to lead integrated technology design across Commercial, Medical Affairs and General & Administrative (G&A) functions. This leader will shape architecture across the evolving business application portfolio, connecting processes, data and platforms to support commercialization, global expansion and efficient operations. The role will guide solution decisions from business intake through implementation and operational readiness, working closely with functional leaders, Information Technology (IT), control owners and delivery partners. This is a Director-level individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities across cross-functional teams and external partners.

Responsibilities:

• Define target architecture and inform investment roadmaps across current and future Commercial, Medical Affairs and G&A capabilities, translating business strategy into integrated solutions that support product launches, international expansion and enterprise growth.

• Partner with business and technology leaders to shape requests, clarify outcomes and dependencies, assess options, and recommend solutions based on business value, risk, scalability and total cost of ownership.

• Provide architecture leadership across the G&A portfolio, including Finance, Human Resources, Procurement, Legal, corporate services and enterprise operations. Connect workflows across these functions and with Commercialization, Supply Chain, and other business areas, extending architecture patterns as new business capabilities emerge.

• Provide architecture leadership for critical cross-platform integrations, new capabilities and key technology decisions across Commercial and Medical systems, partnering with Medical, Omnichannel, Field and Data Solutions leads who own solution design within their respective areas. Assess enterprise platform scalability, including enterprise resource planning (ERP), for growth in legal entities, products, users and transaction volumes. Guide global templates and local requirements for language, currency, tax, statutory reporting and business practices.

• Architect connected planning, forecasting and external partner ecosystems as business needs evolve. Examples include linking commercial and financial plans with supply operations and integrating third-party logistics (3PL) providers, distributors and manufacturing partners.

• Evaluate artificial intelligence (AI), automation and emerging technologies against business needs. Reuse existing enterprise tools where suitable and define integration, data access, human oversight and measurable outcomes for new capabilities.

• Define reusable application, data and integration patterns using application programming interfaces (APIs), integration platforms and events. Establish authoritative data sources, master data ownership, reconciliation and exception handling with the relevant domain owners.

• Partner with enterprise Data teams to design reliable information flows, consistent business definitions and reporting dependencies across operational systems, analytics and decision support.

• Establish design standards and architecture reviews. Document decisions, system boundaries and dependencies, and resolve cross-platform trade-offs while keeping delivery teams accountable for implementation quality.

• Provide technical leadership from discovery and vendor selection through design, implementation, testing, deployment and operational acceptance. Define performance, availability, recovery and support requirements early in the lifecycle.

• Design for global delivery and support, with clear ownership, monitoring, knowledge transfer and handoffs across time zones. Ensure solutions transition to internal teams and managed service providers with agreed readiness criteria.

• Partner with Security, Quality, Privacy, Finance and control owners to embed applicable Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Good Practice (GxP), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and local requirements into designs, including access, segregation of duties, validation, audit trails and retention.

• Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, consolidate overlapping systems and reduce integration and support costs. Define the growth, risk and performance thresholds that trigger a different platform or operating approach.

Partner with platform owners, domain specialists, engineers and architects across internal and external teams to develop solution designs and integrations across systems, drawing on their expertise while maintaining overall architectural coherence. Challenge designs constructively, communicate recommendations to senior leaders, and ensure vendor solutions meet RevMed architecture standards and agreed commercial scope.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 12+ years of progressive technology experience, including 5+ years in solution architecture or comparable technical leadership across complex enterprise programs.

• Experience in life sciences or another regulated industry is required; biotech or pharmaceutical experience is highly preferred.

• Demonstrated architecture experience spanning Commercial or Medical platforms and enterprise G&A systems, with depth in one or more domains and the ability to lead design decisions across the broader portfolio.

• Demonstrated ability to anticipate technology shifts and apply AI and automation to solution design and delivery, challenging established approaches and introducing practical new ways of working that improve speed, quality and business outcomes.

• Strong experience with cloud and software-as-a-service platforms, integration architecture, enterprise data flows, security and nonfunctional requirements such as performance, reliability and recovery.

• Experience translating business requirements into architecture options, roadmaps and technical designs, and guiding delivery through implementation and transition to support.

• Working knowledge of applicable SOX controls, regulated-system lifecycle practices, privacy and data protection requirements, and experience partnering with the accountable specialists to implement controls.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, explain technical trade-offs in business terms, resolve competing priorities and lead internal and partner teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience supporting oncology commercialization, multiple product launches, new legal entities or expansion across the United States, Europe and Asia Pacific.

• Experience architecting solutions across enterprise platforms such as Veeva CRM, Oracle NetSuite, SAP, Workday, Ironclad Contract Lifecycle Management, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Databricks, or comparable platforms. Depth in one or more of these ecosystems, combined with experience integrating solutions across business functions, is preferred.

• Experience with external commercial, distribution or manufacturing integrations, master data management, or regulated content and review workflows.

• Practical experience deploying AI or automation with enterprise controls, and improving platform reuse, delivery speed or total cost of ownership.

• Enterprise or solution architecture certification, or equivalent demonstrated architecture practice.

jobs.title: Staff Propulsion Engineer, Combustion Devices, Liquids
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Our products and technologies require an extraordinary team. A team that will mold the technologies of tomorrow while delivering today’s best. We are an intrinsically motivated team that has a passion for solving problems and empowering each other every day to develop our skills knowing that there is always room for growth.

As a Staff Propulsion Engineer for Combustion Devices you are an advanced technical leader and a primary owner for combustion hardware across one or more engine programs. You will lead clean sheet design development and validation of combustion devices such as injectors chambers nozzles preburners and ignition systems. You will drive architecture and trade studies for combustion devices solve the most challenging technical problems refine standards and best practices and mentor other engineers. You will own hardware and technical roadmaps from concept through qualification and production support and will often support multiple engines or product lines at once.

• Lead clean sheet design and development of combustion devices including main injectors, preburner injectors, combustion chambers, nozzles, and ignition systems and integrate these into the engine system

• Own combustion device hardware through the full lifecycle including concept design, detailed design, build, test, qualification, production support, and fielded hardware issue resolution

• Define and conduct trade studies for engine and combustion architecture options and provide clear recommendations on configuration performance cost risk and manufacturability

• Develop and improve standards work instructions design guides and acceptance and qualification test approaches for combustion devices and ensure consistent application across programs

• Lead root cause investigations for combustion device issues in test or production and drive implementation of durable corrective actions in design process and test

• Plan and oversee development and qualification test campaigns for combustion devices and work closely with test and analysis teams to interpret data and update designs and models

• Collaborate closely with systems analysis materials manufacturing and test teams to reduce variation improve reliability and enable efficient production of combustion hardware

• Mentor and train junior and senior engineers in combustion device design analysis test and development practices and lead design reviews and technical deep dives

• Collaborate closely with manufacturing and printing to establish guideline, standards, and requirements for manufacturing quality, repeatability, and qualification

Required Qualifications

• Direct experience owning design test or analysis of rocket engine injectors chambers or nozzles through build and hot fire testing

• Working knowledge and hands on experience with fluid mechanical and basic electrical systems as applied to propulsion hardware

• Strong understanding of industry standards and requirements and experience working within aerospace or defense quality environments

• Experience with structural thermal or fluids analysis using tools such as Ansys and or CFD tools for combustor and injector analysis

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Partnerships
jobs.description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

About the role:

AssemblyAI ships new speech models fast, and a growing share of our usage runs through partner platforms: voice agent orchestrators like LiveKit, Pipecat and Vapi, telephony providers like Telnyx, routers like OpenRouter, and cloud marketplaces like AWS and Databricks. Every model release has to land in those platforms at parity, and every partner's sales and solutions teams need to know how to position it. That is the job.

As our first Partnerships Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll own the technical side of our integration partnerships: keeping integrations current and healthy, enabling partner GTM teams on each new model, and running the technical sell (evals, benchmarks, demos) that turns integrations into usage. You'll report to the Head of Partnerships and work closely with Applied AI, Product, Sales and Marketing.

This is a builder role. You'll write code most weeks, and you'll spend the rest of your time in front of partner engineers, AEs and solutions teams.

This role is hybrid. You'll need to live within commuting distance of our SF office.

What You'll Do:

Keep priority integrations at parity with every release

• Own the end-to-end launch checklist for priority partners: test each new model and feature in the partner's stack, ship the plugin or SDK update, and confirm it's live

• Open and shepherd PRs into partner repos; work with partner engineers to get them reviewed, merged and released

• Monitor integration health (usage by model, error rates, version drift, deprecated model IDs) and fix issues before customers find them

• Keep partner-facing docs, examples and quickstarts accurate as our API changes

Enable partner GTM teams

• Run recurring enablement sessions with partner AEs, FDEs and solutions engineers on each new model: what changed, how the integration works, how to talk about it with customers

• Build seller-ready assets: one-pagers, "when to recommend AssemblyAI" guides, objection handling, demo apps

• Plan and run joint GTM sessions, webinars and launch content with partner marketing teams

Run the technical sell

• Turn model performance into partner-ready evidence: WER and entity accuracy benchmarks, latency comparisons, side-by-side evals on partner or customer audio

• Support partner-sourced customer evaluations and technical escalations

jobs.title: Social Media Community Strategist, Freelance
jobs.description:
Why You’ll Never Want to Leave

Respect People. Produce Results.

For more than 35 years, we’ve built a reputation for both the work we do and how we do it.

Respect shows up in how we work together and with our clients. It means trusting people to do their jobs, giving them the space to do it well, and holding each other to a high standard. Because when people are respected, they do better work, work that grows businesses, shapes culture, and builds relationships that last. And just as important, they have the support to build a career and a life worth investing in.

Who You’ll Be Collaborating With

Every day, you’ll be teaming up with a diverse, enthusiastic, multi-disciplinary team of professionals with a smart sense of humor and a strong desire to grow and develop.

We’re looking for an experienced freelance Social Media Community Manager to join our Brand and Connections Strategy team, supporting social programs for a major automotive brand and a leading fuel brand.

This is a fast-paced, hands-on role focused on the day-to-day management of social communities across platforms Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and X. Responsibilities include community moderation, proactive and reactive engagement, crisis alerts and management, content calendar management, publishing, social listening, and identifying opportunities for timely, low-lift content.

You’ll step into established social programs and brand voices, working closely with strategy, creative and account teams to keep both brands responsive, relevant and connected to their communities. Beyond managing conversations, you’ll help identify what those conversations can tell us, surfacing shifts in sentiment, recurring audience behaviors, cultural moments and opportunities that can inform content and strategy.

The role also includes client-facing responsibilities, including contributing to sentiment reporting, content calendar reviews, and sharing community insights and recommendations. We’re looking for someone who’s energized by culture, curious about audience behavior, and is ready to support our teams and their priorities.

Essential Job Functions

Community management is one of the most direct ways people experience a brand on social. In this role, you’ll help support how brands listens, responds, and participate in culture in ways that feel timely, useful and true to their established voices.

• Manage day-to-day community engagement across social platforms (proactive and reactive), fostering positive community experiences and meaningful one-to-one interactions

• Write and publish platform-native social copy and engagement responses according to brand guidelines

• Monitor brand sentiment, cultural trends, and relevant conversations across social platforms, contributing to the creation of reactive, low-lift social content (e.g., replies, captions, simple visuals, short-form or mobile-first content) informed by real-time conversation and trends

• Schedule and publish social content across native channels and social media management tools

• Identify social listening insights and opportunities to inform monthly content planning

• Contribute social sentiment analysis and insight to monthly reports

• Identify and escalate sensitive issues, emerging risks, or customer service concerns according to established brand protocols

• Bring relevant community learnings to the Social & Digital Strategist to help evolve content and engagement strategies

• Confidently participate in client-facing meetings by sharing community insights, engagement learnings, and reports

Required and preferred hard and soft skills

• 2+ years of experience managing social media communities for brands, agencies, consumer-facing organizations, or freelancing

• Experience working in social media management tools to schedule and publish content, manage and reply to inbound messages, and manage creative assets required (experience working in Sprinklr strongly preferred)

• Experience using tools to monitor trending topics and brand sentiment in social media and formulating plans of action for brand engagement and/or response as appropriate (Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Hootesuite, Crimson Hexagon/Brandwatch, Netbase, Meltwater, native platform analytics, etc.)

• Strong familiarity and proficiency managing brand accounts across major and emerging Social Media platforms

• Experience working in high-pace environments and collaborative team settings

• Relentlessly curious; seeks to understand not just what is happening, but why

• Culturally aware and proactive, always looking for new ways to engage communities and improve how brands show up in social

• Strong interest in social media trends, internet culture, and evolving platform behaviors

• Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally and contributing to client-facing settings

• Highly organized and able to maintain quality and accuracy across two fast-moving social programs

• Have an exceptional attention to detail; sweat the small stuff and pride yourself on the pursuit of precision

jobs.title: EH&S Specialist II
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The EHS team carries a profound responsibility to keep people and the environments where we operate safe while we build the future. We're not here to slow things down; we're here to enable safe speed. At this stage in Relativity’s trajectory, you'll have the rare opportunity to shape how EHS is embedded in every process and decision, from the factory floor to the launch pad. We have a voice at every level, and we use it to build a culture where EHS isn’t just about compliance, but rather a shared responsibility amongst all employees.

About the Role:

• Collaborate with technicians and engineers to provide safety insights for developing processes

• Identify hazards, perform risk assessments like Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), and implement effective control measures

• Participate in the test and activation of launch pad ground support equipment, including high pressure gas systems, cryogenic systems, flammable liquids, electrical systems, mechanical systems, and more

• Implement safety processes and programs for Launch Operations based on on-site observations, identified gaps, and feedback from all levels of personnel

• Balance time between in-field support and documentation, helping to build on our positive safety culture through visibility and availability

• Conduct safety audits, inspections, and incident investigations using root cause investigation strategies and provide meaningful corrective action recommendations

• Long term this position will include vehicle processing and launch support, which covers a wide range of EHS topics. These areas may include fall protection, hearing protection, respiratory protection, hazard communication, industrial hygiene, confined spaces, control of hazardous energy and more

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)

• Minimum 2+ years of EHS experience. Preferred experience in launch operations, aerospace manufacturing, pressure systems, or other complex technical environments

• Familiarity with OSHA, ANSI, ASME, and/or related safety standards

• Experience conducting risk assessments, hazard analysis, and incident investigations in complex technical environments

• Experience in field application of various safety programs in a high-speed technical environment

Nice to haves but not required:

• Experience in providing EHS training

• Experience in continuous improvement strategies

• Relevant Certifications: Associate Safety Professional (ASP), Graduate Safety Professional (GSP), Certified Safety Professional (CSP), OSHA 10 hour, OSHA 30 hour, RCRA/DOT, or other professional safety certifications

• Proficient in Microsoft Office tools

• Strong organizational, analytical, and time-management skills

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Ripple is building the Internet of Value: infrastructure that moves money as fast as information moves today. Every payment that flows across our network passes through real-time financial crimes controls: sanctions screening, wallet risk analysis, transaction monitoring, and travel rule compliance. The Financial Crimes Engineering team builds and operates that layer.

This is the engineering that determines whether payments clear or hold, whether Ripple meets its regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, and whether the network can scale without compromising on compliance. The problem space is genuinely hard: high-throughput distributed systems, real-time decisioning, multi-source coordination across external compliance data providers, regulator-grade audit trails, and resilience.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will set the multi-year technical direction for the compliance control plane and drive its adoption beyond your own team. You will own the architecture of the vendor-agnostic, resilient, provable system that lets Ripple move value without moving financial crime, and you will shape how compliance engineering works across the company. This is a role for someone who defines which problems the organization solves, not only how they get solved: you will set the technical strategy other teams build against, establish the patterns that become organizational standards, and serve as the senior-most engineering voice on how regulatory obligations become durable infrastructure.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Own the multi-year architectural vision for the compliance control plane: real-time screening orchestration, the resilience and observability layer, vendor-agnostic integration, and the decision and data plane, sequenced against where Ripple's products and regulatory surface will be in three years, not where they are today

• Drive the hardest, highest-ambiguity technical problems end to end: multi-vendor failover, sub-second decisioning under load, regulator-grade auditability, and resilience across partial dependency failures

• Set technical direction that extends beyond FinCrimes: define the integration contracts, resilience patterns, and compliance primitives that partner engineering teams adopt, and drive alignment across organizational boundaries where no single team owns the outcome

• Translate evolving regulatory obligations and organizational goals into durable engineering primitives and a sequenced technical roadmap, and influence what the organization invests in to get there

• Anticipate platform risks and scaling constraints years before they become incidents, and lead the initiatives that address them

• Partner directly with executive leadership across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product to shape how regulatory requirements become engineering reality, and represent the platform's technical position to auditors, regulators, and external partners

• Set standards for production ownership across the team and beyond: observability, alerting, incident response, and the reliability bar that other teams calibrate against

• Multiply the technical capability of the organization: mentor staff and senior engineers, elevate design quality through architecture review, and raise the ceiling of what the team can take on

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

• 12+ years building production backend systems, with deep expertise in Java (or comparable JVM languages, Go, Rust)

• A track record of owning architecture for complex distributed systems at scale across multiple teams or organizations, defining the designs that others build against and that outlast your involvement

• Demonstrated ability to set technical direction at the organizational level and drive adoption of standards and patterns across team boundaries without formal authority

• Strong resilience and distributed-systems design instincts: failover, graceful degradation, idempotency, high-throughput real-time decisioning, and designing systems that survive the failure of dependencies you do not control

• Excellent API design judgment (REST/gRPC) and a history of establishing patterns that become organizational defaults

• Proven skill navigating ambiguity in a regulated environment, turning regulator findings, audit obligations, and partner asks into shippable, durable engineering plans, and defending those decisions to auditors and examiners

• Working knowledge of Kubernetes, observability tooling (Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar), and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)

• A track record of developing senior and staff engineers and measurably lifting the technical bar of an organization

• Experience in fintech, payments, identity, or compliance technology is a strong plus, though exceptional systems architects from adjacent high-stakes domains are welcome

WHY THIS ROLE:

• Consequence: your architecture decides whether real payments clear, in real time, for real customers.

• Ownership beyond the platform: you are not owning a service or even a system, you are shaping the compliance control plane that every Ripple product depends on and the standards that partner teams build to.

• Building the next generation: we are actively designing the vendor-agnostic, resilient compliance platform built to scale across new jurisdictions and product surfaces. This is the person who leads that design and sets its direction for the next several years.

• Executive-level influence: you will work directly with senior leaders across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product. The job is technical, but the influence is organizational.

• Technical leadership without leaving the code: the senior-most IC voice on a team where the engineering genuinely matters.

Other common names for this role:

For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.

CA Annual Base Salary Range

$240,000—$300,000 USD

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

• The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders

• A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.

• Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.

• In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.

• Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team

• We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

• Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity

• Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support

Take Care of Yourself

• R&R days so you can rest and recharge

• Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming

• Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it

• Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.

• Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

jobs.title: Staff Propulsion Engineer, Fluid & Mechanical Systems, Liquids
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Our products and technologies require an extraordinary team. A team that will mold the technologies of tomorrow while delivering today’s best. We are an intrinsically motivated team that has a passion for solving problems and empowering each other every day to develop our skills knowing that there is always room for growth.

Ursa Major teams move fast and do a lot with little. As a Staff Propulsion Engineer for Fluid and Mechanical Systems you are an advanced technical leader and primary owner for fluid and mechanical hardware and systems across one or more engine programs of various maturities. You will lead clean sheet design development and validation of components and systems such as valves actuators gimbals feed systems and test stand fluid systems. You will drive system architecture and trades solve the most challenging technical problems refine standards and best practices and mentor other engineers. You will own hardware and system roadmaps from concept through qualification and production support and often support multiple engines or product lines at once. Oversee maintenance and continued operation of flight proven hardware.

Responsibilities

• Lead clean sheet design and development of fluid and mechanical engine components including control valves, actuators, gimbals, and feed systems and integrate these into the engine and test stand architectures.

• Own fluid and mechanical hardware and subsystems through the full lifecycle, including concept design, detailed design, build, test, qualification, production support, and fielded hardware issue resolution.

• Develop and maintain system level fluid architectures including P&IDs, operating concepts, and control strategies for engine and test stand systems and perform trade studies on configuration performance cost risk and operability

• Lead performance and sizing analysis for high pressure cryogenic and hot fluid systems including valve sizing, line sizing, pressure drop, cavitation margin, and dynamic response

• Develop and improve standards, work instructions, design guides, and acceptance and qualification test approaches for fluid and mechanical components and systems and ensure consistent use across programs

• Lead root cause investigations for fluid or mechanical system issues in test or production and drive durable corrective actions in design process and operations

• Plan and oversee development qualification and acceptance test campaigns for fluid and mechanical hardware and work closely with test and analysis teams to interpret data and update designs and models

• Collaborate with combustion devices systems analysis materials manufacturing avionics and test operations teams to reduce variation improve reliability and enable efficient production and operation of fluid and mechanical systems

• Mentor and train junior and senior engineers in fluid system and mechanical design analysis test and development practices and lead design reviews and technical deep dives

• Work with purchasing and material control to identify and address supply chain challenges, obsolescence, and vendor quality

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor degree in Mechanical Aerospace or related Engineering field Master preferred

• 8 plus years of experience in propulsion or mechanical design roles with significant time focused on fluid and mechanical systems for aerospace or similar high consequence applications

• Direct experience owning design test or analysis of high pressure fluid systems and components such as valves actuators regulators manifolds or gimbals through build and test

• Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and intuition for high pressure cryogenic and propellant systems and experience with system level fluid architecture and integration

• Demonstrated proficiency with computer aided design and drafting and experience applying geometric dimensioning and tolerancing per ASME Y14.5

• Working knowledge and hands on experience with fluid mechanical and basic electrical systems as applied to propulsion hardware and control

• Experience operating within ISO 9001 or AS9100 environments and working knowledge of aerospace hardware qualification requirements and standards such as SMC S 016

• Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex hardware or subsystem scope across multiple builds or programs and deliver production ready designs

• Excellent problem solving task management communication and cross functional collaboration skills

Preferred Experience

• Experience leading technical teams or workstreams for fluid and mechanical systems on development or production engine or test stand programs

• Hands on test experience with high pressure cryogenic or propellant fluid systems including component and system level testing

• Familiarity with closed cycle or staged combustion engine architectures and their fluid system implications

• Demonstrated proficiency with basic machining practices or close collaboration with machine shops and experience with design for additive manufacturing for valve and actuator hardware

• Experience with structural thermal or fluids analysis using tools such as Ansys and or CFD tools for valve and fluid system analysis

• Experience with PTC Creo or Siemens NX and PLM systems such as Windchill

• Experience designing components and systems for cryogenic service in oxygen hydrogen or methane and supporting flight qualification or flight hardware operations

jobs.title: Senior Recruiting Manager
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Recruiting Manager, you are the single-threaded owner of talent delivery for a Business Line and/or Strategic Program within one of Anduril's Divisions. You combine strategic business partnership with direct people leadership. This role exists at the intersection of strategy and execution. You are embedded deeply within your Business Line - understanding its programs, products, revenue drivers, and leadership priorities at a level that allows you to translate business objectives into hiring strategies, prioritize demand against capacity, and ensure the right talent lands on the right programs at the right time.

As a Sr. Recruiting Manger, you add direct people leadership - owning performance management, coaching, career development, and capacity allocation for a team of recruiters while simultaneously acting as the strategic advisor for your key stakeholders.

You are the voice of the business to TA and the voice of TA to the business. You own the hiring plan, the reporting, the escalations, and the outcomes. This is the formalized leadership layer within our Business Line construct - the person who ensures every major program and initiative has the talent it needs to hit its milestones.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Strategic Business Partnership & Ownership

• Own the end-to-end TA strategy for your assigned Business Line, including headcount planning, demand management, requisition prioritization, and delivery against hiring targets tied to program milestones and revenue commitments.

• Act as a trusted advisor to BL leadership (VP, Program Directors, General Managers, and Division Heads), using market intelligence, hiring data, and capacity models to influence decisions and shape the talent roadmap.

• Define and manage hiring goals, SLAs, and success metrics for your Business Line — reporting progress through dashboards and business reviews with full transparency on pipeline health, risks, and capacity.

• Partner with Division BizOps, Finance, and Workforce Planning to align on headcount allocation, budget, hiring sequencing, and revenue-driven demand changes.

• Own all hiring progress reporting for your Business Line, delivering regular updates to divisional leadership and acting as the primary escalation point for hiring blockers.

Recruiting Execution & Delivery

• Set the standard for recruiting excellence: sourcing strategy, candidate engagement, assessment rigor, and closing. You are the bar that your team calibrates against.

• Maintain hands-on market expertise by actively recruiting on a select portfolio, ensuring you deeply understand talent availability, compensation dynamics, and competitive positioning for your BL's role families.

• Lead major cross-functional hiring initiatives and surge efforts for your BL — batch days, high-volume campaigns, and ramp-to-milestone sprints — acting as the single-threaded owner for program execution.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

• Provide direct people leadership for recruiters aligned to your Business Line: performance management, coaching, mentorship, career development, and structured feedback through regular 1:1s.

• Manage recruiter allocation, capacity, and performance tracking — acting as the single source of truth for the Divisional Head of TA on team health and delivery confidence.

• Foster a high-performance culture that emphasizes skill development, collaboration, data discipline, and delivering a world-class candidate and hiring manager experience.

• Provide structured, high-quality feedback into recruiter performance reviews, ensuring business impact and hiring outcomes are recognized alongside activity metrics.

Functional Excellence & Process Rigor

• Drive consistency in role intakes, interview processes, compensation calibration, and candidate experience across your BL — ensuring every search runs to a standard, not ad hoc.

• Champion cross-BL collaboration and candidate sharing within your Division — optimizing talent placement and ensuring fungible, high-quality pipelines across programs.

• Proactively identify process gaps, hiring bottlenecks, and systemic issues within your BL portfolio — building sustainable solutions rather than one-off fixes.

Partner with Recruiting Operations on tooling, reporting, and automation opportunities specific to your BL's hiring patterns.Include job responsibilities with 6-10 bullet points

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Years of experience commensurate with level and track:

• 10+ years of progressive TA experience, with significant experience owning a business unit's hiring strategy. Fully autonomous. Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence VP-level stakeholders.

• Proven full-cycle recruiting experience in a complex technical environment — you must be credible as a practitioner, not just a strategist.

• Strong business acumen: ability to connect hiring outcomes to program milestones, revenue commitments, and capacity models.

• Excellent analytical skills — experience using data to drive prioritization, tell a story to leadership, and hold a team accountable to outcomes.

• Experience leading hiring initiatives beyond individual searches: surge campaigns, batch hiring, portfolio prioritization, capacity planning.

• Ability to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous environments, managing competing priorities with sound judgment and minimal oversight.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in frontier-tech, defense, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing industries with understanding of clearance requirements, site-based hiring, and program-driven demand.

• Direct experience managing or leading a team of recruiters

• Experience partnering with BizOps, Finance, and HR Business Partners on workforce planning, budget alignment, and headcount governance.

• Formal program or project management background (PMP, Agile, or similar).

• Experience building and scaling recruiting operations for a specific business unit during a period of high growth or organizational change.

• Track record of developing recruiters — evidence of coaching, mentoring, or managing team members to improved performance outcomes.

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Relief) - Encinitas, CA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As a per diem Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area.

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care.

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation and 401k match. Pay range is $20-$49 and based on a leveling system and experience

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer II  - AXS
jobs.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.

The Role

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) II is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable and reliable systems and applications. Focus on automation, monitoring, and incident response to ensure high system availability and performance. This role will collaborate with development teams, and employ infrastructure as code principles. This role combines software development and system administration skills to enhance overall system reliability and efficiency. Contributes to capacity planning, on-call support, and documentation efforts within the organization.

What Will You Do?

• Collaborates with cross-functional teams to launch new features and services.

• Delivers automation solutions for deployment, monitoring, management. and incident response.

• Develops and improves operational practices and procedures.

• Participate in incident response and resolution activities, including root cause analysis, to minimize downtime and prevent future occurrences.

What Will You Bring?

• BA/BS Degree (4-year) relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not mandatory.

• 4-6 years In a site reliability, dev ops, or systems engineering position

• Intermediate knowledge of cloud service operations, including data assurance, monitoring, alerting and notifications.

• Intermediate knowledge of Infrastructure as code

• Intermediate knowledge of containers and orchestration platforms

• Intermediate knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery

What’s in it for You?

• Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!

• Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.

• Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.

More about AXS

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment.

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

More about AEG

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.
