jobs.description:
Job Description:

In order to support the Digital Payload Processors Design Team,  Airbus Defence and Space is offering the following

Master Thesis on Characterization of Sequence Robustness for Secure NTN Communications (d/f/m)

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a signal processing engineer for space systems? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the department Telecom & Navigation Processing as a Master student (d/f/m)!

• Location: Taufkirchen / Ottobrunn, near Munich
• Start: 01.02.2027
• Duration: 6 months

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

• Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 35-hour week (flexitime).
• Mobile working after agreement with the department.
• International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
• Work with modern/diversified technologies.
• At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
• Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities, Scope of Master’s Thesis

6G / 5G is giving the convergence of terrestrial and satellite-based networks a major boost. Under the keyword "Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN)", satellites are being consistently integrated into the mobile communications standard for the first time, subsequently paving the way for a global and dense communication network in the future 6G generation.

Due to the inherent conditions of wireless communication – and particularly with the deployment of open standards and vast coverage areas – the threat posed by jammers and spoofers is ubiquitous. Specifically at the physical layer, the detection and suppression of malicious signals constitute an enormous challenge that must be overcome to ensure the integrity of the network.

The Master’s Thesis position will support the ongoing R&D activities on on-board implementation and scaling of a jamming robust gNodeB.

The successful candidate shall contribute to one or more of the following fields:

• Sequence Analysis: Investigating the mathematical and statistical properties of different sequence designs in the context of NTN-specific channel conditions.
• Attack Modeling: Developing simulation models for various pilot-spoofing and jamming scenarios to evaluate their impact on signal integrity.
• Robustness Characterization: Analyzing how different sequence properties react to malicious interference through various performance metrics.
• Feature Identification: Identifying unique "signal signatures" or features that can be used to distinguish between legitimate and spoofed signals.
• Benchmark Development: Providing a comparative evaluation of sequence-based robustness to support the development of on-board detection algorithms.

Desired skills and qualifications

• Enrolled as a full-time student in Telecommunication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
• Strong foundation in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Communication Theory
• Proficiency in scripting and simulation using MATLAB or Python
• Basic understanding of OFDM waveforms
• Familiarity with communication standards (e.g., 3GPP, 6G/5G, or CCSDS) is a plus
• Excellent written and spoken English for technical documentation and communication; German is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Sr. Business Manager

As a Senior Manager, Business Analysis at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You will lead and team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you'll do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

General Responsibilities:

• Strategic leadership: Develop business strategies that will drive growth, profitability, and competitive success for Capital One in the face of shifting consumer and regulatory behavior
• Business ownership: Have an ownership mindset, and potentially P&L accountability for a business segment. Strategic planning with a 1-6 month horizon
• Leadership: May manage and develop a team of analysts. Coaching and mentoring associates throughout the organization with a goal of developing and retaining talent at Capital One
• Product: Develop and implement new product and pricing strategies for various lending products; lead product level modeling/analytics
• Marketing: Lead direct to consumer marketing efforts for select products, and strategic intent for products distributed through various channels. Build targeted insights to inform the design and development of new customer experiences, as well as breakthrough technology and concepts designed to deliver on new go-to-market strategies
• Credit Risk: Drive step-change improvements in credit performance by connecting drivers of future consumer credit trends to historical behavior, creating risk models, and testing hypotheses using rigorous monitoring and analysis
• Execution: Coordinate across the line of business to manage and sequence delivery of business intent, build business requirements and execute against the product strategy. Oversee multiple projects and programs concurrently
• Partnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One including: IT, Sales, Operations, Finance and others to drive improvement in quality, volume, service, and profitability
• Strategic & analytic orientation: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the business is based on rigorous analytic marketing & credit risk management
• Strong business judgment, leadership and integrity: He/she should be a tenacious decision maker, able to bring a healthy, aggressive, yet responsible approach to business
• Solid people leadership experience: Ability to build and leverage the capabilities of a high-performing team, as well as business partners across the enterprise. He/she should foster innovation, drive critical decisions, hold business partners accountable, and be able to consistently deliver results
• Strong executive communication skills: Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills
• Clear results orientation: display an intense focus on achieving both short and long term goals. He/she should be able to drive and execute an agenda in an uncertain and fluid environment
• Successful track record of thriving in a fast paced, entrepreneurial and dynamic environment. Previous consulting experience is a plus

VP,  Murex Application Development

It Starts With You:

Santander is a global leader and innovator in the financial services industry and is evolving from a high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization. Our people are at the heart of this journey and together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.  This is more than a strategic shift.  It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

If you are interested in exploring the possibilities We Want to Talk to You!

The Difference You Make:

Santander’s Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) business is seeking a Murex Application Developer who will serve as a senior-level technology leader responsible for the design, development, implementation, integration, and ongoing support of Santander CIB's Murex MX.3 platform. The role partners with Global Markets, Risk, Finance, Operations, Architecture, Infrastructure, and Enterprise Technology teams to deliver strategic business initiatives while ensuring platform stability, resiliency, scalability, and regulatory compliance. The incumbent provides advanced technical expertise with minimal management guidance, leads complex technology initiatives, mentors engineering teams, and drives engineering best practices across the Capital Markets technology organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the architecture, design, development, implementation, and support of strategic Murex MX.3 initiatives supporting Santander CIB Global Markets.
• Own delivery of enhancements across Front Office, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Finance, Operations, and Back Office domains.
• Design and configure Murex components including workflows, pricing, simulation, trade lifecycle, market data, static data, datamarts, and reporting.
• Partner with Trading, Risk, Finance, Operations, and Architecture teams to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
• Lead platform upgrades, migrations, production releases, environment strategy, and vendor engagement with Murex Professional Services.
• Drive platform resiliency, performance tuning, production stability, operational excellence, and incident resolution.
• Establish engineering standards, conduct design and code reviews, mentor developers, and foster continuous improvement.
• Support regulatory and strategic initiatives impacting Global Markets, including risk and finance transformation programs.
• Lead multiple concurrent initiatives while managing delivery risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
• Strong Communication skills and ability to interact/support Trade Floor.

What You Bring

To perform this role successfully, the individual must demonstrate deep Capital Markets technology expertise, strong engineering leadership, and a proven track record delivering enterprise Murex solutions.

Education

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, or a related discipline required.
• Master's Degree preferred.
• Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience will be considered.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of Information Technology, Application Development, or Capital Markets Technology experience.
• 3+ years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring, developing, and supporting Murex MX.3.
• Extensive experience across Front Office, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Finance, Operations, Back Office, and/or Datamart modules.
• Strong understanding of OTC Derivatives, FX, Fixed Income, Equities, Securities Financing, and Money Markets.
• Experience with MxML Exchange, market data, static data, workflows, pricing, simulation, and reporting.
• Experience integrating Murex with enterprise platforms using APIs, messaging, and middleware technologies.
• Experience with Agile delivery, SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management.
• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior business and technology stakeholders.
• Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills.
• Experience leading platform modernization, cloud adoption initiatives, and strategic technology transformation is preferred.
• Bi-Lingual/Spanish skills highly desired.

Certifications

• Murex certification or equivalent implementation experience preferred.
• AWS, Azure, Oracle, Java, Scrum, or related certifications are a plus.

It Would Be Nice For You To Have

• Experience supporting global distributed delivery teams.
• Experience with regulatory initiatives such as FRTB, Basel, SA-CCR, or similar Capital Markets programs.
• Knowledge of cloud-native architecture, observability, and platform automation.

jobs.title: Manager, Technology Operations
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Fulfillment Experience builds the capabilities and operating mechanisms that make Walmart a reliable, convenient on-demand partner. Our teams determine what customers can buy, the promise and fulfillment choices they see, how orders are managed and recovered, and how the network performs at scale. We partner across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Merchandising, Store Operations, Fulfillment Centers, Last Mile, Transportation, and Strategy to improve customer outcomes while balancing speed, assortment, cost, and operational feasibility.

Role summary

The (USA) Manager, Technology Operations identifies and solves complex, high-impact fulfillment problems across a defined product, operational, or customer-experience area. This role turns ambiguous customer, operational, and financial signals into a clear diagnosis, an aligned plan, and measurable results. Working across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, and operations partners, the Manager leads initiatives from discovery and analysis through decision, delivery, readiness, and impact measurement. Success requires structured problem solving, clear communication, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence without direct authority.

What you'll do

• Own a complex problem space or initiative that improves customer experience, fulfillment performance, or financial outcomes.

• Use customer, operational, and financial data to identify opportunities, quantify impact, isolate root causes, and define success measures.

• Translate ambiguous problems into clear problem statements, hypotheses, options, and data-driven recommendations.

• Lead cross-functional solution design and execution with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Store Operations, Fulfillment Centers, Last Mile, Transportation, and other partners.

• Build and manage end-to-end plans that make ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points, pilots, launch readiness, and success measures clear.

• Drive alignment and resolve trade-offs without direct authority; escalate issues with a clear recommendation when timely leadership decisions are needed.

• Create concise, executive-ready updates and decision materials that clarify what changed, why it matters, and the action required.

• Measure results after launch, identify gaps or unintended outcomes, and drive refinements, scaling, or corrective action.

• Improve the team's planning, visibility, and execution through better processes, tools, automation, and operating routines.

What you'll bring

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in eCommerce, supply chain, operations, product, strategy, analytics, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.

• Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to turn ambiguous issues into clear questions, synthesize disparate inputs, identify root causes, and recommend a practical path forward.

• Strong analytical fluency and comfort using data to form hypotheses, assess trade-offs, define metrics, and measure impact.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex work understandable and action-oriented for audiences at every level.

• Proven ability to influence without authority, build trust across functions, navigate competing priorities, and drive commitments to closure.

• Disciplined program-management skills, including planning, milestone management, dependency and risk management, and launch or change readiness.

• Sound customer, operational, and financial judgment; able to balance the ideal solution with what is practical to execute at scale.

• A high-ownership mindset, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias for action.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience partnering directly with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver technology-enabled business outcomes.

• Experience in omnichannel retail, eCommerce, fulfillment, supply chain, marketplaces, or a similarly complex operating environment.

• Working knowledge of SQL, BI and visualization tools, Jira, Airtable, or process-automation tools.

Depuis près de 100 ans, Ryder fournit à ses clients du monde entier des solutions intégrées de transport, de logistique et de gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement qui optimisent leurs activités. La constitution et l'entretien d'une flotte nécessitent du temps, des ressources et une expertise que peu d'entreprises peuvent se permettre de mobiliser.

Chez Ryder, nous investissons depuis longtemps dans nos employés et favorisons une culture de collaboration et de travail d'équipe qui encourage l'évolution professionnelle à tous les niveaux et pour tous les postes.

Nous sommes une entreprise figurant au classement Fortune 500, comptant plus de 800 établissements et plus de 40 000 employés aux États-Unis et au Canada. La satisfaction des employés fait partie intégrante de notre culture.

À propos du poste

Lieu : Mirabel, QC
Type d'emploi : Temps plein / Permanent
Salaire : 26,00 $ de l'heure
Horaire : Du lundi au vendredi, 40 heures par semaine
Type de transport : Livraisons locales – Retour à domicile chaque jour

Résumé du poste

Le chauffeur classe 3 est responsable de la conduite sécuritaire et efficace d'un véhicule commercial pour effectuer des livraisons locales. Il assure le transport, le chargement et le déchargement des marchandises, tout en respectant les réglementations applicables et les normes de sécurité de Ryder.

Le poste nécessite une expérience pratique obligatoire avec les hayons élévateurs (Tailgate), les transpalettes (Pump Truck) et les Dolly pour la manutention des marchandises.

Fonctions essentielles

• Conduire un véhicule commercial de façon sécuritaire et efficace dans le cadre des livraisons locales.

• Utiliser les hayons élévateurs (Tailgate), les transpalettes (Pump Truck) et les Dolly de façon sécuritaire.
• Assurer la conformité aux lois, règlements, normes et politiques applicables en matière de transport et de sécurité routière.
• Effectuer les inspections du véhicule avant et après les trajets.
• Détecter, signaler et minimiser les risques liés à la sécurité.
• Maintenir des dossiers, registres de conduite et documents de livraison précis et à jour.

Autres responsabilités

• Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe confiée par la direction.

• Permis de conduire valide de classe 3, avec mention F pour les freins pneumatiques, lorsque requise.

• Bonne connaissance des pratiques de conduite sécuritaire.
• Sens de l'organisation, autonomie et fiabilité.

Summary

The Commercial Driver (DZ/Class 3) position is responsible for safely and efficiently operating a commercial motor vehicle to complete local deliveries. This position requires hands-on experience operating hydraulic liftgates (Tailgates), pallet jacks (Pump Trucks), and Dollies for freight handling and delivery operations.

Are you a legally qualified professional who is excited by the opportunity to combine legal expertise with innovative AI-powered technology?

Do you enjoy working closely with clients, helping them improve legal workflows, drive adoption, and realise measurable value from technology solutions?

About our Team

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles.

About the Role

We are looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Legal Engineers team. This role offers legally qualified professionals the opportunity to work at the intersection of law, technology and AI, helping law firms and in-house legal teams transform how legal work is delivered through AI-enabled workflows and practical legal technology.

As a Legal Engineer, you will act as the bridge between LexisNexis technology and the legal professionals who use it every day. Working alongside Customer Success and Account Management, you will lead workflow discovery sessions, design and implement AI-enabled solutions, and help customers realise measurable improvements in efficiency, quality and adoption. You'll work closely with Partners, General Counsel, Knowledge Management, Innovation, Legal Operations and Technology teams to solve real business challenges.

Responsibilities

• Lead workflow discovery sessions with customers to understand current legal processes, identify pain points and define opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.
• Design, configure and deploy AI-enabled workflows and skills that align with customer processes and business objectives.
• Deliver targeted onboarding, enablement and adoption sessions tailored to different user groups and practice areas.
• Work alongside Customer Success to embed new workflows into day-to-day legal practice and drive sustained adoption.
• Monitor customer usage and identify opportunities to improve adoption, engagement and value realisation.
• Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes, including improvements in efficiency, quality, consistency and risk reduction.
• Act as the voice of the customer by translating workflow requirements, product gaps and customer feedback into actionable insights for Product and Development teams.
• Share best practices and reusable workflow solutions across customers and internal teams.

Requirements

• Qualification as a Solicitor in England & Wales, ideally with 3+ years' PQE gained within a large law firm or major in-house legal team.
• Experience working with complex legal workflows across transactional and/or contentious practice areas.
• Strong consulting, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging senior legal professionals.
• A genuine interest in legal technology, AI and workflow transformation, with curiosity about how technology can improve legal service delivery.
• Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to influence, collaborate and drive change across multiple stakeholders.

Success in this Role

Successful Legal Engineers help customers redesign how legal work is delivered through AI-enabled workflows and legal technology. They build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, drive measurable adoption and usage, deliver practical workflow solutions, and provide valuable customer insight that shapes future product development.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

You will be responsible for the overall coordination and processing of new patient medication orders and reorders, which includes verifying and reverifying benefits. You will also help our patients with translating and entering in new or refill prescriptions into the pharmacy information system, communicating and collecting copay amounts, obtaining authorizations, and working with insurance companies, healthcare providers and/or internal teams to screen, identify, resolve and defer orders that have accounts receivable or clinical issues. Excellent communication skills are needed in order to effectively interact with insurance companies, patients and internal partners to ensure the processing of specialty medications in a timely manner and to ensure that financial and clinical expectations are being met prior to fulfillment. If you like working in a fast-paced environment and demonstrating compassionate, genuine care for patients and customers, this job is for you!

Candidates must be willing to train onsite for a minimum of 4 weeks before being deployed to work from home. Training schedule will be Monday through Friday 9:00am-6:00pm.

Work Schedule available: We are seeking individuals open to working a 40 hour shift/schedule anytime Monday - Friday, between 7:30am-11pm. You will be given a set schedule upon starting.

• Provides courteous and helpful customer service to customers utilizing specialty mail-order pharmacy services by addressing basic customer inquiries, concerns, and issues in a timely and professional manner.
• Assists customers with entering new medication orders or refilling existing prescriptions through the specialty mail-order pharmacy.
• Reviews prescription details, such as medication name, dosage, and quantity, to ensure accuracy and compliance with the healthcare provider's instructions.
• Addresses basic customer inquiries about the status of their specialty medication order while providing estimated delivery times and assisting with tracking information or general shipment inquiries.
• Identifies and escalates complex customer concerns or issues to appropriate teams or supervisors for further assistance and resolution.
• Maintains accurate and organized records of customer interactions, inquiries, and actions taken.
• Develops a basic understanding of the specialty medications, healthcare products, and services offered by the mail-order pharmacy.
• Participates in training programs and ongoing learning initiatives to enhance customer service skills and product knowledge.
• Collaborates with team members, supervisors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth operations and customer satisfaction within the specialty mail-order pharmacy customer service department.
• Assists colleagues and customers with English-to-Spanish translation for basic customer inquiries

Required Qualifications

• Bilingual (English-Spanish).
• 6+ months experience in a customer service role handling and resolving a high volume of complex customer needs over the phone.
• 6+ months work experience with Windows-based applications like Windows, Microsoft Office, internet navigation, and email applications.
• 6+ months computer keyboarding experience, skills and aptitude.

Preferred Qualifications

• Registered Pharmacy Technician
• Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT)
• Certified Customer Service Professional (CCSP) preferred.

Education

• High school diploma or at least 1 year equivalent experience.

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$17.00 - $25.65

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls.  The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.  This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

This is a full-time onsite role based in the location(s) posted and is performed from the designated work location five days per week. No relocation is offered.

AT&T Global Public Sector is a trusted provider of secure, IP enabled, cloud-based, network solutions and professional services to the Federal Government. We are dedicated to recruiting, developing and empowering a diverse, high-performing workforce that is passionate about what they do, committed to our shared values and dedicated to our customers’ mission.

AT&T is seeking a Deputy Chief Engineer, Systems to provide senior technical expertise supporting the architecture, design, integration, and evolution of complex IT, data center, and communications solutions for a large-scale federal program.

In this role, you will work closely with the Chief Engineer and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define and maintain an integrated systems architecture and technical roadmap. You will help ensure solutions spanning compute, virtualization, storage, networking, enterprise platforms, and supporting infrastructure are scalable, secure, resilient, interoperable, and aligned with customer mission and operational requirements.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

·         Define and evolve system architectures and technical roadmaps for complex, mission-critical IT and communications environments.

·         Architect integrated solutions spanning compute, virtualization, storage, networking, data center infrastructure, enterprise platforms, and supporting technologies.

·         Translate customer, operational, and technical requirements into system architectures, engineering requirements, interface definitions, and design solutions.

·         Support the Chief Engineer in establishing technical direction, engineering standards, architectural principles, and system-level design approaches.

·         Provide technical integration across system, network, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and test engineering disciplines.

·         Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives and technical trade studies addressing scalability, performance, capacity, availability, resiliency, security, interoperability, and lifecycle requirements.

·         Guide solutions through high-level design, detailed design, integration, test, implementation, and transition to operations.

·         Identify and resolve system-level dependencies, technical risks, architectural gaps, and complex cross-domain integration challenges.

·         Ensure architectures incorporate appropriate redundancy, fault tolerance, recoverability, monitoring, management, and operational support considerations.

·         Review system designs, architecture documentation, engineering artifacts, interface definitions, and vendor/OEM solutions for technical completeness and architectural alignment.

·         Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to incorporate applicable security requirements and controls into system designs.

·         Partner with test and engineering teams to ensure technical requirements and system designs are measurable, traceable, and verifiable.

·         Provide technical expertise during design reviews, integration activities, implementation, troubleshooting, and resolution of complex engineering issues.

·         Evaluate emerging technologies, capacity requirements, technology obsolescence, and lifecycle considerations to support long-term architecture planning.

Customer Specific Clearance (#clearable)

·         Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related technical field.

·         Demonstrated experience architecting and integrating enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, ScienceLogic, or comparable IT service management, infrastructure monitoring, observability, and operations management solutions within complex IT environments.

·         Strong knowledge of compute, virtualization, storage, networking, enterprise infrastructure, and systems integration.

·         Experience developing and reviewing system architectures, technical designs, engineering requirements, and interface documentation.

·         Knowledge of systems engineering principles, requirements decomposition, architecture development, interface management, integration, and verification.

·         Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical alternatives and make sound engineering recommendations across multiple technology domains.

·         Ability to identify and resolve complex system-level technical and integration issues.

·         Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to engineering teams, program leadership, customers, and other stakeholders.

·         Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related technical field.

·         Experience supporting large-scale federal government, telecommunications, or mission-critical technology programs.

·         Knowledge of resilient architecture, disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability design principles.

·         Experience integrating cybersecurity requirements into enterprise infrastructure and system architectures.

·         Experience supporting formal engineering lifecycle activities, including requirements analysis, design reviews, integration, verification and validation, test, and operational readiness.

·         Experience with capacity planning, infrastructure modernization, technology lifecycle management, and OEM/vendor solution integration.

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Human Resources (HR) Business Partner to provide strategic HR partnership across key Commercial Banking organizations, including the Chief Administrative Office (CAO) and a rapidly evolving Commercial Banking and Corporate & Investment Banking  AI and Data organization.

The HR Business Partner will be a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping organizations at different stages of maturity navigate growth, integration, organizational effectiveness, workforce transformation, talent management, and change, while translating business strategy into human capital solutions. The successful candidate brings strong business acumen, urgency, and a solution-oriented mindset, operates independently, uses data to influence decisions, and builds consensus across complex stakeholder groups.

Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.

You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. jobs.description:

Job Description:

Job Summary:

Reporting to the Head of Finance Transformation North America, the VIE Finance Transformation Analyst- AI & Emerging Tech is a high-impact, forward-looking role designed to lead the integration of Artificial Intelligence within the Finance function.

As the AI lead for the US Finance Transformation team, the incumbent is responsible for enforcing standard Airbus Finance Transformation Strategies while pioneering "Agentic Finance"—the use of AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and machine learning to automate complex workflows. This role transcends traditional reporting, focusing on building the Future of Finance by identifying, developing, and scaling AI use cases that drive operational excellence across North America.

The person will also be responsible for ensuring that the company’s financial systems and processes comply with relevant laws and regulations and plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity and legal compliance of the financial operations.

They will ensure the full lifecycle of projects by following the Airbus project management methodology and will be responsible for delivering the solutions through to entry into service. This role will interact with all the Airbus Functions including Procurement, Digital, Customer Services, Logistic, Production, Human-Resources and with multiple Stakeholders.

Primary Responsibilities:

AI Initiative Leadership & Implementation (40%)

• Deliver on the Finance Transformation roadmap by driving the adoption of existing and new AI solutions.
• Implement AI-based tools & integrate AI further into the Finance Function as a primary point of contact for AI-related use cases.
• Identify and develop AI use cases that deliver measurable value and efficiency to the finance teams.
• Predictive Modeling: Move beyond historical reporting to build ML-driven models for revenue forecasting, cash flow, and variance analysis.
• Team Upskilling & Change Management: Act as the internal "AI Coach" for the finance team. Promote awareness and understanding of AI technologies across the North American finance teams.
• Provide leadership in ensuring consistent use of the Airbus project methodology.
• Be an expert to manage high-risk & complex projects while leveraging cross-functional resources and capabilities.

Process Optimization & Transformation (30%)

• Support the transition from legacy processes to modern solutions.
• Promote the usage of modern interfaces to enhance user experience and data integrity.
• Prompt Engineering: Act as the team’s lead in crafting and refining prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract insights and automate financial narratives.
• Data Integrity: Secure data consistency across ERPs (P11, AP1, PAM, PEA, PE1, PFW & EC2) by leveraging AI for real-time anomaly and fraud detection and establish protocols to secure the month-end close and ensure absolute data integrity.
• Legacy Decommissioning: Spearhead the transition from MS Office-based workflows to AI-integrated platforms treating data as a product rather than a file.
• Develop and execute meticulous project plans, encompassing scope definition, resource allocation, risk assessment, and change management strategies, ensuring on-time and within-budget delivery.
• Create and maintain detailed process documentation, including configuration guides, user manuals, and standard operating procedures, fostering knowledge transfer and ensuring long-term system sustainability.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Change Management  (15%)

• Collaborate closely with the European extended team and local stakeholders across Functions and Divisions to ensure regional alignment with global standards.
• Promote awareness and understanding of AI technologies across the North American finance community.

Compliance & Data Integrity   (10%)

• Segregation of Duties (SoD): Ensure AI automation maintains the integrity of the Airbus SoD matrix and internal control frameworks.
• Standardization: Enforce the "Airbus Way of Working" by ensuring AI tools do not create "shadow processes" but instead reinforce the core Finance Transformation strategy.
• Secure data integrity and consistency for financial reporting through the use of advanced data tools.
• AI Auditing: Regularly audit algorithms for transparency, fairness, and strict regulatory compliance (ICSA/SOX).

Other tasks as requested (5%)

Required

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Accounting, Information Systems or related field of study.

Preferred

A Master's degree is highly preferred.

Experience:

Required

• 2–5 years of experience in Finance or Accounting.

Qualified Skills:

• Financial Closing: Facilitate seamless Year-end and Period-end closing activities, empowering end-users to execute complex tasks and reporting.
• Problem Solving & RCA: Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA), After-Action Reviews (AAR), and Post-Implementation Reviews to address outcomes and drive continuous process improvement.
• User Enablement: Conduct extensive training sessions and author comprehensive user manuals and documentation for business stakeholders.
• Data Synthesis: Apply advanced analytical reasoning to prioritize high-volume data and develop strategic, multi-scenario solutions.

jobs.title: Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Non-Destructive Testing Development for Additively Manufactured Ti-Al parts
jobs.description:
Job Description:

In order to support our Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Non-Destructive Testing Development for Additively Manufactured Ti-Al parts

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a job title? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Engineering department as a Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Non-Destructive Testing Development !

• Location: Donauwörth
• Start: As soon as possible
• Duration: 3-6 months

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Your benefits

• Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 35-hour week (flexitime).
• Mobile working after agreement with the department.
• International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
• Work with modern/diversified technologies.
• Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• Define the optimal measurement stages and witness-specimen concepts within the L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V process chain in an on-site additive manufacturing production.
• Characterize measurement repeatability, geometry influences, and the natural resonance spectrum variation of nominally processed witness specimens across manufacturing stages.
• Quantify the sensitivity of specific resonance modes and spectral features to controlled process- and material-state variations (e.g., microstructural changes, residual stress, defects, post-processing deviations).
• Identify robust multivariate spectral features or frequency combinations and establish preliminary screening and acceptance criteria to reliably distinguish nominal from off-nominal material states.
• Validate the screening concept against reference material state data and define a practical industrial implementation envelope, specifying how PCRT complements existing NDT and quality-assurance routes.
• Desired Final Deliverable: An experimentally validated PCRT quality-screening methodology, utilizing a dedicated witness specimen tracked across key L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V manufacturing stages, that defines clear acceptance criteria and limits for catching abnormal material states before costly downstream processing.

Desired skills and qualifications

• You are an enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) seeking a master thesis in the field of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, materials science, or non-destructive testing (or comparable fields).
• Experience in additive manufacturing or 3D printing is beneficial.
• You demonstrate a strong analytical mindset, solution-oriented thinking, independence, and a willingness to learn.
• You are communicative, proficient in English, and have basic German skills.
• You have the ability to work collaboratively in an international environment, liaising with development, production, industrialization, and quality assurance departments.
• You are resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic and cutting-edge research topic.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

SECURITY CLEARANCE: Must have or be able to obtain UK SC Security Clearance

LOCATION: Stevenage (Required to work on site)

TYPE: Full time

TRAVEL REQUIRED: Frequent travel within the UK and internationally (for test campaigns, training, and team meets)

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

• Financial Reward: Competitive salary, annual profit share, contributory pension, share options, car leasing scheme, free onsite parking, season ticket loan, tax-free technology scheme, discounted shopping and much more
• Work / Life Balance: 37 hour week, flexible working around core hours, hybrid working, up to 2 additional days per month as TOIL, option to buy/sell holiday. There are no core hours on Friday afternoons. Employees may use this flexibility at their discretion, provided they fulfil their contractual working hours and meet business needs (such as urgent deadlines or client requirements)
• Personal Development: Personalised development plan, Airbus Leadership University and unlimited access to 10,000+ E-learning courses, internal mobility including international opportunities
• Health & Wellbeing: Wellbeing benefits (including 24/7 online GP and mental health support), Employee Assistance Programme, discounted family health / dental insurance / eye tests, cycle-to-work scheme
• Family and Caregiving: Life assurance, enhanced pay for maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave and caregiving
• Inclusive Environment: Wellbeing room, Multi-faith room, Employee Representative Groups (Gender, LGBTQ+, International, Generational, Disability, Social & Cultural Diversity, Neurodiversity)

Our world is changing. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight (#ZEROe) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the heart of our purpose. So, what's your next change?

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for an Electrical & Functional Test Engineer to join our Satellite team in Stevenage.

Supporting Earth, Navigation and Science missions and Military Telecomm projects, you will be responsible for the comprehensive electrical and functional testing of the full spacecraft, supporting critical environmental tests and global launch campaigns.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM

• Interpret electrical and functional test requirements directly from technical test specifications.
• Provide robust test solutions, including test sequence coding, procedure preparation, debugging, and execution on the Flight Model spacecraft or test bench.
• Provide vital technical inputs to project test reviews, including Test Readiness Reviews, Post Test Reviews, and Non-Conformance Review Boards (NRBs).
• Develop and debug Automatic Test Procedures (ATP) using bespoke high-level software languages (such as the Open Center checkout system based on Elisa).
• Prepare and execute precise spacecraft system investigations in line with actions from NRBs.
• Support spacecraft systems functional and performance tests during European environmental testing (TVAC, Magnetic, EMC) and launch campaigns.

ABOUT YOU

• Experience of complex electronic systems testing, ideally including spacecraft systems and subsystems (e.g., Data Handling, 1553, SpaceWire, CAN bus, Power systems, FDIR).
• Experience of writing and debugging test sequences, preparing technical test procedures and reports, and supporting project test reviews.
• Experience of programming and scripting languages, particularly writing and debugging Linux/Unix bash scripts (knowledge of C, Java, Python, UDMS, TCL, or VBA is highly beneficial).
• Experience of utilizing varied test equipment for electrical measurements, including DMMs, oscilloscopes, current probes, data acquisition units, and data bus monitors.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customised development solutions.

HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOU

Many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you need and we’ll always do our best to accommodate your request.

Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments for the selection process – you can share this with your Talent Acquisition Partner if you are invited to interview. Examples may include (but not exclusive to) accessible facilities; auxiliary aids; room layout, etc. Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence.

As a Disability Confident Employer, Airbus UK will offer an interview to any applicant that considers themselves to have a disability or long-term condition and meets the minimum criteria of the role (as set out in the job advert). To ‘opt in’, just select the option during your application submission and our Talent Acquisition team will contact you.

jobs.title: Logistic Service Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a Logistics Operations & Contract Manager has arisen within Airbus Operations, El puerto Sta Maria (Cádiz).

The selected candidate will join the Logistics & Supply Chain Operations Team, a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment working in close contact with internal stakeholders, Finance, Procurement, Quality, and external Logistics Providers. The jobholder will reinforce our physical logistics and contract governance operations, ensuring end-to-end supply chain performance, budget control, and strict regulatory compliance across the site.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The jobholder will be responsible for:

• Manage physical logistics operations and continuous improvement: Monitor and control key performance indicators (performance, cost, quality, and environment), ensure adherence to Airbus logistics solutions and policies, drive rapid issue escalation, and lead short-term improvement initiatives alongside end-to-end logistics and surface/infrastructure optimization.
• Secure logistics resources and adapt to planning changes: Guarantee the availability of standard distribution means in the required quality and quantity, while assessing the logistics impact of short- and medium-term production or planning adjustments.
• Oversee Logistics Provider (LP) contract compliance and budgets: Ensure accurate contract execution and cost savings, manage operational scope change requests, work specifications, ad-hoc services, and claims, conduct technical negotiations (unit prices, volumes, and forecasts), and monitor the logistics budget in coordination with Finance and Procurement.
• Align operations with internal stakeholders: Implement and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal customers, anticipating and challenging their evolving requests to ensure seamless implementation of changes.
• Drive proactive risk management: Identify operational and supplier risks alongside internal stakeholders and Logistics Providers, performing root cause analyses and executing effective mitigation plans.
• Ensure regulatory, quality, and safety compliance: Maintain accountability for Airworthiness Authorities, Quality, Environment, Health & Safety (EHS), and Dangerous Goods compliance in logistics execution, while planning and running audits with Quality to close findings and advance industrial maturity.

SKILLS

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

• Education: Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration degree, or a related discipline.
• Experience: Proven experience in physical logistics management, supply chain operations, and third-party logistics (3PL) contract or subcontractor governance.
• Soft skills: Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, structured problem-solving mindset, and high adaptability to work across multidisciplinary teams in a networking mode.
• Languages: Advanced level in English (fluent Spanish will be valued).
• Technical knowledge: KPI and budget control, SLA management, Lean/continuous improvement methodologies, ERP/WMS logistics tools, and working knowledge of EHS and Dangerous Goods regulations.
• Valuable / Nice to have: Experience in the aerospace or automotive sector, familiarity with Airworthiness Authorities and Quality audits, or a Master’s degree in Supply Chain/Logistics will be valued.

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

• Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
• Attractive salary.
• Hybrid model of working when possible.
• Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.
• Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
• On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
• Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
• Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment.
• Option to access special rates in products & benefits.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

jobs.title: Transportation Associate
jobs.description:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS!  ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.
Basic qualifications

jobs.description:
We are seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced electromechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction. Amazon is seeking a talented and motivated Senior Mechanical Engineer to drive the design, development, and launch of novel robotics hardware. The ideal candidate will have experience in mechanism architecture, electromechanical integration, and vendor coordination, and must have the ability to work well both independently and in a multidisciplinary team setting.

We're hiring a Senior Quality Engineer focused in Robotics Manufacturing. Our products contain hundreds of precision parts and many torque-critical assemblies, and one weak process puts the whole product at risk. You own product quality for your production lines, from incoming parts to final test. You decide what is checked, how it is measured, and what happens when something fails. Your measure of success: yield goes up every quarter, no defect escapes twice, and every problem closes with a verified fix.

Key job responsibilities
- Define critical-to-quality characteristics, control plans and inspection standards for each station, and keep them current as the design changes.
- Set up and run incoming, in-process and final inspection with sampling plans, and chair the material review board for non-conforming material.
- Lead root-cause problem solving on build issues, test failures, supplier defects and field escapes, using eight-discipline problem solving, five-why, fishbone and design of experiments, through to verified corrective action.
- Keep processes stable and capable with statistical process control and capability studies.
- Run the metrology lab: coordinate measuring machine programming, vision and optical measurement, torque and force verification, and gauge calibration. Validate every gauge and test station with measurement system analysis before its data is trusted.
- Drive process failure mode and effects analysis and error-proofing with Manufacturing Engineering.
- Own supplier quality for production parts: run production part approval and first-article inspection, and drive supplier corrective action requests through to closure.
- Review engineering changes, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and tolerance stack-ups, and give design-for-inspection feedback early.
- Report first pass yield, defective parts per million, escape rate, scrap and cost of poor quality to leadership each week, with the actions behind the numbers.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience in making data driven business decisions
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, industrial or materials engineering, or equivalent experience.
- Five or more years in quality engineering for electromechanical or precision hardware, with hands-on ownership of a production line.
- Fluency in advanced product quality planning, failure mode and effects analysis, control plans, statistical process control, measurement system analysis, first article inspection and eight-discipline problem solving.
- Hands-on metrology: coordinate measuring machine, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, gauge calibration and repeatability studies.

Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience with actuators, gearboxes, motors or motion systems
- Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma Black Belt or Shainin certification
- Working knowledge of ISO 9001, IATF 16949 or AS9100.

jobs.title: Failure Analysis Engineer, SPICE Lab (Seattle)
jobs.description:
SPICE lab (a Seattle-based branch of Amazon's Lab126 subsidiary) is a research and development group partnering with Amazon's most ambitious hardware organizations. SPICE lab supports Amazon's growing portfolio of hardware programs including Prime Air, Leo, Mechatronics, AWS, Annapurna, Lab126 Devices and others. If you are passionate about building the future and want to take part in developing ideas from concept to production, consider joining the SPICE lab team!

The Role: The Failure Analysis team leverages science and engineering to improve product reliability and safety, accelerate innovation, and make a direct impact on design through high-quality analysis and expert interpretation of data. This position will support the Annapurna Labs organization by investigating failure mechanisms in enterprise compute and networking assemblies, including thermal solutions. You will develop and execute world-class failure analysis outcomes utilizing electrical fault isolation techniques, physical analysis, spectroscopy, and chemical characterization. A majority of time will be spent in a lab environment, so demonstrated enthusiasm for hands-on work developing and executing lab procedures is key. You will act as the formal liaison between SPICE lab and the Annapurna Labs' cross-functional teams, coordinating failure analysis campaigns, triaging devices from reliability qualifications, and providing guidance on manufacturing and design best practices to drive reliability improvements at scale.

Key job responsibilities
• Conduct failure analysis utilizing electrical fault isolation techniques, physical analysis, spectroscopy, and chemical characterization.
• Consultation on corrective actions, method development, design/manufacturing best practices cross-functionally to drive measurable improvements to hardware reliability.
• Interface with Senior and Principal engineering staff to identify and execute lab method development spanning enterprise compute assemblies, including power distribution, compute, networking, and thermal management components.

A day in the life
You will split time between your desk in our office area and the lab facility down the hallway. You'll have a queue of failure analysis investigations at various stages, tracked using our Issue Management application and provide Annapurna Labs stakeholders periodic updates on progress. Your projects will culminate in failure analysis reports which you'll use to build consensus around corrective actions for the business to take. You will also undertake special projects to innovate on behalf of customers and expand the Product Integrity team's knowledge base, developing new methodologies to drive materials selection, design, and operational improvements.

About the team
SPICE lab supports three main functions: Reliability Testing, Failure Analysis, and Materials Characterization. We frequently work together because conducting thorough root cause analysis is valuable for understanding and remedying any issues uncovered as part of a program's reliability testing plan. Likewise, the reliability testing team can help to reproduce failure mechanisms, helping to validate Failure Analysis team's hypotheses. Many of the same techniques are valuable in measuring materials properties or other figures of merit in materials selection exercises.

- 4+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- Master’s degree or above in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent
- Adept at electrical characterization techniques for electrical fault isolation (including curve trace, DMM) and materials characterization (SEM/EDS, FTIR, XRF, CT x-ray)
- Experience with enterprise compute thermal solutions. Examples include: 3D vapor chambers, immersion/liquid cooling systems, evaporative cooling infrastructure.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in the design of complex mechanical products and equipment at volume
- Preferred qualifications
- Experience with thermal characterization techniques for NTD or fault isolcation, such as lock-in thermography or OBIRCH
- Experience with developing and executing testing for thermal interface materials and/or heatsink devices.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager, Technical to own how Prime Video keeps those customers. You will set the multi-year product strategy for payment-driven retention across subscriptions, Channels and transactional purchases, worldwide, and you will own the outcome.

This domain is defined by scale and by ambiguity. The mechanisms that keep a customer's payment working span Prime Video, Amazon's payments organizations, card networks, banks, wallet providers, mobile app stores, telecommunications partners and local payment schemes in every market we operate in. The role is inherently cross functional as no single team controls the outcome, and no playbook exists for most of it. You will decide where we invest, build the case for it, and align organizations that do not report to you.

Key job responsibilities
Own the three to five year vision and strategy for payment-driven retention (Involuntary Churn), across established and emerging countries.

Establish the tenets that govern how we make trade-offs, and keep them when they are tested. Decide where we invest. Size opportunities across markets, payment methods and customer segments, and make the judgment calls on sequencing. Distinguish the reversible decisions from the one-way doors, and bring the rigor each deserves.

Shape the architecture, not only the roadmap. Work with principal engineers and applied scientists on how the payment and retention systems are built, where the models sit in the decision path, and which technical choices today would constrain our options in three years.

Lead a measurement standard. Define the output and outcome metrics for this domain, build the leading indicators that predict a customer's payment risk before it shows up in a cancellation, and design the experimentation that proves what works. Expect other teams to adopt what you establish.

Carry the customer's side of the argument. Customers experience this domain as a message, a retry, a hold on their account, or a loss of access.

Partner with design and user research on experiences that recover the customer without eroding their trust, across devices, languages and regulatory regimes.

Influence without authority across organizations. Build and hold alignment with Amazon payments teams, Prime, Legal, Finance, Accounting and external partners, each with their own priorities and their own roadmaps.
Write the documents that move the company. Narratives, PRFAQs, and the operating plan sections for this domain.

- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience technical product management

- 8+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

jobs.description:

If you've ever wondered what it takes to put a satellite into orbit — this is it. The software our team builds is one of the last steps before every satellite leaves the ground. Your code will help validate that a satellite is ready for launch, automate processes that engineers previously ran manually, and give the program real-time visibility into hundreds of satellites as they move through our facility.

We're looking for a software engineer to help build and maintain these tools while providing operational software support during our second-shift hours. You'll work alongside manufacturing engineers and satellite hardware teams in a hands-on, on-site environment at Kennedy Space Center — debugging real issues on the floor one day, shipping a new automation feature the next. Because you'll cover the later part of our operational day, you'll often be the primary software point of contact for engineers processing satellites in the afternoon and evening.

If you're comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy working close to physical systems, want to see your code directly impact satellite launches, and are looking for a second-shift schedule, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain software tools and automated procedures used to test and prepare satellites for launch
- Provide second-shift operational software support to manufacturing and mission engineers processing satellites during afternoon/evening hours

A day in the life
You start in the afternoon by picking up where first shift left off and checking in with the engineers on the floor. One day you're writing a new automated validation check; the next, you're debugging an issue during live satellite processing in the evening; the third, you're shipping a pipeline improvement. You develop solutions, test them, get review from hardware experts, and release to production. Because you cover the later hours, your support keeps satellite processing moving when much of the team has finished for the day.

You'll work closely with hardware engineers on-site and software teams across the company. The environment is hands-on: problems are real, timelines are tight, and the impact is visible. jobs.title: Senior Tech Prog Mgr, Data Center Simulations, Data Center Learning
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced technical program manager with a background in program definition, quality assurance, and strategy development? Would you like to help builders learn mission-critical equipment faster and more safely, using software simulations they can run from their own desks?

We're seeking an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to join our Global Learning Labs team, part of the Data Center Learning organization. In this role, you'll lead our new Data Center Simulations program. Our Learning Labs are "flight simulators for data center operations": hands-on training facilities that replicate production environments so builders can practice skills without risking customer impact. Now we're extending that idea into software, with simulations and emulations of data center equipment that will help us train better, faster, and cheaper.

The program starts from momentum that already exists. Builders across our organization are using AI coding tools to create interactive, browser-based simulations of equipment ranging from switchgear to mechanical cooling. Work that once took a dedicated software team months now takes a single builder days. That speed is a remarkable opportunity, but it creates a challenge. A simulation can look and feel right and still be subtly wrong, and the equipment it represents is mission-critical and sometimes life-critical. You will turn this builder-led experimentation into a trusted training capability. That means defining the standard a simulation must meet before it's used for training, assessment, or certification, building the validation program that applies that standard, and helping the most promising work find a long-term home.

This role requires excellent program/project management skills, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, and strong communication skills (including excellent writing skills). The ideal candidate will be a highly organized self-starter with a strong bias for action and the ability to work with cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will also have a healthy technical knowledge of data center operations and of software development and testing. Experience with learning and development programs is a plus. Excellent business acumen and judgment, and bias toward data-driven decision making are also required. Above all, the successful candidate will have a passion for contributing to team and customer success.

Our Learning Labs team is located around the world, but for this role, we're looking for someone to be based in Seattle. This is a fully global program that will serve builders in every region where AWS operates.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers—someone who will help us amplify the positive and inclusive team culture we've been building. And we're looking for someone fun to work with! If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
This role will own overall program planning and execution for Data Center Simulations, coordinating activities across Amazon Infrastructure Services and with external partners worldwide. You'll be responsible for:

- Choosing or adapting a simulation validation framework, drawing on established standards from industries such as defense, aerospace, and nuclear power.
- Defining and publishing the certification criteria a simulation must meet before it can be used for training.
- Sourcing and managing the third-party testing and validation vendors who carry out validation against that standard.

You'll also look after the open, experimental community of builder-created simulations: keeping track of the work, encouraging teams to combine efforts and share resources, and guiding the most promising projects through validation into approved training use. As the program matures, you'll help shape the path from behavioral simulation to emulation, which runs code identical to production, for the highest-stakes training such as gameday drills and shift-ready certifications.
